meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s Who has given me in old age Ismā‘īl (Ishmael) and Isḥāq (Isaac). Verily, my Lord is indeed the All‑Hearer of invocations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Praise be to God Who has given me despite my old age Ishmael — born to him when he Abraham was 99 years old — and Isaac — born to him when he was 112 years old. Lo! my Lord is indeed the Hearer of supplication.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي وَهَبَ لِي عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِسْحَاقَ إِنَّ رَبِّي لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s Who has given me in old age Ismā‘īl (Ishmael) and Isḥāq (Isaac). Verily, my Lord is indeed the All‑Hearer of invocations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (My Lord!) O my lord! (Make me to establish proper worship) make me perform the prayer properly, (and some of my posterity (also)) he says: bless me and bless my offspring so that we perform the prayer properly; (our Lord!) O our Lord! (and accept the prayer) accept my worship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلاَةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: “O my Lord! Make me one who performs Aṣ‑Ṣalāt (Iqāmat‑aṣ‑Ṣalāt), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: My Lord make me an establisher of prayer and make of my seed those who will establish it the use of partitive min in min dhurriyatī ‘of my seed’ is because God informed him that some of them his seed would be disbelievers. Our Lord! And accept my supplication the supplication mentioned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ ٱلصَّلاَةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَتِي رَبَّنَا وَتَقَبَّلْ دُعَآءِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: “O my Lord! Make me one who performs Aṣ‑Ṣalāt (Iqāmat‑aṣ‑Ṣalāt), and (also) from my offspring, our Lord! And accept my invocation.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Forgive me) my sins (and my parents) and forgive my believing forefathers (and believers) and forgive all believing men and women (on the day when the account is cast) when there is reckoning and both the good and evil deeds are displayed, such as those whose good deeds outweigh their evil deeds will enter Paradise and those whose evil works outweigh their good deeds will enter hell; while those whose good works equal their evil works will be among the people of the Heights.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. “Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and (all) the believers on the Day when the reckoning will be established.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Our Lord forgive me and my parents — this was before their enmity towards God Mighty and Majestic became clear; but it is also said that his mother submitted to God the alternative reading here being the singular wālidī ‘my father’; or yet another variant reading being waladī ‘my son’ and forgive believers on the day when the reckoning shall come to pass’ the day it shall be effected. God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. “Our Lord! Forgive me and my parents, and (all) the believers on the Day when the reckoning will be established.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Deem not that Allah is unaware of what the wicked do) do not think that Allah will not punish the idolaters for what they do. (He but gives them a respite till a day when eyes will stare (in terror)) the eyes of the disbelievers will stare in terror on the Day of Judgement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَافِلاً عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلأَبْصَارُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Consider not that Allāh is unaware of that which the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers) do, but He gives them respite up to a Day when the eyes will stare in horror..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And do not suppose that God is heedless of what the evildoers the disbelievers from among the people of Mecca do. He but gives them respite without chastisement until a day when eyes shall stare wide-open because of the terror of what they see one says shakhasa basaru fulān to mean ‘he opened them his eyes and did not shut them’;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَافِلاً عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ ٱلظَّالِمُونَ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ ٱلأَبْصَارُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Consider not that Allāh is unaware of that which the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers) do, but He gives them respite up to a Day when the eyes will stare in horror..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (As they come hurrying on in fear) looking to the caller, (their heads upraised) stretching their necks; it is also said that this means: lowering down their heads, (their gaze returning not to them) out of fear and terror, (and their hearts as air) empty from all goodness; it is also said: neither coming out nor going back in.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ لاَ يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. (They will be) hastening forward with necks outstretched, their heads raised up (towards the sky), their gaze returning not towards them and their hearts empty (from thinking because of extreme fear)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as they come hastening muhti‘īna is a circumstantial qualifier with their heads turned upwards to the heaven their gaze their sight returning not to them and their hearts as air devoid of any sense because of their being terror-stricken.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ لاَ يَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. (They will be) hastening forward with necks outstretched, their heads raised up (towards the sky), their gaze returning not towards them and their hearts empty (from thinking because of extreme fear)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And warn mankind) warn the people of Mecca by means of the Qur'an (of a day) the Day of Badr; it is also said that this is a reference to the Day of Judgement (when the doom will come upon them, and those who did wrong) the idolaters (will say: Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Reprieve us for a little while) in the life of this world. (We will obey Your call) to monotheism (and will follow the messengers) we will obey the messengers. Allah will then say to them: (Did ye not swear before) before this, when you were in the life of the lower world (that there would be no end for you) in the life of the world and that there is no resurrection?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوۤاْ أَقْسَمْتُمْ مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُمْ مِّن زَوَالٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. And warn (O Muḥammad ) mankind of the Day when the torment will come to them; then the wrong-doers will say: “Our Lord! Respite us for a little while, we will answer Your Call and follow the Messengers!” (It will be said): “Had you not sworn aforetime that you would not leave (the world for the Hereafter)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And warn make them have fear O Muhammad (s) mankind the disbelievers of the day when chastisement will come upon them namely the Day of Resurrection and those who did evil who disbelieved will say ‘Our Lord give us respite by returning us to the world for a brief while that we might respond to Your call by affirming Your Oneness and follow the messengers’. It is then said to them in rebuke ‘But did you not use to swear formerly in the world that for you there would be no passing away? min zawālin min is extra from this world to the Hereafter?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنذِرِ ٱلنَّاسَ يَوْمَ يَأْتِيهِمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ فَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ رَبَّنَآ أَخِّرْنَآ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ قَرِيبٍ نُّجِبْ دَعْوَتَكَ وَنَتَّبِعِ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَوَلَمْ تَكُونُوۤاْ أَقْسَمْتُمْ مِّن قَبْلُ مَا لَكُمْ مِّن زَوَالٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. And warn (O Muḥammad ) mankind of the Day when the torment will come to them; then the wrong-doers will say: “Our Lord! Respite us for a little while, we will answer Your Call and follow the Messengers!” (It will be said): “Had you not sworn aforetime that you would not leave (the world for the Hereafter)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (have ye not) dwelt in the dwellings of those who wronged themselves (of old)) through idolatry and denial without take heed from their destruction (and (hath it not) become plain to you how We dealt with them) in this worldly life, (and made) struck (examples for you) in the Qur'an of all sorts: of promises, of threats, of mercy and of chastisement?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِي مَسَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلأَمْثَالَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. “And you dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged themselves, and it was clear to you how We had dealt with them. And We put forth (many) parables for you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And you dwelt in it in the dwelling-places of those who wronged themselves through unbelief those from among communities of old and it became clear to you how We dealt with them by way of punishment — but you were not restrained thereby — and We struck made clear similitudes for you in the Qur’ān but you did not take heed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَسَكَنتُمْ فِي مَسَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَتَبَيَّنَ لَكُمْ كَيْفَ فَعَلْنَا بِهِمْ وَضَرَبْنَا لَكُمُ ٱلأَمْثَالَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. “And you dwelt in the dwellings of men who wronged themselves, and it was clear to you how We had dealt with them. And We put forth (many) parables for you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Verily they have plotted their plot) they did their deed through their denial of the messengers, (and their plot is with Allah) the punishment of their deed is with Allah, (though their plot were one whereby the mountains should be moved) whereby the mountains should crumble; it is also said that this means: the plotting of Nimrod was such that the mountains would have crumbled, for the sounds of the Ark and eagles were heard.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرُواْ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. Indeed, they plotted their plot, and their plot was with Allāh, though their plot was not such as to remove the mountains (real mountains or the Islāmic law) from their places (as it is of no importance) [Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr](1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily they plotted against the Prophet s their plot — when they desired to kill him or detain him in his house or banish him — but their plotting is with God that is to say knowledge or the requital thereof is with God and their plotting even though it be great was not such whereby mountains should be moved meaning that it is not of any importance but that they are only harming themselves thereby. It is said that the use of ‘mountains’ here is meant to be literal; alternatively it is also said to be a reference to the laws of Islam which are likened to these mountains in the way that they are established and fixed a variant reading has la-tazūlu instead of li-tazūla with in softened from inna ‘verily’ in which case the intended meaning is that the extent of their plotting is great. It is said that ‘plotting’ here is actually a reference to their unbelief. This second reading is consonant with God’s saying Whereby the heavens are almost torn and the earth split asunder and the mountains fall crashing Q. 1990; according to the former reading however one should read it as if it were wa-mā kāna and their plotting was not such ….

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ مَكَرُواْ مَكْرَهُمْ وَعِندَ ٱللَّهِ مَكْرُهُمْ وَإِن كَانَ مَكْرُهُمْ لِتَزُولَ مِنْهُ ٱلْجِبَالُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. Indeed, they plotted their plot, and their plot was with Allāh, though their plot was not such as to remove the mountains (real mountains or the Islāmic law) from their places (as it is of no importance) [Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr](1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So think not that Allah will fail to keep His promise to His messengers) that He will help and destroy their enemies. (Lo! Allah is Mighty) in His dominion and sovereignty, (Able to Requite) Able to act in retribution against His enemies in this worldly life and in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنْتِقَامٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. So, think not that Allāh will fail to keep His Promise to His Messengers. Certainly, Allāh is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So do not suppose that God will fail to keep His promise of victory to His messengers. Truly God is Mighty Victor nothing able to escape Him Lord of Retribution against those who disobey Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ تَحْسَبَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِفَ وَعْدِهِ رُسُلَهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنْتِقَامٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. So, think not that Allāh will fail to keep His Promise to His Messengers. Certainly, Allāh is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth) it will be changed to a state other than the actual state. Its changing will take place by adding to and subtracting from it, and its valleys and mountains will be levelled down; and it is also said that this means: the earth will be changed to other than what it is now, (and the heavens (also will be changed)) they will be folded up in His right Hand (and they will come forth unto Allah) they emerge and become manifest to (the One, the Almighty) Who conquers His created being by means of death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens, and they (all creatures) will appear before Allāh, the One, the Irresistible..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And mention the day when the earth will be changed to other than the earth and the heavens namely the Day of Resurrection mankind shall be gathered onto a white clear earth as reported in the hadīth of the two Shaykhs al-Bukhārī and Muslim. Muslim relates the following hadīth ‘The Prophet s was asked “Where will people be on that day?” He said “On the Bridge sirāt” ’; and they shall come forth they shall exit from their graves to God the One the Almighty.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تُبَدَّلُ ٱلأَرْضُ غَيْرَ ٱلأَرْضِ وَٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَبَرَزُواْ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَاحِدِ الْقَهَّارِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens, and they (all creatures) will appear before Allāh, the One, the Irresistible..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou wilt see the guilty) the idolaters (on that day) the Day of Judgement (linked together in chains) with the satans.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلأَصْفَادِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And you will see the Mujrimūn (criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism, polytheists) that Day Muqarranūn (1) (bound together) in fetters..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And you shall see O Muhammad (s) the sinners the disbelievers on that day coupled chained together with their individual devils in chains manacles or collars

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَى ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّقَرَّنِينَ فِي ٱلأَصْفَادِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And you will see the Mujrimūn (criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism, polytheists) that Day Muqarranūn (1) (bound together) in fetters..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Their raiment of pitch) of black fire, like tar; it is also said that this means: their raiment are made of very hot, trickling tar, (and the Fire covering their faces).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. Their garments will be of pitch, and fire will cover their faces..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: their shirts made of pitch because it ignites fire more intensely and their faces are engulfed by the Fire

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَرَابِيلُهُم مِّن قَطِرَانٍ وَتَغْشَىٰ وُجُوهَهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. Their garments will be of pitch, and fire will cover their faces..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: They emerge and become manifest to Allah so (That Allah may repay each soul) whether it is a believing or a sinful soul (what it hath earned) of good or evil. (Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning) Allah is severe in His chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. That Allāh may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allāh is Swift at reckoning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: that God may requite li-yajziya is semantically connected to the verb barazū ‘they shall come forth’ every soul for what it has earned of good and evil. Truly God is swift at reckoning — He shall reckon with all creatures in about half a day of the days of this world as one hadīth states to that effect.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَجْزِىَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. That Allāh may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allāh is Swift at reckoning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This is a clear message for mankind) convey it them on behalf of Allah; it is also said: this is an exposition for them detailing commands and prohibitions, promises and threats, the lawful and the prohibited (in order that they may be warned thereby) that they may be warned by means of the Qur'an, (and that they may know) and acknowledge (that He is only One God) without a son or partner, (and that men of understanding) people endowed with intelligence (may take heed) through the Qur'an'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا بَلاَغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوۤاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلأَلْبَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. This (Qur’ān) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One Ilāh (God — Allāh) — (none has the right to be worshipped but Allāh) — and that men of understanding may take heed. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: This Qur’ān is a Proclamation for mankind in other words it was revealed in order to proclaim to them and so that they may be warned thereby and that they may know by way of the arguments contained in it that He namely God is One God and that people of pith possessors of intellect may remember yadhdhakkara the original tā’ of yatadhakkara has been assimilated with the dhāl that they may be admonished.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا بَلاَغٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِ وَلِيَعْلَمُوۤاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَـٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلأَلْبَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. This (Qur’ān) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One Ilāh (God — Allāh) — (none has the right to be worshipped but Allāh) — and that men of understanding may take heed. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his chain of transmitters on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said in explanation of Allah's saying (Alif. Lam. Ra.): '(Alif. Lam. Ra.) He says: I am Allah, and I see; it is also said that this is an oath, Allah swore by the Alif and by the Lam and by the Ra. (These are verses of the Scripture) this surah consists of verses from the Scripture (and a plain Reading) He says: I swear by the Qur'an which makes plain the lawful and the prohibited, the commands and prohibitions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: الۤرَ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْكِتَابِ وَقُرْآنٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Alif-Lām-Rā. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān, and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ān..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Alif lām rā’ God knows best what He means by these letters. Those — these verses — are the verses of the Book the Qur’ān āyātu’l-kitābi this annexation functions in the sense of min ‘from’ and of a manifest Qur’ān one that makes evident what is truth and what is falsehood wa-qur’ānin mubīnin is made up of a supplement with an added adjectival qualification.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: الۤرَ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْكِتَابِ وَقُرْآنٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Alif-Lām-Rā. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān, and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Book and a plain Qur’ān..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It may be that those who disbelieve) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an (wish ardently that they were Muslims) in this worldly life. He says: there may come a day when the disbeliever would wish that he was a Muslim. This is because when Allah takes out of hell whoever was a sincere believer and enters them into Paradise, the disbeliever wishes at that moment he had been a Muslim in this worldly life.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْ كَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allāh’s Will in Islām i.e. Islāmic Monotheism — this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise] (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It may be that read rubbamā or rubamā those who disbelieve on the Day of Resurrection when they witness their predicament and that of the Muslims will wish that they had been muslims rubba here is used to indicate ‘many’ since many of them will wish this; but it is also said to indicate ‘few’ since they will be so stupefied by the terrors that they will not come out of their stupor to wish such a thing except on a few occasions

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوْ كَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. How much would those who disbelieved wish that they had been Muslims [those who have submitted themselves to Allāh’s Will in Islām i.e. Islāmic Monotheism — this will be on the Day of Resurrection when they will see the disbelievers going to Hell and the Muslims going to Paradise] (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Let them) O Muhammad (eat) without having any proof or resolve for that which lies ahead (and enjoy life) and live a life of disbelief and illicitness, (and let (false) hope beguile them) and let long hope preoccupy them from obeying Allah. (They will come to know!) they will come to know upon death and in the grave and on the Day of Judgement what will be done to them. This is a threat to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Leave them the disbelievers O Muhammad (s) to eat and to enjoy this world of theirs and that they be diverted distracted by hope of a long life and other such matters that keep them away from faith for they will come to know the sequel of their affair — this was revealed before the command to fight them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُواْ وَيَتَمَتَّعُواْ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلأَمَلُ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Leave them to eat and enjoy, and let them be preoccupied with (false) hope. They will come to know!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We destroyed no township) We destroyed no people of a township (but there was a known decree for it) except that there is an appointed term for their destruction.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We did not destroy any town min qaryatin min is extra meaning its inhabitants but that it had a known decree a pre-determined term after which it would be destroyed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And never did We destroy a township but there was a known decree for it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (No nation can outstrip its term) He says: no nation perishes or is destroyed before the appointed time for its perishing or destruction (nor can they lag behind) no nation is given respite when its appointed time comes.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. No nation can advance its term, nor delay it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No community min ummatin min is extra can outstrip its predetermined term nor can they seek to delay it nor can they put it off.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. No nation can advance its term, nor delay it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they) this refers to 'Abdullah Ibn Umayyah al-Makhzumi and his host who (say) to Muhammad (pbuh): (O thou unto whom the Reminder is revealed) O you who claim that Gabriel brought you the Qur'an, (lo! thou art indeed a madman!) who is inventing lies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And they say: “O you (Muḥammad ) to whom the Dhikr (The Qur’ān) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they that is the disbelievers of Mecca say to the Prophet s ‘O you to whom the Remembrance the Qur’ān — as you claim — has been revealed lo! you are indeed possessed!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِي نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And they say: “O you (Muḥammad ) to whom the Dhikr (The Qur’ān) has been sent down! Verily, you are a mad man! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Why bringest thou not angels unto Us) from heaven so that they bear witness that you are Allah's Messenger, (if thou art of the truthful?) in what you say.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلائِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Why do you not bring us the angels if you are of the truthful?’ in saying that you are a prophet and that this Qur’ān is from God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلائِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “Why do you not bring angels to us if you are of the truthful?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah said: (We send not down the angels) from heaven (save with the Fact) with destruction or for taking their souls away, (and that case (the disbelievers) would not be tolerated) they would not be given any respite when the angels come down to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱلحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُواْ إِذاً مُّنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says The angels do not descend tanazzalu one of the two tā’ letters of tatanazzalu has been omitted save with the truth with the chastisement; and then that is upon the descent of the angels with the chastisement they the disbelievers would not be reprieved would not be granted respite.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةَ إِلاَّ بِٱلحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُواْ إِذاً مُّنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. We send not the angels down except with the truth (i.e. for torment), and in that case, they (the disbelievers) would have no respite!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We, even We, reveal the Reminder) We sent Gabriel with the Qur'an, (and lo! We verily are its) the Qur'an's (Guardian) from satans such that they do not add or diminish from it anything nor change its judgements; it is also said that this means: We are Guardian of Muhammad (pbuh) from the disbelievers and satans.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur’ān) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily it is We nahnu emphasises the subject of inna or functions as a separating pronoun Who have revealed the Remembrance the Qur’ān and assuredly We will preserve it against substitution distortion additions and omissions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُ لَحَافِظُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Verily, We, it is We Who have sent down the Dhikr (i.e. the Qur’ān) and surely, We will guard it (from corruption) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We verily sent (messengers) before thee) O Muhammad, (among the factions of the men of old) among the groups of old.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Indeed, We sent (Messen gers) before you (O Muḥammad ) amongst the sects (communities) of old..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We sent before you messengers to former factions sects.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِي شِيَعِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Indeed, We sent (Messen gers) before you (O Muḥammad ) amongst the sects (communities) of old..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And never came there unto them a messenger) who was sent to them (but they did mock him) but they did deride the messenger.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And never did a messenger come to them but that they mocked him in the same way that your people have mocked you — this is meant to comfort the Prophet s.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock at him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus do We make it) We leave denial (traverse the hearts of the guilty) the hearts of the idolaters:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter the hearts of the Mujrimūn [criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Thus We cause it to find its way in other words in the same way that We have caused denial to enter the hearts of those individuals We cause it to enter into the hearts of the sinners that is the disbelievers of Mecca.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Thus do We let it (polytheism and disbelief) enter the hearts of the Mujrimūn [criminals, polytheists and pagans (because of their mocking at the Messengers)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They believe not therein) such that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an, or that chastisement will descend upon them, (though the example of the men of old have gone before) when they denied the messengers, just as your people have denied you, and Allah's norm concerning them was to punish and destroy them because of their denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. They would not believe in it (the Qur’ān); and already the example of (Allāh’s punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They do not believe in him in the Prophet s even though the example of the men of old has already gone before that is the way of God in dealing with them those of old by chastising them for denying the truthfulness of their prophets those Meccans are like these former.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. They would not believe in it (the Qur’ān); and already the example of (Allāh’s punishment of) the ancients (who disbelieved) has gone forth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And even if We opened unto them) unto the people of Mecca (a Gate of Heaven) from which to enter (and they kept mounting through it) and they kept ascending and descending through it, i.e. like the angels.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَاباً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto (all the day long) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And even if We were to open for them a gate from the heaven and they were to continue ascending through it the gate

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَاباً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ فَظَلُّواْ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And even if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they were to keep on ascending thereto (all the day long) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They) the disbeliever of Mecca (would say: Our sight is wrong) our sight is gone (nay, but we are folk bewitched) our minds have been seized; we have been bewitched.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَالُواْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. They would surely say (in the evening): “Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: they would say ‘It is merely that our eyes have been dazzled they have been shut. Nay we are a folk bewitched!’ imagining this.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَالُواْ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَارُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. They would surely say (in the evening): “Our eyes have been (as if) dazzled (we have not seen any angel or heaven). Nay, we are a people bewitched.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And verily in the heaven We have set mansions of the stars) by means of which people are guided in the darkness of the sea or land; it is also said that this means: castles, (and We have beautified it) the sky by means of the stars (for beholders) who look at it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ بُرُوجاً وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We have placed in the heaven constellations twelve of them Aries Taurus Gemini Cancer Leo Virgo al-sunbula Libra Scorpio Sagittarius Capricorn Aquarius and Pisces which are the mansions of the seven orbiting planets Mars rules Aries and Scorpio Venus Taurus and Libra Mercury Gemini and Virgo the Moon Cancer the Sun Leo Jupiter Sagittarius and Pisces and Saturn Capricorn and Aquarius; and We have adorned it with these planets for beholders;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِي ٱلسَّمَاءِ بُرُوجاً وَزَيَّنَّاهَا لِلنَّاظِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And indeed, We have put the big stars in the heaven and We beautified it for the beholders (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We have guarded it from every outcast devil) from every accursed devil who is chased away by the stars to prevent them, i.e. the satans, from listening to the angels,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And We have guarded it (the near heaven) from every outcast Shaiṭān (devil)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and We have guarded them with meteors from every outcast devil;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَحَفِظْنَاهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And We have guarded it (the near heaven) from every outcast Shaiṭān (devil)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save him who stealeth the hearing, and them doth a clear flame pursue) they are pursued by a bright, burning star.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Except him (devil) who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except the one who listens by stealth — he is pursued by a clear flame a shining meteor that burns him or pierces him or drives him insane.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Except him (devil) who steals the hearing then he is pursued by a clear flaming fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the earth have We spread out) on water, (and placed therein) on the earth (firm hills) firm mountains as poles, (and caused each seemly thing) of vegetation and fruits in measured and known quantities. It is said this means: from every thing measured such as gold, silver, ore, copper, etc., (to grow therein) on the mountains; and it is said: on the earth.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the earth We have stretched it out spread it flat and cast therein firm mountains lest it should sway beneath its inhabitants and caused to grow therein every kind of balanced thing every kind of thing known and determined.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And the earth We have spread out, and have placed therein firm mountains, and caused to grow therein all kinds of things in due proportion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We have given unto you) We have created for you (livelihoods therein) on the earth: vegetations and fruits and that which you eat, drink and wear, (and unto those for whom ye provide not) and He also provides livelihood for those to whom you do not provide such as birds and wild beasts; it is also said that this refers to children in the wombs of their mothers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We have made for you therein means of livelihood read ma‘āyish such as fruits and grains and We have made this for you those for whom you do not provide such as servants crawling creatures and cattle; it is God Who provides for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَايِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُ بِرَازِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And there is not a thing) of vegetation, fruits or rains (but with Us are the stores thereof) except that We have its keys; its keys are in Our Hand not in yours. (And We send it) i.e. rain (not down save in appointed measure) with a specific quantity and weight known to the One Who stores it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ عِندَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلاَّ بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And there is not a thing but that the stores thereof the keys to its stores are with Us and We do not send it down except in a known measure according to the benefits of all creatures.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن مِّن شَيْءٍ إِلاَّ عِندَنَا خَزَائِنُهُ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُ إِلاَّ بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And there is not a thing, but with Us are the stores thereof. And We send it not down except in a known measure..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We send the winds fertilising) trees and clouds, (and cause water) rain (to descend from the sky, and give it you to drink) on the earth. (It is not ye who are the holders of the store) of its keys (thereof) i.e. of the rain.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then cause the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We send the winds as fertilisers to fertilise the clouds whereupon they fill up with water and send down out of the heaven out of the clouds water rain so that We give it to you to drink for you are not the storers thereof that is the stores thereof are not in your control.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَاحَ لَوَاقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَاءً فَأَسْقَيْنَاكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنْتُمْ لَهُ بِخَازِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And We send the winds fertilizing (to fill heavily the clouds with water), then cause the water (rain) to descend from the sky, and We give it to you to drink, and it is not you who are the owners of its stores [i.e. to give water to whom you like or to withhold it from whom you like]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! and it is We, even We, Who quicken) We resurrect (and give death) in this worldly life, (and We are the Inheritor) We are the Owners of what is in the heavens and in the earth after the death of its inhabitant and also before their death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَارِثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritor..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed it is We Who give life and bring death and We are the heirs Who shall endure inheriting all creation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَارِثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And certainly We! We it is Who give life, and cause death, and We are the Inheritor..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And verily We know the eager among you) i.e. those who have died of your fathers and mothers; it is also said that this means: those who come forward to the first line (and verily We know the laggards) those who are still alive among their sons and daughter; it is also said that this means: those who withdraw to the last line.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We know the predecessors among you that is those creatures from Adam who have already passed and verily We know the successors those who will come afterwards until the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَأْخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And indeed, We know the first generations of you who had passed away, and indeed, We know the present generations of you (mankind), and also those who will come afterwards..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! your Lord will gather them together) the former and the latter. (Lo! He is Wise) He decreed that they will be mustered, (Aware) of their mustering, reward and punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it is indeed your Lord Who will gather them lo! He is Wise in His actions Knower of His creatures.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ إِنَّهُ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And verily, your Lord will gather them together. Truly, He is All-Wise, All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Verily We created man) Adam (of potter's clay) of dry clay (of black mud altered) clay that stinks; it is also said that this means: shaped clay.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We created man Adam out of a dry clinking clay that gives off a clinking sound when it is tapped of malleable mud black mud.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And indeed, We created man from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the jinn) the first father of the jinn (did We create aforetime) before the creation of Adam (pbuh) (of essential fire) of smokeless fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the jānn the father of the jinn namely Iblīs We created beforehand — that is before the creation of Adam — out of the permeative fire a smokeless fire that can escape through openings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَاهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And the jinn, We created aforetime from the smokeless flame of fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (remember) when thy Lord said unto the angels) who were on the earth, there were 10,000 of them: (Lo! I am creating a mortal out of potter's clay of black mud altered) of stinking mud.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلآئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَراً مِّن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: “I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And mention when your Lord said to the angels ‘Indeed I am going to create a mortal out of a dry clay drawn from a malleable mud.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلآئِكَةِ إِنِّي خَالِقٌ بَشَراً مِّن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And (remember) when your Lord said to the angels: “I am going to create a man (Adam) from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So, when I have made him) so when I created his hands, legs, eyes and the rest of him (and have breathed into him of My Spirit) and placed the spirit into him, (do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him) as a greeting.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. “So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves to him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So when I have proportioned him completed him and breathed caused to flow of My Spirit in him so that he becomes a living thing — the annexation of ‘the Spirit’ to him is a conferring of honour upon Adam — fall down in prostration before him!’ a prostration meant as an act of salutation by bowing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُ سَاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. “So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves to him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So the angels fell prostrate) to Adam (pbuh) (all of them together)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And so the angels prostrated all of them together kulluhum ajma‘ūn contains two elements of emphasis

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. So the angels prostrated themselves, all of them together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save Iblis), their chief. (He refused) he felt too proud (to be among the prostrate) to Adam (pbuh).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Except Iblīs (Satan) — he refused to be among the prostrators..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except Iblīs the father of the jinn — he was standing among the angels he refused to be among those prostrating.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Except Iblīs (Satan) — he refused to be among the prostrators..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He) Allah, Exalted is He, (said: O Iblis!) O you who have despaired of My mercy, (What aileth you that thou art not among the prostrate?) why do you not prostrate to Adam?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ يٰإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلاَّ تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. (Allāh) said: “O Iblīs (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He God exalted be He ‘O Iblīs what is wrong with you what prevents you that you are not among those prostrating?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ يٰإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلاَّ تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. (Allāh) said: “O Iblīs (Satan)! What is your reason for not being among the prostrators?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: Why should I prostrate myself unto a mortal whom Thou hast created out of potter's clay of black mud altered?) he said: it is not becoming of me to prostrate to clay.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Said he ‘I was not about to prostrate myself I should not prostrate myself before a mortal whom You have created out of a dry clay drawn from malleable mud’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُ مِن صَلْصَالٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “I am not the one to prostrate myself to a human being, whom You created from dried (sounding) clay of altered mud.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Allah said to him: (Then go thou forth from hence) from the form of angels; it is also said that this means: go forth from My favour and mercy; and it is also said that this means: go forth from the earth, (for verily you are outcast) accursed and banished from My mercy.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. (Allāh) said: “Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajīm (an outcast or a cursed one).” [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Said He ‘Then be gone from hence that is from the Garden — but it is also said from the heavens — for you are indeed accursed outcast.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. (Allāh) said: “Then, get out from here, for verily, you are Rajīm (an outcast or a cursed one).” [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! the curse) My curse and the curse of the angels and all created beings (shall be upon you till the Day of Judgement) until the Day of Reckoning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed the curse shall rest upon you until the Day of Judgement’ the Day of Requital.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “And verily, the curse shall be upon you till the Day of Recompense (i.e. the Day of Resurrection).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Iblis said: (My Lord!) O my Lord! (Reprieve me till the day when they are raised) from the grave; the accursed did not wish to taste death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Said he ‘My Lord! Reprieve me until the day when they mankind shall be resurrected’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِي إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “O my Lord! Give me then respite till the Day they (the dead) will be resurrected.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Allah said: (Then lo! thou art of those reprieved) you will be given respite

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Allāh said: “Then verily, you are of those reprieved,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Said He ‘Then lo! you are of those reprieved

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Allāh said: “Then verily, you are of those reprieved,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Till an appointed time) the first blast of the Trumpet

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. “Till the Day of the time appointed.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: until the day of the known time’ the time of the blowing of the First Trumpet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. “Till the Day of the time appointed.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: My Lord) O my Lord, (Because Thou hast sent me astray) as you made me err from guidance, (I verily shall adorn the path of error) lusts and desires (for them) for the children of Adam (in the earth, and shall mislead them) make them to err (every one) from guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِي لأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Said he ‘My Lord because You have lead me astray bi-mā ‘because’ the bi- is for oaths the response for which is what follows I shall adorn for them evil acts acts of disobedience in the earth and I shall lead them astray all of them;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِي لأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. [Iblīs (Satan)] said: “O my Lord! Because you misled me, I shall indeed adorn the path of error for them (mankind) on the earth, and I shall mislead them all..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save such of them as are Thy perfectly devoted slaves) those who are protected from me; it is also said that this means: those who profess monotheism.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. “Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except those servants of Yours who are sincerely devoted to You’ namely believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. “Except Your chosen, (guided) slaves among them.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) then Allah, Exalted is He, said: (This is a right course) a noble and honoured course; it is also said that this means: it is incumbent upon Me to make those who obeyed you and those who entered with you cross; it is also said that this means: an established straight path which He is pleased with; it is also said that this means: this is a lofty course (incumbent upon Me):

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. (Allāh) said: “This is a Way which will lead straight to Me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He God exalted be He said ‘This is a straight path leading to Me

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَذَا صِرَاطٌ عَلَيَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. (Allāh) said: “This is a Way which will lead straight to Me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! as for My slaves) My believing slaves, (thou hast no power) or strength (over any of them save such of the froward) such of the disbelievers (as follow thee) as obey you,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. “Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghāwūn (Mushrikūn and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: in other words truly over My servants that is believers you shall have no warrant no power except those who follow you from among the perverse the disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عِبَادِي لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَانٌ إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. “Certainly, you shall have no authority over My slaves, except those who follow you of the Ghāwūn (Mushrikūn and those who go astray, criminals, polytheists, and evil-doers).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! for all such, hell will be the promised place) the destination of those who obey you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. “And surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly Hell shall be their tryst all of them that is all those who follow you shall be with you in Hell.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. “And surely, Hell is the promised place for them all.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It hath seven gates) some higher than others: its highest is Gehenna and lowest al-Hawiyah, (and each gate hath an appointed portion) each gate has a specific number of disbelievers who will enter it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. “It (Hell) has seven gates, for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It has seven gates seven layers — to each gate therein belongs an appointed portion lot of them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَابٍ لِكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. “It (Hell) has seven gates, for each of those gates is a (special) class (of sinners) assigned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies, i.e. Abu Bakr, 'Umar and their fellow believers (are among Gardens and water springs) springs of pure water.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. “Truly! The Muttaqūn (the pious)(1) will be amidst Gardens and water-springs (Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly the God-fearing shall be amidst gardens orchards and springs’ flowing through them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. “Truly! The Muttaqūn (the pious)(1) will be amidst Gardens and water-springs (Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((And it is said unto them): Enter them) Allah, Exalted is He, will say to them on the Day of Judgement: enter Paradise (in peace) with peace and greetings; it is also said that this means: with safety and redemption from Us, (secure) from death and evanescence.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلامٍ آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. “(It will be said to them): ‘Enter therein (Paradise), in peace and security.’.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it shall be said to them ‘Enter them in peace that is safe from all danger — or it means enter with the greeting of ‘Peace!’ in other words say ‘Peace’ and then enter secure!’ from all terror.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلامٍ آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. “(It will be said to them): ‘Enter therein (Paradise), in peace and security.’.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We remove whatever rancour) treachery and enmity that was between them in this worldly life (may be in their breasts. As brethren) in the Hereafter, (face to face, (they rest) on couches raised) upon visiting one another.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰناً عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. “And We shall remove from their breasts any deep feeling of bitterness (that they may have). (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We remove whatever rancour spite may be in their breasts. As brethren ikhwānan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to them they shall recline upon couches facing one another mutaqābilīn is also a circumstantial qualifier in other words they do not look upon each other’s backs because the couches revolve with them in them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِي صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰناً عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. “And We shall remove from their breasts any deep feeling of bitterness (that they may have). (So they will be like) brothers facing each other on thrones.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Toil) tiredness or hardship (cometh not unto them there) in Paradise, (nor will they be expelled from thence) expelled from Paradise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. “No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No toil no weariness will touch them nor will they be expelled from thence ever.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. “No sense of fatigue shall touch them, nor shall they (ever) be asked to leave it.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Announce, (O Muhammad) unto My slaves) tell my servants (that verily I am the Forgiving) of sins, (the Merciful) towards him who dies in a state of repentance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَبِّىءْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Declare (O Muḥammad ) to My slaves, that truly, I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Tell inform O Muhammad (s) My servants that verily I am the Forgiving of believers the Merciful to them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَبِّىءْ عِبَادِي أَنِّي أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Declare (O Muḥammad ) to My slaves, that truly, I am the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And that My doom is the dolorous doom) the painful doom for the one who does not repent and dies in a state of disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلأَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And that My Torment is indeed the most painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and that My chastisement of those who are disobedient is the painful chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِي هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلأَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And that My Torment is indeed the most painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And tell them of Abraham's guests) the Archangel Gabriel and the twelve angels who accompanied him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrāhīm (Abraham)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And tell them of the guests of Abraham that is the angels — there were twelve ten or three of them among them Gabriel;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And tell them about the guests (the angels) of Ibrāhīm (Abraham)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((How) when they came in unto him) unto Abraham, (and said: Peace) they greeted him. (He said) Abraham said to them when they did not touch his food: (Lo! we are afraid of you) we are scared of you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلاماً قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. When they entered to him, and said: Salām (peace)! [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “Indeed! We are afraid of you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: how when they entered unto him and said ‘Peace!’ that is they said this very word salām. He Abraham said after having offered them food which they did not eat ‘Lo! we are afraid of you’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ دَخَلُواْ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُواْ سَلاماً قَالَ إِنَّا مِنْكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. When they entered to him, and said: Salām (peace)! [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “Indeed! We are afraid of you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Be not afraid!) do not be scared of us, O Abraham! (Lo! we bring you good tidings of a boy possessing wisdom) in his tender years, clement in his old age.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ لاَ تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلامٍ عَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. They (the angels) said: “Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy (son) possessing much knowledge and wisdom.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Do not be afraid; lo! we are the messengers of your Lord sent to give you good tidings of a knowledgeable boy’ one very knowledgeable boy namely Isaac — as we mentioned in sūrat Hūd Q. 1169.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ لاَ تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلامٍ عَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. They (the angels) said: “Do not be afraid! We give you glad tidings of a boy (son) possessing much knowledge and wisdom.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can you bring good tidings?) now.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَىٰ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your glad tidings?” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘Do you give me good tidings of a boy when old age has befallen me?’ ‘alā an massaniya l-kibaru is a circumstantial qualifier in other words despite the fact of its having befallen me? So of what thing do you give me good tidings?’ an interrogative meant to indicate amazement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِي عَلَىٰ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your glad tidings?” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: We bring thee good tidings in truth) that you will have a son. (So be not thou of the despairing) in relation to having a son.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلاَ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَانِطِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. They (the angels) said: “We give you glad tidings in truth. So, be not of the despairing.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘We give you good tidings in truth sincerely; so do not be of the despairing’ the despondent.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَشَّرْنَاكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلاَ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَانِطِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. They (the angels) said: “We give you glad tidings in truth. So, be not of the despairing.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said: (And who despaireth not the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray) those who disbelieve in Allah or are ungrateful for His blessings?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلاَّ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘And who — in other words no one — despairs read yaqnitu or yaqnatu of the mercy of his Lord save those who are astray?’ save disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِ إِلاَّ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham)] said: “And who despairs of the Mercy of his Lord except those who are astray?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to Gabriel and his aids: (And afterward what is your business) what is the matter, why did you come, O you messengers (of Allah)?)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham) again] said: “What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘So what is your business O you who have been sent by God?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. [Ibrāhīm (Abraham) again] said: “What then is the business on which you have come, O Messengers?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: We have been sent unto a guilty folk) to idolaters who brought destruction upon themselves because of their evil acts, meaning here the people of Lot.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. They (the angels) said: “We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimūn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘We have been sent to a sinning folk a disbelieving folk namely the people of Lot in order to destroy them;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. They (the angels) said: “We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimūn (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((All) save the family of Lot) his daughters Za'ura and Raytha and his righteous wife [who was one of his wives]. (Them we shall deliver everyone) from destruction,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. “(All) except the family of Lūṭ (Lot). Them all we are surely going to save (from destruction)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: all except the family of Lot; indeed we shall save them all of them because of their faith

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ آلَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. “(All) except the family of Lūṭ (Lot). Them all we are surely going to save (from destruction)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Except his wife) his other wife, Wa'ilah the hypocrite, (of whom We had decreed that she should be of those who stay behind) and be destroyed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. “Except his wife, for whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except his wife — We have decreed that she indeed should be of those who will remain behind’ of those who will stay behind in the chastisement because of her unbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱمْرَأَتَهُ قَدَّرْنَآ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. “Except his wife, for whom We have decreed that she shall be of those who remain behind (i.e. she will be destroyed).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the messengers) Gabriel and his helpers (came unto the family of Lot) to Lot,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ آلَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came to the family of Lūṭ (Lot)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when those who had been sent by God came to the family of Lot that is to Lot himself

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ آلَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. Then, when the Messengers (the angels) came to the family of Lūṭ (Lot)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: Lo! ye are folk unknown (to me)) you are unknown in our country, nor are we familiar with the wording of your greeting.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. He said: “Verily, you are people unknown to me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: he said to them ‘Indeed you are strangers’ that is I do not know you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. He said: “Verily, you are people unknown to me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Nay, but we bring thee that concerning which they keep disputing) the torment in which they are in doubt,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
