meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. They said: “Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Rather we have come to you because of that which they your people used to doubt namely the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ جِئْنَاكَ بِمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. They said: “Nay, we have come to you with that (torment) which they have been doubting..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And bring thee the Truth) the news of the torment, (and lo! we are truth tellers) that a chastisement is coming down on them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. “And we have brought you the truth (the news of the destruction of your nation) and certainly, we tell the truth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we have brought you the Truth and indeed we speak truthfully in what we say.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَادِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. “And we have brought you the truth (the news of the destruction of your nation) and certainly, we tell the truth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So travel with thy household in a portion of the night) at the end of the night, at dawn, (and follow you their backs) walk behind them in the direction of Sa'ar. (Let none of you turn round) let none of you lag behind, (but go whither ye are commanded) towards Sa'ar.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلاَ يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُواْ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. “Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So travel with your family in a portion of the night and follow their rear walk behind them; and let none of you turn round lest he see the dreadful nature of that punishment which will be sent down on them and go whither you are commanded’ namely to Syria.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَارَهُمْ وَلاَ يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُواْ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. “Then travel in a part of the night with your family, and you go behind them in the rear, and let no one amongst you look back, but go on to where you are ordered.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We made plain the case to him) We commanded him to go to Sa'ar, (that the root of them (who did wrong)) the people of Lot (was to be cut at early morn) in the morning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ ٱلأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those (sinners) was to be cut off in the early morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We conveyed We revealed to him the matter which was that these sinners was to be eradicated by morning musbihīn is a circumstantial qualifier in other words their annihilation will take place in the morning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَلِكَ ٱلأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَؤُلآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. And We made known this decree to him, that the root of those (sinners) was to be cut off in the early morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the people of the city came) to the house of Lot, (rejoicing at the news (of new arrivals)) and at the prospect of engaging in their evil acts.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (at the news of the young men’s arrival)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And then came the people of the city the city of Sodom that is the people of Lot upon being told that there were handsome clean-shaven individuals — namely the angels — in the house of Lot rejoicing yastabshirūn is a circumstantial qualifier desiring to commit an abomination with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. And the inhabitants of the city came rejoicing (at the news of the young men’s arrival)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Lot said to them: (Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!) do not shame me in front of them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلآءِ ضَيْفِي فَلاَ تَفْضَحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. [Lūṭ (Lot)] said: “Verily, these are my guests, so shame me not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Lot said ‘Lo! these are my guests so do not disgrace me;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ إِنَّ هَؤُلآءِ ضَيْفِي فَلاَ تَفْضَحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. [Lūṭ (Lot)] said: “Verily, these are my guests, so shame me not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And keep your duty to Allah) fear Allah concerning that which is forbidden, (and shame me not!) do not humiliate me in front of my guests.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلاَ تُخْزُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. “And fear Allāh and disgrace me not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and fear God and do not humiliate me’ by seeking them to commit an abomination with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلاَ تُخْزُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. “And fear Allāh and disgrace me not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Have we not forbidden you) O Lot (from (entertaining) anyone?) from welcoming any strangers as guests.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ أَوَ لَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. They (the people of the city) said: “Did we not forbid you from entertaining (or protecting) any of the ‘Ālamīn (people, foreigners and strangers from us)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Have we not forbidden you from entertaining anyone?’ from offering them hospitality?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ أَوَ لَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. They (the people of the city) said: “Did we not forbid you from entertaining (or protecting) any of the ‘Ālamīn (people, foreigners and strangers from us)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: Here are my daughters) it is also said that this means: here are the daughters of my people, I will marry you to them, (if ye must be doing (so)) if you want to get married.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَؤُلآءِ بَنَاتِي إِن كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. [Lūṭ (Lot)] said: “These (the girls of the nation) are my daughters (to marry lawfully), if you must act (so).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘These here are my daughters if you must be doing’ what you desire to do in the way of satisfying your lust then marry them. God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَؤُلآءِ بَنَاتِي إِن كُنْتُمْ فَاعِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. [Lūṭ (Lot)] said: “These (the girls of the nation) are my daughters (to marry lawfully), if you must act (so).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By thy life (O Muhammad)) Allah swore by the life of Muhammad (pbuh) and it is also said that He swore by His religion (they) i.e. the people of Lot (moved blindly) they did not see (in the frenzy of approaching death) because of their ignorance that they were heading towards their death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. Verily, by your life (O Muḥammad ), in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By your life — this is an address to the Prophet s — in their drunkenness they were bewildered hesitant.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِي سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. Verily, by your life (O Muḥammad ), in their wild intoxication, they were wandering blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then the (Awful) Cry) of chastisement (overtook them at the sunrise) when the sun was rising.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. So Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them at the time of sunrise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then the Cry the Cry of Gabriel seized them at sunrise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. So Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them at the time of sunrise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We utterly confounded them) We turned their location upside down, (and We rained upon them) upon their sodomites and sinners (stones of heated clay) coming down from the first heaven; it is also said that these stones were of manure and mud which were heated up like bricks.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We made their that is their cities’ topmost part their nethermost by Gabriel’s raising them the cities to the heaven and dropping them face down onto the earth and We rained on them stones of baked clay clay baked in fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلْنَا عَالِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Therein) in that which We did to them (verily are portents) signs and lessons (for those who read the signs) it is also said that this means: for those who meditate; and also: for those who can see; and: for those who take admonition.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. Surely! In this are signs for those who see (or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed in that which is mentioned there are signs indications of God’s Oneness for those who take note those who observe and take heed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. Surely! In this are signs for those who see (or understand or learn the lessons from the Signs of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! It) i.e. the township of Lot (is upon a road still uneffaced) a road that they pass by all the time.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. And verily, they (the cities) were right on the highroad (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now)(1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed they that is the cities of the people of Lot are on a road that still remains Quraysh’s route to Syria one not yet effaced so why do they not take heed from their example?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. And verily, they (the cities) were right on the highroad (from Makkah to Syria i.e. the place where the Dead Sea is now)(1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Therein) in their destruction (is indeed a portent) a lesson (for believers).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. Surely, therein is indeed a sign for the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: There is indeed a sign a lesson in that for believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. Surely, therein is indeed a sign for the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the dwellers in the wood) i.e. the people of Shu'ayb (indeed were evil-doers) idolaters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan (Midian) to whom Prophet Shu‘aib (S ) was sent by Allāh], were also Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And certainly in has been softened in other words understand it as being innahu the dwellers in the wood a huddle of trees near Midian — these were the people of the prophet Shu‘ayb — were evildoers for denying Shu‘ayb.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأَيْكَةِ لَظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. And the Dwellers in the Wood [i.e. the people of Madyan (Midian) to whom Prophet Shu‘aib (S ) was sent by Allāh], were also Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So We took vengeance on them) in this worldly life by means of chastisement; (and lo! they both) the townships of Lot and Shu'ayb (are on a high road plain to see) and which they do pass by.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So We exacted retribution from them by destroying them through extreme heat. And certainly both of them that is the cities of the people of Lot and those of the dwellers in the wood are upon a open road plain to see so will you not take heed from their example O people of Mecca?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. So, We took vengeance on them. They are both on an open highway, plain to see..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the dwellers in Al-Hijr) the people of Salih (indeed denied (Our) messengers) Salih and all the other messengers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. And verily, the dwellers of Al-Ḥijr (the rocky tract) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily the dwellers in al-Hijr — a valley between Medina and Syria — namely the tribe of Thamūd denied those who had been sent by God when they denied the prophet Sālih as this constituted a denial of the other messengers since they all shared the fact that they came with the Message proclaiming the Oneness of God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. And verily, the dwellers of Al-Ḥijr (the rocky tract) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We gave them Our revelations) the camel as well as other things, (but they were averse to them) they denied them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We brought them Our signs by way of the she-camel of Sālih but they were averse to them refusing to reflect on them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمْ آيَاتِنَا فَكَانُواْ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. And We gave them Our Signs, but they were averse to them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they used to hew out dwellings from the hills) from the mountains, (wherein they dwelt) secure) in the sense that they were safe from their collapse; it is also said that this means: safe from the torment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتاً آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains, (feeling themselves) secure..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains feeling secure.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَانُواْ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتاً آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. And they used to hew out dwellings from the mountains, (feeling themselves) secure..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But the (Awful) Cry overtook them) as a chastisement (at the morning hour) in the morning,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. But Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But the Cry seized them in the morning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. But Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them in the early morning (of the fourth day of their promised punishment days)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And that which they were wont to count as gain) their words, deeds and that which they worshipped (availed them not) against Allah's torment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. And all that they used to earn availed them not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And so that which they used to count as gain in the way of building fortresses and amassing riches did not avail did not protect them from the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. And all that they used to earn availed them not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings and marvels (save with truth) in order to expound the Truth, falsehood and the proofs against them, (and lo! the Hour is surely coming. So forgive, O Muhammad, with a gracious forgiveness) turn away from them gently without using foul language nor feel alarmed at their denial. This was, however, abrogated by the verse of fighting.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لآتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming. So overlook (O Muḥammad ), their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihād — holy fighting in Allāh’s cause]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them save with the Truth. And truly the Hour shall come without doubt whereupon every person will be requited according to his deeds. So be forgiving O Muhammad (s) to your people with gracious forgiveness turn away from them without any feeling of anxiety — this was abrogated by the ‘sword’ verse Q. 95.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لآتِيَةٌ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them except with truth, and the Hour is surely coming. So overlook (O Muḥammad ), their faults with gracious forgiveness. [This was before the ordainment of Jihād — holy fighting in Allāh’s cause]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! thy Lord! He is the All-Wise Creator) Who will resurrect those who believe in Him and those who do not believe in Him, and He also knows their reward and punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلاَّقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Creator of everything the Knowing of everything.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلاَّقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. Verily, your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We have given thee seven of the oft repeated (verses)) He says: We honoured you with seven verses of the Qur'an which are read in every unit of the prayer, i.e. the opening chapter of the Book (al-Fatihah); it is also said that this means: We honoured you with the following of the Qur'an, for the whole Qur'an consists of pairs or couples: commands and prohibitions, promises and threats, the lawful and the unlawful, the abrogating and the abrogated, a literal meaning and an allegorical meaning, ambiguous verses and unambiguous verses, news of the past and events of the future, the praise of some people and the rebuke of others, (and the great Qur'an) He says: and We honoured you with the great, glorious and magnificent Qur'an just as We revealed the Torah and Gospel to the Jews and Christians.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعاً مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِي وَٱلْقُرْآنَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87.And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al‑Mathāni (seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Sūrat Al‑Fātiḥah) and the Grand Qur’ān(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We have given you seven of the oft-repeated verses — the Prophet s said that this meant sūrat al-Fātiha as reported by the two Shaykhs Bukhārī and Muslim since it is repeated in every unit of prayer rak‘a — and the great Qur’ān.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعاً مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِي وَٱلْقُرْآنَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87.And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al‑Mathāni (seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Sūrat Al‑Fātiḥah) and the Grand Qur’ān(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Strain not thine eyes towards) covet not (that which We cause some wedded pairs among them) men from the Banu Qurayzah and the Banu'l-Nadir; it is also said that this refers to men from the Quraysh-because that with which We honoured you, prophethood, the Qur'an and Islam, is far greater than that which We have given them (to enjoy) in terms of wealth, (and be not grieved on their account) do not grieve for their destruction if they choose not to believe, (and lower thy wing (in tenderness) for the believers) be compassionate with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجاً مِّنْهُمْ وَلاَ تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wing for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do not extend your glance toward that which We have given different groups of them to enjoy and do not grieve for them should they not believe and lower your wing temper your nature for the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِ أَزْوَاجاً مِّنْهُمْ وَلاَ تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. Look not with your eyes ambitiously at what We have bestowed on certain classes of them (the disbelievers), nor grieve over them. And lower your wing for the believers (be courteous to the fellow-believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And say: Lo! I, even I, am a plain warner) I am a messenger warning you against Allah's chastisement, in a language that you all understand,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّيۤ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. And say (O Muḥammad ): “I am indeed a plain warner.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And say ‘Indeed I am the warner of God’s chastisement lest it be sent down on you the clear warner clear in his warning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقُلْ إِنِّيۤ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. And say (O Muḥammad ): “I am indeed a plain warner.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Such as We send down) on the Day of Badr (for those who make division) the folk who were slain in the valley, i.e. Abu Jahl Ibn Hisham, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi, Hanzalah Ibn Abi Sufyan and 'Utbah and Shaybah the sons of Rabi'ah as well as all their companions who were killed at Badr,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَمَآ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Even as We sent down chastisement on those who make division the Jews and the Christians

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَمَآ أَنْزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. As We have sent down on the dividers, (Quraish pagans or Jews and Christians)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those who break the Qur'an into parts) they said many different things about the Qur'an; some said it was magic, others said it was poetry, others said it was a form of divination; some said it was fables of the people of old while others said that it was mere lies invented by the Prophet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. Who have made the Qur’ān into parts (i.e. believed in one part and disbelieved in the other). [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who have reduced the Recitation namely those scriptures revealed to them to parts believing in some and disbelieving in others. It is alternatively said that the individuals meant here were those who ‘divided up’ among themselves the roads to Mecca barring people from Islam. Some of them said that the Qur’ān was sorcery some that it was soothsaying and others that it was poetry.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُواْ ٱلْقُرْآنَ عِضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. Who have made the Qur’ān into parts (i.e. believed in one part and disbelieved in the other). [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Them, by thy Lord) O Muhammad; Allah here swore by Himself, (We shall question) on the Day of Judgement, (every one),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. So, by your Lord, (O Muḥammad ), We shall certainly call all of them to account..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By your Lord We shall question them all — a questioning involving rebuke —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْأَلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. So, by your Lord, (O Muḥammad ), We shall certainly call all of them to account..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Of what they used to do) and say in this worldly life; it is also said that this means: they will be questioned about their abstention from the profession of “there is no god but Allah”.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. For all that they used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: about what they used to do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. For all that they used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So proclaim that which thou art commanded) He says: reveal your matter in Mecca, (and withdraw from the idolaters).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Therefore proclaim openly (Allāh’s Message — Islāmic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikūn (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers).(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So proclaim O Muhammad (s) what you have been commanded to proclaim in other words declare it openly and carry it out and turn away from the idolaters — this was revealed before the command to struggle against the idolaters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Therefore proclaim openly (Allāh’s Message — Islāmic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikūn (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers).(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We defend thee from the scoffers) We have lifted from you the burden of those who deride you,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed We have sufficed you against the mockers who mocked you by Our having destroyed each one of them through some harm and these were al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra al-‘Āsī b. Wā’il ‘Udayy b. Qays al-Aswad b. al-Muttalib and al-Aswad b. ‘Abd Yaghūth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَاكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. Truly! We will suffice you against the scoffers,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who set some other god along with Allah) they acknowledge different other gods along with Allah. (But they will come to know) what will be done with them. Allah destroyed, in the span of one night and one day, each one of them by means of a different torment. These were five in number, among them was al-'As Ibn Wa'il al-Sahmi who was stung by something and died on the spot, may Allah keep him far from His mercy. And among them was al-Harth Ibn Qays al-Sahmi who ate salted fish which made him very thirsty. He drank so much water that his stomach burst open and he died, may Allah ruin him. And among them was al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib whose head Gabriel banged on a tree and then hit his face with thorns until he died, may Allah curse him. And among them is al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd Yaghuth who left his house in an extremely hot day and was caught by the simoom such that his colour turned black and resembled an Abyssinian. He went back to his house, but they refused to open the door for him. He banged the door with his head so hard that he died, may Allah forsake him. And among them was al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi who died as a result of an arrow which grazed his anklebone, may Allah banish him. All these people used to say before they died: “the Lord of Muhammad (pbuh) has killed me”.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلـٰهاً آخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. Who set up along with Allāh another ilāh (god); but they will come to know. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those mockers who set up besides God another god this entire clause is an adjectival qualification; but it is also said to be the subject and because there is an implicit conditional meaning in the above-mentioned clause the particle fā’ has been inserted into the predicate which is the following soon they will know the sequel of their affair.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلـٰهاً آخَرَ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. Who set up along with Allāh another ilāh (god); but they will come to know. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Well know We that thy bosom) O Muhammad (is at times oppressed by what they say) in their denial of you, and that you are a poet, a magician, a liar and a diviner,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily wa-laqad is for confirmation We know that your breast is at times oppressed by what they say in the way of mockery and denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. Indeed, We know that your breast is straitened at what they say..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But hymn the praise of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord, (and be of those who make prostration (unto Him)) of those who prostrate to Him; it is also said that this means: of those who are obedient to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So glorify intimately repeating the praise of your Lord in other words say subhāna’Llāhi wa-bi-hamdihi — and be of those who prostrate themselves those who pray;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُنْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. So glorify the praises of your Lord and be of those who prostrate themselves (to Him) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And serve your Lord) persevere in obeying your Lord (till the inevitable cometh unto thee) i.e. until death comes to you'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (i.e. death) (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and worship your Lord until Certainty — Death — comes to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (i.e. death) (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his chain of transmitters on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said: 'When the words of Allah (The reckoning draws near for mankind…) [21:1] and (The hour drew near…) [54:1], people waited whatever time Allah willed them to wait, but nothing happened. So they said: “O Muhammad! When will the torment which you promised us happen?” As a response, Allah revealed: (The commandment of Allah will come to pass) the chastisement of Allah has come. The Prophet (pbuh) was sitting at that point and he suddenly stood, having no doubt in his mind that the chastisement had come. But immediately after that, Allah said: (so seek not ye to hasten it) i.e. the chastisement, at which the Prophet (pbuh) sat down. (Glorified) Allah exonerated Himself from having a son or partner (and Exalted be He) He is too elevated and absolves Himself (above all that they associate (with Him)) of idols.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَىٰ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلاَ تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. The Commandment (the Hour or the punishment of disbelievers and polytheists or the Islāmic laws or commandments) ordained by Allāh will come to pass, so, seek not to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above all that they associate as partners with Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When the idolaters found chastisement slow in coming the following was revealed God’s commandment has come that is the Hour has come this verb atā is in the past tense because it means that the event therein described will come to pass in other words it God’s commandment is close at hand so do not seek to hasten it do not demand it before its due time for it will come to pass without doubt. Glory be to Him — an affirmation of His transcendence — and exalted be He above what they associate with Him in the way of others.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَىٰ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ فَلاَ تَسْتَعْجِلُوهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. The Commandment (the Hour or the punishment of disbelievers and polytheists or the Islāmic laws or commandments) ordained by Allāh will come to pass, so, seek not to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted is He above all that they associate as partners with Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He sendeth down the angels) i.e. Gabriel and the angels with him (with the Spirit of His command) with prophethood and scripture by His command (unto whom He will of His bondmen) He means Muhammad and other prophets, ((saying): Warn mankind) warn mankind by means of the Qur'an and recite it until they say (that there is no god save Me, so keep your duty unto Me) so obey me and profess my divine Oneness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةَ بِٱلْرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرُوۤاْ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنَاْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. He sends down the angels, with the Rūḥ (revelation) of His Command, to whom of His slaves He wills (saying): “Warn (mankind) that Lā ilāha illā Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so fear Me (by abstaining from sins and evil deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He sends down the angels namely Gabriel with the Spirit with the Revelation of His command by His will to whomever He will of His servants and these are the prophets saying that an is explicative Warn threaten the disbelievers with chastisement and make them aware that there is no God save Me so fear Me fear Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلاۤئِكَةَ بِٱلْرُّوحِ مِنْ أَمْرِهِ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِ أَنْ أَنْذِرُوۤاْ أَنَّهُ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنَاْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. He sends down the angels, with the Rūḥ (revelation) of His Command, to whom of His slaves He wills (saying): “Warn (mankind) that Lā ilāha illā Ana (none has the right to be worshipped but I), so fear Me (by abstaining from sins and evil deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He hath created the heavens and the earth with truth) for the Truth; it is also said that this means: for evanescence and extinction. (High be He exalted) He exonerates Himself (above all that they associate (with Him)) of idols.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ تَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He created the heavens and the earth with the Truth that is with the purpose of manifesting truth. Exalted be He above what they associate with Him in the way of idols.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ تَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. He has created the heavens and the earth with truth. High is He, Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He hath created man) the reference here is to Ubayy Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi (from a drop of) stinking (fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent) openly arguing in favour of falsehood, saying: Who will revive these bones when they rot away?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلإِنْسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. He has created man from Nuṭfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He created man from a drop of fluid of sperm until He makes him strong and tough yet behold! he is disputatious extremely quarrelsome openly making this disputatiousness clear in his rejection of resurrection contending Who shall revive the bones when they are decayed? Q. 3678.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَلَقَ ٱلإِنْسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. He has created man from Nuṭfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the cattle) i.e. the camels (hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing) made of their skin (and uses) you drink their milk and use them as a means of transport, (and whereof ye eat) and you eat their meat.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and of them you eat..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the cattle camels cows and sheep al-an‘āma ‘cattle’ is in the accusative because of the implied verb governing it as explained by the following words khalaqahā lakum He created them for you you being included among the number of mankind. In them there is warmth that by which you keep warm in the way of clothes and garments taken from their hairs and wools as well as other uses such as their offspring milk and for you to ride and of them you eat the adverbial clause wa-minhā ‘of them’ precedes the verb for the purpose of establishing harmony with the end-rhyme of the Qur’ānic verse;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَنْعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا دِفْءٌ وَمَنَافِعُ وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and of them you eat..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And wherein is beauty for you) a beautiful scene, (when ye bring them home) back from pasture, (and when ye take them out to pasture).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And therein is beauty for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture in the morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and for you there is in them beauty adornment when you bring them home to rest when you return them to their resting places in the evening and when you drive them forth to pasture when you bring them out to the grazing pastures in the morning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا جَمَالٌ حِينَ تُرِيحُونَ وَحِينَ تَسْرَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And therein is beauty for you, when you bring them home in the evening, and as you lead them forth to pasture in the morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they bear your loads) your luggage and provision (for you unto a land) i.e. Mecca (ye could not reach save with great trouble to yourselves) except with great toil. (Lo! your Lord is Full of Pity) towards him who believes, (Merciful) by deferring your chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُواْ بَالِغِيهِ إِلاَّ بِشِقِّ ٱلأَنفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they bear your burdens your baggage to a land which you could not reach without being on camel-back save with great trouble to yourselves save by straining them. Indeed your Lord is Gentle Merciful to you in having created these for you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَحْمِلُ أَثْقَالَكُمْ إِلَىٰ بَلَدٍ لَّمْ تَكُونُواْ بَالِغِيهِ إِلاَّ بِشِقِّ ٱلأَنفُسِ إِنَّ رَبَّكُمْ لَرَؤُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And they carry your loads to a land that you could not reach except with great trouble to yourselves. Truly, your Lord is full of Kindness, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them) in the way of Allah, (and for ornament) they are good to look at. (And He createth that which ye know not) He says: He created things that you do not know, since He has not named them to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He created horses and mules and asses that you may ride them and for adornment wa-zīnatan is an object denoting reason; the use of both of these reasons ‘to ride’ and ‘for adornment’ as illustrations of God’s graces does not preclude that they may have been created for other purposes such as for consumption in the case of horses — which is established as lawful by a hadīth in both Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim; and He creates what you do not know of marvelous and strange things.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْخَيْلَ وَٱلْبِغَالَ وَٱلْحَمِيرَ لِتَرْكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةً وَيَخْلُقُ مَا لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Allah's is the direction of the way) He is the guide whether it is in the sea or on the land, (and some (roads) go not straight) they are crooked and one cannot find one's way through them. (And had He willed He would have led you all aright) in your way whether you are in the sea or on the land; it is also said that (And Allah's is the direction of the way) means: it is Allah Who guides to monotheism, and some of the religions are crooked and unjust such as Judaism, Christianity and Zoroastrianism. And if Allah had willed, He would have guided you all to His religion.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And upon Allāh is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path(1). But there are ways that turn aside (such as Paganism, Judaism and Christian ity). And had He willed, He would have guided you all (mankind)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And God’s is the direction of the way that is to point out the straight path and some of them that is the paths are deviant swerving away from straightness. And had He willed to guide you He would have guided you to seek the way all so that you would be rightly guided of your own choice.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ قَصْدُ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمِنْهَا جَآئِرٌ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَهَدَاكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And upon Allāh is the responsibility to explain the Straight Path(1). But there are ways that turn aside (such as Paganism, Judaism and Christian ity). And had He willed, He would have guided you all (mankind)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He it is Who sendeth down water) rain (from the sky, whence ye have drink) from the rain which remains in springs and rivers, (and whence are trees) and by means of which tress and vegetation grow (on which ye send your beasts to pasture) on which your cattle are sent to pasture.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ مَآءً لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. He it is Who sends down water (rain) from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He it is Who sends down water from the heaven whence you have drink for you to drink and whence are trees which grow because of this water whereat you let your animals graze.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي أَنْزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ مَآءً لَّكُم مِّنْهُ شَرَابٌ وَمِنْهُ شَجَرٌ فِيهِ تُسِيمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. He it is Who sends down water (rain) from the sky; from it you drink and from it (grows) the vegetation on which you send your cattle to pasture..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therewith) by means of water (He causeth crops to grow for you, and the olive and the date-palm and grapes and all kinds of fruit. Lo! Herein) in all the different kinds of fruit and of their tastes (is indeed a portent) a sign and a lesson (for people who reflect) upon that which Allah has created for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلأَعْنَابَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَاتِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily, in this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for a people who give thought..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: With it He makes the crops grow for you and olives and date-palms and vines and all kinds of fruit. Surely in that which is mentioned there is a sign indicating His Oneness exalted He be for people who reflect upon His handiwork and therefore believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنبِتُ لَكُمْ بِهِ ٱلزَّرْعَ وَٱلزَّيْتُونَ وَٱلنَّخِيلَ وَٱلأَعْنَابَ وَمِن كُلِّ ٱلثَّمَرَاتِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. With it He causes to grow for you the crops, the olives, the date-palms, the grapes, and every kind of fruit. Verily, in this is indeed an evident proof and a manifest sign for a people who give thought..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He hath constrained the night and the day and the sun and the moon to be of service unto you) to be subservient to you, (and the stars are made subservient by His command) by His leave. (Lo! Herein) in the subservience of that which I have mentioned (indeed are portents) signs (for people who have sense) for people who act and believe that it is Allah Who made all these things subservient.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيلَ وَٱلْنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلْنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And He has subjected to you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for a people who understand. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He disposed for you the night and the day and the sun wa’l-shamsa read in the accusative as a supplement to what precedes it; or read wa’l-shamsu in the nominative as a subject of a new sentence and the moon and the stars also read both ways are disposed musakhkharātin read in the accusative as a circumstantial qualifier or in the nominative musakhkharātun as a predicate by His command by His will. Surely in that there are signs for people who understand a people who reflect.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيلَ وَٱلْنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ وَٱلْنُّجُومُ مُسَخَّرَاتٌ بِأَمْرِهِ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَاتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And He has subjected to you the night and the day, and the sun and the moon; and the stars are subjected by His Command. Surely, in this are proofs for a people who understand. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And whatsoever He hath created for you in the earth of diverse hues) of different species of plants and fruits and other things, (lo! Therein) in the different things that Allah has created (is indeed a portent) a sign and lesson (for people who take heed) for people who take admonition from that which is in the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفاً أَلْوَانُهُ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And whatsoever He has created for you on the earth of varying colours [and qualities from vegetation and fruits (botanical life) and from animals (zoological life)]. Verily, in this is a sign for a people who remember..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He has disposed for you whatever He has created for you in the earth of animals plants and otherwise diverse in hue such as red yellow green and otherwise. Surely in that there is a sign for people who remember a people who are admonished.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا ذَرَأَ لَكُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مُخْتَلِفاً أَلْوَانُهُ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً لِّقَوْمٍ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And whatsoever He has created for you on the earth of varying colours [and qualities from vegetation and fruits (botanical life) and from animals (zoological life)]. Verily, in this is a sign for a people who remember..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He it is Who hath constrained the sea to be of service) to be subservient (that ye eat fresh meat) i.e. fish (from thence, and bring forth from thence) from the sea (ornaments) embellishments: pearls and other things (which ye wear. And thou seest the ships ploughing it) you see the ships coming and going in the sea by means of the same wind (that ye (mankind) may seek of His bounty) of His deeds; it is also said that this means: of His provision, (and that haply ye may give thanks) to His bounty.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُواْ مِنْهُ لَحْماً طَرِيّاً وَتَسْتَخْرِجُواْ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And He it is Who has subjected the sea (to you), that you eat thereof fresh tender meat (i.e. fish), and that you bring forth, out of it, ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek (thus) of His Bounty (by transporting the goods from place to place) and that you may be grateful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who disposed the sea He it is Who subdued it that it might be sailed upon and dived in that you may eat from it fresh meat that is fish and bring forth from it ornaments which you wear namely pearls and coral. And you see observe the ships ploughing therein ploughing through the water that is cleaving it as they sail upon it coming and going with the same wind; and that you may seek wa-li-tabtaghū is a supplement to li-ta’kulū ‘that you may eat’ of His bounty exalted He be by way of commerce and that you might be thankful to God for all that.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ ٱلْبَحْرَ لِتَأْكُلُواْ مِنْهُ لَحْماً طَرِيّاً وَتَسْتَخْرِجُواْ مِنْهُ حِلْيَةً تَلْبَسُونَهَا وَتَرَى ٱلْفُلْكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيهِ وَلِتَبْتَغُواْ مِن فَضْلِهِ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And He it is Who has subjected the sea (to you), that you eat thereof fresh tender meat (i.e. fish), and that you bring forth, out of it, ornaments to wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, that you may seek (thus) of His Bounty (by transporting the goods from place to place) and that you may be grateful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He hath cast into the earth firm hills) firm mountains (that it) the earth (quake not with you, and streams) and He made rivers flow therein for your own benefit (and roads) and He made therein roads (that ye may find a way) in order that you find your way therein.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَاراً وَسُبُلاً لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He cast into the earth firm mountains lest it should shake move with you and He made therein rivers such as the Nile and ways roads so that you might be guided to your destinations

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقَىٰ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمْ وَأَنْهَاراً وَسُبُلاً لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And landmarks (too)) mountains and other things for travellers, (and by the star) and by the sun, the moon and the North Star (they) the travellers (find a way) by means of them when travelling on land and in the sea.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَلامَاتٍ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And landmarks (signposts during the day) and by the stars (during the night), they (mankind) guide themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: — and landmarks as well by which you might find the roads landmarks such as mountains during the day and by the star meaning by the stars they are guided to the roads and to the direction of prayer qibla by night.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَلامَاتٍ وَبِٱلنَّجْمِ هُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And landmarks (signposts during the day) and by the stars (during the night), they (mankind) guide themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Is He then Who createth) Allah (as him who createth not?) as him who cannot create: i.e. idols. (Will ye not then remember?) will you not take heed in that which Allah has created for you?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لاَّ يَخْلُقُ أَفَلا تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Is then He, Who creates as one who creates not? Will you not then remember?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Is He then Who creates — namely God — as he who does not create namely idols so that you associate them with Him in worship? No. Will you not then remember this and so become believers?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَمَن يَخْلُقُ كَمَن لاَّ يَخْلُقُ أَفَلا تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Is then He, Who creates as one who creates not? Will you not then remember?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if ye would count the favour of Allah ye cannot reckon it) it is also said that this means: you will not be able to give thanks to it. (Lo! Allah is indeed Forgiving) He pardons, (Merciful) towards whoever repents.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لاَ تُحْصُوهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And if you would count the favours of Allāh, never could you be able to count them. Truly! Allāh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if you were to count God’s grace you could never reckon it number it precisely let alone be able to give thanks for it. Indeed God is Forgiving Merciful since He bestows graces upon you despite your shortcomings and your acts of disobedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن تَعُدُّواْ نِعْمَةَ ٱللَّهِ لاَ تُحْصُوهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And if you would count the favours of Allāh, never could you be able to count them. Truly! Allāh is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Allah knoweth that which ye keep hidden) of good or evil (and that which ye proclaim) of good or evil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you reveal..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And God knows what you keep secret and what you disclose.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And Allāh knows what you conceal and what you reveal..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those unto whom they cry) they worship (beside Allah created naught) they cannot create anything like Our creation, (but are themselves created) they are themselves carved.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئاً وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Those whom they (Al-Mushrikūn)(1) invoke besides Allāh have not created anything, but are themselves created..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And those whom you invoke tad‘ūna or read yad‘una ‘they invoke’ besides God namely the idols do not create anything but are themselves created fashioned from stones and other materials.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ يَخْلُقُونَ شَيْئاً وَهُمْ يُخْلَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Those whom they (Al-Mushrikūn)(1) invoke besides Allāh have not created anything, but are themselves created..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((They are) dead) they are lifeless idols, (not living. And they know not when they) i.e. the idols (will be raised) from the graves and give account; it is also said that this means: the disbelievers do not know when they will give account for their deeds; and it is also said: the angels do not know when they will give account.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْواتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. (They are) dead, not alive; and they know not when they will be raised up..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They are dead possessing no life amwātun ‘dead’ is a second predicate not living an emphasis and they the idols are not aware when is the time in which they shall be raised that is creatures so how can they be worshipped? For only the Creator the Living the Knower of the Unseen can be a God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْواتٌ غَيْرُ أَحْيَآءٍ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ أَيَّانَ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. (They are) dead, not alive; and they know not when they will be raised up..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Your God is One God) He knows this, not your idols. (But as for those who believe not in the Hereafter) those who do not believe in resurrection after death (their hearts refuse to know) acknowledge Allah's divine Oneness, (for they are proud) too proud to believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلٰهُكُمْ إِلٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Your Ilāh(2) (God) is One Ilāh (God — Allāh, none has the right to be worshipped but He). But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts deny (the faith in the Oneness of Allāh), and they are proud (3)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Your God the One deserving of your worship is One God without any equal in terms of His essence or His attributes and this is God exalted He be. But as for those who do not believe in the Hereafter their hearts are in denial rejecting the Oneness of God and they are arrogant scorning to believe in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلٰهُكُمْ إِلٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ فَٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ قُلُوبُهُم مُّنكِرَةٌ وَهُم مُّسْتَكْبِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Your Ilāh(2) (God) is One Ilāh (God — Allāh, none has the right to be worshipped but He). But for those who believe not in the Hereafter, their hearts deny (the faith in the Oneness of Allāh), and they are proud (3)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Assuredly Allah knoweth that which they keep hidden) of hatred, resentful envy, plotting and treachery (and that which they proclaim) of vilification, slander and violent confrontation. (Lo! He loveth not the proud) those who are too proud to believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Certainly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Truly, He likes not the proud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Without doubt verily God knows what they keep secret and what they disclose and will requite them for it. Indeed He does not love the arrogant meaning He will punish them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ جَرَمَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّونَ وَمَا يُعْلِنُونَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُسْتَكْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Certainly, Allāh knows what they conceal and what they reveal. Truly, He likes not the proud..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when it is said unto them) to those who were later killed in the valley of Badr: (What hath your Lord revealed?) What does Muhammad (pbuh) say to you on behalf of your Lord? (they say: (Mere) fables of the men of old) the mere lies and tales of the people of old.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ مَّاذَآ أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُواْ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And when it is said to them: “What is it that your Lord has sent down (to Muḥammad )?” They say: “Tales of the men of old!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The following was revealed regarding al-Nadr b. al-Hārith And when it is said to them ‘What is it mā is an interrogative particle; dhā is a relative particle that your Lord has revealed?’ to Muhammad (s) they say that these revelations are ‘fables lies of the ancients’ in order to lead people astray.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمْ مَّاذَآ أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُواْ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And when it is said to them: “What is it that your Lord has sent down (to Muḥammad )?” They say: “Tales of the men of old!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That they may bear their burdens) their sins (undiminished on the Day of Resurrection, with somewhat of the burdens) as well as the sins (of those whom they mislead) those whom they drove away from Muhammad (pbuh) and from the Qur'an and faith (without knowledge) or proof. (Ah! evil is that which they bear!) evil are the sins which they bear, i.e. those who were slain at the valley of Badr among the leaders of Quraysh.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَحْمِلُواْ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلاَ سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. They will bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also of the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: That they may bear at the conclusion of the matter their burdens their sins complete none of them expunged on the Day of Resurrection and also bear some of the burdens of those whom they lead astray without any knowledge because they summoned them to error and they the latter followed them and thus both share in the sin. How evil awful is the burden they bear this load of sins of theirs which they carry.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَحْمِلُواْ أَوْزَارَهُمْ كَامِلَةً يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ وَمِنْ أَوْزَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ يُضِلُّونَهُمْ بِغَيْرِ عِلْمٍ أَلاَ سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. They will bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection, and also of the burdens of those whom they misled without knowledge. Evil indeed is that which they shall bear!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those before them plotted) against their prophets, just as the leaders of Quraysh who were slain in the valley of Badr plotted against Muhammad (pbuh); the reference here is to the tyrant Nimrod who built the tower, (so Allah struck at the foundations of their building) Allah extracted their tower from its foundation, (and then the roof fell down upon them) the tower fell upon him (from above them, and the doom came on them) through this destruction (whence they knew not);

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Those before them indeed plotted, but Allāh struck at the foundation of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them, from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Those before them had indeed plotted those such as Nimrod — he built a lofty tower that he might ascend through it to the heavens and wage war against its inhabitants; then God came at He aimed at their edifice from the foundations from the base unleashing against it winds and earthquake which demolished it; and so the roof collapsed upon them from above them that is while they were beneath it and the chastisement came upon them whence they were not aware from a direction which would not have occurred to them alternatively it is said that this description is a simile for demonstrating the thwarting of that which they had settled on in the way of plots against God’s messengers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ مَكَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ فَأَتَى ٱللَّهُ بُنْيَانَهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّقْفُ مِن فَوْقِهِمْ وَأَتَاهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Those before them indeed plotted, but Allāh struck at the foundation of their building, and then the roof fell down upon them, from above them, and the torment overtook them from directions they did not perceive. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them) chastise and humiliate them (and will say) Allah will say on the Day of Judgement: (Where are My partners) where are the idols which you claimed are My partners, (for whose sake ye opposed (My Guidance)) for whose sake you opposed My guidance and declared enmity towards My prophets? (Those who have been given knowledge) i.e. the angels (will say: Disgrace this day) the chastisement on this Day of Judgement (and evil) the Fire and hardship (are upon the disbelievers),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآئِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْيَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلْسُّوۤءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: “Where are My (so called) partners concerning whom you used to disagree and dispute (with the believers, by defying and disobeying Allāh)?” Those who have been given the knowledge (about the Torment of Allāh for the disbelievers) will say: “Verily, disgrace and misery this Day are upon the disbelievers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them humiliate them and He God will say to them by the tongues of the angels in rebuke ‘Where are those associates of Mine as you were wont to claim concerning whom for whose sake you used to make breaches?’ you used to opposed the believers. Those who were given knowledge from among the prophets and believers will say ‘Truly disgrace on this day as well as misfortune are for the disbelievers — they say this rejoicing at their the disbelievers’ misfortune —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ يُخْزِيهِمْ وَيَقُولُ أَيْنَ شُرَكَآئِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُنْتُمْ تُشَاقُّونَ فِيهِمْ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلْعِلْمَ إِنَّ ٱلْخِزْيَ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَٱلْسُّوۤءَ عَلَى ٱلْكَافِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Then, on the Day of Resurrection, He will disgrace them and will say: “Where are My (so called) partners concerning whom you used to disagree and dispute (with the believers, by defying and disobeying Allāh)?” Those who have been given the knowledge (about the Torment of Allāh for the disbelievers) will say: “Verily, disgrace and misery this Day are upon the disbelievers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Whom the angels cause to die) on the Day of Badr (while they are wronging themselves) through disbelief. (Then will they make full submission (saying)) they will answer; it is also said that this means: they resign to Allah, saying: (We used not to do any wrong) we did not worship anything beside Allah nor did we associate partners with Him. (Nay!) Allah will say: nay! (Surely Allah is Knower of what ye used to do) and say and worship beside Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوۤءٍ بَلَىٰ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves .” Then, they will make (false) submission (saying): “We used not to do any evil.” (The angels will reply): “Yes! Truly, Allāh is All-Knower of what you used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those whom the angels take in death read feminine person tatawaffāhum or masculine yatawaffāhum while they are wronging themselves’ through disbelief. Then they will offer submission becoming compliant and submitting themselves to belief in God upon death saying ‘We were not doing any evil’ any associating others with God whereat the angels say ‘Nay! Surely God is Knower of what you used to do’ and will requite you for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ تَتَوَفَّاهُمُ ٱلْمَلائِكَةُ ظَالِمِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ فَأَلْقَوُاْ ٱلسَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعْمَلُ مِن سُوۤءٍ بَلَىٰ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Those whose lives the angels take while they are doing wrong to themselves .” Then, they will make (false) submission (saying): “We used not to do any evil.” (The angels will reply): “Yes! Truly, Allāh is All-Knower of what you used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever) neither to die nor leave it. (Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant) the abode of the disbelievers is Gehenna.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱدْخُلُوۤاْ أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. “So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein forever, (1) and indeed, what an evil abode will be for the arrogant.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it will also be said to them So enter the gates of Hell to abide therein! Evil indeed is the lodging the abode of the arrogant.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱدْخُلُوۤاْ أَبْوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَا فَلَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. “So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein forever, (1) and indeed, what an evil abode will be for the arrogant.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And it is said unto those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry and indecencies; the reference here is to 'Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud and his fellow believers: (What hath your Lord revealed?) what does Muhammad (pbuh) say to you from your Lord? (They say Good) the profession of Allah's divine Oneness and keeping ties of kinship: (For those who do good) for those who profess monotheism (in this world there is a good (reward)) Paradise on the Day of Judgement (and the home of the Hereafter) i.e. Paradise (will be better) than this worldly life and all there is in it. (Pleasant indeed will be the home of those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْاْ مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُواْ خَيْراً لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُواْ فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ ٱلآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqūn (the pious) (2) “What is it that your Lord has sent down?” They say: “That which is good.” For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqūn (the pious)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it is said to those who fear idolatry ‘What has your Lord revealed?’ They will say ‘Good! For those who were virtuous by embracing faith in this world there will be a virtuous reward namely a goodly life; and truly the abode of the Hereafter that is Paradise is better than the world and all that is in it. God says the following regarding it And truly excellent is the abode of the God-fearing it the Hereafter is.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْاْ مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ رَبُّكُمْ قَالُواْ خَيْراً لِّلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُواْ فِي هٰذِهِ ٱلْدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ وَلَدَارُ ٱلآخِرَةِ خَيْرٌ وَلَنِعْمَ دَارُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And (when) it is said to those who are the Muttaqūn (the pious) (2) “What is it that your Lord has sent down?” They say: “That which is good.” For those who do good in this world, there is good, and the home of the Hereafter will be better. And excellent indeed will be the home (i.e. Paradise) of the Muttaqūn (the pious)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Gardens of Eden) this is the chamber of the All-Merciful (which they enter) on the Day of Judgement, (underneath which) beneath its trees and dwellings (rivers) of wine, water, honey and milk (flow, wherein) in Paradise (they have what they will) whatever they desire and like. (Thus Allah repayeth those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: جَنَّاتُ عَدْنٍ يَدْخُلُونَهَا تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ لَهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآؤونَ كَذَلِكَ يَجْزِي ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. ‘Adn (Eden) Paradise (Gardens of Eternity) which they will enter, under which rivers flow, they will have therein all that they wish. Thus Allāh rewards the Muttaqūn (the pious) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās
