meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُواْ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَابُ ٱلصِّرَاطِ ٱلسَّوِيِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 135. Say (O Muḥammad ): “Each one (believer and disbeliever.) is waiting, so wait you too; and you shall know who are they that are on the Straight and Even Path (i.e. Allāh’s religion of Islāmic Monotheism), and who are they that have let themselves be guided (on the Right Path)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas who said regarding the meaning of Allah, Exalted is He, saying: (Their reckoning draweth nigh for mankind): He says: the chastisement that the people of Mecca were promised in the Book has drawn near, (while they turn away in heedlessness) while they are oblivious to it; they have disbelieved in and discarded it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Their reckoning Draws near for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nigh has drawn for mankind the people of Mecca the deniers of the Resurrection their reckoning on the Day of Resurrection yet they are heedless of it disregardful of the preparation required for it by way of embracing faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Their reckoning Draws near for mankind, while they turn away in heedlessness..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Never cometh there unto them) whenever Gabriel comes to their Prophet with (a new reminder from their Lord) i.e. the Qur'an: verse after verse and surah after surah, as if the coming of Gabriel, time after time, and the recitation of Muhammad (pbuh) and their listening to it are new, not that the Qur'an is new, (but they listen to it while they play) while they mock Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ مُّحْدَثٍ إِلاَّ ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Never comes to them an admonition (a chapter of the Qur’ān) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: There does not come to them any new reminder from their Lord revealed gradually in other words new words of the Qur’ān but they listen to it as they play as they engage in mockery

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا يَأْتِيهِمْ مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ مُّحْدَثٍ إِلاَّ ٱسْتَمَعُوهُ وَهُمْ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Never comes to them an admonition (a chapter of the Qur’ān) from their Lord as a recent revelation but they listen to it while they play..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (With hearts preoccupied) with hearts heedless of the matter of the Hereafter. (And they confer in secret) they hide among themselves their disbelief in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an. (The wrong-doers) these are the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host; they say to one another: (say: Is this) they mean Muhammad (pbuh) (other than a mortal like you) other than a human being like you? (Will ye then succumb to magic) will you then believe in magic and lies (when ye see (it)) while knowing that it is magic and lies?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. With their hearts occupied (with evil things). Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): “Is this (Muḥammad ) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: with their hearts preoccupied heedless of its meanings. And they are secret in their conference their speech they the evildoers alladhīna zalamū a substitution for the third person plural indicator wāw of wa-asarrū’l-najwā ‘and they are secret in conference’ ‘Is this namely Muhammad (s) other than a mortal human being like yourselves? and so what he produces is mere sorcery. Will you then take to sorcery will you succumb and follow it even though you are able to see?’ even though you know that it is sorcery?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَهِيَةً قُلُوبُهُمْ وَأَسَرُّواْ ٱلنَّجْوَى ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ هَلْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ أَفَتَأْتُونَ ٱلسِّحْرَ وَأَنتُمْ تُبْصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. With their hearts occupied (with evil things). Those who do wrong, conceal their private counsels, (saying): “Is this (Muḥammad ) more than a human being like you? Will you submit to magic while you see it?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He saith) Muhammad (s)ays to them: (My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and the earth) Allah knows the secret words that the dwellers of the heaven and the earth say and the secret works they do. (He is the Hearer) of what Abu Jahl and his host say, (the Knower) of Abu Jahl and his host as well as of their punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. He (Muḥammad ) said: “My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said to them ‘My Lord knows the words that are spoken in the heavens and the earth and He is the Hearer of what they keep secret the Knower’ of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّي يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. He (Muḥammad ) said: “My Lord knows (every) word (spoken) in the heavens and on earth. And He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, say they) some of them say, ((these are but) muddled dreams) false dreams, that which Muhammad (pbuh) brought to us is but false dreams; (nay, he hath but invented it) some others say: Muhammad (pbuh) invented the Qur'an; (nay, he is but a poet) some of them said: no, he is a poet. (Let him bring us a portent) a sign (even as those of old (who were God's messengers) were sent (with portents)) just as the messengers of old were sent with signs to their people, as he claims.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قَالُوۤاْ أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلاَمٍ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِآيَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Nay, they say:“These (revelations of the Qur’ān which are revealed to Muḥammad ) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! — Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Āyāh (sign as a proof) like the ones that the former (Prophets) were sent (with)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay bal in the three instances below effects a transition from one subject to another but they say regarding those parts of the Qur’ān he the Prophet has brought to them are ‘A muddle of nightmares a confusion of things he has seen in his sleep. Nay he has fabricated it he has invented it; nay he is a poet and what he has brought is merely poetry! So let him bring us a sign such as was sent to the ancients’ like the she-camel Sālih the staff and the glowing hand of Moses. God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قَالُوۤاْ أَضْغَاثُ أَحْلاَمٍ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَاهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِآيَةٍ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Nay, they say:“These (revelations of the Qur’ān which are revealed to Muḥammad ) are mixed up false dreams! Nay, he has invented them! — Nay, he is a poet! Let him then bring us an Āyāh (sign as a proof) like the ones that the former (Prophets) were sent (with)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then says: (Not a township) not a single population of a township (believed of those which We destroyed) when they disbelieved in the signs (before them) before your people: (would they then believe) would your people then believe in the signs? Nay, they will not.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَآ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs): will they then believe?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No town before them ever believed — meaning none of its inhabitants — of those that We destroyed for the denial of the signs brought to them. Would they then believe? No.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ آمَنَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَاهَآ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. Not one of the towns (populations), of those which We destroyed, believed before them (though We sent them signs): will they then believe?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We sent not (as Our messengers) before you other than men) human beings like you (whom We inspired) to whom We sent angels just as We have sent to you. (Ask the followers of the Reminder) the people of the Torah and the Gospel (if you know not) that Allah sent only human messengers?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلاَّ رِجَالاً نُّوحِيۤ إِلَيْهِمْ فَاسْئَلُوۤاْ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And We sent not before you (O Muḥammad ) but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures — the Taurāt (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We sent none before you other than men to whom We revealed read nūhī or yūhā ‘to whom it is revealed’ and We sent not any angels. Ask the People of the Remembrance those with knowledge of the Torah and the Gospel if you do not know this; for they will know it. Since you are more likely to believe them than the believers are to believing Muhammad (s).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلاَّ رِجَالاً نُّوحِيۤ إِلَيْهِمْ فَاسْئَلُوۤاْ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لاَ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And We sent not before you (O Muḥammad ) but men to whom We revealed. So ask the people of the Reminder [Scriptures — the Taurāt (Torah), the Injeel (Gospel)] if you do not know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We gave them not) i.e. the Prophet (bodies that would not eat food) or drink, (nor were they immortals) in this worldly life. Rather, they ate and drank and died. This verse was revealed about the people of Mecca when they said: how come this Messenger eats food and walks in the marketplace?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَداً لاَّ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَالِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We did not make them namely the messengers bodies that did not eat food nay they eat it; and they were not immortal in this world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَاهُمْ جَسَداً لاَّ يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُواْ خَالِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And We did not create them (the Messengers, with) bodies that ate not food, nor were they immortals..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We fulfilled the promise unto them) We fulfilled the promise given to the prophets that they will be saved. (So We delivered them) i.e. the prophets (and whom We would) and those who believed in the prophets, (and We destroyed the prodigals) and We destroyed the idolaters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Then, We fulfilled to them the promise. So, We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifūn ..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We fulfilled to them the promise to deliver them. So We delivered them and whomever We would of those who believed in them and We destroyed the prodigal those who denied them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَاهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَاهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Then, We fulfilled to them the promise. So, We saved them and those whom We willed, but We destroyed Al-Musrifūn ..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Now We have revealed unto you) unto your Prophet (a Scripture) We sent Gabriel with a Scripture (wherein is your Reminder) wherein lies your eminence and dignity if you believe in it. (Have ye then no sense) do you not believe then in your eminence and dignity?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَاباً فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book (the Qur’ān) in which there is Dhikrukum, . Will you not then understand?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Now We have sent down as revelation to you O clan of Quraysh a Book in which there is the remembrance that is yours for it is in your language. Will you not understand? and so believe in it?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَاباً فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Indeed, We have sent down for you (O mankind) a Book (the Qur’ān) in which there is Dhikrukum, . Will you not then understand?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (How many a community that dealt unjustly) whose people were disbelievers and idolaters (have We shattered) have We destroyed, (and raised up) and created (after them) after their destruction (another folk) who lived in their habitations!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْماً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. How many a town (community) given to wrong-doing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And how many did We destroy of towns — meaning its inhabitants — that had been wrongdoing disbelieving and brought forth another people after it!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةً وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْماً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. How many a town (community) given to wrong-doing, have We destroyed, and raised up after them another people!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And, when they felt Our might) when they saw Our chastisement which was to destroy them, (behold them fleeing from it) they run away from Our might!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when they felt Our might when the inhabitants of the town sensed destruction to be near behold they ran away from it they flee hastily therefrom.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَحَسُّواْ بَأْسَنَآ إِذَا هُمْ مِّنْهَا يَرْكُضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Then, when they perceived (saw) Our Torment (coming), behold, they (tried to) flee from it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The angels said to them: (Flee not) do not run away, (but return to that (existence) which emasculated you) return to the comfort which you enjoyed (and to your dwellings) and to your houses, (that ye may be questioned) about faith; it is also said that this means: that you may be asked about the killing of the Prophet (pbuh).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَرْكُضُواْ وَٱرْجِعُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But the angels said to them scornfully ‘Do not run away! Return to the opulence the comforts which you were given to enjoy and your dwelling-places that perhaps you might be asked’ for something of your worldly possessions as usual.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَرْكُضُواْ وَٱرْجِعُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَاكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْأَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Flee not, but return to that wherein you lived a luxurious life, and to your homes, in order that you may be questioned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They cried) when they were being killed and tormented: (Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers) when we killed our Prophet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ يٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. They cried: “Woe to us! Certainly, we have been Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh)”..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘O yā is for calling attention to something woe to us! this is our destruction! We have indeed been doing wrong’ through our disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ يٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. They cried: “Woe to us! Certainly, we have been Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh)”..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And this their crying) i.e. saying " Alas for us! " (ceased not till We made them as reaped corn, extinct) dead, motionless. This is the story of a township near Yemen called " Hudur ". Allah sent a prophet to them but they killed him. Allah set on them Nebuchadnezzar who exterminated them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيداً خَامِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So that saying remained their cry which they would make and repeat until We made them as reaped crops as crops harvested with sickles when they were killed with the sword stilled dead like the stillness of fire when it is extinguished.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا زَالَت تِلْكَ دَعْوَاهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَاهُمْ حَصِيداً خَامِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And that cry of theirs ceased not, till We made them as a field that is reaped, extinct (dead)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We created not the heaven and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings (in play) without ordaining commands and prohibitions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for (mere) play (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and all that is between them playing being frivolous but to indicate Our power and to benefit Our servants.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. We created not the heavens and the earth and all that is between them for (mere) play (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Then Allah revealed the following, when they said that the angels are Allah's daughters: (If We had wished to find a pastime) if We wished to have daughters; and it is said that this means: if We wished to have a wife; and it is also said that this means: if We wished to have children, (We could have found it in Our presence) from Us from among the maidens of Paradise (if We ever did) and We will never do this.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْواً لاَّتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Had We desired to find some diversion that which provides diversion in the way of a partner or a child We would have found it with Ourselves from among the beautiful-eyed houris or angels were We to do so. But We did not do so thus We never desired it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْواً لاَّتَّخَذْنَاهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَاعِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Had We intended to take a pastime (i.e. a wife or a son), We could surely have taken it from Us, if We were going to do (that)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but We hurl the true) We cast the Truth (against the false) upon falsehood; it is also said: We exposit the Truth and falsehood, (and it doth break its head) and it makes it perish (and lo! it vanisheth) i.e. falsehood. (And yours) O group of disbelievers (will be woe) severe punishment (for that which ye ascribe (unto Him)) for your claim that the angels are Allah's daughters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Qur’ān) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Allāh by uttering that Allāh has a wife and a son)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but We hurl We cast the truth faith against falsehood disbelief and it obliterates it and behold it vanishes disappears damaghahu ‘it obliterates it’ actually means ‘it struck the brain with a blow’ a blow which is fatal. And for you O disbelievers of Mecca there shall be woe severe chastisement for what you ascribe to God of mate or child.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَاطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Qur’ān) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Allāh by uttering that Allāh has a wife and a son)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto Him belongeth whosoever is in the heavens and the earth) all created beings are His slaves. (And those who dwell in His presence) among the angels (are not too proud to worship Him) they are not too proud to obey Him and acknowledge His Lordship (nor do they weary) and they do not tire from worshipping Allah;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَهُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ لاَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلاَ يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And to Him exalted be He belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth as possessions and those who are near Him namely the angels wa-man ‘indahu the subject the predicate of which is the following clause do not disdain to worship Him nor do they weary.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَهُ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَنْ عِنْدَهُ لاَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِهِ وَلاَ يَسْتَحْسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. To Him belongs whosoever is in the heavens and on earth. And those who are near Him (i.e. the angels) are not too proud to worship Him, nor are they weary (of His worship)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They glorify (Him) night and day) they pray to Him at night and during the day; (they flag not) they do not get bored of worshipping Allah and of acknowledging His Lordship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لاَ يَفْتُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They glorify Him night and day and they do not falter in it for it comes to them as naturally as breathing comes to us something which we can never be distracted from.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُسَبِّحُونَ ٱلَّيلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ لاَ يَفْتُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. They (i.e. the angels) glorify His Praises night and day, (and) they never slacken (to do so). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or have they chosen) or have they, i.e. the people of Mecca, worshipped (gods from the earth) on the earth (who raise the dead) or create human beings?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوۤاْ آلِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Or have they taken (for worship) ālihah (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or am functions with the meaning of bal ‘nay’ to effect a transition in subject-matter; the hamza is for rhetorical denial have they chosen gods that are from the earth such as stones gold or silver who that is gods who resurrect? who bring the dead back to life? No! Indeed only one who brings the dead back to life can be God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوۤاْ آلِهَةً مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Or have they taken (for worship) ālihah (gods) from the earth who raise the dead?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (If there were therein) in the heavens and earth (Gods beside Allah) other than Allah, (then verily both had been disordered) the dwellers of the heavens and the earth would have been destroyed. (Glorified be Allah, the Lord of the Throne, from all that they ascribe (unto Him)) from the children and partners they ascribe to Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ آلِهَةٌ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) ālihah (gods) besides Allāh, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) would have been ruined. Glorified is Allāh, the Lord of the Throne, (High be He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Had there been in either of them that is in the heavens and the earth gods other than God that is other than Him the two would have surely deteriorated they the heavens and the earth would have deviated from their observed order because counteractive forces would exist among such gods as is usually the case when there is more than one ruler that there is counteraction and a lack of consensus regarding something. So glory be to God — an exaltation — the Lord the Creator of the Throne al-kursī above what they ascribe the disbelievers to God of His having a partner and otherwise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ آلِهَةٌ إِلاَّ ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا فَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Had there been therein (in the heavens and the earth) ālihah (gods) besides Allāh, then verily both (the heavens and the earth) would have been ruined. Glorified is Allāh, the Lord of the Throne, (High be He) above all that (evil) they associate with Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth) Allah will not be questioned about what He says, commands or does, (but they will be questioned) and the servants will be asked about what they say and do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He shall not be questioned about what He does but they shall be questioned about their actions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُسْأَلُ عَمَّا يَفْعَلُ وَهُمْ يُسْأَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or have they chosen) or have they worshipped (other gods) idols (beside Him) beside Allah? (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (Bring your proof (of their godhead)) bring your proofs for the validity of their worship. (This) i.e. the Qur'an (is the Reminder of those with me) is the events of those with me (and those before me) and the events of those who were before among the believers and disbelievers, and it does not contain that Allah has children or partners, (but most of them) all of them (know not the Truth) nor believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and so they are averse) they disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَانَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِي بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ فَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Or have they taken for worship (other) ālihah (gods) besides Him? Say: “Bring your proof.” This (the Qur’ān) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or have they chosen besides Him exalted be He other than Him gods? herein is an interrogative meant as a rebuke. Say ‘Bring your proof for this — but such a thing is impossible. This is the Remembrance of those with me namely my community and that Remembrance is the Qur’ān and the Remembrance of those before me of communities namely the Torah and the Gospel and other Books of God not a single one of which contains the statement that with God there exists another god in the way that they claim — exalted be He above such a thing. Nay but most of them do not know the truth the affirmation of God’s Oneness and so they are disregardful’ of that discernment that leads to knowledge of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِهِ آلِهَةً قُلْ هَاتُواْ بُرْهَانَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِيَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِي بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ فَهُمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Or have they taken for worship (other) ālihah (gods) besides Him? Say: “Bring your proof.” This (the Qur’ān) is the Reminder for those with me and the Reminder for those before me. But most of them know not the Truth, so they are averse..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We sent no messenger before you) O Muhammad (but We inspired him) tell your people that they should say: (There is no God save Me (Allah), so worship Me) so declare My divine Oneness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ نُوحِيۤ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لاۤ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنَاْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muḥammad ) but We revealed to him (saying): Lā ilāha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allāh)], so worship Me (Alone and none else).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We did not send any Messenger before you but We revealed to him read nūhī or yūhā ‘but it was revealed to him’ that ‘There is no god except Me so worship Me’ that is affirm My Oneness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ نُوحِيۤ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُ لاۤ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ أَنَاْ فَٱعْبُدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And We did not send any Messenger before you (O Muḥammad ) but We revealed to him (saying): Lā ilāha illa Ana [none has the right to be worshipped but I (Allāh)], so worship Me (Alone and none else).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they say) i.e. the people of Mecca: (The Beneficent hath taken unto Himself a child) angels as daughters. (Be He glorified!) Allah exonerated Himself from having children or partners (Nay, but are honoured slaves) rather they are, i.e. the angels, are servants whom Allah has honoured with obeying Him;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَداً سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And they say: “The Most Gracious (Allāh) has begotten a son (or children).” Glory to Him! They [whom they call children of Allāh i.e. the angels, ‘Īsā (Jesus) — son of Maryam (Mary), ‘Uzair (Ezra)], are but honoured slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they say ‘The Compassionate One has taken a son’ from the angels. Glory be to Him! Nay but they are merely servants who are honoured in His presence; for the very servitude of all creatures to Him is inconsistent with the attribution of any of them as progeny of His.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَلَداً سُبْحَانَهُ بَلْ عِبَادٌ مُّكْرَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And they say: “The Most Gracious (Allāh) has begotten a son (or children).” Glory to Him! They [whom they call children of Allāh i.e. the angels, ‘Īsā (Jesus) — son of Maryam (Mary), ‘Uzair (Ezra)], are but honoured slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They speak not until He hath spoken) Gabriel does not go ahead of Michael, whether by words or acts, until He commands him, (and they act by His command) and they, i.e. the angels, say and do in accordance with Allah's command.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They do not venture to speak before Him — they only speak after He has spoken and they act according to His command that is following His issuing of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَسْبِقُونَهُ بِٱلْقَوْلِ وَهُمْ بِأَمْرِهِ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He knoweth what is before them) of the matter of the Hereafter (and what is behind them) of the matter of this worldly life, (and they) i.e. the angels (cannot intercede) on the Day of Judgement (except for him whom He accepteth) except for those who profess Allah's divine Oneness and with whose monotheism Allah is pleased, (and they quake for awe of Him) among those who fear Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يَشْفَعُونَ إِلاَّ لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُمْ مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He knows what is before them and what is behind them that is what they have done and what they will do and they do not intercede except for him with whom He is satisfied that he be interceded for and they for awe of Him exalted be He are apprehensive fearful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يَشْفَعُونَ إِلاَّ لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُمْ مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِ مُشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And one of them) of the angels; and it is said this means: of created beings (who should say: Lo! I am a God beside Him) beside Allah, (that one We should repay with hell) Hell will be his lot because of this. (Thus We repay wrong-doers) thus We repay disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّيۤ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And if any of them should say: “Verily, I am an ilāh (a god) besides Him (Allāh),” such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And should any of them say ‘I am a god besides Him’ that is besides God in other words a god other than Him — and this is Iblīs who summoned others to worship his soul and commanded that it be obeyed — such a one We will requite with Hell. Thus in the same way that We requite him We requite wrong-doers idolaters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّيۤ إِلَـٰهٌ مِّن دُونِهِ فَذٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And if any of them should say: “Verily, I am an ilāh (a god) besides Him (Allāh),” such a one We should recompense with Hell. Thus We recompense the Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Have not those who disbelieve) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (known that the heavens and the earth were of one piece) We did not send down to it a drop of rain or grow vegetation on the earth which were aligned with each other (then We parted them) and then separated them and singled them out from each other through rain and plants, (and We made every living thing of water) We made of water from the male and female everything that requires water? (Will they) i.e. the people of Mecca (not then believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقاً فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ أَفَلاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Have they not one may read a-wa-lam or a-lam realised have they not come to know those who disbelieve that the heavens and the earth were closed together and then We parted them We made seven heavens and seven earths — or it is meant that the heaven was parted and began to rain when it did not use to do so and that the earth was parted and began to produce plants when it did not use to do so; and We made of water the water that falls from the heaven and that springs from the earth every living thing? in the way of plants and otherwise in other words water is the cause of such things having life. Will they not then believe? by affirming My Oneness?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقاً فَفَتَقْنَاهُمَا وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ حَيٍّ أَفَلاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Have not those who disbelieve known that the heavens and the earth were joined together as one united piece, then We parted them? And We have made from water every living thing. Will they not then believe?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We have placed in the earth firm hills) the mountains as pillars for it (lest it quake with them) lest the earth trembles with them on it, (and We have placed therein) in the earth (ravines) valleys (as roads) as spacious roads (that haply they may find their way) in their goings and comings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ٱلأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجاً سُبُلاً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We set in the earth firm mountains lest it should shake with them and We set in them in the firm mountains ravines as roads subulan substitutes for fijājan ‘ravines’ which are wide through-routes that perhaps they may be guided to their destinations during travel.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِي ٱلأَرْضِ رَوَاسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِهِمْ وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا فِجَاجاً سُبُلاً لَّعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. And We have placed on the earth firm mountains, lest it should shake with them, and We placed therein broad highways for them to pass through, that they may be guided..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We have made the sky a roof) for the earth (withheld (from them)) such that it does not fall; it is also said that this means: it is protected from the satans by the stars. (Yet they) i.e. the people of Mecca (turn away from) they do not believe nor reflect upon (its portents) its sun, moon and stars.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفاً مَّحْفُوظاً وَهُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We made the heaven a roof for the earth functioning like the roof of a house preserved from collapsing; and yet of the signs thereof namely the signs of this heaven such as the sun the moon and the stars they are disregardful failing to reflect on them and thus realise that the Creator of such things can have no partner.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ سَقْفاً مَّحْفُوظاً وَهُمْ عَنْ آيَاتِهَا مُعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We have made the heaven a roof, safe and well guarded. Yet they turn away from its signs (i.e. sun, moon, winds, clouds, etc.)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon) He made the sun and the moon subservient. (They float, each in an orbit) each one of them rotate around its orbit.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon each kullun the nunation of this particle stands in place of the second noun of the genitive construction that would have been al-shams ‘the sun’ or al-qamar ‘the moon’ or their subsidiaries namely al-nujūm ‘the stars’ in an orbit a circular one like a mill in the sky swimming moving with speed like a swimmer in water. In order to effect the analogy with the latter the plural person of the verb employed for rational beings is used.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلْلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ كُلٌّ فِي فَلَكٍ يَسْبَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We appointed) We have created (immortality) in this worldly life (for no mortal) among the prophets (before thee. What! if thou diest) O Muhammad, (can they be immortal) in this worldly life? This verse was revealed when they said: we will wait until Muhammad dies and then we will find rest.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ أَفَإِنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muḥammad ): then if you die, would they live forever?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When the disbelievers said that Muhammad (s) would die the following was revealed And We did not assign to any human being before you immortality permanence of life in this world. What if you are fated to die will they be immortal? in it? No! The last sentence constitutes the syntactical locus of the interrogative of denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا جَعَلْنَا لِبَشَرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ ٱلْخُلْدَ أَفَإِنْ مِّتَّ فَهُمُ ٱلْخَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And We granted not to any human being immortality before you (O Muḥammad ): then if you die, would they live forever?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Every soul) that is possessed of breath (must taste of death, and We try you) We test you (with evil and with good) with hardship and comfort, (for ordeal) both are a test from Allah. (And unto Us ye will be returned) after you die and then He will requite you for your works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good. And to Us you will be returned. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Every soul shall taste death in this world and We will try you We will test you with ill and good such as poverty and wealth sickness and health as an ordeal fitnatan an object denoting reason in other words for the purpose of seeing whether you will be patient and give thanks or not. And then unto Us you shall be brought back that We may requite you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذَآئِقَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ وَنَبْلُوكُم بِٱلشَّرِّ وَٱلْخَيْرِ فِتْنَةً وَإِلَيْنَا تُرْجَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Everyone is going to taste death, and We shall make a trial of you with evil and with good. And to Us you will be returned. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when those who disbelieve) Abu Jahl and his host (behold thee) O Muhammad, (they but choose thee) O Muhammad (out for mockery) in what they say to you, ((saying)) to one another: (Is this he who maketh mention of) is this he who ridicules (your gods? And they would deny all mention of the Beneficent) they deny the Beneficent, saying: we do not know anyone by the name of the Beneficent (al-Rahman) except Musaylimah, the liar.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَآكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلاَّ هُزُواً أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذْكُرُ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَهُمْ بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And when those who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allāh) see you (O Muḥammad ), they take you not except for mockery (saying): “Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?” While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Gracious (Allāh). [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And whenever the disbelievers see you they only take you in derision that is as one to be derided saying ‘Is this the one who mentions your gods?’ that is the one who derides them? And yet when it comes to the mention of the Compassionate One to them they hum repeated for emphasis are disbelieving of it saying ‘We do not know of any such individual’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَآكَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوۤاْ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلاَّ هُزُواً أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي يَذْكُرُ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَهُمْ بِذِكْرِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ هُمْ كَافِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And when those who disbelieved (in the Oneness of Allāh) see you (O Muḥammad ), they take you not except for mockery (saying): “Is this the one who talks (badly) about your gods?” While they disbelieve at the mention of the Most Gracious (Allāh). [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Man) i.e. Adam (is made of haste) he is hasty; it is also said that this means: man, al-Nadr Ibn al-Harth, was created hasty, for he wanted chastisement to be hastened for him. (I shall show you My portents) I shall show you the signs of My divine Oneness in the horizons; it is also said that this means: I will show the signs of My punishment of you through the sword on the Day of Badr, (but ask Me not to hasten) My chastisement before its appointed time.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلإنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُوْرِيكُمْ آيَاتِي فَلاَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Man is created of haste. I will show you My Āyāt (torments, proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).So ask Me not to hasten (them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The following was revealed regarding their demand that chastisement be hastened Man was created of haste that is to say because he is so hasty in his affairs it is as if he had been created out of it. Assuredly I shall show you My signs My promises of chastisement so do not demand that I hasten in sending it. And so He God made them suffer death at the battle of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خُلِقَ ٱلإنْسَانُ مِنْ عَجَلٍ سَأُوْرِيكُمْ آيَاتِي فَلاَ تَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Man is created of haste. I will show you My Āyāt (torments, proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).So ask Me not to hasten (them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they say) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca: (When will this promise) that you have promised us, O Muhammad, ((be fulfilled), if ye are truthful?)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And they say: “When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they say ‘When will this promise of resurrection be fulfilled if you are truthful?’ about it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And they say: “When will this promise (come to pass), if you are truthful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (If those who disbelieved) if those who disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an knew the chastisement awaiting them, they would not ask for it to be hastened, (but knew the time when they will not be able to drive off) when the chastisement comes, they will not be able to push away (the Fire from their faces and from their backs, and they will not be helped) to drive away the chastisement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لاَ يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلاَ عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. If only those who disbe lieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, and they will not be helped..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says If those who disbelieved only knew of the time when they shall not be able to ward off repel the Fire from their faces nor from their backs nor shall they be helped nor shall they be protected from it at the Resurrection the response to the conditional particle law ‘if only’ is something along the lines of ‘they would not have said that’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَوْ يَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ حِينَ لاَ يَكُفُّونَ عَن وُجُوهِهِمُ ٱلنَّارَ وَلاَ عَن ظُهُورِهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. If only those who disbe lieved knew (the time) when they will not be able to ward off the Fire from their faces, nor from their backs, and they will not be helped..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but it) the Last Hour (will come upon them unawares) suddenly (so that it will stupefy them) so it will take them by surprise, (and they will be unable to repel it) from themselves, (neither will they be reprieved) nor will their chastisement be postponed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلاَ هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it, nor will they get respite..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but it the Resurrection shall come upon them suddenly dumbfounding them confusing them and they shall not be able to ward it off nor shall they be granted any respite nor shall they be given any extra time to make a repentance or offer an excuse.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ تَأْتِيهِم بَغْتَةً فَتَبْهَتُهُمْ فَلاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلاَ هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it, nor will they get respite..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Messengers before thee, indeed, were mocked) the messengers who came before you, O Muhammad, were mocked by their people just as your people are mocking you, (but that whereat they mocked) the chastisement they mocked; it is also said that this means: they were chastised because of their mockery, (surrounded) was decreed and came down upon (those who scoffed at them) those who mocked the prophets.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِىءَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Indeed, (many) Messengers were mocked at before you (O Muḥammad ), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily messengers before you were derided — herein is a statement to comfort the Prophet s — but those who mocked them were encircled by it was sent down against them that which they used to deride namely chastisement — likewise it shall befall those who have derided you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱسْتُهْزِىءَ بِرُسُلٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ فَحَاقَ بِٱلَّذِينَ سَخِرُواْ مِنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِ يَسْتَهْزِئُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Indeed, (many) Messengers were mocked at before you (O Muḥammad ), but the scoffers were surrounded by that, whereat they used to mock..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad to the people of Mecca: (Who guardeth you) who protects you (in the night or in the day from the Beneficent) from the chastisement of the Beneficent? It is also said that this means: who protects you from the punishment of other than the Beneficent? (Nay, but they turn away from) but they disbelieve and discard the (the mention of their Lord) from the profession of Allah's divine Oneness and the Scripture of their Lord,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلْلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Say: “Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Gracious (Allāh)?” Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say to them ‘Who can guard you preserve you by night and day from the Compassionate One?’ from His chastisement if it should befall you? In other words no one can do such a thing. Those being addressed here do not fear God’s chastisement because they deny the truth of it. Nay but of the Remembrance of their Lord that is the Qur’ān they are disregardful failing to reflect on it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن يَكْلَؤُكُم بِٱلْلَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ بَلْ هُمْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Say: “Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Gracious (Allāh)?” Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or have they gods) or do they have deities (who can shield them from Us) from Our chastisement? (They cannot help themselves) they, these gods, cannot drive away chastisement from themselves, so how can they drive it away from others? (nor can they be defended from Us) nor are they going to receive immunity from Our chastisement, so how can they give immunity to others?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِّن دُونِنَا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. Or have they ālihah (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or is it that they have am ‘or’ functions with the sense of a hamza used to indicate denial that is read it as a-lahum ‘do they have’ gods to defend them against that which might cause them harm besides Us? In other words do they have anyone other than Us to defend them against such things? No! They namely the gods cannot help themselves and so they will not be able to help them; nor shall they the disbelievers be protected from Us from Our chastisement one may say sahibaka’Llāhu to mean ‘May God preserve and protect you’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ آلِهَةٌ تَمْنَعُهُمْ مِّن دُونِنَا لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُونَ نَصْرَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ وَلاَ هُمْ مِّنَّا يُصْحَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. Or have they ālihah (gods) who can guard them from Us? They have no power to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us (i.e. from Our Torment)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but We gave these) the people of Mecca (and their fathers) before them (ease) a reprieve (until life grew long for them) until their lifespan grew long for them. (See they) i.e. the people of Mecca (not how we visit the land) how We seize the land, (reducing it) conquering it, for Muhammad (of its outlying parts) from its sides? (Can they then be the victors) are they then going to be victorious over Muhammad (pbuh)?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰؤُلاۤءِ وَآبَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ أَفَلاَ يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِي ٱلأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَالِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome? (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but We provided comforts for these and their fathers in the way of the graces which We bestowed on them until life lasted long for them so that they were deluded by such longevity. Do they not see how We visit the land how We target their land diminishing it at its edges? by granting the Prophet victory through conquest. Are they the ones who will prevail? No it is rather the Prophet and his Companions who will do so.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ مَتَّعْنَا هَـٰؤُلاۤءِ وَآبَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ طَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْعُمُرُ أَفَلاَ يَرَوْنَ أَنَّا نَأْتِي ٱلأَرْضَ نَنقُصُهَا مِنْ أَطْرَافِهَآ أَفَهُمُ ٱلْغَالِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Nay, We gave the luxuries of this life to these men and their fathers until the period grew long for them. See they not that We gradually reduce the land (in their control) from its outlying borders? Is it then they who will overcome? (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (I warn you only by the Inspiration) by that which is revealed of the Qur'an. (But the deaf hear not the call when they are warned) but you cannot make hear he who pretends not to hear Allah's call.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْيِ وَلاَ يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I warn you only by the revelation (from Allāh and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [i.e. one should follow only the Qur’ān and the Sunnah ] (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say to them ‘I warn you only by the Revelation’ that comes from God and not by my own prompting. But the deaf do not hear the call when idhā read pronouncing both hamzas fully or omitting the second hamza between it and the yā’ they are warned. They are like those who are deaf when they fail to act in accordance with the warnings they hear.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أُنذِرُكُم بِٱلْوَحْيِ وَلاَ يَسْمَعُ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلدُّعَآءَ إِذَا مَا يُنذَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I warn you only by the revelation (from Allāh and not by the opinion of the religious scholars and others). But the deaf (who follow the religious scholars and others blindly) will not hear the call, (even) when they are warned [i.e. one should follow only the Qur’ān and the Sunnah ] (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if a breath of thy Lord's punishment were to touch them, they assuredly would say: Alas for us! Lo! we were wrong-doers) against ourselves, and we were disbelievers in Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يٰويْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: “Woe to us! Indeed we have been Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers).” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if a whiff a slight instance of your Lord’s chastisement were to touch them they would indeed say ‘O yā used for drawing attention to something woe for us! O this is our destruction! Truly we were doing evil’ in ascribing partners to God and denying the Mission of Muhammad (s).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن مَّسَّتْهُمْ نَفْحَةٌ مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّكَ لَيَقُولُنَّ يٰويْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. And if a breath (minor calamity) of the Torment of your Lord touches them, they will surely cry: “Woe to us! Indeed we have been Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers).” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection) on the Day of Judgement, there will be a balance which will weigh only good and bad works (so that no soul is wronged in aught) no one will have his good works diminished nor his evil works increased. (Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it) We requite for it. (And We suffice for reckoners) We are enough as Preserver and Knower.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَازِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ فَلاَ تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئاً وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَاسِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We to take account..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We shall set up the just balances the equitable ones for the Day of Resurrection that is on it and no soul shall be wronged in any way neither by deducting a good deed from its record nor by adding to it an evil one; and even if it the action be the weight of a single mustard seed We shall produce it with its full weight and We suffice as reckoners to count all things.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَضَعُ ٱلْمَوَازِينَ ٱلْقِسْطَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَامَةِ فَلاَ تُظْلَمُ نَفْسٌ شَيْئاً وَإِن كَانَ مِثْقَالَ حَبَّةٍ مِّنْ خَرْدَلٍ أَتَيْنَا بِهَا وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَاسِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We to take account..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We verily gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion) the deliverer from dubious matters; it is also said that the Criterion means: victory and the upper hand over Pharaoh (and a light) which shows error (and a Reader) and an admonition (for those who keep from evil) for those who ward off idolatry, disbelief and indecencies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْراً لَّلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And indeed We granted to Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurāt (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqūn (the pious) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We gave Moses and Aaron the Criterion the Torah that discriminates between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and unlawful and an illumination by it and remembrance an admonition therein for those who are wary of God

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ وَضِيَآءً وَذِكْراً لَّلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And indeed We granted to Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron) the criterion (of right and wrong), and a shining light [i.e. the Taurāt (Torah)] and a Reminder for Al-Muttaqūn (the pious) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those who fear their Lord) those who work for their Lord (in secret) even if He is invisible to them (and who dread the Hour) and who dread the chastisement of the Last Day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and they are afraid of the Hour (Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who fear their Lord in concealment from people that is when they are in seclusion from them and who on account of the Hour that is on account of its terrors are apprehensive fearful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَهُمْ مِّنَ ٱلسَّاعَةِ مُشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Those who fear their Lord without seeing Him, and they are afraid of the Hour (Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This) Qur'an (is a blessed Reminder) it contains mercy and forgiveness for he who believes in it (that We have revealed) We sent Gabriel with it: (Will ye) O people of Mecca (then reject it) disbelieve in it?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ أَفَأَنْتُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And this is a blessed Reminder (the Qur’ān) which We have sent down: will you then (dare to) deny it?(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And this namely the Qur’ān is a blessed Remembrance which We have revealed. Will you then deny it? the interrogative here is intended as a rebuke.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ مُّبَارَكٌ أَنزَلْنَاهُ أَفَأَنْتُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And this is a blessed Reminder (the Qur’ān) which We have sent down: will you then (dare to) deny it?(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We verily gave Abraham of old) before he reached the age of puberty; it is also said that this means: We honoured him with prophethood before Moses and Aaron; and it said that this means: before Muhammad (pbuh) (his proper course) i.e. knowledge and understanding, (and We were Aware of him) i.e. that he deserved it,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَآ إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrāhīm (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were All-Knower of him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We had given Abraham his rectitude before that is his right guidance before he came of age — and We were Aware of him in that he was deserving of such guidance

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَآ إِبْرَاهِيمَ رُشْدَهُ مِن قَبْلُ وَكُنَّا بِهِ عَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And indeed We bestowed aforetime on Ibrāhīm (Abraham) his (portion of) guidance, and We were All-Knower of him (as to his Belief in the Oneness of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) Nimrod son of Canaan and his host: (What are these images unto which ye pay devotion) which you worship?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيۤ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. When he said to his father and his people: “What are these images, to which you are devoted?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when he said to his father and his people ‘What are these images these idols to which you constantly cleave?’ that is which you are constantly worshipping.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا هَـٰذِهِ ٱلتَّمَاثِيلُ ٱلَّتِيۤ أَنتُمْ لَهَا عَاكِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. When he said to his father and his people: “What are these images, to which you are devoted?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: We found our fathers worshippers of them) and so we worship them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ وَجَدْنَآ آبَآءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. They said:“We found our fathers worshipping them.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘We found our fathers worshipping them’ and so we followed their example.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ وَجَدْنَآ آبَآءَنَا لَهَا عَابِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. They said:“We found our fathers worshipping them.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Verily ye and your fathers) before you (were in plain error) in disbelief and manifest error.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. He said: “Indeed, you and your fathers have been in manifest error.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said to them ‘Truly you and your fathers by worshipping them have been in manifest error’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ لَقَدْ كُنتُمْ أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُمْ فِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. He said: “Indeed, you and your fathers have been in manifest error.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said) to Abraham: (Bringest thou unto us the Truth) is what you say serious, O Abraham, (or art thou some jester) or are you mocking us?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللاَّعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. They said: “Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Do you bring us the truth in that which you are saying or are you being frivolous?’ in this regard.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَجِئْتَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ أَمْ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱللاَّعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. They said: “Have you brought us the truth, or are you one of those who play about?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said: (Nay, but your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them; and I am of those who testify unto that) to what I have said.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِي فطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَاْ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلشَّاهِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. He said: “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and to that I am one of the witnesses..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘Nay but your Lord the only One worthy of being worshipped is the Lord the Owner of the heavens and the earth the One Who originated them Who created them without any precedent and to that which I have said I am a witness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ بَل رَّبُّكُمْ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ ٱلَّذِي فطَرَهُنَّ وَأَنَاْ عَلَىٰ ذٰلِكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلشَّاهِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. He said: “Nay, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Who created them and to that I am one of the witnesses..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And, by Allah) he said this to himself, (I shall circumvent) I shall demolish (your idols after ye have gone away and turned your backs) to go to the festival.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. “And by Allāh, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And by God I shall devise a stratagem against your idols after you have gone away with your backs turned’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَٱللَّهِ لأَكِيدَنَّ أَصْنَامَكُمْ بَعْدَ أَن تُوَلُّواْ مُدْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. “And by Allāh, I shall plot a plan (to destroy) your idols after you have gone away and turned your backs.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: When they went to their festival and they left Abraham behind in their township, he went to the house of their idols. (Then he reduced them to fragments) he destroyed them, (all save the chief of them) he left it intact, (that haply they might have recourse to it) after coming back from their festival and he could say that it was it that did it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذاً إِلاَّ كَبِيراً لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. So, he broke them into pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And so after they had set off to a gathering of theirs on one of their festival days he reduced them to fragments read judhādhan or jidhādhan meaning ‘pieces’ smashing them with a hatchet all except the principal one among them around whose neck he hung the hatchet that they might return to it that is to the principal one and see what he had done to the others.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلَهُمْ جُذَاذاً إِلاَّ كَبِيراً لَّهُمْ لَعَلَّهُمْ إِلَيْهِ يَرْجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. So, he broke them into pieces, (all) except the biggest of them, that they might turn to it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: They entered the house of their idols. (They said: Who hath done this to our gods? Surely it must be some evil-doer) he committed an evil deed against our deities.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. They said: “Who has done this to our ālihah (gods)? He must indeed be one of the Zālimun (wrong-doers).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said upon returning and seeing what had been done ‘Who has done this to our gods? Truly he is an evildoer’ in this regard.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ مَن فَعَلَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَآ إِنَّهُ لَمِنَ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. They said: “Who has done this to our ālihah (gods)? He must indeed be one of the Zālimun (wrong-doers).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said) a man among them said: (We heard a youth make mention of them) speaking ill of them and mentioning that he will break them, (who is called Abraham).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. They said: “We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrāhīm (Abraham).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said one to the other ‘We heard a young man making ill mention of them deriding them — he is called Abraham’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا فَتًى يَذْكُرُهُمْ يُقَالُ لَهُ إِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. They said: “We heard a young man talking against them, who is called Ibrāhīm (Abraham).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said) Nimrod said to them: (Then bring him (hither) before the people's eyes) in the presence of people (that they may testify) that he did it; and it is said that this means: that they may testify that he said he will demolish them; and it is also said that this means: that they may witness his punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ فَأْتُواْ بِهِ عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. They said: “Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Then bring him before the people’s eyes that is openly that they may testify’ against him as being the perpetrator.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ فَأْتُواْ بِهِ عَلَىٰ أَعْيُنِ ٱلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَشْهَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. They said: “Then bring him before the eyes of the people, that they may testify.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said) Nimrod said to him: (Is it thou who hast done this) i.e. breaking them (to our gods, O Abraham?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَأَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يٰإِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. They said: “Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrāhīm (Abraham)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said to him after he had been brought before them ‘So is it you read a-anta either pronouncing fully the two hamzas; or substituting an alif for the second one or not pronouncing it the second one and inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the other one or without this insertion who has done this to our gods O Abraham?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَأَنْتَ فَعَلْتَ هَـٰذَا بِآلِهَتِنَا يٰإِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. They said: “Are you the one who has done this to our gods, O Ibrāhīm (Abraham)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: He said) Abraham said: (But this, their chief) who has the axe on its shoulder (hath done it. So question them, if they can speak) so that they can inform you who broke them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ بَلْ فَعَلَهُ كَبِيرُهُمْ هَـٰذَا فَاسْأَلُوهُمْ إِن كَانُواْ يِنْطِقُونَ
