And plead not with Me) by means of supplications (on behalf of those who have done wrong) i.e. to save those who disbelieved among your people: (Lo! they will be drowned) in the flood.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلاَّ مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلاَ تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ إِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. So, We revealed to him (saying): “Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and water gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So We revealed to him saying ‘Build the Ark the ship under Our watch under Our observation and protection and by Our revelation Our command. Then when Our command comes that they be destroyed and the oven of the baker gushes with water — and this was Noah’s sign — bring into it admit into the ship of every kind of animal two mates a male and a female that is two of every species thereof ithnayn is an object; min ‘of’ is semantically connected to usluk ‘bring into it’. According to the story God exalted be He gathered all the beasts of prey and the birds and other animals for Noah. As he Noah pushed forth his hands into each species his right hand would fall upon a male and the left upon a female whereafter he would take them on board the ship a variant reading for min kuli ‘of every’ is min kullin ‘of every kind’ in which case zawjayni ‘two mates’ becomes a direct object with ithnayn ‘two’ being repeated for emphasis thereof; together with your family — his wife ? and children — except for those against whom the Word has already gone forth that they be destroyed namely his wife and his son Canaan Kan‘ān unlike Shem Sām Ham Hām and Japheth Yāfith whom together with their three wives he carried on board. In sūrat Hūd the following is mentioned where Noah is told who he should carry in the ship ‘… and those who believe.’ And none believed with him except a few Q. 1140. It is said that these were six men and their wives. Moreover it is said that all those who were on the ship numbered seventy eight half of them were men and half were women. And do not plead with Me concerning those who have done wrong those who have disbelieved that I should refrain from destroying them. They shall indeed be drowned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ أَنِ ٱصْنَعِ ٱلْفُلْكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَوَحْيِنَا فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُنَا وَفَارَ ٱلتَّنُّورُ فَٱسْلُكْ فِيهَا مِن كُلٍّ زَوْجَيْنِ ٱثْنَيْنِ وَأَهْلَكَ إِلاَّ مَن سَبَقَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنْهُمْ وَلاَ تُخَاطِبْنِي فِي ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ إِنَّهُمْ مُّغْرَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. So, We revealed to him (saying): “Construct the ship under Our Eyes and under Our Revelation (guidance). Then, when Our Command comes, and water gushes forth from the oven, take on board of each kind two (male and female), and your family, except those thereof against whom the Word has already gone forth. And address Me not in favour of those who have done wrong. Verily, they are to be drowned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee) of the believers, (then say: Praise be to Allah) gratitude is due to Allah (Who hath saved us from the wrong-doing folk!) who has saved us from the disbelievers!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s, Who has saved us from the people who are Ẓālimūn (i.e. oppressors, wrong‑doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allāh).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when you have settled when you are balanced in the Ark together with those with you say “Praise be to God Who has delivered us from the wrongdoing folk” from the disbelievers and the destruction that came upon them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱسْتَوَيْتَ أَنتَ وَمَن مَّعَكَ عَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ فَقُلِ ٱلْحَمْدُ للَّهِ ٱلَّذِي نَجَّانَا مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And when you have embarked on the ship, you and whoever is with you, then say: “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s, Who has saved us from the people who are Ẓālimūn (i.e. oppressors, wrong‑doers, polytheists, those who join others in worship with Allāh).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And say) when you come off the ship: (My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing place) blessed with water and trees, (for Thou art Best of all who bring to land) in the life of this world and in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلاً مُّبَارَكاً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And say: “My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And say upon disembarking from the ship “My Lord cause me to land with a landing read munzalan as the verbal noun as well as the noun of place for ‘landing’; or manzilan as meaning the site of the landing blessed being that landing or place for You are the best of all who bring to land” ’ that which has been mentioned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلْنِي مُنزَلاً مُّبَارَكاً وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ ٱلْمُنزِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And say: “My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (verily are portents) are signs and admonitions for the people of Mecca in order for them to emulate, (for lo! We are ever putting (mankind) to the test) with misfortunes; and it is also said that this means: with punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لآيَاتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nūḥ (Noah)], there are indeed Āyāt (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely in that mentioned matter of Noah the ship and the destruction of the disbelievers there are signs indicators of God’s power exalted be He and indeed wa-in in has been softened in place of the hardened form its subject being the pronoun of the matter We were putting to the test indeed We were trying the people of Noah by sending him as God’s messenger to them and by his admonitions to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذٰلِكَ لآيَاتٍ وَإِن كُنَّا لَمُبْتَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Verily, in this [what We did as regards drowning of the people of Nūḥ (Noah)], there are indeed Āyāt (proofs, evidences, lessons, signs, etc. for men to understand), for sure We are ever putting (men) to the test..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then, after them) after the destruction of Noah's people, (We brought forth another generation) different people;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْناً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Then, after them, We created another generation..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then after them We brought forth another generation another people namely and these were the people of ‘Ād.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قَرْناً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Then, after them, We created another generation..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We sent among them) and We sent to them (a messenger of their own) of their own lineage (saying: Serve Allah) saying: declare Allah's divine Oneness. (Ye have no other god save Him) you have no other god except the One in Whom I command you to believe. (Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولاً مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): “Worship Allāh! You have no other Ilāh (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We sent among them a messenger of their own namely Hūd saying ‘Worship God! You have no other god besides Him. Will you not then be wary?’ of His punishment and become believers?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِمْ رَسُولاً مِّنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱعْبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ إِلَـٰهٍ غَيْرُهُ أَفَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We sent to them a Messenger from among themselves (saying): “Worship Allāh! You have no other Ilāh (God) but Him. Will you not then be afraid (of Him i.e. of His punishment because of worshipping others besides Him)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the chieftains of his folk) of the folk of the messenger, (who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter) and disbelieved in resurrection after death, (and whom We had made soft) whom We blessed with wealth and offspring (in the life of the world, said: This) i.e. this Messenger (is only a mortal) a human being (like you, who eateth of that whereof you eat) who eats as you eat (and drinketh of that ye drink) and drinks as you do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلآخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي ٱلْحَيـاةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: “He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The council of his people who disbelieved and denied the encounter of the Hereafter they denied that they will end up thereat and whom We had given affluence whom We had provided with comforts in the life of this world said ‘This is only a human being like you he eats what you eat and drinks what you drink.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلْمَلأُ مِن قَوْمِهِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَكَذَّبُواْ بِلِقَآءِ ٱلآخِرَةِ وَأَتْرَفْنَاهُمْ فِي ٱلْحَيـاةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَا هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ يَأْكُلُ مِمَّا تَأْكُلُونَ مِنْهُ وَيَشْرَبُ مِمَّا تَشْرَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And the chiefs of his people who disbelieved and denied the Meeting in the Hereafter, and whom We had given the luxuries and comforts of this life, said: “He is no more than a human being like you, he eats of that which you eat, and drinks of what you drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (If ye were to obey a mortal) a human being (like yourselves, ye surely would be losers) you would be ignorant and losers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَراً مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً لَّخَاسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. “If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And by God if you obey a human being like yourselves this clause contains both an oath and a conditional; the response belongs to the former the oath which at the same time suffices in place of a response for the latter the conditional you will surely then that is should you obey them be losers you will have been duped.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِنْ أَطَعْتُمْ بَشَراً مِّثْلَكُمْ إِنَّكُمْ إِذاً لَّخَاسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. “If you were to obey a human being like yourselves, then verily you indeed would be losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Doth he) does this Messenger (promise you that you, when ye are dead and have become dust) after death (and bones) and decayed bones, (will (again) be brought forth) will be brought back to life after death?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَاباً وَعِظاماً أَنَّكُمْ مُّخْرَجُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resur rected)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones you shall be brought forth? mukhrajūna this is the predicate of the first annakum ‘that … you’; the second annakum simply reiterates it because of the long separation between the subject and its predicate.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَعِدُكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ إِذَا مِتُّمْ وَكُنتُمْ تُرَاباً وَعِظاماً أَنَّكُمْ مُّخْرَجُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “Does he promise you that when you have died and have become dust and bones, you shall come out alive (resur rected)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Be gone, be gone, with that which ye are promised!) how farfetched, how farfetched! This will never be.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. “Far, very far is that which you are promised!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Far-fetched far-fetched hayhāt is a noun of action in the past tense functioning as a verbal noun meaning ba‘uda ba‘uda ‘far from it far from it!’ is what you are promised! in the way of being brought forth from the graves li-mā the lām is extra for explication.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَيْهَاتَ هَيْهَاتَ لِمَا تُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. “Far, very far is that which you are promised!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live) the fathers die and their children live, (and we shall not be raised (again)) after we die.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. “There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: There is nothing that is there is no life but our life in this world we die and we live again only through the lives of our offspring and we shall not be raised again.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنْيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَبْعُوثِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. “There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He is only a man) they mean the Messenger is only a man (who hath invented a lie about Allah) in that which he says. (We are not going to put faith in him) we are not going to believe what he says.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ ٱفتَرَىٰ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. “He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allāh, and we are not going to believe in him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He is the Messenger is just a man who has invented a lie against God and we will not believe in him’ we will not accept the truth of resurrection after death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ رَجُلٌ ٱفتَرَىٰ عَلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً وَمَا نَحْنُ لَهُ بِمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. “He is only a man who has invented a lie against Allāh, and we are not going to believe in him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) the Messenger said: (My Lord! Help me) by sending punishment on them (because they deny me) because they disbelieve in my message,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. He said: “O my Lord! Help me because they deny me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘My Lord help me because they have denied me’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱنْصُرْنِي بِمَا كَذَّبُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. He said: “O my Lord! Help me because they deny me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Allah said: (In a little while they surely will become repentant) they will regret their disbelief when the chastisement seizes them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. (Allāh) said: “In a little while, they are sure to be regretful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘In a little while of time ‘ammā the mā is extra they will become remorseful’ about their disbelief and their denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ عَمَّا قَلِيلٍ لَّيُصْبِحُنَّ نَادِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. (Allāh) said: “In a little while, they are sure to be regretful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So the (Awful) Cry overtook them rightfully) i.e. the punishment, which is the cry of Gabriel, seized them, (and We made them) when the chastisement stopped (like a wreckage (that a torrent hurls). A far removal) an utter destruction and disappointment for failing to obtain Allah's mercy (for wrong-doing folk!) for the disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَآءً فَبُعْداً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. So, Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them in truth (with justice), and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So, away with the people who are Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh, disobedient to His Messengers). *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So the Cry the Cry of chastisement and destruction seized them rightfully and they died and We made them as husks ghuthā’ is desiccated vegetation in other words We transformed them into similarly desiccated worthless things. So a far removal from mercy for the evildoing folk the denying folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ غُثَآءً فَبُعْداً لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. So, Aṣ-Ṣaiḥah (torment — awful cry) overtook them in truth (with justice), and We made them as rubbish of dead plants. So, away with the people who are Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allāh, disobedient to His Messengers). *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then after them) then after their destruction (We brought forth other generations) from generation to generation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوناً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Then, after them, We created other generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then after them We brought forth other generations other peoples.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَنشَأْنَا مِن بَعْدِهِمْ قُرُوناً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Then, after them, We created other generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (No nation can outstrip its term) no nation can bring forward the term appointed for its destruction, (nor yet postpone it) to a later date.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No community can precede its term by dying before it nor be deferred beyond it the person in the second verb yasta’khirūna ‘be deferred’ is masculine having been feminine in the first verb tasbiqu ‘precede’ because this masculine plural takes into account the plural masculine content of the term ‘community’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَأْخِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. No nation can advance their term, nor can they delay it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We sent our messengers one after another. Whenever its messenger came unto a nation they denied him) they denied that messenger; (so We caused them to follow one another (to disaster)) with chastisement (and We made them bywords) We made them the talk of their time. (A far removal) what a disappointment for failing to obtain Allah's mercy (for folk who believe not!) for people who disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضاً وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْداً لِّقَوْمٍ لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Then, We sent Our Messen gers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Aḥādīth (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So, away with a people who believe not!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then sent We Our messengers successively read tatran or tatrā one following the other with a long interval between every two. Whenever there came to a community jā’a ummatan read pronouncing both hamzas or without pronouncing the second one between it and the wāw vowel its messenger they denied him; so We made them follow one another to destruction and We turned them into folktales. So away with a people who do not believe!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا تَتْرَا كُلَّ مَا جَآءَ أُمَّةً رَّسُولُهَا كَذَّبُوهُ فَأَتْبَعْنَا بَعْضَهُمْ بَعْضاً وَجَعَلْنَاهُمْ أَحَادِيثَ فَبُعْداً لِّقَوْمٍ لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Then, We sent Our Messen gers in succession. Every time there came to a nation their Messenger, they denied him; so We made them follow one another (to destruction), and We made them as Aḥādīth (the true stories for mankind to learn a lesson from them). So, away with a people who believe not!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our) nine (tokens and a clear warrant) and a clear proof.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Then, We sent Mūsa (Moses) and his brother Hārūn (Aaron), with Our Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a manifest warrant a clear proof namely the hand the staff and other signs

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَأَخَاهُ هَارُونَ بِآيَاتِنَا وَسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Then, We sent Mūsa (Moses) and his brother Hārūn (Aaron), with Our Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and manifest authority,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto Pharaoh and his chiefs, but they scorned (them)) they were too proud to believe in Moses and the signs (and they were despotic folk) they opposed Moses and felt too proud to believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوْماً عَالِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to Pharaoh and his council; but they disdained to believing in them and in God and they were a tyrannical folk subjugating the Children of Israel through oppression.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَمَلَئِهِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُواْ وَكَانُواْ قَوْماً عَالِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. To Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his chiefs, but they behaved insolently and they were people self-exalting (by disobeying their Lord, and exalting themselves over and above the Messenger of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals) two human beings, meaning Moses and Aaron (like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us) while their people are our obedient servants?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَالُوۤاْ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. They said: “Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they said ‘Shall we believe two humans like ourselves while their people are servile to us?’ obedient and submissive.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَالُوۤاْ أَنُؤْمِنُ لِبَشَرَيْنِ مِثْلِنَا وَقَوْمُهُمَا لَنَا عَابِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. They said: “Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So they denied them) they denied their message, (and became of those who were destroyed) they were drowned in the sea.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. So, they denied them both [Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)], and became of those who were destroyed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they denied them both and became of those who were destroyed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُمَا فَكَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلْمُهْلَكِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. So, they denied them both [Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)], and became of those who were destroyed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we verily gave Moses the Scripture) the Torah, (that haply they might go aright) that haply they might be led to guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ ٱلْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And indeed We gave Mūsā (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We gave Moses the Scripture the Torah that perhaps they his people the Children of Israel might be guided thereby from error — he Moses was given it the Scripture after the destruction of Pharaoh and his folk all at once.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ ٱلْكِتَابَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And indeed We gave Mūsā (Moses) the Scripture, that they may be guided..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We made the son of Mary) i.e. Jesus (and his mother a portent) a sign and admonition: a son without a father and a pregnancy without physical contact, (and We gave them refuge on a height) on an elevated location, (a place of flocks and water springs) the reference here is to Damascus.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We made the son of Mary Jesus and his mother a sign — He did not say ‘two signs’ because the same sign is in both of them his being born without his mother’s having a male spouse. And We gave them refuge on a height rabwa a highland — in this case either the Holy House of Jerusalem Damascus or Palestine all of which are alternative opinions — level dhāt qarār an flat high- land on which its inhabitants are able to settle yastaqirru and watered by springs running water over ground which the eyes can see.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱبْنَ مَرْيَمَ وَأُمَّهُ آيَةً وَآوَيْنَاهُمَآ إِلَىٰ رَبْوَةٍ ذَاتِ قَرَارٍ وَمَعِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. And We made the son of Maryam (Mary) and his mother as a sign, and We gave them refuge on high ground, a place of rest, security and flowing streams..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (O ye messengers!) the reference here is to Muhammad (Eat of the good thing) eat of the lawful things, (and do right) do righteous works between yourself and your Lord. (Lo! I am Aware) I am aware of the reward (of what ye do) of what you do, O Muhammad, and also of what they do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَاتِ وَٱعْمَلُواْ صَالِحاً إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Ṭayyibāt [all kinds of Ḥalāl foods which Allāh has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.] and do righteous deeds. Verily, I am All-Knower of what you do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘O messengers eat of the good things the lawful things and perform righteous acts such as obligatory and supererogatory rituals. Surely I know what you do and will requite you for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلرُّسُلُ كُلُواْ مِنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَاتِ وَٱعْمَلُواْ صَالِحاً إِنِّي بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. O (you) Messengers! Eat of the Ṭayyibāt [all kinds of Ḥalāl foods which Allāh has made lawful (meat of slaughtered eatable animals, milk products, fats, vegetables, fruits, etc.] and do righteous deeds. Verily, I am All-Knower of what you do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! this your religion is one religion) and your belief is one chosen belief (and I am your Lord) One sole Lord who honoured you with it, (so keep your duty unto Me) so obey Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَاْ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. And verily, this your religion (of Islāmic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear (keep your duty to) Me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And know that this creed of Islam is your community your religion O you being addressed that is you must adhere to it as one community — a necessary state of affairs a variant reading for anna ‘that’ has the softened form in; a variant has inna ‘truly’ indicating the beginning of an independent new sentence and I am your Lord so fear Me’ so be fearful of Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَاْ رَبُّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. And verily, this your religion (of Islāmic Monotheism) is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear (keep your duty to) Me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But they (mankind) have broken their religion among them into sects) so they split among themselves with regard to religion into different groups: groups of Jews, Christians, idolaters and Magians, (each sect) the adherents of each religion and sect (rejoicing in its tenets) being impressed with what they have.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوۤاْ أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُراً كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, (1) each group rejoicing in what is with it (as its beliefs)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But they the followers split into sects regarding their affair their religion zuburan ‘sects’ is a circumstantial qualifier of the subject of the verb taqatta‘ū ‘they split’ in other words they became opposing parties the likes of the Jews and the Christians and others each party rejoicing in exultant with what they had that is with the religion they had.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَقَطَّعُوۤاْ أَمْرَهُمْ بَيْنَهُمْ زُبُراً كُلُّ حِزْبٍ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ فَرِحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. But they (men) have broken their religion among them into sects, (1) each group rejoicing in what is with it (as its beliefs)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So leave them) O Muhammad (in their error) in their ignorance (till a time) until the advent of punishment on the Day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. So leave them in their error for a time..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So leave them the disbelievers of Mecca in their error their misguidance for a while until they die.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ فِي غَمْرَتِهِمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. So leave them in their error for a time..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Think they) do the adherents of these sects think (that in the wealth and sons wherewith We provide them) in the life of this world,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. Do they think that, in wealth and children with which We enlarge them,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do they suppose that in the wealth and children with which We provide them in the life of this world

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّمَا نُمِدُّهُمْ بِهِ مِن مَّالٍ وَبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. Do they think that, in wealth and children with which We enlarge them,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We hasten unto them with good things) in this world; and it is said: in the Hereafter? (Nay, but they perceive not) that We provide them in the life of this world but will humiliate them in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ بَل لاَّ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. We hasten to them with good things. Nay, [it is a Fitnah (trial) in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter] but they perceive not. [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We are hastening to provide them with good things? No. Rather they are not aware that this is a way of gradually drawing them into their punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نُسَارِعُ لَهُمْ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ بَل لاَّ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. We hasten to them with good things. Nay, [it is a Fitnah (trial) in this worldly life so that they will have no share of good things in the Hereafter] but they perceive not. [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Then Allah clarified to whom He hastens with good things in the life of this world, saying: (Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord) of their Lord's chastisement; for these We hasten with good things;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely those who for fear of their Lord are apprehensive are fearful of His chastisement

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ خَشْيةِ رَبِّهِمْ مُّشْفِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. Verily, those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who believe in the revelations of their Lord) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an, for these We hasten with good things;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِآيَاتِ رَبَّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. And those who believe in the Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord; (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and who believe in who accept the truth of the signs of their Lord — the Qur’ān;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِآيَاتِ رَبَّهِمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. And those who believe in the Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord; (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who ascribe not partners) idols (unto their Lord) for these We hasten with good things;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لاَ يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and who do not associate others with their Lord

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِرَبِّهِمْ لاَ يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. And those who join not anyone (in worship) as partners with their Lord;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who give that which they give) of their wealth for alms and spend of it in the way of Allah; and it is said that this means: those who do what they do of righteous deeds (with hearts afraid because they are about to return unto their Lord) in the Hereafter, fearing that perhaps their works will not be accepted,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ آتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities have been accepted or not), (1) because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and who give what they give of voluntary alms and righteous deeds while their hearts tremble with awe fearful lest it not be accepted from them because the particle lām ‘for’ is taken as implied before annahum ‘that they’ they are going to return to their Lord —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُؤْتُونَ مَآ آتَواْ وَّقُلُوبُهُمْ وَجِلَةٌ أَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمْ رَاجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. And those who give that (their charity) which they give (and also do other good deeds) with their hearts full of fear (whether their alms and charities have been accepted or not), (1) because they are sure to return to their Lord (for reckoning)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (These) who have such traits (race for the good things) hasten to perform righteous works, (and they shall win them in the race.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Ṣalāt (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those are the ones who hasten to perform good works and they are the ones who shall come out ahead in them according to God’s knowledge.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ يُسَارِعُونَ فِي ٱلْخَيْرَاتِ وَهُمْ لَهَا سَابِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. It is these who hasten in the good deeds, and they are foremost in them [e.g. offering the compulsory Ṣalāt (prayers) in their (early) stated, fixed times and so on]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And We task not any soul) with works (beyond its scope) beyond its capability, (and with Us is a Record) this is the Record of the recording angels (al-hafazah) who record people's good and bad works (which speaketh the Truth) they will testify truthfully and fairly, (and they will not be wronged) their good deeds will not be diminished and their bad works will not be increased.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لاَ يُظْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. And We tax not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We do not task any soul beyond its capacity what it can bear — thus he who is not able to pray standing let him pray sitting down and he who is not able to fast let him eat; and with Us is a Record that speaks the truth regarding what it a soul has done — and this Record is the Preserved Tablet al-lawh al-mahfūz wherein deeds are written down; and they namely the souls in their acts will not be wronged in a single thing thereof and so nothing is diminished of the reward for good deeds nor is anything extra added to the evil deeds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ نُكَلِّفُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا وَلَدَيْنَا كِتَابٌ يَنطِقُ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ لاَ يُظْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. And We tax not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but their hearts) the hearts of the people of Mecca: i.e. Abu Jahl and his host (are in ignorance) and heedlessness (of this) Qur'an, (and they have other works) decreed upon them, (besides) besides that which you enjoin them of good works, (which they are doing) in the life of this world until their appointed time comes, O Muhammad;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. Nay, but their hearts are covered from (understanding) this (the Qur’ān), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but their hearts that is the hearts of the disbelievers are in ignorance of this Qur’ān and they have other deeds which they will perpetrate besides the ones mentioned against the believers and they will therefore be chastised for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قُلُوبُهُمْ فِي غَمْرَةٍ مِّنْ هَـٰذَا وَلَهُمْ أَعْمَالٌ مِّن دُونِ ذٰلِكَ هُمْ لَهَا عَامِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. Nay, but their hearts are covered from (understanding) this (the Qur’ān), and they have other (evil) deeds, besides, which they are doing..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Till when We grasp their luxurious ones) their tyrants and leaders: Abu Jahl Ibn Hisham, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi, al-'As Ibn Wa'il al-Sahmi, 'Utbah and Shaybah and their friends (with the punishment) with hunger for seven years, (behold! they supplicate) they plead.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. Until, when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment: behold, they make humble invocation with a loud voice..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed hattā is for inceptiveness when We seize their affluent ones their wealthy and their leaders with chastisement with the sword on the day of Badr behold! they are supplicating loudly clamouring in supplication. It is then said to them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَآ أَخَذْنَا مُتْرَفِيهِمْ بِٱلْعَذَابِ إِذَا هُمْ يَجْأَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. Until, when We seize those of them who lead a luxurious life with punishment: behold, they make humble invocation with a loud voice..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Say to them, O Muhammad: (Supplicate not this day) to escape Our punishment! (Assuredly you will not be helped) you will not be saved (by Us) from Our punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَجْأَرُواْ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا لاَ تُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly, you shall not be helped by Us. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Do not supplicate out loud on this day! Truly you will not receive help you will not be protected against Us.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تَجْأَرُواْ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّكُمْ مِّنَّا لاَ تُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. Invoke not loudly this day! Certainly, you shall not be helped by Us. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (My revelations) the Qur'an (were recited) and shown (unto you, but ye used to turn back on your heels) to your initial religion,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Indeed, My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and refusing with hatred to listen to them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily My signs in the Qur’ān used to be recited to you but you used to take to your heels falling back in retreat

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ كَانَتْ آيَاتِي تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ فَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ أَعْقَابِكُمْ تَنكِصُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Indeed, My Verses used to be recited to you, but you used to turn back on your heels (denying them, and refusing with hatred to listen to them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (In scorn thereof) feeling haughty because of the Holy House, claiming that you are its guardians. (Nightly did you rave together) you cursed Muhammad (pbuh) his Companions and the Qur'an in your nightly gatherings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِراً تَهْجُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. In pride , talking evil about it (the Qur’ān) by night..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: disdainful of embracing faith because of it that is because of the Sacred House or the Meccan Sanctuary and their being inhabitants thereof secure in contrast to the situation with all other peoples in their hometowns while in your night sessions sāmiran is a circumstantial qualifier in other words they come together to converse at night around the Sacred House you talked nonsense’ if read as tahjurūna the third form from hajara means while ‘you disregarded’ the Qur’ān; but if read as the fourth form tuhjirūna from ahjara it means while ‘you speak falsehood’ about the Prophet and the Qur’ān.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُسْتَكْبِرِينَ بِهِ سَامِراً تَهْجُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. In pride , talking evil about it (the Qur’ān) by night..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Have they not pondered the Word) have they not reflected upon the Qur'an and that which it contains of threats, (or hath that come unto them) upon the people of Mecca, of safety and freedom from obligation (which came not unto their fathers of old?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَآءَهُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allāh, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet ), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Have they not contemplated yaddabbarū should actually be yatadabbarū but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl the discourse namely the Qur’ān that is proof of the Prophet’s sincerity or has there come upon them that which has not come upon their forefathers?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلْقَوْلَ أَمْ جَآءَهُمْ مَّا لَمْ يَأْتِ آبَآءَهُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allāh, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet ), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Or know they not their messenger) the lineage of their Messenger, (and so reject him) and so deny him?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muḥammad ) so they deny him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or is it that they do not recognise their own Messenger and so they reject him?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَمْ يَعْرِفُواْ رَسُولَهُمْ فَهُمْ لَهُ مُنكِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. Or is it that they did not recognize their Messenger (Muḥammad ) so they deny him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or say they) indeed they say: (There is a madness in him? Nay, but he bringeth them the Truth) Muhammad (pbuh) brought them the Qur'an, the profession of Allah's divine Oneness and the Message; (and most of them are haters) deniers (of the Truth) of the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَآءَهُمْ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. Or say they: “There is madness in him?” Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. Tauḥīd: Worshipping Allāh Alone in all aspects, the Qur’ān and the religion of Islām], but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they say ‘There is a madness in him’? — this interrogative is meant as an affirmation of the truth of the Prophet’s sincerity and of the fact that messengers did come to past communities and of the fact that they do indeed recognise their Messenger to be truthful and trustworthy and of the fact that there is no madness in him. Nay bal is for transition he has brought them the truth namely the Qur’ān that comprises affirmations of the Oneness of God and the Laws of Islam; but most of them are averse to the truth.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ بِهِ جِنَّةٌ بَلْ جَآءَهُمْ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. Or say they: “There is madness in him?” Nay, but he brought them the truth [i.e. Tauḥīd: Worshipping Allāh Alone in all aspects, the Qur’ān and the religion of Islām], but most of them (the disbelievers) are averse to the truth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if the Truth had followed their desires) if it was according to their whims such that there is a deity in the heavens and a deity in the earth, (verily the heavens and the earth and whosoever is therein) of created beings (had been corrupted. Nay, We have brought them their Reminder) We sent Gabriel to their Prophet with the Qur'an wherein lies their glory and honour, (but from their Reminder) but from their glory and honour (they now turn away) they disbelieve.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder (the Qur’ān), but they turn away from their reminder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if the truth namely the Qur’ān had followed their desires and come to them with mention of what they fancied in the way of God having a partner and a child may God be exalted above such associations indeed the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been corrupted they the heavens and the earth would have deviated from their observed order because contradictions would ensue as is usually the case when there is more than one ruler. Nay We have brought them their Remembrance namely the Qur’ān in which they are remembered and honoured but they are disregardful of their own Remembrance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْحَقُّ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ لَفَسَدَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهِنَّ بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِذِكْرِهِمْ فَهُمْ عَن ذِكْرِهِمْ مُّعْرِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. And if the truth had been in accordance with their desires, verily, the heavens and the earth, and whosoever is therein would have been corrupted! Nay, We have brought them their reminder (the Qur’ān), but they turn away from their reminder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or dost thou ask of them) or do you ask, O Muhammad, the people of Mecca (any tribute) some payment, and this is why they are not responding? (But! the bounty of your Lord) in Paradise (is better) is better than what they have in the life of this world, (for He is best of all who make provision) in this world and in the next.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجاً فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّازِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. Or is it that you (O Muḥammad ) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do you ask them for any recompense? any remuneration in return for the faith that you have brought them? Yet the recompense of your Lord is His remuneration His reward and His provision are better one reading has kharjan ‘recompense’ in both instances sc. kharjan fa-kharju; another has kharājan in both sc. kharājan fa-kharāju and He is the best of providers the best of givers and remunerators.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ خَرْجاً فَخَرَاجُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلرَّازِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. Or is it that you (O Muḥammad ) ask them for some wages? But the recompense of your Lord is better, and He is the Best of those who give sustenance..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! thou) O Muhammad (summonest them indeed unto a right path) to an established religion which Allah is pleased with: Islam.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. And certainly, you (O Muḥammad ) call them to a Straight Path (true religion — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly you summon them to a straight path a straight route that is the religion of Islam.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتَدْعُوهُمْ إِلَىٰ صِرَاطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. And certainly, you (O Muḥammad ) call them to a Straight Path (true religion — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! those who believe not in the Hereafter) those who do not believe in resurrection after death (are indeed astray from the path) from Allah's religion.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter in resurrection reward and punishment deviate swerve away from the path that is the route to salvation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ عَنِ ٱلصِّرَاطِ لَنَاكِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. And verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter are indeed deviating far astray from the Path (true religion — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Though We had mercy on them) i.e. the people of Mecca (and relieved them of the harm) and relieved them of the hunger which was (afflicting them, they still would wander blindly on) they still would carry on blind to the Truth and guidance (in their contumacy) in their disbelief and error.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And had We shown them mercy and relieved them of the harm afflicting them — the famine that befell them in Mecca for seven years — they would surely persist in their insolence in their error bewildered hesitating.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ رَحِمْنَاهُمْ وَكَشَفْنَا مَا بِهِمْ مِّن ضُرٍّ لَّلَجُّواْ فِي طُغْيَانِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. And though We had mercy on them and removed the distress which is on them, still they would obstinately persist in their transgression, wandering blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Already have We grasped them with punishment) with hunger and drought, (but they humble not themselves unto their Lord) but they did not submit themselves to their Lord by professing Allah's divine Oneness, (nor do they pray) nor do they believe,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. And indeed, We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allāh) with submission to Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We have already seized them with chastisement with hunger yet they did not humble themselves to their Lord nor did they devote themselves to prayer nor did they seek the pleasure of God through supplication.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَخَذْنَاهُمْ بِٱلْعَذَابِ فَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُواْ لِرَبِّهِمْ وَمَا يَتَضَرَّعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. And indeed, We seized them with punishment, but they humbled not themselves to their Lord, nor did they invoke (Allāh) with submission to Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Until) give them respite, O Muhammad, until (when We open for them the gate of extreme punishment) i.e. of hunger, (behold! they are aghast thereat) they despair of all goodness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَاباً ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. Until, when We open for them a gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Until hattā is for inceptiveness when We opened on them the gate of a severe chastisement namely the day of Badr slaying them behold! they are aghast thereat despairing of anything good.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ بَاباً ذَا عَذَابٍ شَدِيدٍ إِذَا هُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. Until, when We open for them a gate of severe punishment, then lo! they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He it is Who hath created for you) O people of Mecca (ears) with which to hear (and eyes) with which to see (and hearts) with which to comprehend. (Small thanks give ye) your thanks for all the things you have been given, O people of Mecca, is small!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلأَبْصَارَ وَٱلأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلاً مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. It is He Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), eyes (sight), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who made created for you hearing meaning ears and eyes and hearts. Little thanks do you show qalīlan mā mā emphasises the paucity of the thanks.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَنْشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلأَبْصَارَ وَٱلأَفْئِدَةَ قَلِيلاً مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. It is He Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), eyes (sight), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He it is Who hath sown you broadcast) created you (in the earth, and unto Him ye will be gathered) after you die, and then He will requite you according to your works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who dispersed created you on earth and to Him you shall be gathered resurrected.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي ذَرَأَكُمْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. And it is He Who has created you on the earth, and to Him you shall be gathered back..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He it is Who giveth life) upon resurrection (and causes death) in the life of this world, (and His is the difference of night and day) He changes the day and the night; He makes them come and go, increase and decrease in length; the brightness of day and darkness of night-all these are a sign that Allah will bring the dead back to life. (Have ye then no sense) do you then not believe in resurrection after death?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلاَفُ ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who gives life by breathing the Spirit into the embryo mudgha and brings death and due to Him is the alternation of night and day in darkness and brightness and through increase and diminution. Will you not then comprehend? His handiwork exalted be He and so reflect?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ وَلَهُ ٱخْتِلاَفُ ٱللَّيْلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. And it is He Who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of night and day. Will you not then understand?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but they) i.e. the people of Mecca (say the like of that which) disbelieve in resurrection after death in the same was as (said the men of old) the people of old disbelieved in resurrection after death;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قَالُواْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but they say the like of what the ancients said.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ قَالُواْ مِثْلَ مَا قَالَ ٱلأَوَّلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. Nay, but they say the like of what the men of old said. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They say: When we are dead and have become mere) scattered (dust and) decayed (bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again) after we have died?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً وَعِظَاماً أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. They said: “When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They the ancients said ‘What when we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we then be raised? No! the two hamzas in each of the two instances are either pronounced fully or with the second one not pronounced but with an alif inserted between the two hamzas in both readings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَاباً وَعِظَاماً أَإِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. They said: “When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We were already promised this) which you are promising us, O Muhammad, (we and our forefathers) before us, were also promised the same. (Lo! This) that which you are saying to us, O Muhammad, (is naught but fables) the mere talk and lies (of the men of old.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. “Verily, this we have been promised — we and our fathers before (us)! This is nothing but tales of the ancients!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Already We and our fathers have been promised this resurrection after death before these are nothing but the fables the lies of the ancients’ mere jokes and strange tales asātīr the plural of ustūra.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ وُعِدْنَا نَحْنُ وَآبَآؤُنَا هَـٰذَا مِن قَبْلُ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلاَّ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. “Verily, this we have been promised — we and our fathers before (us)! This is nothing but tales of the ancients!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad: (Unto Whom (belongeth) the earth and whosoever is therein) of created beings; answer me, (if ye have knowledge?)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. Say: “Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say to them ‘To whom does the earth and whoever is in it of creatures belong if you truly knew?’ their Creator and Owner.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُل لِّمَنِ ٱلأَرْضُ وَمَن فِيهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. Say: “Whose is the earth and whosoever is therein? If you know!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They will say: Unto Allah. Say) to them, O Muhammad: (Will ye not then remember) will you not then take heed and obey Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. They will say: “It is Allāh’s!” Say: “Will you not then remember?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will say ‘To God’. Say to them ‘Will you not then remember?’ tadhakkarūna the second tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl will you not then be admonished and so realise that the One Who has the power to originate creation also has the power to resurrect after death?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. They will say: “It is Allāh’s!” Say: “Will you not then remember?”.

tafsir: (Say) also to them, O Muhammad: (Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. Say: “Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the Great Throne?’ that is the throne kursī.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبْعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. Say: “Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?”.

tafsir: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth)) Allah created them. (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (Will ye not then keep duty (unto Him)) will you then not avoid the worship of other than Him?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. They will say: “Allāh.” Say: “Will you not then fear Allāh ?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will say ‘God’. Say ‘Will you not then be God-fearing?’ will you then not be wary of worshipping things other than Him?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ أَفَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. They will say: “Allāh.” Say: “Will you not then fear Allāh ?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) also to them, O Muhammad: (In Whose hand is the dominion over all things) in Whose hand is the store of all things (and He protecteth) and He judges, (while against Him there is no protection) while no judgement can be made upon him; it is also said that this means: He protects people from His chastisement but none can protect others from His chastisement, (if ye have knowledge?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجْيِرُ وَلاَ يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. Say “In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, , if you know?” [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘In whose hand is the dominion the possession of all things the final tā’ in malakūt is hyperbolic and who protects while from Him there is no protection if you know?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ مَن بِيَدِهِ مَلَكُوتُ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَهُوَ يُجْيِرُ وَلاَ يُجَارُ عَلَيْهِ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. Say “In Whose Hand is the sovereignty of everything (i.e. treasures of each and everything)? And He protects (all), while against Whom there is no protector, , if you know?” [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: They will say: Unto Allah (all that belongeth)) all that is through Allah's power. (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (How then are ye bewitched) then why do you lie about Allah; it is also said that this means, according to a different reading: see, O Muhammad, how they turn away because of lies?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. They will say: “(All that belongs) to Allāh.” Say: “How then are you deceived and turned away from the truth?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will say ‘God.’ a variant reading for Allāh ‘God’ in both instances verses 87 and 89 has li’Llāh ‘to God’ which is in keeping with the sense of ‘to whom belongs what has been mentioned?’. Say ‘How then are you bewitched?’ how then are you duped and turned away from the truth the worship of God alone in other words ‘How do you envisage all this to be invalid?’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَيَقُولُونَ لِلَّهِ قُلْ فَأَنَّىٰ تُسْحَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. They will say: “(All that belongs) to Allāh.” Say: “How then are you deceived and turned away from the truth?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but We have brought them the Truth) We sent Gabriel to their Prophet with the Qur'an in which it is stated that Allah has no son or partner, (and lo! they are liars) when they say the angels are Allah's daughters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islāmic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but We have brought them the truth veracity and they are indeed liars in rejecting it namely the truth of the following

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ أَتَيْنَاهُمْ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. Nay, but We have brought them the truth (Islāmic Monotheism), and verily, they (disbelievers) are liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Allah hath not chosen any son) from the Children of Adam nor are the angels His daughters, (nor is there any God along with Him) as partner; (else would) if the case was as they claim then (each God have assuredly championed that which he created) each god would take for himself that which he created, (and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah) Allah exonerated Himself (above all that they allege) of all their lies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَـهٍ إِذاً لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلاَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. No son (or offspring) did Allāh beget, nor is there any ilāh (god) along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified is Allāh above all that they attribute to Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God has not taken any son nor is there any god along with Him; for then that is if there were a god along with Him each god would have taken away what he created he would have made it exclusively his and prevented the other god from having any mastery over it; and some of them would surely rise up against others in challenge just as the kings of this world are wont to do. Glorified be God — an exaltation of Him — above what they ascribe to Him of what has been mentioned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٍ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَـهٍ إِذاً لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَـٰهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلاَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. No son (or offspring) did Allāh beget, nor is there any ilāh (god) along with Him. (If there had been many gods), then each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified is Allāh above all that they attribute to Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Knower of the invisible) that which is unseen by people; it is also said the invisible includes everything that will happen in the future (and the visible!) that which people know; it is also said that the visible includes everything that has already happened (and exalted be He over) Allah is far transcendent above (all that they ascribe as partners (unto Him)) of idols!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَالِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. All‑Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted is He over all that they associate as partners to Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Knower of the Unseen and the visible what is hidden and what is observed if read in the genitive ‘ālimi’l-ghaybi ‘Knower of the Unseen’ this is an adjectival qualification; if in the nominative ‘ālimu’l-ghaybi ‘the Knower of the Unseen this would be the predicate of an implied preceding huwa ‘He is’ and exalted magnified be He above what they associate! with Him of partners.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَالِمِ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَادَةِ فَتَعَالَىٰ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. All‑Knower of the unseen and the seen! Exalted is He over all that they associate as partners to Him!.

tafsir: (My Lord! then set me not among the wrong-doing folk) do not place me with the disbelieving people on the Day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. “My Lord! Then (save me from Your punishment), put me not amongst the people who are the Ẓālimūn (polytheists and wrong-doers).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: my Lord then do no put me among the evildoing folk’ lest I be destroyed when they are destroyed.

tafsir: (And verily We are Able to show thee) O Muhammad (that which We have promised them) of torment on the Day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muḥammad ) that with which We have threatened them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly We are able to show you what We promise them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّا عَلَىٰ أَن نُّرِيَكَ مَا نَعِدُهُمْ لَقَادِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. And indeed We are Able to show you (O Muḥammad ) that with which We have threatened them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Repel evil with that which is better) repel by means of " there is no god except Allah " the expression of idolatry which is coming from Abu Jahl and his host; and it is also said that this means: repel from yourself their indecent talk through the greeting of peace. (We are best Aware of that which they allege) of lies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. Repel evil with that which is better. We are Best-Knower of the things they utter..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Ward off with that which is better that is to say with the better trait of pardoning and shunning them the evil act the hurt they cause you — this was revealed before the command to fight them. We know best what they allege what they invent of lies and what they say and so We will requite them for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْفَعْ بِٱلَّتِي هِيَ أَحْسَنُ ٱلسَّيِّئَةَ نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَصِفُونَ

meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. And say: “My Lord! I seek refuge with You from the whisperings (suggestions) of the Shayāṭīn (devils)..

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That I may do right) and believe in You (in that which I have left behind) in the life of the world and disbelieved in! (But nay!) he will not be returned to the life of the world. (It) his saying: “Return me that I may do right” (is but a word that he speaketh) is just a mere expression that he utters and which will not benefit him; (and behind them) in front of them (is a barrier) the grave (until the day when they are raised) from the graves.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَعَلِّيۤ أَعْمَلُ صَالِحاً فِيمَا تَرَكْتُ كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا كَلِمَةٌ هُوَ قَآئِلُهَا وَمِن وَرَآئِهِمْ بَرْزَخٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 100. “So that I may do good in that which I have left behind!” No! It is but a word that he speaks; and behind them is Barzakh (a barrier) until the Day when they will be resurrected..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: that I might act righteously by witnessing that ‘there is no god but God’ that this might be in that which I have left behind’ in what I have wasted of my life in other words that this affirmation might be in its place. God exalted be He says By no means! that is there shall be no return. It namely the statement ‘My Lord!
