meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا تَرَاءَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَابُ مُوسَىٰ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. And when the two hosts saw each other, the companions of Mūsā (Moses) said: “We are sure to be overtaken.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Moses said: (Nay) they have not, (verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me) He will save me from them and guide me to the right way.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ كَلاَّ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. [Mūsā (Moses)] said: “Nay, verily, with me is my Lord. He will guide me.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Moses said ‘Certainly not! they shall not catch us up; indeed I have my Lord with me to provide assistance. He will guide me’ to the route of deliverance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ كَلاَّ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. [Mūsā (Moses)] said: “Nay, verily, with me is my Lord. He will guide me.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We inspired Moses, saying: Smite the sea with thy staff. And) when he hit it (it parted) into 12 roads, (and each part) and each road (was as a mountain vast) like a huge mountain.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. Then, We revealed to Mūsā (Moses) (saying): “Strike the sea with your stick.” And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Thereupon We revealed to Moses ‘Strike the sea with your staff’ and he struck it whereupon it parted it split into twelve parts and each part was as a mighty mountain between each of these parts were paths which they followed such that not even the saddles or the felts of the riders were touched by water.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. Then, We revealed to Mūsā (Moses) (saying): “Strike the sea with your stick.” And it parted, and each separate part (of that sea water) became like huge mountain..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then brought We near the others to that place) then We kept Pharaoh and his people in the cloud, and it is said in the sea, and all of them were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. Then, We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And there We brought near the others Pharaoh and his folk until they followed them across the same paths.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. Then, We brought near the others [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) party] to that place..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We saved Moses and those with him, every one) from drowning;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. And We saved Mūsā (Moses) and all those with him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him by bringing them out of the sea while it was in the state mentioned above.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. And We saved Mūsā (Moses) and all those with him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We drowned the others) Pharaoh and his host in the sea.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Then We drowned the others..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We drowned the others Pharaoh and his folk by closing the sea on them after they had entered the sea and the Children of Israel had exited therefrom.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Then We drowned the others..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers) most of them were not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. Verily, in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely in that drowning of Pharaoh and his folk there is a sign a lesson for those generations who would come after them; but most of them are not believers in God. The only ones to believe were Āsiya — Pharaoh’s wife — Hizqīl the believing man of Pharaoh’s family and Maryam daughter of Nāmūsī she who pointed out the bone remains of the prophet Joseph peace be upon him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. Verily, in this is indeed a sign (or a proof), yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, since He saved them from drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty for He wrought vengeance upon the disbelievers by drowning them the Merciful to believers delivering them from drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Recite unto them) unto Quraysh, your people (the story of Abraham) the event of Abraham in the Qur'an:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. And recite to them the story of Ibrāhīm (Abraham)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And recite to them the disbelievers of Mecca the tiding the tale of Abraham Ibrāhīma is substituted by the following idh qāla ‘when he said’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. And recite to them the story of Ibrāhīm (Abraham)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When he said unto his father) Azar (and his folk) the idol worshippers: (What worship ye) Abraham said to them: what do you worship?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. When he said to his father and his people: “What do you worship?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when he said to his father and his people ‘What do you worship?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. When he said to his father and his people: “What do you worship?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: We worship idols) deities, (and are ever devoted unto them) we worship them and remain devoted to their worship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَاماً فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. They said: “We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘We worship idols — they reiterate the verb in the response in order to supplement it with the following remark — and remain cleaving to them’ we remain worshipping them all day; they give a longer response to indicate their misplaced pride in such an act.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَاماً فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَاكِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. They said: “We worship idols, and to them we are ever devoted.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Do they hear you when ye cry) do these deities answer you when you call upon them?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. He said: “Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘Do they hear you when you supplicate?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. He said: “Do they hear you, when you call on (them)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or do they benefit) you in your livelihood when you obey them (or harm you) in your livelihood when you disobey them?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. “Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they bring you benefit when you worship them or harm? to you if you do not?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. “Or do they benefit you or do they harm (you)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Nay, but we found our fathers acting on this use) we found our fathers worshipping these deities, and we have emulated them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ آبَآءَنَا كَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. They said: “(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Rather we found our fathers so doing’ that is doing the same as we do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ آبَآءَنَا كَذَلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. They said: “(Nay) but we found our fathers doing so.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said: (See now that which ye worship,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. He said: “Do you observe that which you have been worshipping —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘Have you considered what you have been worshipping

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَفَرَأَيْتُمْ مَّا كُنْتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. He said: “Do you observe that which you have been worshipping —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Ye and your forefathers!) before you,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُمُ ٱلأَقْدَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. “You and your ancient fathers?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: you and your ancestors?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنتُمْ وَآبَآؤُكُمُ ٱلأَقْدَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. “You and your ancient fathers?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me) and I disassociate myself from them, (save the Lord of the Worlds) except the worship of the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِيۤ إِلاَّ رَبَّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. “Verily, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They are indeed hateful to me I do not worship them; but the Lord of the Worlds I do worship Him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِيۤ إِلاَّ رَبَّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. “Verily, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who created me) from a sperm drop, (and He doth guide me) He preserves me on the right religion and guides me to the Truth and guidance,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. “Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Who created me it is He Who guides me to the proper religion

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَنِي فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. “Who has created me, and it is He Who guides me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Who feedeth me) He provides for me and gives me my full when I am hungry (and watereth me) and gives me to drink when I am thirsty.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. “And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and provides me with food and drink

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِي هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِي وَيَسْقِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. “And it is He Who feeds me and gives me to drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when I sicken, then He healeth me) He cures me from sickness when I am sick,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. “And when I am ill, it is He who cures me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when I am sick it is He Who cures me;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. “And when I am ill, it is He who cures me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Who causeth me to die) in this worldly life, (then giveth me life (again)) on the Day of Judgement,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. “And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and Who will make me die then give me life

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِي يُمِيتُنِي ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. “And Who will cause me to die, and then will bring me to life (again)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Who, I ardently hope, will forgive me my sin on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning. His sins being his pretending that he was sick, and claiming that it was the biggest idol that smashed the smaller ones and also that his wife was his sister.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِيۤ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. “And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and Who I hope will forgive me my iniquity on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِيۤ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِي خَطِيئَتِي يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. “And Who, I hope, will forgive me my faults on the Day of Recompense, (the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom) understanding and knowledge (and unite me to the righteous) to my forefathers, the messengers, in Paradise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْماً وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. My Lord! Bestow Ḥukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: My Lord! Grant me unerring judgement knowledge and unite me with the righteous the prophets.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْماً وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. My Lord! Bestow Ḥukm (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And give unto me a good report) a good mention (in later generations) those who come after me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And confer on me a worthy repute excellent praise among posterity those who will come after me up to the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. And grant me an honourable mention in later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Delight) and make me among the dwellers of the Garden of Bliss,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss among those who will be given it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And make me one of the inheritors of the Paradise of Delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And forgive my father) and guide my father through me. (Lo! he is of those who err) he is in error, a disbeliever.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لأَبِيۤ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. And forgive my father, verily, he is of the erring..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And forgive my father for indeed he is one of those who are astray by Your relenting to him and forgiving him this was before it became clear to him Abraham that he his father was an enemy of God as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a Q. 9114.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱغْفِرْ لأَبِيۤ إِنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. And forgive my father, verily, he is of the erring..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And abase me not) and do not chastise me (on the day when they are raised) from the graves,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And do not disgrace me do not expose me on the day when they mankind are resurrected;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تُخْزِنِي يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. And disgrace me not on the Day when (all the creatures) will be resurrected..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The day when wealth) the abundance of wealth (and sons) and abundance of sons (avail not (any man),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلاَ بَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: of which day God exalted be He says the following the day when neither wealth nor children will avail anyone

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلاَ بَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. The Day whereon neither wealth nor sons will avail,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Save him who bringeth unto Allah a whole heart) a heart free of sins and love for this worldly life; it is also said that this means: a heart free of hatred for the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. Except him who comes to Allāh with a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifāq (hypocrisy)].”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except him who comes to God with a heart that is sound free from idolatry and hypocrisy — and this is the heart of the believer whom such things will avail.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. Except him who comes to Allāh with a clean heart [clean from Shirk (polytheism) and Nifāq (hypocrisy)].”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the Garden will be brought nigh for those who ward off (evil)) disbelief, idolatry, and indecencies, becoming thus their abode.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqūn (the pious) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And Paradise will be brought near for the God-fearing and they will be able to see it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqūn (the pious) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hell will appear plainly to the erring) to the disbelievers, becoming thus their abode.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and Hell will be revealed plainly for the perverse the disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. And the (Hell) Fire will be placed in full view of the erring..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And it will be said unto them) it will be said to the idol worshippers: (Where is (all) that ye used to worship) of idols in the life of the world,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. And it will be said to them: “Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allāh) that you used to worship..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it will be said to them ‘Where is that which you used to worship

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. And it will be said to them: “Where are those (the false gods whom you used to set up as rivals with Allāh) that you used to worship..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Instead of Allah? Can they help you) can they help you to avoid Allah's chastisement (or help themselves) or help themselves to avoid Allah's chastisement?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. “Instead of Allāh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: besides God? that is other than Him in the way of idols. Do they help you by averting from you the chastisement or do they help one another?’ by averting it from themselves? No neither!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. “Instead of Allāh? Can they help you or (even) help themselves?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then they will be hurled therein) they will be cast all together in hell, (they) the disbelievers of Mecca and all the disbelievers among human beings (and the seducers) the disbelievers of the jinn and their deities,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكُبْكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghāwūn (devils, and those who were in error)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then they will be hurled cast into it they and the perverse

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكُبْكِبُواْ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Then they will be thrown on their faces into the (Fire), they and the Ghāwūn (devils, and those who were in error)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the hosts of Iblis) the offspring of Iblis, (together) who are the satans.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. And the whole hosts of Iblīs (Satan) together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the hosts of Iblīs his followers and those jinn and humans who were obedient to him all together.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. And the whole hosts of Iblīs (Satan) together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they) i.e. the disbelievers (will say, when they are quarrelling) with their deities, leaders and the offspring of Iblis (therein) in hell:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. They will say, while contending therein,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They the perverse shall say as they wrangle therein with those whom they used to worship

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. They will say, while contending therein,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By Allah, of a truth we were in error manifest) in the life of the world,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. By Allāh, we were truly in a manifest error,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘By God we had indeed in softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted in other words it would usually be innahu been in manifest error

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِي ضَلاَلٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. By Allāh, we were truly in a manifest error,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds) in relation to worship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when we equated you in worship with the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُمْ بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. When We held you (false gods) as equals (in worship) with the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It was but the guilty) the idolaters who came before us and whom we emulated (who misled us) who turned us away from faith and obedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimūn [Iblīs (Satan) and those human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it was none other than the sinners the devils or our predecessors whose example we were following that led us astray from guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And none has brought us into error except the Mujrimūn [Iblīs (Satan) and those human beings who commit crimes, murderers, polytheists, oppressors]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Now we have no intercessors) from amongst the angels, prophets or righteous people who may intercede for us,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 100. Now, we have no interces sors,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So now we have no intercessors as the believers have in the way of angels prophets and other believers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَافِعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 100. Now, we have no interces sors,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nor any loving friend) nor anyone close who might be interested in our plight.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 101. Nor a close friend (to help us)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: nor any sympathetic friend who might be concerned for us.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 101. Nor a close friend (to help us)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Oh, that we had another turn) in the life of the world, (that we might be of the believers!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 102. (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: If only we had another turn another return to this world we would have been among those who believe!’ law ‘if only’ here is for the conditional optative to which nakūna ‘we would have been’ constitutes the response.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 102. (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! Herein) in that which I have mentioned of their states (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition, (yet most of them are not believers!) that is, if they were to have another turn in the life of the world; it is also said that this means: they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 103. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely in that which is mentioned of the tale of Abraham and his people there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 103. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord! He is Indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 104. And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 104. And verily, your Lord, He is truly the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah)) i.e. they denied Noah and all the other messengers who were mentioned by Noah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 105. The people of Nūḥ (Noah) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The people of Noah denied the messengers by denying him for they all brought the same message affirming God’s Oneness; or it is because he stayed among them for so long that it was as though he was many messengers the feminine person of the verb kadhdhabat ‘denied’ governed by qawm ‘the people’ is on account of the import but it is masculine on account of its morphological form;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 105. The people of Nūḥ (Noah) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet; he was not their brother in religion but only in kinship (Noah said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 106. When their brother Nūḥ (Noah) said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when Noah their brother — their brother only in terms of lineage — said to them ‘Will you not fear? God?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 106. When their brother Nūḥ (Noah) said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) faithful in conveying the message; it is also said that this means: I was deemed very trustworthy in your eyes before this, so how could you doubt me today, (unto you) from Allah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 107. “I am a trustworthy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you to deliver the Message with which I have been sent.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 107. “I am a trustworthy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 108. “So fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God and obey me in what I enjoin you to of God’s Oneness and obedience to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 108. “So fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my provision (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 109. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for it for delivering it; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 109. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my advice.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 110. “So, keep your duty to Allāh, fear Him and obey me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God and obey me’ — he repeats this statement for emphasis.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 110. “So, keep your duty to Allāh, fear Him and obey me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Shall we put faith in thee) shall we believe in you, O Noah, (when the lowest (of the people) follow thee) when our most lowly and weak have followed you? We will not believe in you until you repulse them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلأَرْذَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 111. They said: “Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Shall we believe in you in your words when it is the lowliest people who follow you?’ wa’ttaba‘aka a variant reading has wa-atbā‘uka ‘when your followers’ plural of tābi‘ ‘follower’ as a subject the riffraff such as the weavers and the shoemakers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلأَرْذَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 111. They said: “Shall we believe in you, when the meanest (of the people) follow you?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Noah said: (And what knowledge have I of what they may have been doing (in the past)) I do not know whether it is you or them who will agree with me?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 112. He said: “And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘And what do I know of what they may have been doing?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِي بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 112. He said: “And what knowledge have I of what they used to do?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! their reckoning) their reward and sustenance (is my Lord's concern, if ye but knew) this;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 113. “Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Their reckoning is only my Lord’s concern and He will requite them if only you were aware — had you known this you would not have reviled them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّي لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 113. “Their account is only with my Lord, if you could (but) know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And I am not (here) to repulse believers) from the worship of Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنَاْ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 114. “And I am not going to drive away the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And I am not about to drive away the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنَاْ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 114. “And I am not going to drive away the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (I am only a plain warner) I am only a Messenger warning you of a curse that you know well.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ أَنَا إِلاَّ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 115. I am only a plain warner.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I am just a plain warner’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ أَنَا إِلاَّ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 115. I am only a plain warner.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: If thou cease not) from what you are saying, (O Noah, thou wilt surely be among those stoned (to death)) we will kill you just as we killed the strangers who believed in you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 116. They said: “If you cease not, O Nūḥ (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death).” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘Lo! if you do not desist O Noah from what you say to us you will assuredly be among those assailed’ with stones or curses.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ لَئِنْ لَّمْ تَنْتَهِ يٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 116. They said: “If you cease not, O Nūḥ (Noah) you will surely be among those stoned (to death).” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Noah said: (My Lord! Lo! my own folk deny me) regarding the message, and have killed those strangers who believed in me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 117. He said: “My Lord! Verily, my people have denied me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Noah said ‘My Lord my people have denied me

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِي كَذَّبُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 117. He said: “My Lord! Verily, my people have denied me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgement) a fair judgement, (and save me and those believers who are with me) from their torment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحاً وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِي مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 118. Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so judge conclusively between me and them and deliver me and the believers who are with me’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحاً وَنَجِّنِي وَمَن مَّعِي مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 118. Therefore judge You between me and them, and save me and those of the believers who are with me.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We saved him and those with him) among the believers (in the laden ship) and it was only waiting to sail away.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 119. And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He exalted be He says So We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark the ship filled with humans animals and birds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنجَيْنَاهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُ فِي ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 119. And We saved him and those with him in the laden ship..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then afterward We drowned the others) i.e. the rest of his people, after Noah boarded the ship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 120. Then, We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then afterwards after We delivered them We drowned the rest of his people.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 120. Then, We drowned the rest (disbelievers) thereafter..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did with them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 121. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 121. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo, thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against them when He drowned them, (the Merciful) towards the believers when He saved them from drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 122. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 122. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((The tribe of) 'Aad denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Hud denied Hud as well as all the messenger whom Hud had mentioned to them,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 123. ‘Ād (people) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Ād denied the messengers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 123. ‘Ād (people) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet (Hud said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 124. When their brother Hūd said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when Hūd their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 124. When their brother Hūd said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger) I am faithful regarding the message (unto you) from Allah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 125. “Verily, I am a trustwor thy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 125. “Verily, I am a trustwor thy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so obey Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) in that which I command you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 126. “So fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God and obey me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 126. “So fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment (therefore) for professing Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 127. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 127. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn, and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Build ye on every high place a monument for vain delight?) you beat up any stranger who passes by you and steal his clothes; this can also be understood in this manner: do you build in every marketplace a sign by means of which you scoff at whoever passes by you?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 128. “Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do you build on every prominence every high place a monument an edifice as a signpost for passers-by so that you may hurl abuse? at those who pass by you and deride them ta‘bathūna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb tabnūna ‘you build’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ آيَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 128. “Do you build high palaces on every high place, while you do not live in them?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And seek ye out strongholds) houses, palaces and pools, (that haply ye may last for ever) in this worldly life? Nay, you will not last for ever!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 129. “And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein forever?(1) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And you set up structures for extracting water underground that perhaps you might as though you will last forever therein and not die.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 129. “And do you get for yourselves palaces (fine buildings) as if you will live therein forever?(1) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if ye seize by force, seize ye as tyrants?) And when you punish, you do so in the manner of the tyrants: you beat up and kill in a state of anger.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 130. “And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when you assault to smite or slay you assault like tyrants mercilessly!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُمْ بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 130. “And when you seize (somebody), seize you (him) as tyrants?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Rather keep your duty to Allah) rather, fear Allah regarding that which He has commanded you of repentance and faith, (and obey me) and follow my way.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 131. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God in this and obey me in what I have commanded you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 131. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Keep your duty towards Him) fear Him (who hath aided) provided (you with (the good things) that ye know),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 132. “And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And fear Him Who has provided you Who has been gracious to you in a way that you know

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيۤ أَمَدَّكُمْ بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 132. “And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Then He explained what He provided them with, saying: (Hath aided ye with cattle and sons) He gave you cattle and sons.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 133. “He has aided you with cattle and children..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: provided you with cattle and sons

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمَدَّكُمْ بِأَنْعَامٍ وَبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 133. “He has aided you with cattle and children..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And gardens and water springs) and pure water.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 134. “And gardens and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and gardens orchards and springs rivers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 134. “And gardens and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! I fear for you) I know you will be visited by (the retribution of an awful day) in the Fire, if you do not repent of disbelief, idolatry and idol worship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّيۤ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 135. “Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of a tremendous day’ in this world and in the Hereafter should you disobey me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّيۤ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 135. “Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest) you warn us (or art not of those who preach) or you are a warner to us;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ ٱلْوَاعِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 136. They said: “It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘It is the same to us whether you admonish us or are not one of those who admonish anyway. In other words we will not heed your admonition.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُنْ مِّنَ ٱلْوَاعِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 136. They said: “It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This) that in which we are now (is but a fable of the men of old) the religion of the people of old; the religion of our forefathers; it is also said that this means: what you say is nothing but the invention of the people of old,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ خُلُقُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 137. “This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: This that you threaten us with is merely the fabrication of the ancients that is their inventions and lies a variant reading for khalq ‘fabrication’ is khuluq ‘ethos’ in other words this denial of resurrection to which we adhere is merely ‘the ethos of the ancients’ in other words their nature and wont;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ خُلُقُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 137. “This is no other than the false tales and religion of the ancients, [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we shall not be doomed) for adhering to this religion, as you claim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 138. “And we are not going to be punished.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and we will not be chastised’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 138. “And we are not going to be punished.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they denied him) they disbelieved in his message and in what he said to them; (therefore We destroyed them) by the wind. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition to those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 139. So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they denied him concerning the chastisement whereupon We destroyed them in this world with the barren wind cf. Q. 5141. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 139. So they denied him, and We destroyed them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord, He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers, for He saved them from the wind.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 140. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 140. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)) the people of Salih denied Salih just as they denied all the messengers that Salih mentioned to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 141. Thamūd (people) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Thamūd denied the messengers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 141. Thamūd (people) denied the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When their brother) their Prophet (Salih said unto them: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلا تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 142. When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when Sālih their brother said to them ‘Will you fear God?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَالِحٌ أَلا تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 142. When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them: “Will you not fear Allāh and obey Him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) I am a Messenger from Allah to you, and I am faithful as regards the message I bring,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 143. “I am a trustworthy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 143. “I am a trustworthy Messenger to you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you of repentance and faith (and obey me) and follow my way and religion.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 144. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God and obey me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 144. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And I ask of you no wage) no payment or provision (therefore) in exchange for the profession of Allah's divine Oneness; (my wage) my reward (is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 145. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَسْأَلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِنْ أَجْرِيَ إِلاَّ عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 145. “No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islāmic Monotheism); my reward is only from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Will ye be left secure) from death, cessation or punishment (in that which is here before us) of bounties,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَآ آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 146. “Will you be left secure in that which you have here?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Will you be left secure in that which is here of good things —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَاهُنَآ آمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 146. “Will you be left secure in that which you have here?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (In gardens and water springs) pure water

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 147. “In gardens and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: amid gardens and springs

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 147. “In gardens and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And tilled fields and heavy sheathed palm-trees) bearing ripe and seemly fruits,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 148. And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and farms and date palms with slender delicate and tender spathes?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 148. And green crops (fields) and date-palms with soft spadix..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Though ye hew out dwellings in the mountain, being skilful?) it is also said that this means: feeling proud of, and haughty about, your farms.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتاً فَارِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 149. “And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And you hew dwellings out of the mountains arrogantly a variant reading of farihīna ‘arrogant’ has fārihīn ‘skilfully’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتاً فَارِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 149. “And you hew out in the mountains, houses with great skill..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore keep your duty to Allah) fear Allah regarding that which He commanded you (and obey me) and follow my way and advice,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 150. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So fear God and obey me in what I have commanded you

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 150. “So, fear Allāh, keep your duty to Him, and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And obey not the command of the prodigal) and obey not the words of the idolaters,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تُطِيعُوۤاْ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 151. “And follow not the command of Al-Musrifūn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and do not obey the command of the prodigal

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تُطِيعُوۤاْ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 151. “And follow not the command of Al-Musrifūn [i.e. their chiefs: leaders who were polytheists, criminals and sinners],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who spread corruption in the earth) through disbelief, idolatry and calling to the worship of other than Allah, (and reform not) they do not command righteousness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ يُصْلِحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 152. “Who make mischief in the land, and reform not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: who cause corruption in the earth through acts of disobedience and act righteously’ by being obedient to God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلاَ يُصْلِحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 152. “Who make mischief in the land, and reform not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a prophet;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 153. They said: “You are only of those bewitched!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched those who have succumbed so many times to sorcery that their minds have been overcome.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 153. They said: “You are only of those bewitched!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just like we do. (So bring some token) a sign to prove what you claim (if thou art of the truthful) that the punishment is coming and that you are a Messenger to us.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 154. “You are but a human being like us. Then, bring us a sign, if you are of the truthful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And moreover you are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign if you are sincere’ in your Mission.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِآيَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 154. “You are but a human being like us. Then, bring us a sign, if you are of the truthful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Salih said to them: ((Behold) this she-camel) she is a sign that I am sent as a prophet to you. (She hath the right to drink (at the well)) one day, (and ye have the right to drink) another day, ((each) on an appointed day) i.e. in alternate days: one day for you and one day for her.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 155. He said: “Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink a share of the water and you shall drink each on a known day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 155. He said: “Here is a she-camel: it has a right to drink (water), and you have a right to drink (water) (each) on a day, known..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And touch her not with ill) do not hamstrung her (lest there come on you the retribution of an awful day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 156. “And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And do not cause her any harm for then you shall be seized by the chastisement of an awful day’ awful because of the awfulness of the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوۤءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 156. “And touch her not with harm, lest the torment of a Great Day should seize you.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: But they hamstrung her) they killed her, (and then were penitent) and they regretted killing her.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُواْ نَادِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 157. But they killed her, and then they became regretful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But they hamstrung her — a group of them hamstrung her with the approval of others; and then became remorseful for having hamstrung it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَعَقَرُوهَا فَأَصْبَحُواْ نَادِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 157. But they killed her, and then they became regretful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So the retribution came on them) after three days. (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them, (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and were all disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 158. So, the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they were seized by the chastisement which had been promised and were destroyed. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 158. So, the torment overtook them. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord) O Muhammad! (He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

tafsir: (Wrong not mankind in their goods) do not diminish people's due in measurement and weight, (and do not evil, making mischief, in the earth) do not commit transgressions and corruption in the land by giving less in measurement and weight and calling to the worship of other than Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَبْخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلاَ تَعْثَوْاْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 183. “And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and do not defraud people in their goods do not diminish anything of what is due to them and do not be degenerate in the earth seeking corruption by killing or otherwise ta‘thaw ‘degenerate’ derives from ‘athiya meaning afsada ‘to corrupt’; mufsidīna ‘seeking corruption’ is a circumstantial qualifier emphasising the import of its operator ta‘thaw.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَبْخَسُواْ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلاَ تَعْثَوْاْ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 183. “And defraud not people by reducing their things, nor do evil, making corruption and mischief in the land..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And keep your duty unto) and fear (Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old) He created the people of old before you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 184. “And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And fear Him Who created you and the former generations’ all creation before you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكُمْ وَٱلْجِبِلَّةَ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 184. “And fear Him Who created you and the generations of the men of old.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: thou art but one of the bewitched) you are neither an angel nor a Prophet;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 185. They said: “You are only one of those bewitched!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 185. They said: “You are only one of those bewitched!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou art but a mortal) a human being (like us) you eat and drink just as we do, (and lo! we deem thee of the liars) in what you claim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 186. “You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: You are just a human being like us. And we indeed in softened in place of the hardened form its subject omitted in other words it would be innahu think that you are one of the liars.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلاَّ بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 186. “You are but a human being like us and verily, we think that you are one of the liars!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us) as punishment, (if thou art of the Truthful) that the punishment is coming.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 187. “So, cause pieces of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then make fragments read kisfan or kisafan of the heaven fall upon us if you are of the truthful’ in your Mission.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 187. “So, cause pieces of the heaven to fall on us, if you are of the truthful!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Shu'ayb said: (My Lord is best aware of what ye do) in your state of disbelief, and He is more aware of you and your punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّيۤ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 188. He said: “My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘My Lord knows best what you are doing’ and will requite you for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّيۤ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 188. He said: “My Lord is the Best Knower of what you do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so there came on them the retribution of the day of gloom) the punishment came in the form of a cloud that stopped above them and burned them with its heat. (Lo! it was the retribution of an awful day) it was a severe day of chastisement for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 189. But they denied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed, that was the torment of a Great Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But they denied him so they were seized by the chastisement of the day of the shade al-zulla — a cloud which gave them shade when they suffered a bout of extreme heat but which then rained down fire on them and they were incinerated. Assuredly it was the chastisement of a tremendous day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 189. But they denied him, so the torment of the day of shadow (a gloomy cloud) seized them. Indeed, that was the torment of a Great Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Herein) in that which We did to them (is indeed a portent) a sign and an admonition for those who came after them; (yet most of them are not believers) they were not believers and most of them were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 190. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ لآيَةً وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 190. Verily, in this is indeed a sign, yet most of them are not believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! thy Lord! He is indeed the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 191. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 191. And verily, your Lord, He is indeed the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! it is) i.e. the Qur'an (a revelation) an address (of the Lord of the Worlds),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 192. And truly, this (the Qur’ān) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly it the Qur’ān is the revelation of the Lord of the Worlds

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَتَنزِيلُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 192. And truly, this (the Qur’ān) is a revelation from the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Which the True Spirit hath brought down) Allah sent down Gabriel, the trustworthy Gabriel, to convey the message to His prophets,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلأَمِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 193. Which the trustworthy Rūḥ [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] has brought down.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: brought down by the Trustworthy Spirit Gabriel

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَزَلَ بِهِ ٱلرُّوحُ ٱلأَمِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 193. Which the trustworthy Rūḥ [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] has brought down.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn
