tafsir: (Upon your heart) according to your memorisation; it is also said that this means: when it was recited to you, (that thou mayst be (one) of the warners) by means of the Qur'an,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنْذِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 194. Upon your heart (O Muḥammad ) that you may be (one) of the warners,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: upon your heart that you may be one of the warners

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَىٰ قَلْبِكَ لِتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنْذِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 194. Upon your heart (O Muḥammad ) that you may be (one) of the warners,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (In plain Arabic speech) He says: the Qur'an is in the Arabic usage; it is also said that this means: inform them, O Muhammad, using their own language.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 195. In the plain Arabic language..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: in a clear Arabic tongue a variant reading for nazala ‘he brought down’ verse 193 has nuzzila ‘was sent down’ and al-rūha ‘the Spirit’ in the accusative the subject of the verb being God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بِلِسَانٍ عَرَبِيٍّ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 195. In the plain Arabic language..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo, it is) i.e. the description of the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) (in the Scriptures of the men of old) is written in the Scriptures of the prophets who came before you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 196. And verily, it (the Qur’ān, and its revelation to Prophet Muḥammad ) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurāt (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly it the allusion to the Qur’ān that would be revealed to Muhammad (s) is in the Scriptures the Books of the ancients such as the Torah and the Gospel.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَفِي زُبُرِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 196. And verily, it (the Qur’ān, and its revelation to Prophet Muḥammad ) is (announced) in the Scriptures [i.e. the Taurāt (Torah) and the Injeel (Gospel)] of former people..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Is it not a token) a sign for the prophethood of Muhammad, Allah bless him and give peace, (for them) for the people of Mecca (that the doctors of the Children of Israel know it?) That is, when they asked them about Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and they informed them about both.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوَ لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 197. Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullāh ibn Salām I who embraced Islām) (1) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Is it not a sign of this fact for them for the disbelievers of Mecca that the learned of the Children of Israel recognise it? those such as ‘Abd Allāh b. Salām and his companions from among those who became Muslim believers they are able inform you of this read yakun with āyatan in the accusative or takun with āyatun in the nominative.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوَ لَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ آيَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُ عُلَمَاءُ بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 197. Is it not a sign to them that the learned scholars (like ‘Abdullāh ibn Salām I who embraced Islām) (1) of the Children of Israel knew it (as true)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if We had revealed it) and if We sent Gabriel with the Qur'an (unto one of any other nation than the Arabs) to a person who spoke no Arabic,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلأَعْجَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 198. And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ān) to any of the non-Arabs,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For had We revealed it to some non-Arabs a‘jamūn is the plural of a‘jam

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ نَزَّلْنَاهُ عَلَىٰ بَعْضِ ٱلأَعْجَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 198. And if We had revealed it (this Qur’ān) to any of the non-Arabs,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he had read it unto them) unto Quraysh, (they would not have believed in it) i.e. in the Qur'an, because they did not believe in what was in their own language, so how were they to believe in something which is in a different language?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 199. And he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and had he recited it to them that is to the disbelievers of Mecca they would not have believed in it disdaining to follow it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَرَأَهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا بِهِ مُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 199. And he had recited it to them, they would not have believed in it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus do We make it) the denial (traverse the hearts of the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 200. Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ān) to enter the hearts of the Mūjrimūn (criminals, polytheists, sinners)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So in the same way in which We would have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of disbelievers had it been recited by a non-Arab We have caused denial of it to penetrate the hearts of the criminals the Meccan disbelievers when Muhammad (s) recites it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ سَلَكْنَاهُ فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 200. Thus have We caused it (the denial of the Qur’ān) to enter the hearts of the Mūjrimūn (criminals, polytheists, sinners)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They will not believe in it) so that they do not believe in Muhammad (pbuh) or in the Qur'an (till they behold the painful doom,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَلِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 201. They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will not believe in it until they behold the painful chastisement

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُاْ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَلِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 201. They will not believe in it until they see the painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: So that it) the torment (will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not) the coming of the punishment upon them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 202. It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so that it will come upon them suddenly while they are not aware.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَيَأْتِيَهُم بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 202. It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then they will say) when the punishment comes upon them: (Are we to be reprieved) from the punishment?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 203. Then they will say: “Can we be respited?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Thereupon they will say ‘Shall we be granted any respite?’ that we might become believers?; and it shall be said to them ‘No!’ and they will say ‘When will this chastisement be?’ God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَيَقُولُواْ هَلْ نَحْنُ مُنظَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 203. Then they will say: “Can we be respited?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Would they (now) hasten on Our doom) the coming of Our punishment?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 204. Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 204. Would they then wish for Our Torment to be hastened on?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Hast thou then seen) O Muhammad, (We content them for (long) years) in their state of disbelief,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 205. Think! (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Consider this then — inform Me If We were to let them enjoy life for many years

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَرَأَيْتَ إِن مَّتَّعْنَاهُمْ سِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 205. Think! (even) if We do let them enjoy for years,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And then cometh that which they were promised) of punishment,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 206. And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then there were to come on them that which they have been promised of chastisement

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ جَآءَهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 206. And afterwards comes to them that (punishment) which they had been promised,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((How) that wherewith) Allah's punishment (they were contented) because of the reprieve (naught availeth them) from Allah's punishment?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 207. All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: in what way mā here is interrogative would that enjoyment which they were given avail them? in averting the chastisement or mitigating it? It would be of no avail!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يُمَتَّعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 207. All that with which they used to enjoy shall not avail them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We destroyed no township) no inhabitants of any township (but it had its warners) warning messengers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 208. And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We have not destroyed any town but it had warners messengers to warn its inhabitants;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلاَّ لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 208. And never did We destroy a township but it had its warners..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (For reminder) they remind them of Allah's punishment, (for We never were oppressors) by destroying them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 209. By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as a reminder an admonition for them; for We were never unjust for We destroy them only after they have been warned. The following was revealed to refute what the idolaters were saying

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذِكْرَىٰ وَمَا كُنَّا ظَالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 209. By way of reminder, and We have never been unjust. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The devils) at the time of the Prophet (pbuh) (did not bring it down) did not bring the Qur'an down.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 210. And it is not the Shayāṭīn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ān) down..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It the Qur’ān has not been brought down by the devils.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَنَزَّلَتْ بِهِ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 210. And it is not the Shayāṭīn (devils) who have brought it (this Qur’ān) down..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It is not meet for them) the devils are not fit to do so, (nor is it in their power) nor could they do this,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 211. Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Neither would it behove befit them to bring it down nor are they capable of doing that.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنبَغِي لَهُمْ وَمَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 211. Neither would it suit them, nor they can (produce it)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! verily they) i.e. the devils (are banished from the hearing) they are prevented from hearing the revelation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 212. Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly they are barred restrained with blazing stars from the hearing of the sayings of the angels.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّمْعِ لَمَعْزُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 212. Verily, they have been removed far from hearing it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore invoke not) worship not (with Allah another god) among the idols, (lest thou be one of the doomed) in the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 213. So, invoke not with Allāh another ilāh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So do not invoke any other god with God lest you be among the chastised — if you were to do what they call you to.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 213. So, invoke not with Allāh another ilāh (god) lest you should be among those who receive punishment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And warn thy tribe of near kindred) your blood relations,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلأَقْرَبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 214. And warn your tribe (O Muḥammad ) of near kindred (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And warn the nearest of your kinsfolk namely the Banū Hāshim and the Banū al-Muttalib ‘He the Prophet warned them publicly …’ as reported by al-Bukhārī and Muslim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنذِرْ عَشِيرَتَكَ ٱلأَقْرَبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 214. And warn your tribe (O Muḥammad ) of near kindred (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lower thy wing (in kindness) unto those believers who follow thee) be kind to the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 215. And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And lower your wing show your gentle side to the believers the affirmers of God’s Oneness who follow you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 215. And be kind and humble to the believers who follow you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if they) the Quraysh (disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do) and say.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 216. Then, if they disobey you, say: “I am innocent of what you do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But if they your kinsfolk disobey you say to them ‘I am absolved of what you do’ in worshipping gods other than God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّي بَرِيۤءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 216. Then, if they disobey you, say: “I am innocent of what you do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And put thy trust in the Mighty) in His retribution against His enemies, (the Merciful) towards you and all believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَوكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 217. And put your trust in the All‑Mighty, the Most Merciful,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And put your trust wa-tawakkal or read fa-tawakkal ‘then put your trust’ in the Mighty the Merciful God in other words entrust Him with all your affairs

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَوكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 217. And put your trust in the All‑Mighty, the Most Merciful,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who seeth thee when thou standest up) in prayer,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 218. Who sees you (O Muḥammad ) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Who sees you when you stand for prayer

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي يَرَاكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 218. Who sees you (O Muḥammad ) when you stand up (alone at night for Tahajjud prayers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (seeth) thine abasement among those who fall prostrate (in worship)) among those who pray in their bowing, prostration and standing up; it is also said that this means: in the loins of your forefathers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 219. And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allāh in the five compulsory congregational prayers). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and your movements — in performing the various parts of prayer standing sitting bowing and prostrating — among those who prostrate those who perform the prayers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَقَلُّبَكَ فِي ٱلسَّاجِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 219. And your movements among those who fall prostrate (to Allāh in the five compulsory congregational prayers). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! He, only He, is the Hearer) of what they say, (the Knower) of them and of their works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 220. Verily, He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly He is the Hearing the Knowing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 220. Verily, He, only He, is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend) with fortune telling?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 221. Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayāṭīn (devils) descend?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Shall I inform you O disbelievers of Mecca upon whom the devils descend? tanazzalu one of the tā’ letters in the original tatanazzalu has been omitted.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَاطِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 221. Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayāṭīn (devils) descend?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They descend on every sinful, false one) they descend on every sinful fortune teller: Musaylimah the liar and Talhah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 222. They descend on every lying, sinful person..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They descend upon every sinful profligate liar such as Musaylama and other soothsayers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَنَزَّلُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 222. They descend on every lying, sinful person..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They listen eagerly) the devils listen eagerly to the speech of the angels, (but most of them are liars) the devils are liars because they hear one thing and convey instead 100 things to fortune tellers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 223. Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They the devils report the heard sayings what they hear from the angels they report to the soothsayers but most of them are liars adding much that is false to what they hear — this was revealed before the devils were barred from the heaven.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُلْقُونَ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمْ كَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 223. Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the Unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (As for poets) 'Abdullah Ibn al-Zib'ari and his host who composed poetry, (the erring follow them) those who transmit poetry relate it from them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 224. As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: As for the poets only the perverse follow them in their poetry propounding it and reciting it on their behalf to others; they are thus reprehensible.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلشُّعَرَآءُ يَتَّبِعُهُمُ ٱلْغَاوُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 224. As for the poets, the erring ones follow them,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Hast thou not seen how they) the poets (stray) they come and go, sometimes eulogizing and sometimes satirizing (in every valley) in every genre and theme,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 225. See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people — right or wrong) in their poetry?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Have you not noticed that — are you not aware that — in every valley of the valleys of rhetoric and the art thereof they rove overstepping the bounds of decency in their eulogies and diatribes

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِي كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 225. See you not that they speak about every subject (praising people — right or wrong) in their poetry?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And how they say) in their poetry (that which they do not?) they keep mentioning “I” and “I” when things are not as they say; it is also said that this means: they say things which they cannot do; and hence both poet and narrator are in error.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 226. And that they say what they do not do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and that they say we do what they do not do? in other words that they lie.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ يَقُولُونَ مَا لاَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 226. And that they say what they do not do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an, like Hassan Ibn Thabit and his fellow believing poets (and do good works) between them and their Lord, (and remember Allah much) in their poetry, (and vindicate themselves) through Muhammad (pbuh) and his Companions by answering back the disbelievers (after they have been wronged) after being satirized by the disbelievers. (Those who do wrong) those who satirized the Prophet (pbuh) and his Companions (will come to know by what a (great) reverse they will be overturned!) what kind of destination they will return to in the Hereafter, i.e. the Fire, if they do not believe. And Allah knows best the secrets of His Book'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيراً وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ وَسَيَعْلَمْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 227. Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allāh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Save those poets who believe and perform righteous deeds and remember God frequently in other words those whom poetry does not distract from the remembrance of God and vindicate themselves by lampooning the disbelievers after they have been wronged by the disbelievers’ reviling of them as belonging together with all believers — such individuals are not reprehensible. God exalted be He says God does not like the utterance of evil words out loud unless a person has been wronged Q. 4148; He exalted be He also says so whoever commits aggression against you commit aggression against him in the manner that he committed against you Q. 2194; and those poets and others who are wrongdoers will soon know the reversal the return with which they will meet by which they will return after death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ وَذَكَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيراً وَٱنتَصَرُواْ مِن بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُواْ وَسَيَعْلَمْ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوۤاْ أَيَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 227. Except those who believe (in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism) and do righteous deeds, and remember Allāh much, and vindicate themselves after they have been wronged [by replying back in poetry to the unjust poetry (which the pagan poets utter against the Muslims)]. And those who do wrong will come to know by what overturning they will be overturned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ta. Sin.): '(Ta. Sin.) He says: the (Ta) stands for His might (tawluh) and the (Sin) stands for His majesty (sana'uh); it is also said that it is an oath by which Allah swore. (These are revelations of the Qur'an and a Scripture that maketh plain) this surah consists of verses of the Qur'an and it is a Book that makes plain the lawful and the unlawful;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: طسۤ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Tā-Sīn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān, and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Qur’ān, and (it is) a Book (that makes things) clear:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Tā sīn God knows best what He means by these letters. Those namely these signs are the signs of the Qur’ān signs from it and a Manifest Book manifesting what is truth from what is falsehood wa-kitābin ‘Book’ is a supplement to al-qur’ān with the addition of an adjective mubīn ‘manifest’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: طسۤ تِلْكَ آيَاتُ ٱلْقُرْآنِ وَكِتَابٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Tā-Sīn. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān, and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]. These are the Verses of the Qur’ān, and (it is) a Book (that makes things) clear:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A guidance) from error (and good tidings) that they will gain Paradise (for believers) who are true in their faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allāh (i.e. Islāmic Monotheism)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is a guidance guiding from error and good tidings for the believers who believe in it of Paradise;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هُدًى وَبُشْرَىٰ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. A guide (to the Right Path) and glad tidings for the believers [who believe in the Oneness of Allāh (i.e. Islāmic Monotheism)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then showed the attributes of these true believers, saying: (Who establish worship) those who complete the five daily prayers along with their necessary ritual ablution, bowing, prostrating and all that which is obligated in their due times (and pay the poor-due) from their wealth (and are sure of) they believe in (the Hereafter) resurrection after death, Paradise and hell.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلاَةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِٱلآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Those who perform Aṣ-Ṣalāt (Iqāmat-aṣ-Ṣalāt) and give Zakāt and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who observe prayer performing it in the way that it should be performed and give alms and who are certain of the Hereafter knowing it to be true through the many proofs thereof hum ‘they’ is repeated because a separation has taken place between it the first hum and the predicate yūqinūna.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُقِيمُونَ ٱلصَّلاَةَ وَيُؤْتُونَ ٱلزَّكَاةَ وَهُم بِٱلآخِرَةِ هُمْ يُوقِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Those who perform Aṣ-Ṣalāt (Iqāmat-aṣ-Ṣalāt) and give Zakāt and they believe with certainty in the Hereafter (resurrection, recompense of their good and bad deeds, Paradise and Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! as for those who believe not in the Hereafter) those who do not believe in resurrection after death: Abu Jahl and his host, (We have made their works fair-seeming unto them) in their state of disbelief (so that they are all astray) so they proceed blindly, unable to see.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair‑seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter We have adorned their vile deeds for them by making such deeds seem sensuous so that they then deem them wholesome and so they are bewildered confused about why We deem these deeds to be vile.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلآخِرَةِ زَيَّنَّا لَهُمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَهُمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Verily, those who believe not in the Hereafter, We have made their deeds fair‑seeming to them, so that they wander about blindly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those) who have this attribute (are they for whom is the worst of punishment) a severe chastisement in the Fire, (and in the Hereafter) on the Day of Judgement (they will be the greatest losers) they will loose Paradise and enter the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوۤءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي ٱلآخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلأَخْسَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Those are they for whom there is an awful chastisement the worst chastisement in this world being killed or being taken captive; and in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers because they will end up in the Fire which has been made everlasting for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَهُمْ سُوۤءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ وَهُمْ فِي ٱلآخِرَةِ هُمُ ٱلأَخْسَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. They are those for whom there will be an evil torment (in this world). And in the Hereafter they will be the greatest losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! as for thee) O Muhammad, (thou verily receivest the Qur'an) He says: Gabriel comes down to you with the Qur'an (from the presence of One Wise) in His command and judgement, (Aware) of His created beings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْآنَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And verily, you (O Muḥammad ) are being taught the Qur’ān from One, All-Wise, All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly you — this is an address to the Prophet s — are receiving the Qur’ān it is being transmitted to you intensely from One Wise Knowing in such transmission.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكَ لَتُلَقَّى ٱلْقُرْآنَ مِن لَّدُنْ حَكِيمٍ عَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And verily, you (O Muḥammad ) are being taught the Qur’ān from One, All-Wise, All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Remember) when Moses said unto his household) when he became unsure about the way: (Lo! I spy afar off a fire) on the left side of the road; stay here (I will bring you tidings thence) news about the right way to take, (or bring to you a borrowed flame that ye may warm yourselves) because this happened in a cold winter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لأَهْلِهِ إِنِّيۤ آنَسْتُ نَاراً سَآتِيكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. (Remember) when Mūsā (Moses) said to his household: “Verily, I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Mention when Moses said to his family to his wife during his journey from Midian back to Egypt ‘Assuredly I notice I see in the distance a fire. I will bring you news from there about the journey’s route — for he had lost his way — or bring you a firebrand read as a genitive annexation bi-shihābi qabasin as an explication of shihāb ‘flame’; or read without annexation bi-shihābin qabasin meaning a flame of fire at the end of a wick or a wooden stick that perhaps you might warm yourselves’ tastalūn the tā’ replaces the tā’ of the 8th verbal form ifta‘ala sc. istalā; it derives from salaya or saliya ‘to be exposed to the blaze of fire’ that perhaps you might warm yourselves from the cold.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ مُوسَىٰ لأَهْلِهِ إِنِّيۤ آنَسْتُ نَاراً سَآتِيكُمْ مِّنْهَا بِخَبَرٍ أَوْ آتِيكُمْ بِشِهَابٍ قَبَسٍ لَّعَلَّكُمْ تَصْطَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. (Remember) when Mūsā (Moses) said to his household: “Verily, I have seen a fire; I will bring you from there some information, or I will bring you a burning brand, that you may warm yourselves.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But when he reached it, he was called, saying: Blessed is whosoever is in the Fire) blessed is the Fire (and whosoever is round about it) of angels! This is the reading of Ubayy and 'Abdullah Ibn Mas'ud; it is also said that this means: blessed is He Who lightened this light; and it also said that this means: blessed is he who is seeking, i.e. Moses and whoever is around him of angels, (And glorified be Allah) He exonerated Himself, (the Lord of the Worlds!) the Master of the jinn and human beings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. But, when he came to it, he was called: “Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified is Allāh, the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But when he reached it he was called with the following words ‘Blessed is he that is to say God bless him who is in the fire namely Moses and who is around it namely the angels — or vice-versa the verb bāraka may be followed immediately by the direct object or by a preposition and then the direct object; a noun such as makān ‘location’ is implied after fī ‘in’ sc. man fī makāni’l-nār ‘who is in the area of the fire’; and Glory be to God the Lord of the Worlds — this is included in the call and is meant to declare that God is above all evil associations.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهَا نُودِيَ أَن بُورِكَ مَن فِي ٱلنَّارِ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهَا وَسُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. But, when he came to it, he was called: “Blessed is Whosoever is in the fire, and whosoever is round about it! And glorified is Allāh, the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (O Moses! Lo! it is I) Who is calling you, (Allah, the Mighty) in retribution against those who do not believe in Me, (the Wise) in My command and judgement, I command that none should be worshipped besides Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰمُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. “O Mūsā (Moses)! Verily, it is I, Allāh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: O Moses lo! in other words the fact is that it is I God the Mighty the Wise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰمُوسَىٰ إِنَّهُ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. “O Mūsā (Moses)! Verily, it is I, Allāh, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And throw down thy staff) from your hand! And he threw it, (But when he saw it writhing) moving (as it were a demon) like a serpent which is neither big nor small, (he turned to flee headlong) from it and did not look back out of fear; but Allah said to him: (O Moses! Fear not! Lo! the emissaries fear not in My presence,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِراً وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يٰمُوسَىٰ لاَ تَخَفْ إِنِّي لاَ يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “And throw down your stick!” But when he saw it moving, as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) “O Mūsā (Moses)! Fear not: verily, the Messengers fear not in front of Me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Throw down your staff’ and he threw it down. And when he saw it wriggling moving like a serpent a slender snake he turned his back in flight and did not come back. God exalted be He says ‘O Moses do not fear it. Surely in My presence before Me the messengers do not fear any snake or otherwise

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقِ عَصَاكَ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا تَهْتَزُّ كَأَنَّهَا جَآنٌّ وَلَّىٰ مُدْبِراً وَلَمْ يُعَقِّبْ يٰمُوسَىٰ لاَ تَخَفْ إِنِّي لاَ يَخَافُ لَدَيَّ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “And throw down your stick!” But when he saw it moving, as if it were a snake, he turned in flight, and did not look back. (It was said:) “O Mūsā (Moses)! Fear not: verily, the Messengers fear not in front of Me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving) I forgive the one who repents, (Merciful) I show mercy towards he who dies in a state of repentance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْناً بَعْدَ سُوۤءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. “Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except him who has wronged his soul but then changed his wrong for good — he then performs good deeds — after having done evil in other words he has repented then truly I am Forgiving Merciful I will accept his repentance and forgive him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسْناً بَعْدَ سُوۤءٍ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. “Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good; then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And put thy hand into the bosom of thy robe) in your armpit, (it will come forth white but unhurt) without having contracted leprosy. Go! ((This will be one) among nine tokens) go with nine signs (unto Pharaoh and his people) the Copts. (Lo! they were ever evil-living folk) they were disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوۤءٍ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. “And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people. Verily, they are a people who are Fāsiqūn (rebellious, disobedient to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And insert your hand into your bosom into the collar of your shirt and it will emerge not in its usual skin colour but white without any blemish any vestige of leprosy with a glare that dazzles the eyes as one sign among nine signs with which you shall be sent as God’s messenger to Pharaoh and his folk; indeed they are an immoral lot’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَدْخِلْ يَدَكَ فِي جَيْبِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوۤءٍ فِي تِسْعِ آيَاتٍ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَقَوْمِهِ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. “And put your hand into your bosom, it will come forth white without hurt. (These are) among the nine signs (you will take) to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) and his people. Verily, they are a people who are Fāsiqūn (rebellious, disobedient to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But when Our tokens came unto them) when Moses went with our tokens to them, (plain to see) demonstrating, one after the other, (they said: This is mere magic) what you have brought us, O Moses, is a manifest lie,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. But when Our Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: “This is manifest magic.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But when Our signs came to them plain to see illuminating and clear they said ‘This is manifest sorcery’ clear and evident sorcery.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ آيَاتُنَا مُبْصِرَةً قَالُواْ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. But when Our Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: “This is manifest magic.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they denied them) they denied the tokens, (though their souls acknowledged them) after being accepted by their souls that they were from Allah, (for spite) out of opposition and enmity (and arrogance) and haughtiness and pride. (Then see) O Muhammad (the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers) how was the end result of the idolaters, Pharaoh and his people, how We destroyed them in the sea!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْماً وَعُلُوّاً فَٱنْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And they denied them (those Āyāt) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their own selves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Āyāt) are from Allāh, and Mūsā (Moses) is the Messenger of Allāh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mūsā (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidūn (disbelievers, disobedient to Allāh, evil-doers and liars.)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they denied them they did not affirm them though in reality their souls had been convinced in other words though they were certain that these signs were from God wrongfully and arrogantly in defiance of believing in what Moses had brought these two adverbs refer back to the cause of their denial. So behold O Muhammad (s) how was the sequel for the agents of corruption a sequel which you know they were destroyed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسْتَيْقَنَتْهَآ أَنفُسُهُمْ ظُلْماً وَعُلُوّاً فَٱنْظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ ٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And they denied them (those Āyāt) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their own selves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Āyāt) are from Allāh, and Mūsā (Moses) is the Messenger of Allāh in truth, but they disliked to obey Mūsā (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidūn (disbelievers, disobedient to Allāh, evil-doers and liars.)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We verily gave knowledge) and understanding through prophethood and judgeship (unto David) the son of Jesse (and Solomon) the son of David, (and they said) both of them: (Praise be to Allah) thanks and gratitude to Allah, (Who hath preferred us) through knowledge and prophethood (above many of His believing slaves!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْماً وَقَالاَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And indeed We gave knowledge to Dāwūd (David) and Sulaimān (Solomon), and they both said: “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s, Who has preferred us to many of His believing slaves!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We gave David and Solomon his son knowledge of rendering decisive judgement between people and knowledge of the speech of birds and of other things and they said giving thanks to God ‘Praise be to God Who has favoured us with prophethood and the disposal of jinn humans and devils to our service over many of His believing servants’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَا دَاوُودَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ عِلْماً وَقَالاَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِي فَضَّلَنَا عَلَىٰ كَثِيرٍ مِّنْ عِبَادِهِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And indeed We gave knowledge to Dāwūd (David) and Sulaimān (Solomon), and they both said: “All praise and thanks are Allāh’s, Who has preferred us to many of His believing slaves!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And Solomon was David's heir) as king instead of all the other sons of David who were 19 in number. (And he said) Solomon said: (O mankind! Lo! we have been taught) we were given the understanding of (the language of birds, and have been given (abundance) of all things) and we were given the knowledge of everything in my kingdom. (This surely is evident favour) this is surely a great blessing from Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And Sulaimān (Solomon) inherited (the knowledge of) Dāwūd (David). He said: “O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is evident grace (from Allāh).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And Solomon inherited from David prophethood and knowledge exclusively from among all his other children; and he said ‘O people we have been taught the speech of the birds that is the ability to understand their sounds and we have been given of all things given to prophets and kings. Indeed this gift is the manifest the evident favour’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَوَرِثَ سُلَيْمَانُ دَاوُودَ وَقَالَ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ عُلِّمْنَا مَنطِقَ ٱلطَّيْرِ وَأُوتِينَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْفَضْلُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And Sulaimān (Solomon) inherited (the knowledge of) Dāwūd (David). He said: “O mankind! We have been taught the language of birds, and on us have been bestowed all things. This, verily, is evident grace (from Allāh).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And there were gathered together) and made subservient (unto Solomon his armies of the jinn and humankind, and of the birds, and they were set in battle order) they were all retained from the first to the last until they were gathered together;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسْلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْس وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And there were gathered before Sulaimān (Solomon) his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And on one journey Solomon’s hosts of jinn and humans and birds stood assembled for him as they were being arrayed brought together in groups and marshalled.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَحُشِرَ لِسْلَيْمَانَ جُنُودُهُ مِنَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلإِنْس وَٱلطَّيْرِ فَهُمْ يُوزَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And there were gathered before Sulaimān (Solomon) his hosts of jinn and men, and birds, and they all were set in battle order (marching forward)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Till, when they reached the Valley of the Ants) in Historic Syria, (an ant exclaimed: O ants! Enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his armies crush you) step on you, (unperceiving) unaware of you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَآ أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لاَ يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: “O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimān (Solomon) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When they came to the Valley of the Ants — which is located either in Tā’if or in Syria and whose ants are either small or large — an ant the queen ant who had seen Solomon’s hosts said ‘O ants enter your dwellings lest Solomon and his hosts crush you while they are unaware!’ — the ants are likened to rational beings in their use of the latter’s speech.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَآ أَتَوْا عَلَىٰ وَادِ ٱلنَّمْلِ قَالَتْ نَمْلَةٌ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّمْلُ ٱدْخُلُواْ مَسَاكِنَكُمْ لاَ يَحْطِمَنَّكُمْ سُلَيْمَانُ وَجُنُودُهُ وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Till, when they came to the valley of the ants, one of the ants said: “O ants! Enter your dwellings, lest Sulaimān (Solomon) and his hosts should crush you, while they perceive not.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (Solomon) smiled, laughing) in amazement (at her speech) because he heard her speech while his army did not, (and said: My Lord, arouse me) inspire in me (to be thankful for Thy favour wherewith Thou hast favoured me) you have blessed me with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness (and my parents) whom you also blessed with the profession of Allah's divine Oneness, (and to do good) in all sincerity (that shall be pleasing unto Thee) that you would accept (and include me in (the number of) Thy righteous slaves) and include me with Your righteous slaves in Paradise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكاً مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيۤ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيۤ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحاً تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. So he [Sulaimān (Solomon)] smiled, amused at her speech(1) and said: “My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Whereat he Solomon smiled fa-tabassama the beginning of the sentence amused dāhikan the end of the sentence at its words which he had heard from three miles away and which was carried to him by the winds. When he was on the verge of entering their valley he Solomon made his hosts halt until they the ants had entered their dwellings — on this journey his hosts consisted of cavalry and infantry. And he said ‘My Lord inspire me to be thankful for Your grace with which You have favoured me and my parents and to do good that will please You and include me by Your mercy among Your righteous servants’ the prophets and saints.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَبَسَّمَ ضَاحِكاً مِّن قَوْلِهَا وَقَالَ رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِيۤ أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ ٱلَّتِيۤ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَىٰ وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحاً تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. So he [Sulaimān (Solomon)] smiled, amused at her speech(1) and said: “My Lord! Grant me the power and ability that I may be grateful for Your Favours which You have bestowed on me and on my parents, and that I may do righteous good deeds that will please You, and admit me by Your Mercy among Your righteous slaves.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he sought among the birds) he inspected the birds (and said) when he could not see the hoopoe among them: (How is it that I see not the hoopoe) in his place, (or is he among the absent?)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لاَ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. He inspected the birds, and said: “What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And he reviewed the birds to see the hoopoe — which would locate water beneath the ground and indicate its location by pecking at it whereupon the devils would extract it for Solomon required it for when he prayed; but he could not see him — then he said ‘Why is it that I do not see the hoopoe? in other words is there something preventing me from seeing him? Or is he among the absent? and so I cannot see him because he is absent?’ And when he became certain of the hoopoe’s absence

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَفَقَّدَ ٱلطَّيْرَ فَقَالَ مَالِيَ لاَ أَرَى ٱلْهُدْهُدَ أَمْ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْغَآئِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. He inspected the birds, and said: “What is the matter that I see not the hoopoe? Or is he among the absentees?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: He said: if he is among the absent, then (I verily will punish him with hard punishment) I will pluck out his feathers; such was the punishment of the birds, (or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse) an acceptable excuse.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَاباً شَدِيداً أَوْ لأَاْذبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. “I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘Assuredly I will chastise him with a severe chastisement by having all his feathers as well as his tail plucked and leaving him out in the sun where he would not be able to escape from reptiles or I will slaughter him by slitting his throat unless he brings me read la-ya’tiyannī or la-ya’tinannī a clear warrant’ plain manifest proof for his having a valid excuse.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لأُعَذِّبَنَّهُ عَذَاباً شَدِيداً أَوْ لأَاْذبَحَنَّهُ أَوْ لَيَأْتِيَنِّي بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. “I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But he was not long in coming, and he said: I have found out (a thing) that thou apprehendest not) O king! I reached a place that you have not reached and have come to know that which you do not, (and I come unto thee from Sheba) the city of Sheba (with sure tidings) with an amazing, true information.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. But the hoopoe stayed not long: he (came up and) said: “I have grasped (the knowledge of a thing) which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’ (Sheba) with true news..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But he did not remain read fa-makutha or fa-makatha long in absence in other words he was away only for a short while and came to Solomon humbly with his head up and his wings and tail lowered. Solomon pardoned him and asked him about what he had encountered during his absence and he said ‘I have discovered something of which you have no knowledge and I have brought you from Sheba this may be read in declined form min Saba’in or left as indeclinable min Saba’a — a tribe in Yemen whose name is taken from the name of one of their ancestors which is also the reason why it may be declined — a verified report.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَكَثَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ فَقَالَ أَحَطتُ بِمَا لَمْ تُحِطْ بِهِ وَجِئْتُكَ مِن سَبَإٍ بِنَبَإٍ يَقِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. But the hoopoe stayed not long: he (came up and) said: “I have grasped (the knowledge of a thing) which you have not grasped and I have come to you from Saba’ (Sheba) with true news..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! I found a woman ruling over them) whose name is Balqis, (and she hath been given (abundance) of all things) she has been given the knowledge of all things in her country, (and hers is a mighty throne) adorned with gems, pearls, gold and silver.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I found a woman ruling over them in other words she was their queen her name Bilqīs; and she has been given an abundance of all things that kings might require in the way of machines and instruments and she possesses a great throne — its length was 80 cubits its width 40 cubits its height 30 cubits and was made of gold and silver encrusted with pearls rubies chrysolite and emeralds with its legs made of rubies chrysolite and emeralds containing seven inner doors the door of each chamber shut.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمْرَأَةً تَمْلِكُهُمْ وَأُوتِيَتْ مِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَلَهَا عَرْشٌ عَظِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “I found a woman ruling over them: she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of Allah; and Satan maketh their works) their worship of the sun (fair-seeming unto them, and debarreth them from the way (of Truth)) the devil has barred them from the way of Truth and guidance, (so that they go not aright) to the way of truth and guidance:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لاَ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “I found her and her people worshipping the sun, instead of Allāh, and Shaiṭān (Satan) has made their deeds fair‑seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allāh’s) Way: so they have no guidance.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of God and Satan has adorned for them their deeds and he has barred them from the Way from the path of truth so that they are not guided

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَدتُّهَا وَقَوْمَهَا يَسْجُدُونَ لِلشَّمْسِ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فَصَدَّهُمْ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ فَهُمْ لاَ يَهْتَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “I found her and her people worshipping the sun, instead of Allāh, and Shaiṭān (Satan) has made their deeds fair‑seeming to them, and has barred them from (Allāh’s) Way: so they have no guidance.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So that they worship not Allah) and I said to them: “O you, prostrate to Allah” it is also said that it is Solomon who said: “why do they not prostrate to Allah?” (Who bringeth forth the hidden in the heavens) the rain (and the earth) vegetation, (and knoweth what ye hide) of good and evil (and what ye proclaim) of good and evil,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَّ يَسْجُدُواْ للَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. [As Shaiṭān (Satan) has barred them from Allāh’s Way] so they do not worship (prostrate themselves before) Allāh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to prostrate themselves to God allā yasjudū should be read as an yasjudū the lā is extra and with it has been assimilated the nūn of an similar to the construction where God says li-allā ya‘lama ahlu’l-kitābi so that the People of the Scripture may know Q. 5729; the sentence functions as the direct object of yahtadūna ‘guided’ whose ilā ‘to’ has been omitted; He Who brings forth the hidden al-khab’ is a verbal noun with the same meaning as al-makhbū’ ‘that which is hidden’ of rain and plants in the heavens and the earth and He knows what they conceal within their hearts and what they proclaim with their tongues.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَّ يَسْجُدُواْ للَّهِ ٱلَّذِي يُخْرِجُ ٱلْخَبْءَ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تُخْفُونَ وَمَا تُعْلِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. [As Shaiṭān (Satan) has barred them from Allāh’s Way] so they do not worship (prostrate themselves before) Allāh, Who brings to light what is hidden in the heavens and the earth, and knows what you conceal and what you reveal. [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Allah; there is no God save Him, the Lord of the tremendous Throne.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Allāh, Lā ilāha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God — there is no god except Him the Lord of the Mighty Throne’ this clause constitutes an independent new sentence which is a eulogy comprising praise of the Throne of the Compassionate One to counter the description of the throne of Bilqīs between the two however is an unfathomable difference.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهُ لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Allāh, Lā ilāha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Solomon) said) to the hoopoe: (We shall see whether thou speakest truth or whether thou art of the liars.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. [Sulaimān (Solomon)] said: “We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Solomon said to the hoopoe ‘We shall see whether you have spoken the truth in what you have informed us or whether you are of the liars that is of their ilk — for to say that is rhetorically more powerful than simply saying ‘or whether you have lied’. He the hoopoe indicated to them the place of the water and it was extracted. They thus drank performed their ablutions and prayed. Solomon then composed a letter in the following form ‘From the servant of God Solomon son of David to Bilqīs Queen of Sheba. In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful Peace be upon those who follow Guidance. To wit do not rise up against me in defiance but come to me in submission’. He then stamped it with musk and sealed it with his ring and said to the hoopoe

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ سَنَنظُرُ أَصَدَقْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَاذِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. [Sulaimān (Solomon)] said: “We shall see whether you speak the truth or you are (one) of the liars..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Go with this my letter and throw it down unto them; then turn away) then move away such that they do not see you (and see what (answer) they return) when they read my letter,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَابِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what (answer) they return.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them that is to Bilqīs and her people then turn away withdraw from them but remain close by them and see what response they shall return’ and see what kind of response they shall give. Thus he took it and approached her Bilqīs. But as her soldiers were all around her he cast it into her private chamber. When she saw it she shuddered and was consumed by fear. She read what it said.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱذْهَب بِّكِتَابِي هَـٰذَا فَأَلْقِهْ إِلَيْهِمْ ثُمَّ تَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَٱنْظُرْ مَاذَا يَرْجِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Go you with this letter of mine, and deliver it to them, then draw back from them, and see what (answer) they return.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: He did as Solomon commanded, and Balqis took the letter and went to meet her entourage. ((The Queen of Sheba) said: O chieftains! Lo! there hath been thrown unto me a noble letter) a sealed letter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ إِنِّيۤ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. She said: “O chiefs! Verily, here is delivered to me a noble letter,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then she said to the noblemen of her people ‘O members of the council lo! read yā ayyuhā’l-mala’u innī pronouncing in the last two words both hamzas; or by not pronouncing the second one and changing it into a wāw with kasra vowelling a noble a sealed letter has been delivered to me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ إِنِّيۤ أُلْقِيَ إِلَيَّ كِتَابٌ كَرِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. She said: “O chiefs! Verily, here is delivered to me a noble letter,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! it is from Solomon, and lo! it is) the first line of it is: (In the name of Allah the Beneficent, the Merciful;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. “Verily, it is from Sulaimān (Solomon), and verily, it (reads): In the Name of Allāh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is from Solomon and lo! it is in other words its text says “In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِن سُلَيْمَانَ وَإِنَّهُ بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. “Verily, it is from Sulaimān (Solomon), and verily, it (reads): In the Name of Allāh, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Exalt not yourselves against me) feel not too haughty towards me, (but come unto me as those who surrender) and seek peace; as well as demanding other things which were mentioned in the letter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَّ تَعْلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. “Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims (true believers who submit to Allāh with full submis sion).’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do not rise up against me in defiance but come to me in submission”’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَّ تَعْلُواْ عَلَيَّ وَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. “Be you not exalted against me, but come to me as Muslims (true believers who submit to Allāh with full submis sion).’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (She said: O chieftains! Pronounce for me in my case) inform me about what I should do; it is also said that this means: advise me about what to do. (I decide no case) I will not do anything (till ye are present with me) and advise me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ أَفْتُونِي فِيۤ أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْراً حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. She said: “O chiefs! Advise me in (this) case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (and give me your opinions).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: She said ‘O members of the council give me an opinion read yā ayyuhā’l-mala’u aftūnī pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second and changing it into a wāw in other words guide me in this matter of mine. I never decide on a matter I never conclude it until you are present’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ أَفْتُونِي فِيۤ أَمْرِي مَا كُنتُ قَاطِعَةً أَمْراً حَتَّىٰ تَشْهَدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. She said: “O chiefs! Advise me in (this) case of mine. I decide no case till you are present with me (and give me your opinions).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: We are lords of might) we have weapons (and lords of great prowess) in war, (but it is for thee to command) we shall follow your command; (so consider what thou wilt command) and we will do it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ نَحْنُ أُوْلُو قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُو بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. They said: “We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said ‘We possess force and we possess great might in other words we are hardy in war. The matter is for you to decide. So see what you will command’ us and we will obey you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ نَحْنُ أُوْلُو قُوَّةٍ وَأُولُو بَأْسٍ شَدِيدٍ وَٱلأَمْرُ إِلَيْكِ فَٱنظُرِي مَاذَا تَأْمُرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. They said: “We have great strength, and great ability for war, but it is for you to command: so think over what you will command.” *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Then she pronounced words of wisdom. (She said: Lo! Kings) worldly kings, (when they enter a township) by force in instances of war and fighting, (ruin it) destroy it (and make the honour of its people shame) by beating, killing and exposing them to other things. (Thus will they do) Allah said: this is how worldly kings behave because of arrogance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوۤاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. She said: “Verily kings, when they enter a town (country), they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: She said ‘Indeed kings when they enter a town ruin it with destruction and reduce the mightiest of its inhabitants to the most abased. That is what they too will do namely the senders of this letter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَتْ إِنَّ ٱلْمُلُوكَ إِذَا دَخَلُواْ قَرْيَةً أَفْسَدُوهَا وَجَعَلُوۤاْ أَعِزَّةَ أَهْلِهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَكَذٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. She said: “Verily kings, when they enter a town (country), they despoil it and make the most honourable amongst its people the lowest. And thus they do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But lo! I am going to send a present unto them) to Solomon, (and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “But verily, I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Now I will send them a gift and wait to see with what response the envoys return’ in the way of accepting the gift or rejecting it. If it be a king to whom we have sent it he will accept it; but if it be a prophet he will reject it. Thus she sent male and female servants one thousand in total together with five hundred bricks of gold a crown studded with jewels and musk ambergris and other things with an envoy carrying a letter. The hoopoe thus hurried back to bring the news to Solomon who ordered bricks of gold and silver to be made and laid out across a vast square the distance of nine parasangs from his seat and for a towering wall of gold and silver to be constructed around it and for the most splendid creatures of the land and the sea together with the children of the jinn to be brought to line the right and left sides of the square.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي مُرْسِلَةٌ إِلَيْهِمْ بِهَدِيَّةٍ فَنَاظِرَةٌ بِمَ يَرْجِعُ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. “But verily, I am going to send him a present, and see with what (answer) the messengers return.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: So when (the envoy) came unto Solomon) when her envoy went to Solomon, ((the King) said: What! Would ye help me with wealth) with a gift? (But that which Allah hath given me) of prophethood and kingship (is better than that which He hath given you) of wealth. (Nay it is ye (and not I) who exult in your gift) if it were to be returned to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ آتَانِيَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ آتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. So, when (the messengers with the present) came to Sulaimān (Solomon), he said: “Will you help me in wealth? What Allāh has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But when he the envoy came to Solomon with the gift and the servants he said ‘Are you supplying me with wealth? What God has given me of prophethood and kingship is better than what He has given you of the things of this world. Nay but it is you and not I who exult in your gift for you pride yourselves upon the possession of the ornaments of this world!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ أَتُمِدُّونَنِ بِمَالٍ فَمَآ آتَانِيَ ٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّآ آتَاكُمْ بَلْ أَنتُمْ بِهَدِيَّتِكُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. So, when (the messengers with the present) came to Sulaimān (Solomon), he said: “Will you help me in wealth? What Allāh has given me is better than that which He has given you! Nay, you rejoice in your gift!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Return unto them) with their gift. (We verily shall come unto them with hosts) armies (that they cannot resist) which they have no power to stop, (and we shall drive them out from thence) from Sheba (with shame) with their hands tied to their necks, (and they will be abased) humiliated.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لاَّ قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. [Then Sulaimān (Solomon) said to the chief of her messengers who brought the present]: “Go back to them. We verily shall come to them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Go back to them with the gifts that you have brought for We shall assuredly come to them with hosts which they will not be able to face and we shall expel them from there from the land of Sheba Saba’ — named thus after their tribal ancestor — humiliated and they shall be utterly abased’ unless they come to me in submission. When the envoy returned to her with the gift she had her throne placed inside seven doors inside her palace with her palace inside seven palaces and had all the doors locked with guards at them. She then prepared to make the journey to Solomon to see what he would command her. She departed with twelve thousand chieftains qayl each accompanied by thousands of men until when she came to within a parasang of him he sensed her arrival.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱرْجِعْ إِلَيْهِمْ فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّهُم بِجُنُودٍ لاَّ قِبَلَ لَهُمْ بِهَا وَلَنُخْرِجَنَّهُم مِّنْهَآ أَذِلَّةً وَهُمْ صَاغِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. [Then Sulaimān (Solomon) said to the chief of her messengers who brought the present]: “Go back to them. We verily shall come to them with hosts that they cannot resist, and we shall drive them out from there in disgrace, and they will be abased.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Solomon said: (O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering) and seeking peace?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمَلأُ أَيُّكُمْ يَأْتِينِي بِعَرْشِهَا قَبْلَ أَن يَأْتُونِي مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. He said: “O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās
