tafsir: And he cast a glance at the stars — to delude them into thinking that he relies on them so that they would then trust him —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِي ٱلنُّجُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. Then, he cast a glance at the stars,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then said: Lo! I feel sick!) so that they leave him alone.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. And he said: “Verily, I am sick(2) (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)].” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and said ‘Indeed I feel I will be sick’ that is I will fall ill.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. And he said: “Verily, I am sick(2) (with plague). [He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan feast)].” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they turned their backs and went away from him) they went to their festival and left him alone.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. So, they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they went away to their festival leaving him behind.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 90. So, they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then turned he) i.e. Abraham (to their gods and said) to them: (Will ye not eat) the honey you have on you?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. Then, he turned to their ālihah (gods) and said: “Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then he turned he stole away to their gods the idols in front of which the food had been placed and said mockingly ‘Will you not eat? — but they failed to utter a word.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰ آلِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 91. Then, he turned to their ālihah (gods) and said: “Will you not eat (of the offering before you)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: When they did not answer him, he said: (What aileth you that ye speak not) why do you not answer me?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَنطِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. “What is the matter with you that you speak not?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He then said What is wrong with you that you do not speak?’ — but still he received no response.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ لاَ تَنطِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 92. “What is the matter with you that you speak not?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then he attacked them striking with his right hand) with an axe; it is also said that he fulfilled his oath.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْباً بِٱلْيَمِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. Then, he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He then turned on them striking them with his right hand with might smashing them. Those who saw him reported this to the rest of his people.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْباً بِٱلْيَمِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 93. Then, he turned upon them, striking (them) with (his) right hand..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (his people) came towards him, hastening) from their festival.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوۤاْ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Then, they (the worship pers of idols) came, towards him, hastening..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they came running towards him walking hurriedly and they said to him ‘We worship them while you smash them?!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَقْبَلُوۤاْ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 94. Then, they (the worship pers of idols) came, towards him, hastening..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said) Abraham said to them: (Worship ye that which ye yourselves do carve) with your own hands from stones and wood,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. He said: “Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said to them in reproach ‘Do you worship what you yourselves have carved out of stone and other materials idols

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 95. He said: “Worship you that which you (yourselves) carve?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When Allah hath created you) and leave the worship of Allah Who created you (and what ye make) and He also created your act of carving as well as that which you carve?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. “While Allāh has created you and what you make!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when God created you and whatever you make?’ whether it be your act of carving and that which you have carved? So worship Him alone! the mā in wa-mā ta‘malūna ‘and whatever you make’ is that of the verbal noun; but it is also said to introduce a relative clause or it is adjectivally qualified.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 96. “While Allāh has created you and what you make!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They said: Build for him a building) a furnace (and fling him in the red hot fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبْنُواْ لَهُ بُنْيَاناً فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. They said: “Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They said amongst themselves ‘Build for him a structure then fill it with firewood and set it on fire and when it is ablaze then cast him into the fierce fire’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُواْ ٱبْنُواْ لَهُ بُنْيَاناً فَأَلْقُوهُ فِي ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 97. They said: “Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And they designed a snare for him) to burn him in the Fire, (but We made them the undermost) of those who dwell in the bottom of the Fire; it is also said that this means: We made them of the losers by subjecting them to chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِ كَيْداً فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ ٱلأَسْفَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. So, they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they sought to outwit him by flinging him into the fire so that it may destroy him but We made them the lowermost the vanquished as he came out of the fire unharmed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَرَادُواْ بِهِ كَيْداً فَجَعَلْنَاهُمُ ٱلأَسْفَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 98. So, they plotted a plot against him, but We made them the lowest..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he said) Abraham said to Lot: (Lo! I am going unto my Lord) I am going to worship my Lord (Who will guide me) who will save me from them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And he said (after his rescue from the fire): “Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And he said ‘I shall indeed depart to my Lord I shall emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief — He will guide me to the place to which My Lord has commanded that I end up in and this was Syria. When he reached the Holy Land he said

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 99. And he said (after his rescue from the fire): “Verily, I am going to my Lord. He will guide me!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Then he said: (My Lord! Vouchsafe me of the righteous) a son who is among the messengers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 100. “My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: My Lord! Grant me a child of the righteous’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي مِنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 100. “My Lord! Grant me (offspring) from the righteous.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So We gave him tidings of a gentle son) a son who is knowledgeable in his youth, gentle in his old age.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلاَمٍ حَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 101. So, We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So We gave him the good tidings of a forbearing son.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِغُلاَمٍ حَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 101. So, We gave him the glad tidings of a forbearing boy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when (his son) was old enough to walk with him) when his son was old enough to strive for Allah and obey Him; it is also said that this means: when his son was old enough to walk with him in the mountains, ((Abraham) said) to his son Ishmael; and it is also said: to his son Isaac: (O my dear son, I have seen in a dream that I must sacrifice thee) I am commanded in a dream vision to sacrifice you. (So look, what thinkest thou) what do you say? (He said: O my father! Do that which thou art commanded) of sacrificing me. (Allah willing, thou shalt find me of the steadfast) in the face of this sacrifice.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْيَ قَالَ يٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيۤ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ قَالَ يٰأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِيۤ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 102. And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: “O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allāh). So see.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when he was old enough to walk with him that is to go about with him and help him out — this is said to have been either at the age of seven or at the age of thirteen — he said ‘O my dear son I see that is I have seen in a dream that I shall sacrifice you — and the visions of prophets are always true and their actions are inspired by the command of God exalted be He. So see what you think’ of this dream. He consulted him so that he his son might accept the idea of being sacrificed and comply with the command for it. He said ‘O my father the final tā’ in abati replaces the yā’ of the genitive possessive annexation yā abī do whatever you have been commanded to do. You shall find me God willing of the steadfast’ in this affair.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْيَ قَالَ يٰبُنَيَّ إِنِّيۤ أَرَىٰ فِي ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّي أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ قَالَ يٰأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤمَرُ سَتَجِدُنِيۤ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 102. And, when he (his son) was old enough to walk with him, he said: “O my son! I have seen in a dream that I am slaughtering you (offering you in sacrifice to Allāh). So see.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then, when they had both surrendered (to Allah)) when they both agreed and consigned the matter to Allah, (and he had flung him down upon his face) and it is said: on his side,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 103. Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allāh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when they had both submitted when they had submitted to and were prepared to comply with God’s command exalted be He and he had laid him down on his forehead when he had pushed him down to the ground thereon — every human being has two brows jabīn between which is the forehead jabha; this was at Minā. Abraham passed the knife across his son’s throat but it did not do anything by some impediment of the Divine Power

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمَّا أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُ لِلْجَبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 103. Then, when they had both submitted themselves (to the Will of Allāh), and he had laid him prostrate on his forehead (or on the side of his forehead for slaughtering);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We called unto him: O Abraham:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يٰإِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 104. We called out to him: “O Ibrāhīm! (Abraham!).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We called to him ‘O Abraham!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَادَيْنَاهُ أَن يٰإِبْرَاهِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 104. We called out to him: “O Ibrāhīm! (Abraham!).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Thou hast already fulfilled the vision) you have fulfilled what you were commanded in the dream vision. (Lo! thus do We reward the good) in their words and works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّؤْيَآ إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 105. You have fulfilled the dream!” Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily you have fulfilled the vision’ by what you have done in that you were able to go through with the act of sacrifice. In other words that which you have done suffices for you as redemption the statement nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is the response to the lammā ‘when’ so that the wāw in wa-nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is extra. So in the same way that We have rewarded you do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls in obeying the Command of God by removing from them their distress.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّؤْيَآ إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 105. You have fulfilled the dream!” Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! that verily was a clear test) that was a manifest trial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلاَءُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 106. Verily, that indeed was the manifest trial..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly this sacrifice to which he was commanded was indeed a clear test’ that is to say the ultimate test of faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلاَءُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 106. Verily, that indeed was the manifest trial..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim) We ransomed him with a fat ram.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 107. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. a ram);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We ransomed him the one whom he had been commanded to sacrifice namely Ishmael or Isaac — two different opinions — with a mighty sacrifice a mighty ram from Paradise the same one that Abel had offered as as sacrifice Gabriel peace be upon him brought it and the lord Abraham sacrificed it as he cried Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفَدَيْنَاهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 107. And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. a ram);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left Abraham with good praise among the people who came after him:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 108. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We left We preserved for him among posterity fair praise namely

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 108. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Peace be unto Abraham) bliss and safety from Us unto Abraham!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 109. “Salām (peace) be upon Ibrāhīm (Abraham)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Abraham!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِبْرَاهِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 109. “Salām (peace) be upon Ibrāhīm (Abraham)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus do We reward the good) with good praise and safety.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 110. Thus indeed do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So in way that We rewarded him do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 110. Thus indeed do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! He) i.e. Abraham (is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 111. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed he is one of Our faithful servants.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 111. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a Prophet of the righteous) of the messengers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيّاً مِّنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 112. And We gave him the glad tidings of Isḥāq (Isaac) — a Prophet from the righteous. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We gave him the good tidings of the birth of Isaac — some have argued that this proves that the one who was sacrificed was not him Isaac — a prophet nabiyyan is a future circumstantial qualifier that is to say ‘he will come to be with his prophethood decreed one of the righteous.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبَشَّرْنَاهُ بِإِسْحَاقَ نَبِيّاً مِّنَ ٱلصَّالِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 112. And We gave him the glad tidings of Isḥāq (Isaac) — a Prophet from the righteous. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We blessed him) with good praise and righteous offspring (and Isaac. And of their seed) and of the offspring of Abraham and Isaac (are some who do good) who believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (and some who plainly wrong themselves) through disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 113. We blessed him and Isḥāq (Isaac). And of their prog eny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We blessed him by multiplying his descendants and Isaac his son We also blessed by appointing the majority of prophets from among his progeny. And among their descendants is he who is virtuous he who is a believer and he who plainly wrongs his soul he who is a disbeliever whose disbelief is manifest.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبَارَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰ إِسْحَاقَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِ مُبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 113. We blessed him and Isḥāq (Isaac). And of their prog eny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We verily gave grace unto Moses and Aaron) by bestowing upon them prophethood and complete surrender unto Him,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 114. And indeed, We gave Our Grace to Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We favoured Moses and Aaron with prophethood

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 114. And indeed, We gave Our Grace to Mūsā (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And saved them and their people) who believed in them (from the great distress) from drowning,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 115. And We saved them and their people from the great distress,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and We delivered them and their people the Children of Israel from the great distress namely Pharaoh’s enslavement of them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَجَّيْنَاهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 115. And We saved them and their people from the great distress,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And helped them) against Pharaoh and his host (so that they became the victors) by means of proof.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 116. And helped them, so that they became the victors;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We helped them against the Egyptians so that they became the victors.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَصَرْنَاهُمْ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلْغَٰلِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 116. And helped them, so that they became the victors;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We gave them the clear Scripture) We gave them the Torah which made clear the lawful and the unlawful,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلْكِتَابَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 117. And We gave them the clear Scripture;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We gave them the enlightening scripture the one whose statements concerning prescribed punishments and rulings and otherwise are excellently expressed — this is the Torah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلْكِتَابَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 117. And We gave them the clear Scripture;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And showed them the right path) We confirmed them on the true, straight religion.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 118. And guided them to the Right Path..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We guided them to the straight path the straight way

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهَدَيْنَاهُمَا ٱلصِّرَاطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 118. And guided them to the Right Path..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We left for them) for Moses and Aaron, (among the later folk (the salutation)) good praise among the people who came after them:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 119. And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and We left We preserved for them among posterity fair praise namely

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 119. And We left for them (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Peace be unto Moses and Aaron) bliss and safety from Us unto Moses and Aaron!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 120. “Salām (peace) be upon Mūsa (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Moses and Aaron!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَارُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 120. “Salām (peace) be upon Mūsa (Moses) and Hārūn (Aaron)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 121. Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So just as We rewarded them both do We reward the virtuous.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 121. Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! they are two of our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 122. Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed both were among Our faithful servants.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 122. Verily, they were two of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn)) his folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 123. And verily, Ilyās (Elias) was one of the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And truly Elias read wa-inna Ilyās with the initial hamza or without wa-inna’l-yāsa was also one of the messengers. Some think that this Elias was the son of Aaron’s brother — Aaron the brother of Moses; but some say that this Elias was some other person who was sent to the people living in and around Baalbak.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 123. And verily, Ilyās (Elias) was one of the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When he said unto his folk: Will ye not ward off (evil)) the worship of other than Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 124. When he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allāh?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When idh is dependent because of an implicit verb udhkur ‘mention’ he said to his people ‘Will you not fear God?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِ أَلاَ تَتَّقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 124. When he said to his people: “Will you not fear Allāh?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Will ye cry unto Baal) will you worship other deities beside Allah; it is also said that this means: will you worship a bull instead of worshipping Allah; it is also said that his people had an idol called Baal which was 30 cubits tall and had four faces (and forsake the best of Creators) and forsake the worship of the greatest of Creators, such that you do not worship him at all,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَالِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 125. “Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well-known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do you call on Baal — this was the name of an idol of theirs which was made of gold from which the name of their city derives with the addition of the suffix bak — that is to say do you worship him and abandon the Best of Creators and not worship Him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلاً وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَالِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 125. “Will you call upon Ba‘l (a well-known idol of his nation whom they used to worship) and forsake the Best of creators, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Allah, your Lord) your Creator (and Lord of your forefathers) and the Creator of your forefathers before you?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 126. “Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’ read as predicates allāhu rabbukum and rabbu in the nominative because of the implicit omitted huwa being the subject; or read allāha rabbakum and rabba in the accusative as supplements to ahsana ‘the best of’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 126. “Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But they denied him) they denied his message, (so they surely will be haled forth (to the doom)) they will be brought in order to be tormented in the Fire,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 127. But, they denied him [Ilyās (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But they denied him. So they will indeed be arraigned in the Fire

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 127. But, they denied him [Ilyās (Elias)], so they will certainly be brought forth (to the punishment),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) save the salves of Allah who are sincere in their worship and have faith in Allah's divine Oneness; these will not be tormented.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 128. Except the chosen slaves of Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: — all except God’s delivered servants namely the believers who will be saved from it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 128. Except the chosen slaves of Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we left for him among the later folk (the salutation)) We left for Elias good praise among the people who came after him:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 129. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and We left for him among posterity fair praise namely

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِي ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 129. And We left for him (a goodly remembrance) among the later generations..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Peace be) bliss and safety from Us (unto Elias!) who is none other than Idris the Prophet!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 130. “Salām (peace) be upon Ilyāsīn (Elias)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Peace from Us be to Elias!’. It is said that this ilyāsīn is the same Elias mentioned above; but it is also said that this denotes him together with all those who were believers with him and so they have been coupled under the same term with him being the predominant as when one might say al-Muhallabūn ‘the Muhallabids’ to mean al-Muhallab and his folk; a variant reading has āl yāsīn by which is meant his family as well as Elias himself.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سَلاَمٌ عَلَىٰ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 130. “Salām (peace) be upon Ilyāsīn (Elias)!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! thus do We reward the good) with words, deeds and good praise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 131. Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed so — just as We rewarded him — do We reward the virtuous.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 131. Verily, thus do We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! he is one of Our believing slaves) who are true in their faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 132. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly he is one of Our faithful servants.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 132. Verily, he was one of Our believing slaves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطاً لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 133. And verily, Lūṭ (Lot) was one of the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed Lot was one of the messengers;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ لُوطاً لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 133. And verily, Lūṭ (Lot) was one of the Messengers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When We saved him and his household) his two daughters: Za'ura and Raytha, (every one,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 134. When We saved him and his family, all,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: mention when We delivered him together with all his family

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَاهُ وَأَهْلَهُ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 134. When We saved him and his family, all,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Save an old woman among those who stayed behind) except his hypocrite wife who stayed behind with those who were destroyed;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عَجُوزاً فِي ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 135. Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except an old woman who was among those who stayed behind in other words those who stayed behind in the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عَجُوزاً فِي ٱلْغَابِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 135. Except an old woman (his wife) who was among those who remained behind..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We destroyed the others) We destroyed those who remained behind after the departure of Lot and his daughters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 136. Then, We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We destroyed all the others the disbelievers from among his people.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلآخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 136. Then, We destroyed the rest (the town of Sodom at the place of the Dead Sea now in Palestine)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Ye) O people of Mecca (verily pass by (the ruin of) them) by the towns of Lot: Sodom, 'Amura, Sabura and Daduma (in the morning

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَّتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُّصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 137. Verily, you pass by them in the morning.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed you pass by them by their remains and the remains of their dwellings during your travels both in the morning that is during the daytime

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَّتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِمْ مُّصْبِحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 137. Verily, you pass by them in the morning.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And at night time; have ye then no sense) do you not believe in what was done to them, such that you do not follow their example?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبِٱلَّيلِ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 138. And at night; will you not then reflect?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and at night will you O people of Mecca not then understand? what befell them and so take heed therefrom?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبِٱلَّيلِ أَفَلاَ تَعْقِلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 138. And at night; will you not then reflect?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)) his folk,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 139. And, verily, Yūnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed Jonah was one of the messengers;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 139. And, verily, Yūnus (Jonah) was one of the Messengers. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When he fled) from his folk; and it is said: when he abandoned his folk (unto the laden ship) which was about to sail,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 140. When he ran to the laden ship:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when he fled to the laden ship — after he became furious with his people as the chastisement which he had promised them did not come down on them; so he boarded the ship which then stopped out in the deep sea. The seamen said ‘There is a runaway slave here upon this ship who has fled from his master a casting of lots should expose him!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 140. When he ran to the laden ship:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And then drew lots and was of those rejected) he lost and threw himself in the sea;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 141. Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then he drew lots with the passengers on the ship and was of those rejected of the losers in the draw and so they threw him into the sea.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 141. Then he (agreed to) cast lots, and he was among the losers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the fish swallowed him while be was blameworthy) he reproached himself for fleeing from his folk;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 142. Then a (big) fish swal lowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then the whale swallowed him while he was blameworthy that is while he was guilty of a blameworthy thing having gone to sea and embarked the ship without his Lord’s permission.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 142. Then a (big) fish swal lowed him as he had done an act worthy of blame..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And had he not been one of those who glorify (Allah)) had he not been of those who prayed before that

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَوْلاَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 143. Had he not been of them who glorify Allāh,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And had he not been one of those who glorify God that is to say those who make remembrance of God for inside the whale’s belly he was repeatedly saying the words ‘There is no god except You. Glory be to You! I have indeed been one of the wrongdoers’ Q. 2187

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَوْلاَ أَنَّهُ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 143. Had he not been of them who glorify Allāh,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He would have tarried in its belly) he would have remained in the belly of the fish (till the day when they are raised) from the graves;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 144. He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: he would have tarried in its belly until the day when they are raised in other words the whale’s belly would have been his tomb until the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَلَبِثَ فِي بَطْنِهِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 144. He would have indeed remained inside its belly (the fish) till the Day of Resurrection..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then We cast him on a desert shore while he was sick) he was as weak as a little child;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 145. But, We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then We cast him We flung him out of the belly of the whale onto the barren land onto the face of the earth that is onto the shore on that same day — or three or seven or twenty or forty days later — and he was sick ailing like a newly-born featherless chick.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَنَبَذْنَاهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 145. But, We cast him forth on the naked shore while he was sick,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We caused a tree of gourd to grow above him;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 146. And We caused a gourd plant to grow over him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We made a gourd plant to grow above him to provide shade for him with its stem which is not the case usually with gourds as a miracle for him; a mountain goat would come to him in the morning and in the evening and he would drink its milk until he finally regained his strength.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 146. And We caused a gourd plant to grow over him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And We sent him to a hundred thousand (folk) or more) 20,000 more,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 147. And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We sent him afterwards — as We had done before to a people in Nineveh in the region of Mosul — to a community of a hundred thousand or in fact more — a community of twenty thirty or seventy thousand.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ مِئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 147. And We sent him to a hundred thousand (people) or even more..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they believed) in him, (therefore We gave them comfort for a while) until the time of death without punishing them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَآمَنُواْ فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 148. And they believed; so, We gave them enjoyment for a while..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they believed after they saw with their own eyes the chastisement which they had been promised. So We gave them comfort We kept them alive to enjoy their wealth for a while until their terms of life would be concluded while they took comfort therein.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَآمَنُواْ فَمَتَّعْنَاهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 148. And they believed; so, We gave them enjoyment for a while..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Now ask them (O Muhammad)) ask the people of Mecca, and specifically the Banu Malih: (Hath thy Lord daughters) females (whereas they have sons) males? They said: " yes! " And the Prophet (pbuh) said to them: " do you wish for Allah what you do not wish for yourselves? "

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 149. Now ask them (O Muḥammad ): “Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So ask them inquire of the Meccan disbelievers by way of reproach are daughters to be for your Lord after their claim that the angels were God’s daughters while sons are to be for them? so that the best becomes exclusively theirs?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 149. Now ask them (O Muḥammad ): “Are there (only) daughters for your Lord and sons for them?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or created We the angels females) as you claim (while they were present?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ إِنَاثاً وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 150. Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or did We create the angels females while they were witnesses? to Our act of creation that they might then say such a thing?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلاَئِكَةَ إِنَاثاً وَهُمْ شَاهِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 150. Or did We create the angels female while they were witnesses?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! it is of their falsehood) it is due to their denial (that they say:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 151. Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Lo! it is indeed out of their own mendacity their own lies that they say

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلاَ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 151. Verily, it is of their falsehood that they (Quraish pagans) say:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah hath begotten) for they claimed the angels were Allah's daughters. (And lo! verily they tell a lie) in what they say.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 152. “Allāh has begotten (offspring— the angels being the daughters of Allāh)?” And, verily, they are liars!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘God has begotten’ when they say that the angels are God’s daughters. And verily they are liars in this respect.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَاذِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 152. “Allāh has begotten (offspring— the angels being the daughters of Allāh)?” And, verily, they are liars!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 153. Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons? *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Has He preferred daughters to sons? read a’stafā ‘has He preferred’ indicating an interrogative hamza which stands in place of the omitted conjunctive hamza.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَىٰ ٱلْبَنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 153. Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons? *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: What aileth you? How judge ye?) evil is what you choose for yourselves; you choose for Allah what you would not accept for yourselves,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 154. What is the matter with you? How do you decide?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: What is wrong with you? How do you judge? how do you make such a depraved judgement?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 154. What is the matter with you? How do you decide?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Will ye not then reflect?) will you not take heed from what you say?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 155. Will you not then remember?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Will you not then remember? tadhakkarūna the tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl that He glory be to Him is exalted above having a child?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَلاَ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 155. Will you not then remember?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or have ye) O people of Mecca (a clear warrant) a Scripture stating the angels are Allah's daughters?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 156. Or is there for you a plain authority?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do you have a clear warrant? plain definitive proof that God has a child?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 156. Or is there for you a plain authority?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful) that the angels are Allah's daughters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأْتُواْ بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 157. Then bring your Book if you are truthful!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then produce your scripture the Torah and show Me this as it is mentioned in it if you are being truthful about this statement of yours.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأْتُواْ بِكِتَابِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 157. Then bring your Book if you are truthful!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they) the disbelievers of Mecca, and the Banu Malih specifically (imagine kinship between him and the jinn) they claimed that there is a kinship between Allah and the angels when they said that the angels are Allah's daughters; it is also said that this was revealed about the dualists who claimed that Iblis, may Allah curse him, is Allah's partner in that Allah created good while Iblis created evil, (whereas the jinn) the angels (know well that they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca: the Banu Malih (will be brought before (Him)) will be chastised in hell.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَباً وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 158. And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they namely the idolaters have set up between Him exalted be He and the jinn namely the angels jinna they are so called because they are hidden ijtinān from vision a kinship by saying that they are God’s daughters while the jinn certainly know that they that is those who say this shall indeed be arraigned into the Fire to be chastised therein.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلُواْ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَباً وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 158. And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear (before Him) (i.e. they will be called to account)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Glorified be Allah) Allah exonerates Himself (from that which they attribute (unto Him)) from the lies they attribute to Him,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 159. Glorified is Allāh! (He is free) from what they attribute to Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Glory be to God affirming that He is exalted above what they attribute to Him in the way of His having a child

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 159. Glorified is Allāh! (He is free) from what they attribute to Him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Save single minded slaves of Allah) save the slaves of Allah who are sincere in their profession of Allah's divine Oneness and in their worship: these slaves do not invent lies about Allah; it is also said that this verse should be understood as follows: those who claim that there is a kinship between Allah and the angels will be tormented and none of them will escape this torment except the sincere slaves of Allah who are protected from disbelief, idolatry and indecencies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 160. Except the slaves of Allāh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islāmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: — all except God’s devoted servants namely believers the exceptive clause here is discontinuous in other words that is because they declare that God transcends what such individuals attribute to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 160. Except the slaves of Allāh, whom He chooses (for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islāmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! verily, ye) O people of Mecca (and that which ye worship) beside Allah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 161. So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For indeed you and what you worship of idols

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 161. So, verily you (pagans) and those whom you worship (idols).

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said upon the interpretation of Allah's saying (Sad.): '(Sad.) He says: Sad by the Qur'an, i.e. repeat the Qur'an until you distinguish between faith and disbelief, the prophetic wont and blameworthy innovation, truthfulness and lying, the lawful and the unlawful, good and evil; it is also said that Sad stands for barring (sadd) from the guidance, i.e. the barring of the people of Mecca from the Truth and guidance; it is also said that it stands for Abu Jahl; and it is also said that it stands for truthful (sadiq) in his speech; and it is also said that Sad is one of Allah's names; and it is also said that it is an oath by which Allah swore (By the renowned Qur'an) by the Qur'an which possesses honour and clarity of exposition; it is an honour to those who believe in it and it is a clear exposition of the people of old as well as of future generations of people. Allah swore by the Qur'an,

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Sād God knows best what He means by this letter. tafsir: (How many a generation) past generation (We destroyed before them) before the Quraysh, (and they cried out when it was no longer the time for escape!) the angels cried out to them upon their destruction: this is no context for attacking or fleeing; stop! And they stopped until Allah destroyed all of them. This is because before this, upon fighting an enemy, they used to say: attack all together! (Manas! Manas!). Some would therefore survive and others die. But when they were defeated by the enemy they used to cry: flee! Flee! (Manasa! Manasa!), and so they used to flee all together from the battlefield. These were two different signs whenever they engaged in fighting either to attack or to flee from the enemy. When Allah wished to destroy them, the angels cried out to them: this is no context for attacking or fleeing.

meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: How many — in other words many — a generation a community of past communities We have destroyed before them and they cried out when the chastisement was sent down on them when it was no longer the time for escape that is to say the time was not one for fleeing the suffixed tā’ of wa-lāta is extra; the sentence is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb nādaw ‘they cried out’ in other words they called for help but the situation was such that there could be no escape or deliverance; but still the Meccan disbelievers have not taken heed from their example.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَواْ وَّلاَتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. How many a generation have We destroyed before them! And they cried out when there was no longer time for escape..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they) i.e. the Quraysh (marvel that a warner) a warning messenger (from among themselves) from their own lineage (hath come unto them, and the disbelievers) the disbelievers of Mecca (say: This) meaning Muhammad (pbuh) (is a wizard) who sows dispute between people, (a charlatan) who lies about Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَجِبُوۤاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مٌّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muḥammad ) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: “This (Prophet Muḥammad ) is a sorcerer, a liar..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they marvel that a warner has come to them from among themselves a messenger from among their number to warn them and to threaten them with the punishment of the Fire after resurrection — and this warner is the Prophet s. And those who disbelieve the overt noun al-kāfirūnā has replaced the third person pronominalisation say ‘This is a sorcerer a liar.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَعَجِبُوۤاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مٌّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَافِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَاحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And they (Arab pagans) wonder that a warner (Prophet Muḥammad ) has come to them from among themselves. And the disbelievers say: “This (Prophet Muḥammad ) is a sorcerer, a liar..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Maketh he the gods One God) could one God be sufficient to fulfil all our needs, as Muhammad claims? (Lo! That) which Muhammad (s)ays (is an astounding thing) is a bizarre thing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهاً وَاحِداً إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. “Has he made the ālihah (gods) (all) into One Ilāh (God — Allāh). Verily, this is a curious thing!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Has he made the gods One God? — for he had said to them ‘Say there is no god except God’ — in other words they objected how could one god suffice for all of creation? Lo! that is indeed a curious thing’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَجَعَلَ ٱلآلِهَةَ إِلَـٰهاً وَاحِداً إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ عُجَابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. “Has he made the ālihah (gods) (all) into One Ilāh (God — Allāh). Verily, this is a curious thing!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The chiefs among them) among the Quraysh: 'Utbah and Shaybah the sons of Rabi'ah, Ubayy Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi and Abu Jahl Ibn Hisham (go about, exhorting) Abu Jahl said to them: (Go) to your deities (and be staunch to your gods) and persevere in the worship of your deities! (Lo! This) meaning Muhammad (pbuh) (is a thing designed) to perish; it is also said that this means: that which Muhammad is saying is designed to spread to all people of the earth.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُواْ وَاْصْبِرُواْ عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And the leaders among them went about (saying): “Go on, and remain constant to your ālihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the council from among them go about from the place of their assembly at the house of Abū Tālib and the place where they heard the Prophet s say ‘Say there is no god except God’ saying ‘Go! they say to one another go and stand by your gods adhere firmly to worship of them; lo! this that has been mentioned concerning the Oneness of God is indeed a thing sought from us.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُواْ وَاْصْبِرُواْ عَلَىٰ آلِهَتِكُمْ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَيْءٌ يُرَادُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And the leaders among them went about (saying): “Go on, and remain constant to your ālihah (gods)! Verily, this is a thing designed (against you)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We have not heard of this) which Muhammad (s)ays (in later religion) in Judaism and Christianity; they mean to say: we did not hear from the Jews or Christian that God is One. (This) which Muhammad (s)ays (is naught but an invention) which Muhammad has invented.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ ٱخْتِلاَقٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We never heard of this in the latter-day creed namely the creed of Jesus. This is surely nothing but an invention mere lies.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلآخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَا إِلاَّ ٱخْتِلاَقٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “We have not heard (the like) of this in the religion of these later days (i.e. Christianity). This is nothing but an invention! [Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī].
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Hath the reminder been revealed unto him (alone) among us) has he been selected from among us to have prophethood and the Scripture? (Nay, but they) the disbelievers of Mecca (are in doubt concerning My reminder) concerning My Scripture and the prophethood of My Prophet; (nay but they have not yet tasted My doom) they have not tasted My chastisement, this is why they lie about Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فَي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. “Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?” Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ān)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Has the Remembrance the Qur’ān been revealed to him Muhammad (s) out of all of us’ when he is neither the elder nor the noblest among us? In other words it could not have been revealed to him read a-unzila pronouncing both hamzas or not pronouncing the second one but in both cases inserting an intervening alif or without this insertion. God exalted be He says Nay but they are in doubt concerning My Remembrance My revelation that is the Qur’ān for they deny the one who has brought it. Nay but they have not yet tasted My chastisement and if they were to taste it they would certainly believe the Prophet s in what he has brought — but then in such a case their belief in the Prophet would be of no benefit to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِن بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُمْ فَي شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِي بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُواْ عَذَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. “Has the Reminder been sent down to him (alone) from among us?” Nay, but they are in doubt about My Reminder (this Qur’ān)! Nay, but they have not tasted (My) Torment!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or are theirs the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower) He says: or do they have in their hands prophethood and the Scriptures such that they bestow them upon whomever they wish, when He is the Mighty in retribution against whoever does not believe in Him, the Bestower Who has bestowed prophethood and the Scripture upon Muhammad (pbuh)?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord’s mercy the Mighty the Victor the Bestower? treasuries such as prophethood and otherwise so that they might give it to whomever they want?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Or have they the treasures of the Mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Real Bestower?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them theirs?) Or do they have power over the heavens and the earth and over all created beings and marvels that are between the heavens and the earth? (Then let them ascend by ropes) to the gates of heavens! And if they have that power, then let them see whether or not He bestowed upon him prophethood and the Scripture.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُواْ فِى ٱلأَسْبَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they possess the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? If this is what they claim Then let them ascend by the means of ascension that lead to the heaven and bring down some revelation wahy and then assign it exclusively to whomever they wish am in both verses represents the rhetorical hamza of denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فَلْيَرْتَقُواْ فِى ٱلأَسْبَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Or is it that the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them is theirs? If so, let them ascend up with means (to the heavens)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A defeated) and slain (host are (all) the factions) of disbelievers: the disbelievers of Mecca (that are there) they were defeated and killed on the Day of Badr when they intended to kill the Prophet (pbuh).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّن ٱلأَحَزَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. (As they denied Allāh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: A routed mahzūmun is an adjectival qualification of jundun ‘host’ host is all that they are in other words they are nothing but a despicable host nothing more — in their denial of you — from among the factions mina’l-ahzābi also an adjectival qualification of jundun in other words they are like those hosts of factions who were in confederation against prophets before you these were defeated and destroyed and likewise We shall destroy these people.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّن ٱلأَحَزَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. (As they denied Allāh’s Message) they will be a defeated host like the Confederates of the old times (who were defeated)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The folk of Noah before them) before your folk, O Muhammad (denied) Noah (and (so did the tribe of) 'Aad) the folk of Hud deny Hud, (and Pharaoh) denied Moses (firmly planted) who had an established kingdom; and it is said that this means: the one who tortured using posts; this is because whenever he got angry against someone he tortured him using four posts,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلأَوْتَادِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Before them (were many who) denied (Messengers) — the people of Nūḥ (Noah); and ‘Ād; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Before them the people of Noah denied the inflection of the verb kadhdabat ‘denied’ that is governed by qawmu ‘people’ is in the feminine person because of the implicit sense and so did those of ‘Ād and Pharaoh he of the stakes — he used to fix four stakes for the person who incurred his wrath and tie to these stakes that person’s hands and feet and then torture him —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلأَوْتَادِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Before them (were many who) denied (Messengers) — the people of Nūḥ (Noah); and ‘Ād; and Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) the man of stakes (with which he used to punish the people),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (the tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih denied Salih; (and the folk of Lot) denied Lot, (and the dwellers in the wood) the folk of Shu'ayb also denied Shu'ayb: (these were the factions) these were the disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْئَيْكَةِ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلأَحْزَابُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And Thamūd, and the people of Lūṭ (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and Thamūd and the people of Lot and the dwellers in the wood a small forest namely the people of Shu‘ayb peace be upon him — those were the factions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَابُ لْئَيْكَةِ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ ٱلأَحْزَابُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And Thamūd, and the people of Lūṭ (Lot), and the Dwellers of the Wood: such were the Confederates..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Not one of them but did deny the messengers) He says: all these folks denied the messengers just as the Quraysh deny you, (therefore My doom was justified) therefore My chastisement is enjoined upon them,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلاَّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Not one of them but denied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Each one of the factions did not but deny the messengers for when they deny one they have in effect denied them all since their call to God is the same one namely the call to affirmation of His Oneness. So My retribution was justified it was necessary.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِن كُلٌّ إِلاَّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Not one of them but denied the Messengers; therefore My Torment was justified,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (These) i.e. your folk, in case they deny you (wait for but one Shout) which is not followed by a second: this is the blow of the Resurrection, (there will be no second thereto) there will be no respite or return.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلآءِ إِلاَّ صَيْحَةً واحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And these only wait for a single Ṣaiḥah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrāfīl)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And these that is the disbelievers of Mecca do not await but a single Cry namely the Blast of the Resurrection that will herald chastisement for them for which there will be no revoking read fawāq or fuwāq.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰؤُلآءِ إِلاَّ صَيْحَةً واحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And these only wait for a single Ṣaiḥah [shout (i.e. the blowing of the Trumpet by the angel Isrāfīl)] there will be no pause or ending thereto [till.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They say) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca said upon hearing Allah's saying (Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book! … But as for him who is given his record in his left hand) [al-Haqqah: 69:19-25], they said: (Our Lord!) O our Lord! (Hasten on for us our fate) our records, they mean the registers of their deeds (before the Day of Reckoning) so that we know what is in them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. They say: “Our Lord! Hasten to us our Record of good and bad deeds (so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they said — after the following verse was revealed As for him who is given his book in his right hand … to the end of the verse Q. 6919 — ‘Our Lord hasten on for us the record of our deeds before the Day of Reckoning’ — they said this mockingly.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. They say: “Our Lord! Hasten to us our Record of good and bad deeds (so that we may see it) before the Day of Reckoning!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Bear) O Muhammad (with what they say) in your rejection, (and remember Our bondman David) He says: mention to them the event of Our slave David, (lord of might) who had strength for our worship. (Lo! he was ever turning in repentance (towards Allah)) he was obedient, always engaged in the worship of Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱصْبِر عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا ٱلأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Be patient (O Muḥammad ) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dāwūd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft‑returning in all matters and in repentance (towards Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Bear patiently what they say and remember Our servant David the one of fortitude that is to say the one of fortitude in worship he used to fast every other day and keep vigil for half the night sleep for a third and then keep vigil for the last sixth. Indeed he was a penitent soul always returning to what pleases God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱصْبِر عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُودَ ذَا ٱلأَيْدِ إِنَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Be patient (O Muḥammad ) of what they say, and remember Our slave Dāwūd (David), endued with power. Verily, he was ever oft‑returning in all matters and in repentance (towards Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We subdued) We made subservient (the hills to hymn) with him (the praises (of their Lord) with him at nightfall and sunrise) in the morning and evening,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِيِّ وَٱلإِشْرَاقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Verily, We made the mountains glorify Our Praises with him [Dāwūd (David)] at the beginning and the end of the day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly We disposed the mountains to glorify God with him with the same glorification at evening at the time of the night prayer and at sunrise at the time of the morning prayer which is when the sun has fully risen with its light extending everywhere.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلجِبَالَ مَعَهُ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِيِّ وَٱلإِشْرَاقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Verily, We made the mountains glorify Our Praises with him [Dāwūd (David)] at the beginning and the end of the day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him) obedient to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dāwūd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allah’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We disposed the birds mustered in flocks gathered before him glorifying with him; each of the mountains and birds turning to him reverting to obedience of him by glorifying God with him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً كُلٌّ لَّهُ أَوَّابٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And (so did) the birds assembled: all obedient to him [Dāwūd (David)] [i.e. they came and glorified Allah’s Praises along with him]. (Tafsīr Al-Qurṭubī)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We made his kingdom strong) with guardsmen; his royal chamber was guarded every night by 30,000 men (and gave him wisdom) prophethood (and decisive speech) and judgement; he never stumbled in his speech when he judged between people. In his judgement proof was required from the claimant while an oath was required from the defendant.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. We made his kingdom strong and gave him Al-Ḥikmah (Prophethood) and sound judge ment in speech and decision..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We strengthened his Kingdom We reinforced it with guards and hosts every night there thirty thousand men would be standing guard at his sanctuary; and gave him wisdom prophethood and sound judgement in all matters and decisive speech the ability to formulate a satisfactory statement for a decision in any endeavour.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُ وَآتَيْنَاهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
