meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the son of Mary is quoted as an example) they likened him to their deities, (behold! the folk laugh out) upon hearing the words of 'Abdullah al-Zib'ari and his folk,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلاً إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. ‘Īsā (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols], behold, your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when the son of Mary is cited as an example — after God’s following words were revealed ‘Truly you and what you worship besides God shall be fuel for Hell’ Q. 2198 and the idolaters said ‘We are satisfied that our gods be together with Jesus in Hell for he too was worshipped besides God’ — behold! your people that is the idolaters laugh at it at this example — they clamour with joy at what they hear.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَمَّا ضُرِبَ ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ مَثَلاً إِذَا قَوْمُكَ مِنْهُ يَصِدُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. And when the son of Maryam (Mary) is quoted as an example [i.e. ‘Īsā (Jesus) is worshipped like their idols], behold, your people cry aloud (laugh out at the example)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And say) i.e. 'Abdullah al-Zib'ari: (Are our gods better) O Muhammad, (or is he) i.e. Jesus the son of Mary? For if he is allowed in the Fire with the Christians, we are also allowed therein with our deities. (They raise not the objection) they do not mention Jesus the son of Mary (save for argument) save for wrangling and dispute. (Nay! but they are a contentious folk) they argue in defence of falsehood.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُوۤاْ ءَأَ ٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلاَّ جَدَلاً بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. And say: “Are our ālihah (gods) better or is he [‘Īsā (Jesus)]?” They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they say ‘Are our gods better or he?’ Jesus. We are satisfied that our gods be in the same predicament with him. They only cite this that is the example to you for the sake of contention merely arguing with falsehood for they know that the particle mā of wa-mā ta‘budūna ‘and what you worship’ refers only to non-rational beings and cannot therefore include Jesus peace be upon him. Nay but they are a contentious lot an extremely disputatious folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُوۤاْ ءَأَ ٰلِهَتُنَا خَيْرٌ أَمْ هُوَ مَا ضَرَبُوهُ لَكَ إِلاَّ جَدَلاً بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ خَصِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. And say: “Are our ālihah (gods) better or is he [‘Īsā (Jesus)]?” They quoted not the above example except for argument. Nay! But they are a quarrelsome people(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He is nothing) i.e. Jesus the son of Mary (but a slave on whom We bestowed favour) by entrusting him with the message and he is nothing like their deities, (and We made him a pattern) a lesson (for the Children of Israel) in that he was born without a father.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلاً لِّبَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. He [‘Īsā (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He Jesus is only a servant of Ours on whom We bestowed favour through prophethood and We made him by his coming into being without a father an exemplar for the Children of Israel that is to say like an example because of the wondrousness of his case one from which one is able to infer God’s power exalted be He to do whatever He will.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ عَبْدٌ أَنْعَمْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَجَعَلْنَاهُ مَثَلاً لِّبَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. He [‘Īsā (Jesus)] was not more than a slave. We granted Our Favour to him, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel (i.e. his creation without a father)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And had We willed We could have set among you) in your own places; and it is said this means: had We willed We would have created instead of you (angels to be vicegerents in the earth) angels instead of you; it is also said this means: angels to walk in the earth instead of you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ مَّلاَئِكَةً فِي ٱلأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. And if it had been Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And had We willed We would have appointed among you instead of you angels to be your successors in the earth by Our destroying you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَا مِنكُمْ مَّلاَئِكَةً فِي ٱلأَرْضِ يَخْلُفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. And if it had been Our Will, We would have [destroyed you (mankind) all, and] made angels to replace you on the earth. [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Verily) in the coming of Jesus the son of Mary (there is knowledge of the Hour) there is an indication of the coming of the Hour; it is also said that this means: his coming is a sign of the advent of the Hour. (So doubt ye not concerning it) so have no doubt in the coming of the Hour, (but follow Me) by professing Allah's divine Oneness. (This) profession of divine Oneness (is the right path) an established religion with which Allah is pleased: i.e. the religion of Islam.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلاَ تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. And he [‘Īsā (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. ‘Isā’s (Jesus) descent on the earth] (1). Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allāh) (i.e. be obedient to Allāh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islāmic Monotheism, leading to Allāh and to His Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed he that is Jesus is a portent of the Hour — the arrival of it is known by the sending down of him — so do not doubt it tamtarunna the indicative nūn has been omitted for apocopation together with the wāw of the third person plural on account of two unvowelled consonants coming together but say to them ‘Follow me in the affirmation of God’s Oneness. This to which I command you is a straight path’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّهُ لَعِلْمٌ لِّلسَّاعَةِ فَلاَ تَمْتَرُنَّ بِهَا وَٱتَّبِعُونِ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 61. And he [‘Īsā (Jesus), son of Maryam (Mary)] shall be a known sign for (the coming of) the Hour (Day of Resurrection) [i.e. ‘Isā’s (Jesus) descent on the earth] (1). Therefore have no doubt concerning it (i.e. the Day of Resurrection). And follow Me (Allāh) (i.e. be obedient to Allāh and do what He orders you to do, O mankind)! This is the Straight Path (of Islāmic Monotheism, leading to Allāh and to His Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And let not Satan turn you aside) let not Satan turn you away from the religion of Islam or from belief in the coming of the Hour. (Lo! he is an open enemy for you) whose enmity is quite manifest.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. And let not Shaiṭān (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islāmic Mono theism). Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And do not let Satan bar you do not let him turn you away from God’s religion. Indeed he is a manifest enemy of yours one whose enmity is manifest.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يَصُدَّنَّكُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَانُ إِنَّهُ لَكُمْ عَدُوٌّ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 62. And let not Shaiṭān (Satan) hinder you (from the right religion, i.e. Islāmic Mono theism). Verily, he (Satan) to you is a plain enemy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When Jesus came with clear proofs (of Allah's Sovereignty)) when he came with commands, prohibitions and marvels, (he said: I have come unto you with wisdom) with commands, prohibitions and prophethood, (and to make plain some of that concerning which ye differ) that which you contravene in the matter of religion. (So keep your duty to Allah) so fear Allah in that which He commands you, (and obey me) follow my counsel and words.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. And when ‘Īsā (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: “I have come to you with Al-Ḥikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which you differ. Therefore, fear Allāh and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when Jesus came with the clear signs the miracles and the prescriptions of the Law he said ‘Verily I have brought you wisdom prophethood and the prescriptions of the Gospel and I have come to make clear to you some of what you are at variance over in the way of the rulings of the Torah for what concerns religion and otherwise — and he indeed made clear to them the matters of religion. So fear God and obey me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَمَّا جَآءَ عِيسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَاتِ قَالَ قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَلأُبَيِّنَ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِي تَخْتَلِفُونَ فِيهِ فَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 63. And when ‘Īsā (Jesus) came with (Our) clear Proofs, he said: “I have come to you with Al-Ḥikmah (Prophethood), and in order to make clear to you some of the (points) on which you differ. Therefore, fear Allāh and obey me..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Allah, He is my Lord) my Creator (and your Lord) and your Creator. (So worship Him) believe in His divine Oneness. (This is a right path) this is an established religion with which He is pleased.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. “Verily, Allāh! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So, worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allāh’s religion of true Islāmic Monotheism).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly God is my Lord and your Lord; so worship Him — that is a straight path’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ رَبِّي وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ هَـٰذَا صِرَاطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 64. “Verily, Allāh! He is my Lord (God) and your Lord (God). So, worship Him (Alone). This is the (only) Straight Path (i.e. Allāh’s religion of true Islāmic Monotheism).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But the factions) the Christians (among them differed) for some said he was the son of Allah, the Nestorians, some said he is Allah, the Jacobites, others said he is Allah's partner, the Melkites, and others said he is one of three hypostases, al-Marqusiyyah. (Then woe) severe punishment is (unto those who do wrong) to those who became different factions concerning Jesus (from the doom of a painful day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. But, the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong [by ascribing things to ‘Īsā (Jesus) that are not true] from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But the factions differed among themselves regarding the status of Jesus was he God or the son of God or the third of Three deities? So woe waylun is a term implying chastisement to those who do wrong those who blaspheme in what they say about Jesus from the chastisement of a painful day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلأَحْزَابُ مِن بَيْنِهِمْ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمٍ أَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 65. But, the sects from among themselves differed. So woe to those who do wrong [by ascribing things to ‘Īsā (Jesus) that are not true] from the torment of a painful Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Await they) if they do not repent of their claims (aught save the Hour) save the coming of the Hour, (that it shall come upon them suddenly, when they know not) when they are not aware of the descent of punishment upon them?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلاَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly while they perceive not? (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Are they that is the Meccan disbelievers awaiting anything that is to say — they are in fact awaiting nothing — but that Hour should come upon them an ta’tiyahum substitutes for al-sā‘ata ‘the Hour’ suddenly unexpectedly while they are unaware? of the time of its coming beforehand.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ يَنظُرُونَ إِلاَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ أَن تَأْتِيَهُمْ بَغْتَةً وَهُمْ لاَ يَشْعُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 66. Do they only wait for the Hour that it shall come upon them suddenly while they perceive not? (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Friends) in sin, such as 'Uqbah Ibn Abi Ma'it and Ubayy Ibn Khalaf (on that day) on the Day of Judgement (will be foes one to another, save those who kept their duty (to Allah)) except those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies, such as Abu Bakr, 'Umar, 'Uthman, 'Ali and their fellow believers, for these are not like that.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلأَخِلاَّءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. Friends on that Day will be foes one to another, except Al-Muttaqūn (the pious)(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Friends who shared in acts of disobedience in this world will on that day the Day of Resurrection yawma’idhin is semantically connected to His following words be foes of one another except for the God-fearing those who have love for one another through their commitment to obedience of God — such will be friends on that day and it will be said to them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلأَخِلاَّءُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَعْضُهُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ إِلاَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 67. Friends on that Day will be foes one to another, except Al-Muttaqūn (the pious)(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah will then say: (O My slaves! For you there is no fear this day) when others are in fear, (nor is it ye who grieve) when others are in grief;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰعِبَادِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلاَ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. (It will be said to the true believers in Islāmic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘O My servants there is no fear for you this day nor will you grieve

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰعِبَادِ لاَ خَوْفٌ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ وَلاَ أَنتُمْ تَحْزَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 68. (It will be said to the true believers in Islāmic Monotheism): My worshippers! No fear shall be on you this Day, nor shall you grieve,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Ye) who believed Our revelations) Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and were self surrendered) sincere to Allah in their worship and confession of Allah's divine Oneness,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. (You) who believed in Our Āyāt (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allāh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who believed alladhīna āmanū adjectivally qualifies ‘ibādī ‘My servants’ in Our signs — the Qur’ān — and had submitted themselves to Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ بِآيَاتِنَا وَكَانُواْ مُسْلِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 69. (You) who believed in Our Āyāt (proofs, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were Muslims (i.e. who submit totally to Allāh’s Will, and believe in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad) to be honoured with gifts and delights in Paradise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْخُلُواْ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Enter Paradise you antum the subject and your spouses your wives to be made joyful to be made happy and to be honoured tuhbarūna ‘to be made joyful’ is the predicate of the above subject.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱدْخُلُواْ ٱلْجَنَّةَ أَنتُمْ وَأَزْوَاجُكُمْ تُحْبَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 70. Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therein are brought round for them) to serve them (trays of gold) filled with different types of food (and goblets) round goblets without handles, filled with drinks, (and therein) i.e. in Paradise (is all that souls desire and eyes find sweet) to look at. (And you are immortal therein) you will abide in Paradise forever, never to die or leave.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلأَعْيُنُ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will be served from all around with large dishes of gold and goblets akwāb is the plural of kūb which is a drinking vessel without a handle so that the person can drink from whichever side he wants and therein will be whatever souls desire to relish and eyes delight in contemplating and you will abide in it forever.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِصِحَافٍ مِّن ذَهَبٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ وَفِيهَا مَا تَشْتَهِيهِ ٱلأَنْفُسُ وَتَلَذُّ ٱلأَعْيُنُ وَأَنتُمْ فِيهَا خَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 71. Trays of gold and cups will be passed round them; (there will be) therein all that inner-selves could desire, and all that eyes could delight in and you will abide therein forever..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit) this is Paradise in which you are made to dwell, you inherited it (because of what ye used to do) and say in the life of the world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيۤ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. This is Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that is the Paradise which you have been given to inherit as the reward for what you used to do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتِلْكَ ٱلْجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيۤ أُورِثْتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 72. This is Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therein) in the Garden (for you is fruit) different kinds of fruit (in plenty whence to eat.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Therein are abundant fruits for you from which that is parts of which you will eat’ for whatever is eaten is immediately replaced with more of the same.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَكُمْ فِيهَا فَاكِهَةٌ كَثِيرَةٌ مِّنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 73. Therein for you will be fruits in plenty, of which you will eat (as you desire)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! the guilty) the idolaters: Abu Jahl and his host (are immortal in hell's torment) neither to die or leave it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. Verily, the Mujrimūn (criminals, sinners, disbelievers) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed the guilty will abide forever in the chastisement of Hell —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِي عَذَابِ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 74. Verily, the Mujrimūn (criminals, sinners, disbelievers) will be in the torment of Hell to abide therein forever..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It is not relaxed for them) the torment is not removed from them nor is it interrupted, (and they despair therein) they despair in this torment about any goodness or about it being removed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: it will not be lightened for them and they will be utterly despondent in it silent in despair.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يُفَتَّرُ عَنْهُمْ وَهُمْ فِيهِ مُبْلِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 75. (The torment) will not be lightened for them, and they will be plunged into destruction with deep regrets, sorrows and in despair therein. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We wronged them not) by punishing them, (but they it was who did the wrong) by adopting disbelief and idolatry.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. We wronged them not, but they were the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We never wronged them but they themselves were the wrongdoers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا ظَلَمْنَاهُمْ وَلَـٰكِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 76. We wronged them not, but they were the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they cry: O master) when their patience run out, they cry: O master of the Fire! (Let thy Lord make an end of us). The custodian of the Fire answers them after 40 years, (He saith: Lo! here ye must remain) you will dwell eternally in the torment and you will never come out.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَادَوْاْ يٰمَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَّاكِثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. And they will cry: “O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us.” He will say: “Verily, you shall abide forever.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they will call out ‘O Mālik — the name of the Keeper of the Fire — let your Lord finish us off!’ let Him make us die. He will say after the passing of a thousand years ‘You will surely remain!’ you will remain in the chastisement forever.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَادَوْاْ يٰمَالِكُ لِيَقْضِ عَلَيْنَا رَبُّكَ قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ مَّاكِثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 77. And they will cry: “O Malik (Keeper of Hell)! Let your Lord make an end of us.” He will say: “Verily, you shall abide forever.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We verily brought the Truth unto you) He says: Gabriel came to your Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) with the Qur'an, (but ye were, most of you) all of you, (averse to the Truth) deniers of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. Indeed We have brought the truth (Muḥammad  with the Qur’ān) to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says ‘Verily We brought you O people of Mecca the truth by the tongue of the Messenger but most of you were averse to the truth’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَقَدْ جِئْنَاكُم بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَكُمْ لِلْحَقِّ كَارِهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 78. Indeed We have brought the truth (Muḥammad  with the Qur’ān) to you, but most of you have a hatred for the truth(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or do they determine any thing) in relation to the Prophet Muhammad? (Lo! We (also) are determining) something in relation to their destruction.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوۤاْ أَمْراً فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or have they that is the disbelievers of Mecca contrived consolidated some matter? in plotting against the Prophet Muhammad (s). For We too are indeed contriving We too are consolidating Our plan to destroy them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ أَبْرَمُوۤاْ أَمْراً فَإِنَّا مُبْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 79. Or have they plotted some plan? Then We too are planning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or deem they) i.e. Safwan Ibn Umayyah and his two friends (that We cannot hear their secret thoughts and private confidences) around the Ka'bah? (Nay) We do hear, (but Our envoys) the guardian angels, (present with them, do record) their secrets and private conferences.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لاَ نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُم بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? Yes (We do) and Our messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they reckon that We do not hear their secret thoughts and their conspiring? that is to say what they secretly communicate to others and what they openly conspire about among themselves. Yes indeed! We hear all of that and Our messengers the guardians are with them keeping a record of that.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَحْسَبُونَ أَنَّا لاَ نَسْمَعُ سِرَّهُمْ وَنَجْوَاهُم بَلَىٰ وَرُسُلُنَا لَدَيْهِمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 80. Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private counsel? Yes (We do) and Our messengers (appointed angels in charge of mankind) are by them, to record..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad to al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and 'Alqamah: (The Beneficent One hath no son. I am first among the worshippers) I am the first to acknowledge that Allah has no son or partner.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَاْ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. Say (O Muḥammad ): “If the Most Gracious (Allāh) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allāh’s worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allāh Alone and testify that He has no children)].” [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘If the Compassionate One had a son hypothetically speaking I would have been first among the worshippers of that son; but it is established that He exalted be He does not have a child and thus there can be no worshipping of such a child.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِن كَانَ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ وَلَدٌ فَأَنَاْ أَوَّلُ ٱلْعَابِدِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 81. Say (O Muḥammad ): “If the Most Gracious (Allāh) had a son (or children as you pretend), then I am the first of Allāh’s worshippers [who deny and refute this claim of yours (and the first to believe in Allāh Alone and testify that He has no children)].” [Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)) of sons and partners!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted is He from all that they ascribe (to Him)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth the Lord of the Throne the ‘arsh is the same as the kursī above what they allege!’ above the lies which they speak in ascribing a child to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: سُبْحَانَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 82. Glorified is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted is He from all that they ascribe (to Him)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So let them) O Muhammad (flounder (in their talk)) of falsehood (and play) and mock the Qur'an (until they meet) until they see (the Day which they are promised) death and punishment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So leave them to indulge their falsehoods and play in this world of theirs until they encounter that day of theirs which they are promised chastisement in and that is the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 83. So leave them (alone) to speak nonsense and play until they meet the Day of theirs which they have been promised. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And He it is Who in the heaven is God) He is the God of everything that is in the heaven, (and in the earth God) and He is the God of everything that is in the earth. (He is the Wise) in His command and decree, (the Knower) of His created beings and providence.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِي ٱلأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. It is He (Allāh) Who is the only Ilāh (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilāh (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He it is Who in the heaven is God fi’l-samā’i ilāhun pronounce here both hamzas or drop the first one or softening it into a yā’ in other words Who in the heaven is the Worshipped One and in the earth is God both adverbials are semantically connected to what follows; and He is the Wise in the management of His creatures the Knower of their welfare.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي فِي ٱلسَّمآءِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَفِي ٱلأَرْضِ إِلَـٰهٌ وَهُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 84. It is He (Allāh) Who is the only Ilāh (God to be worshipped) in the heaven and the only Ilāh (God to be worshipped) on the earth. And He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And blessed be He unto Whom) He is too exalted and exonerated from having sons and partners He unto Whom (belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings, (and with Whom is knowledge of the Hour) the knowledge of the coming of the Hour, (and unto Whom ye will be returned) in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And Blessed is He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And Blessed Magnificent be He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them; and with Him is the knowledge of the Hour of when it shall come to pass and to Him they will all be returned yurja‘ūna may also be read second person plural turja‘ūna ‘you will be returned’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَعِندَهُ عِلْمُ ٱلسَّاعَةِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُرْجَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 85. And Blessed is He to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, and with Whom is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Whom you (all) will be returned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those unto whom they cry) those whom they worship (instead of Him possess no power of intercession) He says: the angels have no power to intercede in favour of anybody, (saving him who beareth witness unto the Truth) the testification that there is no deity save Allah, sincerely believing in it (knowingly) knowing deep in their hearts it is the Truth. This was revealed about the Banu Malih who claimed the angels were the daughters of Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَاعَةَ إِلاَّ مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession — except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allāh, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allāh) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And those whom they the disbelievers call on those whom they worship besides Him that is besides God have no power of intercession for anyone except those who bear witness to the truth that is those who say ‘there is no god except God’ with full knowledge in their hearts of what they have testified to with their tongues — such are Jesus Ezra and the angels who will intercede for believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يَمْلِكُ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِ ٱلشَّفَاعَةَ إِلاَّ مَن شَهِدَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 86. And those whom they invoke instead of Him have no power of intercession — except for those who bear witness to the truth knowingly (i.e. believed in the Oneness of Allāh, and obeyed His Orders), and they know (the facts about the Oneness of Allāh) (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if thou ask them) i.e. the Banu Malih (who created them, they will surely say: Allah) created us. (How then are they turned away) from whence do they lie against Allah after such a confession?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: “Allāh.” How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allāh, Who created them)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if wa-la-in the lām is for oaths you ask them who created them they will surely say ‘God’ la-yaqūlunna the indicative nūn and the plural person indicator wāw have been omitted. How can they then deviate? how can they be turned away from worshipping God?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَئِن سَأَلْتَهُم مَّنْ خَلَقَهُمْ لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ فَأَنَّىٰ يُؤْفَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 87. And if you ask them who created them, they will surely say: “Allāh.” How then are they turned away (from the worship of Allāh, Who created them)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he saith) Muhammad (pbuh) says: (O my Lord! Lo! those are a folk who believe not) in You or in the Qur'an. So do with them as You will.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلِهِ يٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ قَوْمٌ لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. (And Allāh has the knowl edge) of (Prophet Muḥammad’s ) saying: “O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And as for his saying that is the saying of the Prophet Muhammad (s) wa-qīlihi is accusative dependent because it is a verbal noun followed by an implicit verb in other words wa-qāla qīlihi ‘and he said his saying’ ‘O my Lord! These are indeed a people who have no faith’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلِهِ يٰرَبِّ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ قَوْمٌ لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 88. (And Allāh has the knowl edge) of (Prophet Muḥammad’s ) saying: “O my Lord! Verily, these are a people who believe not!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then bear with them (O Muhammad)) it was said to him: turn away from them (and say: Peace) words of truth. (But) this is a threat (they will come to know) what will be done with them on the Day of Badr, Uhud, the Troops. Then, after this, he was commanded to fight them; it is also said that this means: but they will come to know the hunger and smoke that will befall them'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلاَمٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. So, turn away from them (O Muḥammad ), and say: Salām (peace)! But they will come to know(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Then disregard them leave them be and say ‘Peace!’ I will stay away from you — this was revealed before he was commanded to fight them. For they will soon come to know ya‘lamūna may also be read as second person plural ta‘lamūna ‘you will come to know’ meant to threaten them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْفَحْ عَنْهُمْ وَقُلْ سَلاَمٌ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 89. So, turn away from them (O Muḥammad ), and say: Salām (peace)! But they will come to know(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said in the interpretation of Allah's saying (Ha. Mim.): '(Ha. Mim.) He says: He has already decreed that which will happen, i.e. He has shown it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حـمۤ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Hā.-Mīm. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Hā mīm God knows best what He means by these letters.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حـمۤ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Hā.-Mīm. [These letters are one of the miracles of the Qur’ān and none but Allāh (Alone) knows their meanings]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By the Scripture that maketh plain) and He swore by the Scripture which makes plain that that which will happen has already been decreed, i.e. it is plain; it is also said Allah swore by the (Ha) and (Mim) and also by the Scripture which makes plain the commands and prohibitions, the lawful and unlawful,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْكِتَابِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. By the manifest Book (this Qur’ān) that makes things clear..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By the Book the Qur’ān that clarifies the one that distinguishes what is lawful from what is unlawful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْكِتَابِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. By the manifest Book (this Qur’ān) that makes things clear..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We revealed it) We sent Gabriel with the Qur'an; this is why Allah swore, Allah sent down Gabriel to the nether heaven to dictate the Qur'an to the scribes among the angels, who are the dwellers of the nether heaven (on a blessed night) wherein there is mercy, forgiveness and grace, this is the night of destiny. Then Allah sent Gabriel to Muhammad (pbuh) with verses and surah in a period of about 20 years. (Lo! We are ever warning) by means of the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. We sent it (this Qur’ān) down on a blessed night [(i.e. the night of Al-Qadr, Sūrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadān — the 9 th month of the Islāmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed We revealed it on a blessed night the Night of Ordainment laylat al-qadr or the eve of the middle of Sha‘bān in which it was revealed from the Mother Book from the seventh heaven to the heaven of this world. Indeed We have been warning We have been causing people by it to have fear of God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَاهُ فِي لَيْلَةٍ مُّبَارَكَةٍ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. We sent it (this Qur’ān) down on a blessed night [(i.e. the night of Al-Qadr, Sūrah No. 97) in the month of Ramadān — the 9 th month of the Islāmic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Whereupon) in this night of destiny (every wise command) every thing to take place from year to year (is made clear) is clarified,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: In it that is to say on the Night of Ordainment or on the eve of the middle of Sha‘bān every definitive matter that has been fixed with regard to the provisions and the terms of life and other things decreed by God for the entire year until that same night again the following year is distinguished is decided.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيهَا يُفْرَقُ كُلُّ أَمْرٍ حَكِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Therein (that night) is decreed every matter of ordainments(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (As a command from Our presence) an exposition from Us: We explain to Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death what they are entrusted with from year to year. (Lo! We are ever sending) messengers with Scriptures.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْراً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. As a Command (or this Qur’ān or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: As an ordinance a distinguishing from Us. Indeed We have been sending from your Lord messengers such as Muhammad (s) and those before him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْراً مِّنْ عِنْدِنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُرْسِلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. As a Command (or this Qur’ān or the Decree of every matter) from Us. Verily, We are ever sending (the Messengers),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A mercy) a blessing (from thy Lord) to His slaves, i.e. sending messengers with scriptures to them is a blessing from their Lord. (Lo! He is the Hearer) of the saying of the Quraysh when they said: “Our Lord relieve us of the torment”, (the Knower) of them and of their punishment,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. (As) Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as a mercy out of compassion for those to whom these messengers have been sent. Surely He is the Hearer of their sayings the Knower of their actions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَحْمَةً مِّن رَّبِّكَ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. (As) Mercy from your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lord) Creator (of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them) of created beings: He is Allah, (if ye would be sure) if you believe in this.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them read rabbu’l-samāwāti in the nominative to understand it as a third predicate; or read rabbi’l-samāwāti as a substitution for rabbika ‘your Lord’ if you should be certain O people of Mecca that God exalted be He is the Lord of the heavens and the earth then also be certain that Muhammad (s) is His Messenger.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them, if you (but) have a faith with certainty. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (There is no God) there is no Creator (save Him) Who created the heavens and the earth. (He quickeneth) for the Resurrection (and giveth death) in the life of the world; (your Lord and Lord of your forefathers) your Creator and the Creator of you forefathers before you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ يُحْيِـي وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Lā ilaha illā Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death — your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: There is no god except Him. He gives life and brings death. Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ إِلَـٰهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ يُحْيِـي وَيُمِيتُ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ آبَآئِكُمُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Lā ilaha illā Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). It is He Who gives life and causes death — your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but they) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (play in doubt) they poke fun at the coming of the Hour.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Nay! They play about in doubt..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but they linger in doubt concerning the Resurrection playing in mockery of you O Muhammad (s) and so he said ‘My God assist me against them with seven years of drought like the seven of Joseph’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلْ هُمْ فِي شَكٍّ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Nay! They play about in doubt..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But watch thou for) their torment, O Muhammad, on (the day when the sky will produce visible smoke) filling what is between the sky and the earth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says So watch out for the day when the heaven will produce a visible smoke. Thus the earth became barren and famine became so severe that they began to see what looked like smoke rising between the heaven and the earth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱرْتَقِبْ يَوْمَ تَأْتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That will envelop the people) that smoke will surround the people. (This) smoke (will be a painful torment) a torment of hunger.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Covering the people: this is a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: that will envelop the people and so they said ‘This is a painful chastisement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَغْشَى ٱلنَّاسَ هَـٰذَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Covering the people: this is a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Then they will say): Our Lord relieve us of the torment) remove from us hunger. (Lo! we are believers) in You as well as in Your Messenger and Scripture:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مْؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. (They will say): “Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Our Lord relieve us from the chastisement; indeed we have believed’ we have now affirmed the sincerity of Your Prophet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبَّنَا ٱكْشِفْ عَنَّا ٱلْعَذَابَ إِنَّا مْؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. (They will say): “Our Lord! Remove the torment from us, really we shall become believers!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (How can there be remembrance for them) how can they take admonition or repent if We were to remove the torment from them; and it is also said: how can they take admonition or repent if We were to destroy them at Badr; and it is also said: on the Day of Judgement, (when a messenger) Muhammad (pbuh) (making plain (the Truth)) in a language they understand (had already come unto them,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says How can there be a reminder for them that is to say faith will not benefit them once the chastisement has been sent down when already there has come to them a manifest Messenger whose Message is plain to understand

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ وَقَدْ جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. How can there be for them an admonition (at the time when the torment has reached them), when a Messenger explaining things clearly has already come to them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And they had turned away from him) and they turned away from believing in him (and said: One taught (by others)) i.e. Muhammad is taught by Jabr and Yasar, (a madman) who is bewitched?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muḥammad ) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but they turned away from him and said ‘He has been taught — that is a human being is teaching him the Qur’ān — he is a madman!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوْاْ عَنْهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٌ مَّجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muḥammad ) and said: (He is) one taught (by a human being), a madman!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We withdraw the torment) hunger (a little) until the Day of Badr. (Lo! ye) O people of Mecca (return) to transgression. And when the torment was removed from them, they did indeed return to transgression, and so Allah destroyed them on the Day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Indeed We will remove the chastisement the famine from you for a little time; and so it was removed from them. But you will indeed revert!’ to your disbelief — and they did.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَاشِفُواْ ٱلْعَذَابِ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ عَآئِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Verily, We shall remove the torment for a while. Verily you will revert (to disbelief)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: This is because He said: (On the day when We shall seize them with the greater seizure) We shall punish them with the greater punishment, by the sword on the Day of Badr ((then), in truth We shall punish) with Our torment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Mention the day when We shall assault with the most mighty assault — this was the day of the battle of Badr — then indeed We shall take vengeance on them al-batsh means ‘to seize violently’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ نَبْطِشُ ٱلْبَطْشَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ إِنَّا مُنتَقِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. On the Day when We shall seize you with the greatest seizure (punishment). Verily, We will exact retribution..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And verily We tried before them) before the Quraysh (Pharaoh's folk) by punishing them, (when there came unto them a noble messenger) i.e. Moses,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mūsā (Moses) S],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And certainly We tried We tested before them the people of Pharaoh together with him when a messenger came to them namely Moses peace be upon him who was honoured before God exalted be He

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ كَرِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And indeed We tried before them Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people, when there came to them a noble Messenger [i.e. Mūsā (Moses) S],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Saying: Give up to me) send with me (the slaves of Allah) the Children of Israel. (Lo! I am a faithful messenger unto you) I am a messenger to you from Allah and I am faithful in conveying the message.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوۤاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Saying: “Deliver to me the slaves of Allāh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: saying ‘Give over to me what I summon you to in the way of faith that is manifest your faith to me O servants of God; indeed I am for you a messenger who is faithful’ in what he has been sent with

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنْ أَدُّوۤاْ إِلَيَّ عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Saying: “Deliver to me the slaves of Allāh (i.e. the Children of Israel). Verily, I am to you a Messenger worthy of all trust. *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And saying: Be not proud against Allah) nor lie against Him. (Lo! I bring you a clear warrant) a clear proof and plain warrant.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَن لاَّ تَعْلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّيۤ آتِيكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. “And exalt not yourselves against Allāh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and ‘Do not rebel do not try to act strong against God by neglecting obedience to Him. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant’ clear proof of the sincerity of my Mission — but they threatened to stone him to death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَن لاَّ تَعْلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّيۤ آتِيكُمْ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. “And exalt not yourselves against Allāh. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death) lest you kill me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. “And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So he said ‘And truly I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest you should stone me to death with rocks.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي عُذْتُ بِرَبِّي وَرَبِّكُمْ أَن تَرْجُمُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. “And truly, I seek refuge with my Lord and your Lord, lest you should stone me (or call me a sorcerer or kill me)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if ye put no faith in me) and if you do not believe in the message I bring you, (then let me go) then leave me alone, neither harmed by you nor benefiting from you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. “But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if you do not believe me then stay away from me’ that is then refrain from harming me — but they did not refrain from such action.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن لَّمْ تُؤْمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعْتَزِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. “But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he cried unto his Lord (saying): These are a guilty folk) these are idolatrous folk who brought destruction upon themselves.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. (But they were aggressive), so he [Mūsā (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): “These are indeed the people who are Mujrimūn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So he called to his Lord saying ‘These are indeed a guilty an idolatrous lot!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُ أَنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ قَوْمٌ مُّجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. (But they were aggressive), so he [Mūsā (Moses)] called upon his Lord (saying): “These are indeed the people who are Mujrimūn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then (his Lord commanded) Take away my slaves by night) Allah said to Moses: “take away My slaves, the Children of Israel at the beginning of the night”. (Lo! ye will be followed) to the sea,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلاً إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. (Allāh said): “Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He said ‘Then set out read fa-asri or fa’sri with My servants the Children of Israel by night; for you will assuredly be pursued surely Pharaoh and his people will pursue you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَسْرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيْلاً إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. (Allāh said): “Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And leave the sea behind at rest) spacious roads, spacious enough for Moses and his folk to pass through them, (for lo! they are a drowned host) Pharaoh and his folk will be drowned in the sea.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْواً إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And leave the sea behind once you and your companions have crossed it at rest still and calm until the Egyptians enter it indeed they will be a drowned host’ — he Moses was reassured by this statement — and they were indeed drowned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱتْرُكِ ٱلْبَحْرَ رَهْواً إِنَّهُمْ جُندٌ مُّغْرَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “And leave the sea as it is (quiet and divided). Verily, they are a host to be drowned.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (How many were the gardens and the water springs) in these gardens (that they left behind,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: How many gardens orchards and flowing fountains did they leave behind

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَمْ تَرَكُواْ مِن جَنَّاتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. How many of gardens and springs that they [Fir‘aun’s (Pharaoh) people] left behind,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And the cornlands and the goodly sites) beautiful houses

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And green crops (fields) and goodly places,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as well as sown fields and many a glorious residence many a splendid court

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَزُرُوعٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And green crops (fields) and goodly places,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And pleasant things wherein they took delight) wherein they exulted!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the bounty the comforts in which they rejoiced! in which they lived luxuriously.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَنَعْمَةٍ كَانُواْ فِيهَا فَاكِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And comforts of life wherein they used to take delight!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Even so (it was)) We destroyed them, (and We made it an inheritance for other folk) We made the Children of Israel inherit all that after they were destroyed;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْماً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So it was kadhālika is the predicate of a subject that is missing such as ‘the matter was so’ and We made these an inheritance that is to say their riches for another people namely the Children of Israel.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَاهَا قَوْماً آخَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. Thus (it was)! And We made other people inherit them (i.e. We made the Children of Israel to inherit the kingdom of Egypt)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the heaven) the gate of heaven (and the earth) and the place of prayer on earth (wept not for them) for Pharaoh and his folk; this is because when the believer dies the gate of heaven from which his works ascends, and the place wherein he used to pray on earth, will weep for him; Pharaoh and his folk did not have any good works to ascend to heaven nor any place of prayer on earth, (nor were they reprieved) from drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, (1) nor were they given a respite. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So neither the heaven nor the earth wept for them — in contrast to the case with believers at the point of whose death weep both their places of prayer on earth and the route by which their deeds ascend the heaven; nor were they reprieved nor were they deferred until they were able to make repentance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا بَكَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ وَٱلأَرْضُ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنظَرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And the heavens and the earth wept not for them, (1) nor were they given a respite. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom) from the painful and severe doom.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We delivered the Children of Israel from the humiliating chastisement of having their children slain and their womenfolk taken as servants

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَجَّيْنَا بَنِيۤ إِسْرَائِيلَ مِنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْمُهِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And indeed We saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((We delivered them) from Pharaoh) and his folk who slaughtered their males and used their females as servants. (Lo! he was a tyrant) he was an arrogant transgressor (of the wanton ones) steeped in idolatry.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِياً مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily, he was arrogant and was of the Musrifūn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: from Pharaoh min Fir‘awna is said to be a substitution for al-‘adhābi on the basis of an implied annexation that is to say min ‘adhābi Fir‘awna; or it is said to be a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-‘adhāb ‘the chastisement’. Truly he was a tyrant of the wanton ones.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِن فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُ كَانَ عَالِياً مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. From Fir‘aun (Pharaoh); verily, he was arrogant and was of the Musrifūn (those who transgress beyond bound in spending and other things and commit great sins)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We chose them) i.e. the Children of Israel, (purposely) in accordance with Our knowledge, (above (all) creatures) of their time, by bestowing upon them quails and honey, the Scripture and Messenger, and by saving them from Pharaoh and his folk and from drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Ālamīn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mūsā (Moses)] with knowledge,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And verily We chose them that is the Children of Israel with a knowledge that We had of their state over all the worlds that is the worlds of their time those of the rational beings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدِ ٱخْتَرْنَاهُمْ عَلَىٰ عِلْمٍ عَلَى ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the ‘Ālamīn (mankind and jinn) [during the time of Mūsā (Moses)] with knowledge,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We gave them portents) signs (wherein was a clear trial) and it is this that saved them from Pharaoh and drowning, and He sent down for them quails and honey in the wilderness, etc.; it is also said that (wherein was a clear trial) means: wherein was a great blessing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ ٱلآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلاَءٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We gave them signs in which there was a manifest trial an obvious grace such as the parting of the sea the sending down of manna and quails and other such signs.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآتَيْنَاهُم مِّنَ ٱلآيَاتِ مَا فِيهِ بَلاَءٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And granted them signs in which there was a plain trial..

tafsir: There is) in our life (naught but our first death, and we shall not be raised again) and we shall not be brought back to life after we die.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلأُوْلَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘It that death after which there is life is nothing more than our first death that is when they were sperm-drops and we shall not be resurrected we shall not be raised alive after the second one.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هِيَ إِلاَّ مَوْتَتُنَا ٱلأُوْلَىٰ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُنشَرِينَ

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Bring back our fathers) revive, O Muhammad, our forefathers who died so that we might ask whether what you say is true or false, (if ye speak the Truth) that we will be raised again after we die!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأْتُواْ بِآبَآئِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. “Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Bring us then our fathers alive if you are being truthful’ about our being resurrected after we have died that is to say that we will be given life again.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأْتُواْ بِآبَآئِنَا إِن كُنتُمْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. “Then bring back our forefathers, if you speak the truth!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah said (Are they better) are your people better, (or the folk of Tubba') or the people of Himyar, whose name was As'ad Ibn Malkikarb and his agnomen was Abu Karb, he was called Tubba' because he had a great number of followers (and those before them) before the people of Tubba'? (We destroyed them, for surely they were guilty) they were idolaters. Would your people not fear that We destroy them and punish them?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ مُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimūn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ — he was a prophet or a righteous man — and those communities before them? We destroyed because of their disbelief. In other words they are not mightier than those and yet they were destroyed; indeed they were criminals.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَهُمْ خَيْرٌ أَمْ قَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ أَهْلَكْنَاهُمْ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ مُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Are they better or the people of Tubba‘ and those before them? We destroyed them because they were indeed Mujrimūn (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them) of creation, (in play) in amusement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them intending to play by creating all that lā‘ibīna ‘to play’ is a circumstantial qualifier.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَـٰعِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And We created not the heavens and the earth, and all that is between them, for mere play..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We created them not save with truth) We created them only for the Truth, never for falsehood; (but most of them) most of the people of Mecca (know not) this nor believe in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَآ إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. We created them not except with truth , but most of them know not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We did not create them and all that is between them except with the truth that is to say We created them rightfully so that one might infer thereby Our power and Our Oneness and other matters; but most of them that is the Meccan disbelievers do not know.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا خَلَقْنَاهُمَآ إِلاَّ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. We created them not except with truth , but most of them know not..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Assuredly the Day of Decision) the Day of judgement between created beings (is the term of all of them) is their tryst,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Verily, the Day of Judge ment (when Allāh will judge between the creatures) is the time appointed for all of them —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly the Day of Decision the Day of Resurrection in which God will decide between servants will be the tryst for all of them for everlasting chastisement;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ مِيقَاتُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

tafsir: (A day when friend can in naught avail friend) the day when no relative is of any benefit to his relative, and when no disbeliever is of any avail to another disbeliever, in relation to interceding to Allah or avoiding Allah's punishment, (nor can they be helped) nor can they avert the torment which they will face,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. The Day when a Maulā (a near relative) cannot avail a Maulā (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when a friend will not avail a friend on account of kinship or friendship that is to say the day when he will not be able to ward off from the other anything of the chastisement nor will they be helped — nor will they be protected from it yawma ‘the day’ is a substitution for yawma’l-fasl ‘the Day of Decision’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي مَوْلًى عَن مَّوْلًى شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ

tafsir: (Save him on whom Allah hath mercy) from among the believers, for these are not as described above, for they will intercede for one another. (Lo! He is the Mighty) in retribution against the disbelievers, (the Merciful) towards the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

tafsir: except for him on whom God has mercy — and these are the believers for they will intercede for one another with God’s permission. He is indeed the Mighty the Victor in His retribution of the disbelievers the Merciful to believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ

meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Will be the food of the sinners..

tafsir: ((Saying): Taste) O Abu Jahl! (Lo! thou wast forsooth the mighty) among your own folk, (the noble) in their midst! And it is also said that this means: you were the mighty who felt powerful through your own folk, the noble who was magnanimous with them!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. “Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it will be said to him ‘Taste! that is taste the chastisement. Indeed you are the mighty the noble one! as you claimed when you used to say ‘There is nothing between its two mountains sc. Mecca that is mightier or nobler than me!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذُقْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْكَرِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. “Taste you (this)! Verily, you were (pretending to be) the mighty, the generous!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! This) torment (is that whereof ye used to doubt) in the life of the world, deeming that it will never take place.

tafsir: And it will be said to them This that you see of the chastisement is indeed that which you used to doubt’ about which you used to be uncertain.

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They taste not death therein) in the Garden, (save the first death) which they taste in the life of the world. (And He hath saved them from) and their Lord has removed from them (the doom of hell) the torment of the Fire,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلاَّ ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلأُولَىٰ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will not taste death therein other than the first death namely the one that came in this world after they had lived in it some scholars think that illā ‘other than’ here means ba‘da ‘after’. And He will shield them from the chastisement of Hell-fire —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلْمَوْتَ إِلاَّ ٱلْمَوْتَةَ ٱلأُولَىٰ وَوَقَاهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,.
