meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ آيَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلأَلِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea(1) in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant) with clear proof: the hand and the staff,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And in Mūsā (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And a sign too in Moses wa-fī Mūsā is a supplement to fīhā ‘therein’ that is to say We also left a sign in the story of Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh vested with a clear warrant with a manifest proof;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي مُوسَىٰ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَاهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And in Mūsā (Moses) (too, there is a sign), when We sent him to Fir‘aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But he withdrew (confiding) in his might) pharaoh refused to believe in the proof or in Moses, relying instead on his troops, (and said: A wizard or a madman) bewitched.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: “A sorcerer or a madman.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but he turned away he rejected belief to his supports bi-ruknihi his hosts so called because to him they are like a support rukn saying to Moses that he Moses was ‘A sorcerer or a madman!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِ وَقَالَ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. But [Fir‘aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: “A sorcerer or a madman.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So We seized him and his hosts and flung them) and drowned them (in the sea, for he was reprobate) blameworthy in the sight of Allah, and he will also blame himself.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. So, We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So We seized him and his hosts and cast flung them into the waters the sea and so they drowned for he that is Pharaoh was blameworthy guilty of what is blameworthy such as denying the messengers and claiming divinity.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَخَذْنَاهُ وَجُنُودَهُ فَنَبَذْنَاهُمْ فِي ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. So, We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, for he was blameworthy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And in (the tribe of) 'Aad) the people of Hud ((there is a portent) when We sent) We set on them (the fatal wind against them) the severe wind in which there was no comfort for them, this is the west wind.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. And in ‘Ād (there is also a sign), when We sent against them the barren wind; (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And also in the destruction of ‘Ād was a sign when We unleashed against them a barren wind a wind which brings nothing of good for it does not bear any rain and does not pollinate any trees; this wind was the west wind al-dabūr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. And in ‘Ād (there is also a sign), when We sent against them the barren wind; (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It spared naught) neither them nor their belongings (that it reached) that the wind reached to, (but made it (all) as dust.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It did not leave anything any soul or property that it came upon without making it like decayed bones like something that is withered and in scattered pieces.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلاَّ جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And in (the tribe of) Thamud) the folk of Salih ((there is a portent) when it was told them) Salih told them after they hamstrung the she-camel: (Take your ease awhile) enjoy your life until the advent of the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. And in Thamūd (there is also a sign), when they were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And also in the destruction of Thamūd was a sign when it was said to them after the hamstringing of the she-camel ‘Enjoy yourselves for a while!’ until the end of your terms of life — as stated in the other verse ‘Enjoy yourselves in your dwellings for three days’ Q.1165.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفِي ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُواْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. And in Thamūd (there is also a sign), when they were told: “Enjoy yourselves for a while!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But they rebelled against their Lord's decree) they refused to comply to their Lord's command, (and so the thunderbolt) the cry of doom (overtook them even while they gazed) while looking at the torment descending upon them;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَعَتَوْاْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. But, they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Ṣā‘iqah (1) overtook them while they were looking..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then they defied they scorned the command of their Lord refraining from implementing it; so the thunderbolt that is the destructive cry seized them after the three days had passed as they were looking around in other words it seized them in the daytime.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَعَتَوْاْ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّاعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. But, they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Ṣā‘iqah (1) overtook them while they were looking..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they were unable to rise up) following Allah's chastisement, (nor could they help themselves) nor could their bodies avert the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَاعُواْ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So they were unable to rise up they could not get up upon the sending down of the chastisement nor were they victors over the One Who destroyed them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَاعُواْ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the folk of Noah) We had also destroyed them (aforetime) before the folk of Salih. (Lo! they were licentious folk) they were disbelieving folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. (So were) the people of Nūḥ (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fāsiqūn (rebellious, disobedient to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the people of Noah read wa qawmi Nūhin as a supplement to Thamūda in other words ‘in the destruction of these two peoples by what destructive power exists in the heavens and the earth there is also a sign’; or read wa qawma Nūhin in other words ‘We also destroyed the people of Noah’ aforetime that is before the destruction of those mentioned. Indeed they were an immoral lot.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ قَوْماً فَاسِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. (So were) the people of Nūḥ (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fāsiqūn (rebellious, disobedient to Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We have built) created (the heaven with might, and We it is who make the vast extent (thereof)) as We will; it is also said that this means: we expand the provision thereof.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَييْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space (thereof)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the heaven We built it with might and indeed We are powerful one says āda’l-rajulu or ya’īdu to mean ‘he is strong’; and awsa‘a’l-rajulu to mean ‘he has become capable dhū sa‘a and strong’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا بِأَييْدٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space (thereof)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the earth have We laid out) on water, (how gracious was the Spreader (thereof)!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَاهِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent a Spreader (thereof) are We!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And the earth We spread it out We made it level what excellent Spreaders then! We are.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَاهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَاهِدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And We have spread out the earth: how Excellent a Spreader (thereof) are We!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And all things We have created by pairs) in the earth, (that haply ye may reflect) on the creation of Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And of all things wa-min kulli shay’in is semantically connected to His following words khalaqnā We created pairs two kinds such as male and female heaven and earth sun and moon plain and mountain summer and winter sweet and bitter light and darkness that perhaps you might remember tadhakkarūna one of the two original tā’ letters of tatadhakkarūna has been omitted and hence realise that the Creator of pairs is Himself Singular that you might then worship him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِن كُلِّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore flee unto Allah) flee from Allah unto Allah; it is also said that this means: flee from contravening against Allah to obeying Him; (lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him) I am a warning messenger who explains matters to you in a language you understand.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَفِرُّوۤاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. So, flee to Allāh (from His Torment to His Mercy — Islāmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muḥammad ) am a plain warner to you from Him (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So flee unto God that is to say away from His punishment toward His reward by being obedient to Him and not disobeying Him. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَفِرُّوۤاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 50. So, flee to Allāh (from His Torment to His Mercy — Islāmic Monotheism). Verily, I (Muḥammad ) am a plain warner to you from Him (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And set not any other god along with Allah) refrain from saying: Allah has a son or partner; (lo! I am a plain warner) in a language you understand (unto you from Him) from Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And set not up (or worship not) any other ilāh (god) along with Allāh [Glorified is He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muḥammad ) am a plain warner to you from Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And do not set up another god alongside God. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him before fa-firrū ‘so flee’ one may read an implicit preceding qul lahum ‘Say to them’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ تَجْعَلُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهاً آخَرَ إِنِّي لَكُمْ مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 51. And set not up (or worship not) any other ilāh (god) along with Allāh [Glorified is He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muḥammad ) am a plain warner to you from Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Even so) just as your own people accused you of being a wizard and madman (there came no messenger) calling to Allah (unto those before them) before your people (but they said) to that messenger: (A wizard or a madman!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: “A sorcerer or a madman!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Thus there did not come to those who were before them any messenger but they said that he was ‘A sorcerer or a madman!’ in other words their denial of you by saying that you are a sorcerer or a madman was like the denial of communities before them of their messengers by saying that same thing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلاَّ قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 52. Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them but they said: “A sorcerer or a madman!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another) did all these folks conspire to say to their respective messenger: you are a wizard or madman? (Nay, but they are froward folk) disbelieving folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Have they all enjoined this upon one another? an interrogative intended as a denial. Nay but they are an insolent folk a folk whose own proclivity to insolence has made them all say the same thing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَتَوَاصَوْاْ بِهِ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 53. Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So withdraw from them) so turn away from them, O Muhammad, (for thou art in nowise blameworthy) in Our sight; you have left them with no excuse and you have indeed conveyed the message. After this, Allah commanded him to fight them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. So, turn away (O Muḥammad ) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blameworthy (as you have conveyed Allāh’s Message)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So shun them for you will not be reproached because you have conveyed the Message to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 54. So, turn away (O Muḥammad ) from them (Quraish pagans), you are not blameworthy (as you have conveyed Allāh’s Message)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And warn) admonish by means of the Qur'an, (for warning) admonition by means of the Qur'an (profiteth believers) increases the righteousness of the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. And remind (by preaching the Qur’ān, O Muḥammad ), for verily, reminding profits the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And remind admonish by the Qur’ān for reminding truly benefits believers these being those whom God knows that they will believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 55. And remind (by preaching the Qur’ān, O Muḥammad ), for verily, reminding profits the believers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me) to worship me; this concerns only His obedient servants; and it is also said: had Allah created them for worship, they would not have disobeyed him for a blink of an eye. 'Ali Ibn Abi Talib said: I have not created them except to command them and entrust them with legal responsibility; and it is also said that this means: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might declare My divine Oneness and worship Me.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلإِنسَ إِلاَّ لِيَعْبُدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. And I (Allāh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they may worship Me the fact that disbelievers do not worship God does not contradict this statement since a purpose does not have to be realised in an act for it to be valid as when you may say ‘I sharpened this pencil in order to write with it’ even though you might not actually write with it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلإِنسَ إِلاَّ لِيَعْبُدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 56. And I (Allāh) created not the jinn and mankind except that they should worship Me (Alone)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (I seek no livelihood from them) I have not made them responsible to provide sustenance for themselves, (nor do I ask that they should feed Me) nor do I ask them to help Me to provide their provisions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I do not desire from them any provision either for Myself for themselves or for others nor do I desire that they should feed Me or feed themselves or others.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 57. I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood) to His slaves, (the Lord of unbreakable might) against His enemies, Who has in store a severe chastisement for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. Verily, Allāh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed it is God Who is the Provider the Lord of Strength the Firm the Stern.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 58. Verily, Allāh is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! for those who (now) do wrong) the disbelievers of Mecca (there is an evil day) torment after torment (like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old)) like the torment which befell the nations who came before them; (so let them not ask Me to hasten) chastisement and destruction (on (that day).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوباً مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلاَ يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not (ask Me to) hasten on!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And for those who have wronged their souls through disbelief from among the people of Mecca and others there will assuredly be a lot a share of chastisement like the lot the share of their counterparts who perished before them. So let them not ask Me to hasten on the chastisement should I give them respite until the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوباً مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَابِهِمْ فَلاَ يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 59. And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not (ask Me to) hasten on!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And woe) severe punishment (unto those who disbelieve) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an, (from (that) their day which they are promised) from the torment with which they are threatened and which was explained in surah the Mount (al-Tur)'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allāh and His Oneness — Islāmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For woe a terrible chastisement will come to those who disbelieve from upon that day of theirs which they are promised that is the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 60. Then woe to those who disbelieve (in Allāh and His Oneness — Islāmic Monotheism) from their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the Mount (wa't-Tur)): '(By the Mount) He says: Allah swears by the mount of Zubayr and every mount is a Tur as in the Syriac and Coptic languages, but Allah means here the mount whereon Allah spoke with Moses, and this mount is called the mount of Midian or Zubayr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the Ṭūr (Mount).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By the Mount that is the name of the mountain on which God spoke to Moses

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the Ṭūr (Mount).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And a Scripture inscribed) and He swore by the Guarded Tablet wherein all the works of the Children of Adam are registered

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by a Book Inscribed.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and an inscribed Book

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكِتَابٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by a Book Inscribed.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On fire parchment unrolled) which the Children of Adam will read on the Day of Judgement; this is the scroll of the guardian angels (al-hafazah),

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِي رَقٍّ مَّنْشُورٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. In parchment unrolled..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: on an unrolled parchment that is the Torah or the Qur’ān.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِي رَقٍّ مَّنْشُورٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. In parchment unrolled..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the House frequented) and Allah swore by the House which is filled with the angels. This House is in the sixth heaven opposite to the Ka'bah. There is between it and the Ka'bah, through the borderline of the seventh earth, a Sacred Precinct which is visited every single day by 70,000 angels who never return to visit it. This is the House that Adam built and was raised to the seventh heaven because of the flood, it is called al-dirah and is opposite of the Ka'bah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mūr(1) (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah in Makkah, continuously visited by the angels)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By the greatly frequented House — which is located in the third or the sixth or the seventh heaven directly above the Ka‘ba; it is visited every day by seventy thousand angels circumambulating it and performing prayers around it and never returning to it;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by Al-Bait-ul-Ma‘mūr(1) (the house over the heavens parallel to the Ka‘bah in Makkah, continuously visited by the angels)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the roof exalted) and He swore by the heaven which is raised above everything,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the raised roof that is to say the heaven

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by the roof raised high (i.e. the heaven)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the sea kept filled) and He swore by the full sea which is above the seventh heaven under the Throne of the Beneficent and which is called Life (al-Hayawan). Through it Allah will bring to life, on the Day of Judgement, all created beings. It is also said that 'the sea kept filled' is a hot sea which will become fire and will be opened in Gehenna on the Day of Judgement. Allah swore by all these things,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the swarming sea that is to say the one that is filled

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And by the sea kept filled (or it will be fire kindled on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the doom of thy Lord) on the Day of Judgement (will surely come to pass) will surely take place in relation to Quraysh;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: lo! your Lord’s chastisement will assuredly take place it will assuredly come down on those who deserve it;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَاقِعٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Verily, the Torment of your Lord will surely come to pass..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (There is none that can ward it off) there is none that can prevent this torment.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. There is none that can avert it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: there is none that can avert it from such a deserving one.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا لَهُ مِن دَافِعٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. There is none that can avert it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On the day when the heaven will heave) will rotate (with (awful) heaving) with its inhabitants on like the rotation of a millstone, and created beings will surge on each other because of the terror they see.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: On the day yawma is operated by la-wāqi‘un ‘will assuredly take place’ when the heaven will heave with a great heaving when it will move and spin

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. On the Day when the heaven will shake with a dreadful shaking,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the mountains move away) on the surface of the earth (with (awful) movement) like the movement of the clouds in the sky,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the mountains move with a great motion becoming scattered dust this is the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And the mountains will move away with a (horrible) movement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then woe) then severe chastisement (that day) which is the Day of Judgement (unto the deniers) of Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an; the reference here is to Abu Jahl and his host

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Then woe that Day to the deniers(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe then terrible chastisement will come on that day to the deniers of the messengers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Then woe that Day to the deniers(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who play in talk of grave matters) who engage in falsehood;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Who are playing in falsehood(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who play around in vain talk in falsehood that is to say those who are busily engaged with their disbelief;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِي خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Who are playing in falsehood(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The day when they are thrust with a (disdainful) thrust into the Fire of hell) the angels drag them on their faces and thrust them in Gehenna.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when they will be thrust with a violent thrust into Hell when they will be pushed violently this last clause yawma yuda‘‘ūna ilā nāri jahannama da‘‘an is a substitution for yawma tamūru ‘the day when the heaven will heave’ and it will be said to them in reproach

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. The Day when they will be pushed down by force to the Fire of Hell, with a horrible, forceful pushing..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The angels in-charge of hell will say to them: (This is the Fire which ye were wont to deny) in the life of the world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. This is the Fire which you used to deny..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘This is the Fire which you used to deny!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. This is the Fire which you used to deny..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Is this magic) is this Day and its torment magic, since you said in the life of the world to the messengers that they were wizards, (or do ye not see) or do you not perceive?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لاَ تُبْصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Is this magic or do you not see?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Is this then sorcery this chastisement that you see — as you were wont to say about the revelation that it was sorcery — or is it that you do not see?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَا أَمْ أَنتُمْ لاَ تُبْصِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Is this magic or do you not see?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah will say: (Endure the heat thereof) enter the Fire, (and whether ye are patient of it) of its torment (or impatient of it is all one for you) anxiety or patience is all one for you. (Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do) and say in the life of the world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوۤاْ أَوْ لاَ تَصْبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient or impatient, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Burn in it! And whether you endure it or do not endure your endurance and your anguish will be the same for you because your endurance will be of no use to you. You are only being requited for what you used to do’ that is to say only the requital for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوۤاْ أَوْ لاَ تَصْبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Taste you therein its heat and whether you are patient or impatient, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then showed the abode of the believers, Abu Bakr and his fellow believers, saying: (Lo! those who kept their duty) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (dwell in Gardens and delight) eternally,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Verily, the Muttaqūn (the pious)(2) will be in Gardens (Paradise) and Delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly the God-fearing will be amid gardens and bliss

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Verily, the Muttaqūn (the pious)(2) will be in Gardens (Paradise) and Delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Happy because of what your Lord hath given them) in the Garden, (and (because) their Lord hath warded off from them the torment of hellfire).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَآ آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Enjoying that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: rejoicing delighting in what bi-mā relates to the verbal action their Lord has given them and that their Lord has shielded them from the chastisement of Hell-fire wa-waqāhum rabbuhum ‘adhāba’l-jahīmi is a supplement to ātāhum ‘what He has given them’ in other words rejoicing in their having been given this reward and shielded from Hell-fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَاكِهِينَ بِمَآ آتَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Enjoying that which their Lord has bestowed on them, and (the fact that) their Lord saved them from the torment of the blazing Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah will then say to them: (Eat) of the fruits of the Garden (and drink) of its rivers (in health) suffering no illness, sin or death ((as reward) for what ye used to do) and say in the life of the world,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيئَاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. “Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it will said to them ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier that is to say muhanna’īna as a reward for what bi-mā the bi- is causative you used to do’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيئَاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. “Eat and drink with happiness because of what you used to do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Reclining) sitting (on ranged couches) ranged close to each other. (And We wed them) in the Garden (unto fair ones with wide, lovely eyes.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Ḥūr (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes (3). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will be reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the concealed subject of God’s words fī jannātin ‘amid gardens’ on ranged couches arranged one next to the other and We will wed them zawwajnāhum is a supplement to jannātin ‘gardens’ meaning ‘We will couple them’ to beautiful houris of wide and beautiful eyes.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُتَّكِئِينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ وَزَوَّجْنَاهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. They will recline (with ease) on thrones arranged in ranks. And We shall marry them to Ḥūr (female, fair ones) with wide lovely eyes (3). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And they who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an and are true in their faith (and whose seed follow them in faith) in the life of the world, (We cause their seed to join them (there)) in the Hereafter, enjoying the same rank as that of their fathers; it is also said that this means: and those who believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an, We will enter them into the Garden along with their young children, thus enjoying the same rank, because these offspring had already believed on the Day of the Primordial Covenant. We made their fathers follow them. It is also said that this means: We make the offspring attain to the same rank as that of the fathers, if the ranks of the fathers are higher, (and We deprive them of naught of their (life's) work) He says: We do not diminish the reward of the fathers at all upon making their offspring join them. (Every man is a pledge) such that Allah does with him as He will (for that which he hath earned) of sins.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهَينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And those who believed wa’lladhīna āmanū the subject and whom We made to be followed wa-atba‘nāhum a variant reading has wa’ttaba‘athum ‘and there followed them’ as a supplement to āmanū ‘who believed’ by their descendants dhurrīyātihim a variant reading for this plural has dhurrīyatuhum young and old in faith on the part of the older ones and on the part of the parents in their young ones the predicate of the subject above is the following alhaqnā bihim We will make their mentioned descendants join them in Paradise so that they are in the same degree of reward even though they might not have performed the same meritorious deeds as them to deserve this equal status a way of honouring the parents by having their children join them again; and We will not deprive them read alatnāhum or alitnāhum We will not diminish them of anything min shay’in min is extra of their deeds in order to add it to the deeds of their children. Every man is subject to what he has earned of good or evil deeds and will be requited for evil and rewarded for good.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَانٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَاهُمْ مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيْءٍ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهَينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And those who believe and whose offspring follow them in Faith: to them shall We join their offspring, and We shall not decrease the reward of their deeds in anything. Every person is a pledge for that which he has earned..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And We provide them) i.e. We provided the inhabitants of the Garden in the Garden (with fruit) with different kinds of fruit (and meat) i.e. birds' meat (such as they desire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And We will supply them We will enhance for them their provision from time to time with fruits and meat such as they desire even if they do not request it openly.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمْدَدْنَاهُم بِفَاكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And We shall provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: There) in the Garden (they pass from hand to hand a cup) of wine (wherein is neither vanity) stomach-ache because of drinking it (nor cause of sin) from drinking it; it is also said that " vanity " means: falsehood and oaths, and " cause of sin " means: abusing and lying to each other, which means: in the Garden there is neither falsehood and oaths nor abuse and lying.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْساً لاَّ لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلاَ تَأْثِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin (1) (because it will be lawful for them to drink)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will pass from one to another therein in Paradise a cup of wine wherein is neither vain talk which might come about between them as a result of drinking it nor cause for sin thereby that might befall them — in contrast to the case with the wine of this world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَتَنَازَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْساً لاَّ لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلاَ تَأْثِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk between them), and free from sin (1) (because it will be lawful for them to drink)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And there go round) to serve them, (waiting on them menservants of their own), in their limpidity they (as they were hidden pearls) hidden from heat and cold.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them, as if they were preserved pearls..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And there will circulate from all around them for service youths delicate in demeanour of their own as if in terms of their beauty and immaculateness they were hidden pearls preserved inside shells because when it a pearl is inside it it is better than one that is not.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them, as if they were preserved pearls..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And some of them draw near unto others) upon visiting, (questioning) talking about the life of the world,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And some of them draw near to others, questioning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And some among them will turn to one another questioning each other — they ask one another about how they were in the past and what they have now attained in their delight and acknowledgement of the grace of God to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And some of them draw near to others, questioning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Saying: Lo! of old) before entering the Garden, (when we were with our families) in the life of the world, (we were ever anxious) we were fearful of Allah's chastisement;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيۤ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Saying: “Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allāh) in the midst of our families..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They say as an intimation of the reason for this attainment ‘Truly before amid our families in the world we used to be ever anxious afraid of God’s chastisement;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِيۤ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Saying: “Aforetime, we were afraid (of the punishment of Allāh) in the midst of our families..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But Allah hath been gracious unto us) with forgiveness, mercy and entry into the Garden (and hath preserved us from) and has driven away from us (the torment of the breath of Fire) the chastisement of the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. “So Allāh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but God showed us favour through His forgiveness and shielded us from the piercing chastisement al-samūm the Fire so called because it penetrates the pores al-masāmm; and they say also by way of intimation

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَانَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. “So Allāh has been gracious to us, and has saved us from the torment of the Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! we used to pray unto Him) we used to worship Him and declare His divine Oneness (of old) before this forgiveness, mercy and entry into the Garden. (Lo! He is the Benign) He is Truthful in His word regarding that which He promised us, (the Merciful) towards His believing slaves, since He hath shown mercy towards us.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: indeed before that is in the world we used to call on Him worship Him affirming His Oneness. Verily He is read innahu as the beginning of a new independent sentence even if it introduces the reason in terms of its import; or read annahu as a reason in terms of the syntactical order of the words the Benign the Beneficent the True to His promise the Merciful One of tremendous mercy.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ إِنَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “Verily, We used to invoke Him (Alone and none else) before. Verily, He is Al-Barr (the Most Subtle, Kind, Courteous, and Generous), the Most Merciful.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore warn) therefore, admonish by means of the Qur'an, O Muhammad. (By the grace of Allah) prophethood and Islam (thou art neither soothsayer) foretelling the future (nor madman) bewitched.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلاَ مَجْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Therefore, remind (mankind of Islāmic Monotheism, O Muḥammad ). By the Grace of Allāh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So remind persist in reminding the idolaters and do not desist from this even if they say to you that you are a soothsayer or a madman. For by the grace of your Lord by His bestowal of grace on you you are neither soothsayer bi-kāhinin is the predicate of mā nor madman wa-lā majnūnin a supplement to it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلاَ مَجْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Therefore, remind (mankind of Islāmic Monotheism, O Muḥammad ). By the Grace of Allāh, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or say they) in fact, the disbelievers of Mecca-Abu Jahl, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah and their hosts-say: ((he is) a poet) who invents things, ((one) for whom we may expect the accident of time) we wait to see him suffer the pangs of death?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Or do they say: “(Muḥammad  is) a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or am means bal do they say that he is ‘A poet for whom we may await the accidents of fate?’ the vicissitudes of time so that he will just die like other poets.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. Or do they say: “(Muḥammad  is) a poet! We await for him some calamity by time!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) O Muhammad, to Abu Jahl, al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah and their hosts: (Expect (your fill)) wait for my death! (Lo! I am with you among the expectant) I will also wait for your chastisement; and they were indeed punished on the Day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Say (O Muḥammad  to them): “Wait! I am with you among theose who wait!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘Await! my death. For I too will be with you awaiting’ your death. They were then chastised with death by the sword on the day of Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Say (O Muḥammad  to them): “Wait! I am with you among theose who wait!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Do their minds command them to do this) denial, abuse and harm of Muhammad (pbuh). This was said as an attack against them, (or are they) they are indeed (an outrageous folk) disbelievers and arrogant folk with regard to transgressing against Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلاَمُهُمْ بِهَـٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Or do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muḥammad )] or are they a people transgressing all bounds?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do their faculties of understanding prompt them to say this? their saying to him you are either a sorcerer a poet a soothsayer or a madman in other words they do not in reality prompt them to say this. Or am in effect means bal ‘rather’ are they a rebellious lot? because of their obstinacy.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلاَمُهُمْ بِهَـٰذَآ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Or do their minds command them this [i.e. to tell a lie against you (Muḥammad )] or are they a people transgressing all bounds?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or say they) indeed the disbelievers of Mecca say: (He hath invented it?) Muhammad lies and has invented the Qur'an. (Nay, but they will not believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an as in Allah's pre-eternal knowledge!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَل لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. Or do they say: “He (Muḥammad ) has forged it (this Qur’ān)?” Nay! They believe not!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they say ‘He has improvised it?’ he has concocted the Qur’ān. He has not concocted it; Rather they do not believe out of arrogance. If they continue to say that he has concocted it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُ بَل لاَّ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. Or do they say: “He (Muḥammad ) has forged it (this Qur’ān)?” Nay! They believe not!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then let them produce speech the like thereof) let them produce a Qur'an like the Qur'an of Muhammad (pbuh) (if they are truthful) that Muhammad has invented the Qur'an:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلْيَأْتُواْ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُواْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. Let them then produce a discourse like it (the Qur’ān) if they are truthful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then let them bring a concocted discourse like it if they are truthful in what they say.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلْيَأْتُواْ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِ إِن كَانُواْ صَادِقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. Let them then produce a discourse like it (the Qur’ān) if they are truthful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or were they created out of naught) without a father; and it is also said: without a Lord? (Or are they the creators) rather than being the created?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُواْ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَالِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Or were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or were they created out of nothing? that is without a Creator. Or are they the creators? of themselves. It makes no sense for a created thing to have no creator nor can a thing that will cease to existent have the power to create. There must be a Creator of them and that is God the One so why do they not affirm His Oneness and believe in His Messenger and His Book?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خُلِقُواْ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَيْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَالِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Or were they created by nothing? Or were they themselves the creators?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or did they create the heavens and the earth?) It is Allah Who created them. (Nay, but they are sure of nothing!) but they deny Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بَل لاَّ يُوقِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nor can any but God the Creator have created them so why do they not worship Him? Nay but they are not certain of Him for otherwise they would have believed in His Prophet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضَ بَل لاَّ يُوقِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nay, but they have no firm Belief..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or do they own the treasures of thy Lord) or do they possess the stores of your Lord through rain, provision, vegetation and prophethood? (Or have they been given charge (thereof)?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? in the way of prophethood provision and other matters so that they are able to assign what they will exclusively to whom they will? Or are they the ones in control? or are they the mighty ones who hold sway? the verb from musaytirūna is saytara similar in root form to baytara ‘to practice veterinary medicine’ or bayqara ‘to corrupt’ ‘to ruin’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَيْطِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Or are with them the treasures of your Lord? Or are they the tyrants with the authority to do as they like?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Or have they any stairway (unto heaven) by means of which they overhear (decrees). Then let their listener produce warrant manifest) let their listener produce a clear proof for what they say!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they have a ladder a means of ascension into the heaven whereby they eavesdrop? that is at the top of which they listen in on the conversations of the angels so that they are then able to dispute with the Prophet as they claim. If that is what they assert Then let their eavesdropper let the one claiming to be able to listen in on their conversations on top of this ladder produce a manifest warrant a plain and evident proof. Now on account of the similarity of this assertion to their assertion that the angels are the daughters of God He exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Or have they a stairway (to heaven), by means of which they listen (to the talks of the angels)? Then let their listener produce some manifest proof..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or hath He daughters) or are you pleased for attributing daughters to Him while you yourselves dislike them (whereas ye have sons) whereas you chose sons?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. Or has He (Allāh) only daughters and you have sons?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or does He have daughters as you claim whereas you have sons? Exalted be God above what you claim!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. Or has He (Allāh) only daughters and you have sons?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or askest thou) O Muhammad (a fee from them) in exchange for their faith (so that they are plunged in debt) so that they are drowned in debt if they accept to give you a fee?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْراً فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Or is it that you (O Muḥammad ) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islāmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or are you asking them for a fee a wage in return for what you have brought them in the way of religion so that they are weighed down with debt? with the liability for this so that they are unable to submit to God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ تَسْأَلُهُمْ أَجْراً فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Or is it that you (O Muḥammad ) ask a wage from them (for your preaching of Islāmic Monotheism) so that they are burdened with a load of debt?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or possess they the Unseen) and therefore know that they will not be resurrected (so that they can write (it) down?) that is to say, or do they have a book in which they write whatever they will from the Guarded Tablet, such that they write down what they say and do?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they have access to the Unseen that is the knowledge of it so that they can write it down? and are hence able to dispute with the Prophet s regarding the Resurrection and the matters relating to the Hereafter as they claim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Or that the Ghaib (Unseen) is with them, and they write it down?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or seek they) indeed they seek (to ensnare (the messenger)) to kill you, O Muhammad? (But those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca: Abu Jahl and his host who planned to kill the Prophet (pbuh) (they are the ensnared!) they are the ones who will be killed on the Day of Badr!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْداً فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muḥammad )? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they desire to outmanoeuvre? you and have you killed at the Assembly Council. But those who disbelieve they are the outmanoeuvred ones! the vanquished and the ones destroyed. God preserved him from them and then destroyed them at Badr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْداً فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. Or do they intend a plot (against you O Muḥammad )? But those who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allāh — Islāmic Monotheism) are themselves plotted against!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or have they any god beside Allah) who will save them from Allah's torment? (Glorified be Allah) Allah exonerates Himself (from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him)) of idols!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. Or have they an ilāh (a god) other than Allāh? Glorified is Allāh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Or do they have a god other than God? Glory be to God exalted is He above any partners that they may ascribe! to Him in the way of gods the succession of interrogatives with am ‘or’ are intended to express censure and rebuke.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ سُبْحَانَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. Or have they an ilāh (a god) other than Allāh? Glorified is Allāh from all that they ascribe as partners (to Him)(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And if they) the disbelievers of Mecca (were to see a fragment of the heaven falling, they would say: A heap of clouds) because of their denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْاْ كِسْفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطاً يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. And if they were to see pieces of the heaven falling down, they would say: “Clouds gathered in heaps!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And if they were to see a fragment a portion of the heaven falling on them — as they say Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us Q. 26187 as a chastisement for them — they would say this is ‘A heap of clouds!’ piled on top of one another that will bring us water; and so they do not believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْاْ كِسْفاً مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطاً يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. And if they were to see pieces of the heaven falling down, they would say: “Clouds gathered in heaps!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then let them be) leave them, O Muhammad, (till they meet) until they behold (their day, in which they will be thunder-stricken) they will die,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. So, leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So leave them until they encounter that day of theirs in which they will be thunderstruck in which they will die;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. So, leave them alone till they meet their Day, in which they will sink into a fainting (with horror)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A day) which is the Day of Judgement (in which their guile will naught avail them) the doing of Abu Jahl and his host will not benefit them at all against Allah's chastisement, (nor will they be helped) nor will they be prevented from what is wanted with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when their guile will avail them nothing yawma lā yughnī is a substitution for yawmahumu ‘that day of theirs’ and they will not be helped they will not be protected from the chastisement in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ يُغْنِي عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْئاً وَلاَ هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. The Day when their plotting shall not avail them at all, nor will they be helped (i.e. they will receive their torment in Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And verily, for those who do wrong) the idolaters: the disbelievers of Mecca, (there is a punishment) in the grave (beyond that) other than the chastisement of Gehenna. (But most of them) all of them (know not) this nor believe in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَاباً دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) (2) before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And assuredly for those who do wrong by their persistence in disbelief there is a chastisement beyond that in this world before their death — thus they were punished with famine and drought for seven years and with being killed on the day of Badr; but most of them do not know that the chastisement will befall them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَاباً دُونَ ذَلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لاَ يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. And verily, for those who do wrong, there is another punishment (i.e. the torment in this world and in their graves) (2) before this; but most of them know not. (Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for your Lord's decree) upon conveying the message of your Lord; and it is said this means: be content with the decree of your Lord regarding that which befalls you in the course of obeying your Lord, (for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (when thou uprisest) from your bed for the Fajr prayer.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. So, wait patiently (O Muḥammad ) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes (1), and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord that they be reprieved and do not be grieved for surely you fare before Our eyes you are in Our sight We see you and preserve you. And glorify continuously with praise of your Lord that is to say say subhāna’Llāhi wa bi-hamdihi ‘Glory and praise be to God!’ when you rise from your sleeping-place or your sitting-place

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. So, wait patiently (O Muḥammad ) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes (1), and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And in the night time) upon the advent of the night (also hymn His praise) pray for Him the prayer of Zuhr, 'Asr, Maghrib and 'Isha', (and at the setting of the stars) two units of prayers after Fajr, and the setting of the star when it goes down'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And in a part of the night also glorify His Praises — and at the setting of the stars (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and glorify Him at night — also in actual utterance — and at the receding of the stars idbāra is a verbal noun that is to say also glorify Him after these have set; or it means in the case of the former perform the two evening prayers and in the case of the latter the two units rak‘a of the dawn prayer or — it is said — the morning prayer.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَارَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. And in a part of the night also glorify His Praises — and at the setting of the stars (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the Najm when it setteth): '(By the Najm when it setteth) He says: Allah swears by the Qur'an when Gabriel takes it down to Muhammad in instalments (nujuman): one, two, three or four verses at a time. There was a 20 years interval between the first and last verses. When this verse was revealed, 'Utbah Ibn Abi Lahab heard that the Prophet (pbuh) swore by the revelation of the Qur'an in instalment and so he said: “Tell Muhammad that I disbelieve in the instalments of the Qur'an”. When the Prophet (pbuh) was informed of this, he prayed: “O Allah! Set on him one of Your wild beasts”. Later, Allah set on him a lion near Harran that snatched him from among his friends and took him to a place nearby. It tore him apart from head to foot but did not eat him because of his impurity, just as the Prophet (pbuh) had prayed against him. It is also said here Allah swore by the stars when they set,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the star when it goes down (or vanishes)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By the Star — the constellation Pleiades al-thurayya — when it sets when it disappears

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the star when it goes down (or vanishes)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Your comrade erreth not) this is the reason why Allah made the above oath: your Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) did not lie about what he said to you, (nor is deceived) he is not wrong nor did he err in what he said;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Your companion (Muḥammad ) has neither gone astray nor has erred..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: your companion Muhammad (s) may God bless him and grant him peace has neither gone astray from the path of guidance nor has he erred nor has he engaged in error al-ghayy is ignorance that results from a false belief;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Your companion (Muḥammad ) has neither gone astray nor has erred..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire) he did not utter the Qur'an of his own desire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Nor does he speak of (his own) desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: nor does he in regard to what he brings you speak out of his own desire out of the whims of his soul.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Nor does he speak of (his own) desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (It is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught save an inspiration) from Allah (that is inspired) to him through Gabriel who comes and recites it to him,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. It is only a Revelation revealed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is but a revelation that is revealed to him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ وَحْيٌ يُوحَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. It is only a Revelation revealed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Which one of mighty powers hath taught him) Gabriel taught him,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. He has been taught (this Qur’ān) by one mighty in power [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: it is taught to him by an angel one of awesome power

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَّمَهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. He has been taught (this Qur’ān) by one mighty in power [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (One vigorous) one strong; it is also said this means: one mighty, for his strength was such that he put his hand under the townships of Lot and pulled them out, raised them to the sky and threw them upside down to the ground. His strength was also such that he seized the sides of the gate of Antioch and cried one cry that killed all the living creatures in it. It is also said that his strength was such that he spread one of his feathers on a hill in Jerusalem and struck with it Iblis who was at the farthest corner of India; (and he grew clear to view) Gabriel appeared in the form in which Allah created it him; and it is also said: he appeared in a beautiful form.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrā’īl — Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: possessed of vigour of strength and might or alternatively it dhū mirratin means possessed of a beautiful appearance namely Gabriel peace be upon him; and he stood upright he settled

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. One free from any defect in body and mind then he (Jibrā’īl — Gabriel in his real shape as created by Allah) rose and became stable..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When he was on the uppermost horizon) at the setting place of the sun; and it is said: at the seventh heaven.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. While he [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when he was on the highest horizon the horizon of the sun that is to say at the place from which it rises in the form in which he Gabriel was created so that the Prophet s saw him; he the Prophet had been at Mount Hirā’ where Gabriel had obscured the entire horizon to the west. The Prophet fell down swooning after he had asked him Gabriel to show himself to him in the form in which he was created. Thus Gabriel had made a tryst with him at Hirā’ where he came down to him in human form.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلأَعْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. While he [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] was in the highest part of the horizon, (Tafsīr Ibn Kathīr).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then he drew nigh) Gabriel drew near Muhammad (pbuh); and it is said: Muhammad (pbuh) drew near to his Lord (and came down) closer,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Then he [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then he drew near he came close to him and drew closer still

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Then he [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] approached and came closer,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Till he was (distant) two bows length) of the bows used by the Arabs (or even nearer) nearer by half a bow length,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And was at a distance of two bows’ length or (even) nearer..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: until he was from him the Prophet within the length of two bows away or even nearer than that until he the Prophet had regained consciousness and his fright had subsided

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
