tafsir: and those who are keepers faithful guardians of their trusts amānātihim a variant reading has the singular amānatihim that to which they are entrusted of religion and the affairs of this world and their covenant the one taken from them regarding such things

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لأَمَانَاتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَاعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And those who keep their trusts and covenants..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who stand by their testimony) before the judges when they are called to give witness, and do not refuse to testify,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِم قَائِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And those who stand firm in their testimonies..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and who are forthwith with their testimony bi-shahādatihim a variant reading has the plural bi-shahādātihim ‘their testimonies’ those who offer them and do not withhold them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ بِشَهَادَاتِهِم قَائِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And those who stand firm in their testimonies..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who are attentive at their worship) they observe the prescribed times of their five daily prayers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلاَتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And those who guard their Ṣalāt (prayers) well (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and who preserve their prayers by observing them in their appointed times.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَالَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلاَتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And those who guard their Ṣalāt (prayers) well (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (These) those who have such traits (will dwell in Gardens, honoured) with reward, presents and gifts.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Those will be in Gardens honoured.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أُوْلَـٰئِكَ فِي جَنَّاتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Such shall dwell in the Gardens (i.e. Paradise), honoured..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (What aileth those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca who mock the believers as well as the other disbelievers, (that they keep staring towards thee (O Muhammad)) around you, (open eyed) looking at you without coming close to you,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muḥammad (), in order to deny you and to mock at you, and at Allāh’s Book (this Qur’ān)],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So what is wrong with those who disbelieve that they keep staring towards you muhti‘īna is a circumstantial qualifier

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَالِ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. So what is the matter with those who disbelieve that they hasten to listen from you [O Muḥammad (), in order to deny you and to mock at you, and at Allāh’s Book (this Qur’ān)],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Dispersed (On the right and on the left, in groups?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muḥammad )?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to the right and to the left of you in droves? ‘izīna is also a circumstantial qualifier in other words in groups standing in circles one next to the other saying in mockery of the believers ‘Verily if the likes of these are to enter Paradise we shall enter it before them’. God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. (Sitting) in groups on the right and on the left (of you, O Muḥammad )?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?) This is an answer from Allah to the disbelievers that He will not let them enter the Garden.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Does each one of them hope to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِىءٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of Delight?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, verily. Lo! We created them) i.e. the disbelievers of Mecca (from what they know) i.e. a sperm drop.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay! — meant to thwart their hopes of entering Paradise. Indeed We created them as others from what they know from drops of sperm and so one cannot hope for Paradise merely on account of this one hopes for it by being God-fearing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَاهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. No, that is not like that! Verily, We have created them out of that which they know! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But nay! I swear by the Lord of the rising places) the rising places of winter and summer (and the setting places of the planets) the setting places of winter and summer. There are two rising places and two setting places. The rising place of winter and summer has 177 phases and so do the setting places of winter and summer. The sun rises, in a year, two days in the same phase, and it also sets, in a year, two days in the same phase (that We are Able) this is the reason of the above oath

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. So, I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For verily fa-lā lā is extra I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the sun the moon and all the stars that We are able

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَٰدِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. So, I swear by the Lord of all the [three hundred and sixty-five (365)] points of sunrise and sunset in the east and the west that surely We are Able.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (To replace them by (others) better than them) He says: We are Able to destroy them and replace them with others who are better and more obedient than them. (And We are not to be outrun) We are unable to replace them with others who are better than them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْراً مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to replace them to bring in their place with others better than them and We are not to be outmanoeuvred We will not be frustrated in this.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَىٰ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْراً مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. To replace them by (others) better than them; and We are not to be outrun..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So let them) O Muhammad, i.e. let those who mock you and the other disbelievers (chat) about falsehood (and play) and mock you while continuing to be disbelievers (until they meet) until they behold (their Day which they are promised) in which they are promised chastisement,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. So, leave them to plunge in vain talk(1) and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So leave them to indulge in their falsehoods and to play in this world of theirs until they encounter that day of theirs in which they are promised chastisement;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُواْ وَيَلْعَبُواْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. So, leave them to plunge in vain talk(1) and play about, until they meet their Day which they are promised —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then explained when this chastisement will take place, saying: (The day when they come forth from the graves in haste) in response to the sound (as racing to a goal) or a banner,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعاً كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when they will come forth from the graves hastening to the site of the Gathering as if racing to a standing target nasbin a variant reading has nusubin meaning something that has been erected mansūb such as a flag or a banner

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعاً كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. The Day when they will come out of the graves quickly as racing to a goal,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (With eyes) that see no goodness (aghast) humiliated, (abasement stupefying them) grief and darkness appear on their faces: (Such is the Day which they are promised) such is the Day in which they were promised chastisement; and this day is the Day of Judgement. And this promise is like the promise and warning of Noah'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: with their eyes humbled abject overcast by abasement shrouded in it. Such is the day which they are promised dhālika is the subject and what follows it is the predicate meaning the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يُوعَدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. With their eyes lowered in fear and humility, ignominy covering them (all over)! That is the Day which they were promised!(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Lo! We sent): '(Lo! We sent Noah unto his people (saying): Warn your people) from Allah's wrath and punishment (ere the painful doom come unto them) in the form of drowning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاً إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Verily, We sent Nūḥ (Noah) to his people (saying): “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily We sent Noah to his people saying ‘Warn your people before there come on them — should they not believe — a painful chastisement’ in this world and in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحاً إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Verily, We sent Nūḥ (Noah) to his people (saying): “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful torment.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He said: O my people! Lo! I am a plain warner unto you) I am a warning messenger unto you, addressing you in a language you understand.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. He said: “O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘O my people I am indeed a plain warner to you one whose warning is plain

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ يٰقَوْمِ إِنِّي لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. He said: “O my people! Verily, I am a plain warner to you,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Bidding you): Serve Allah) declare Allah's divine Oneness (and keep your duty unto Him) fear Him and repent of disbelief and idolatry (and obey me) and follow my matter, religion and counsel and accept my advice to you,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنِ ٱعبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. “That you should worship Allāh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to tell you that you should worship God and fear Him and obey me

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَنِ ٱعبُدُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. “That you should worship Allāh (Alone), fear (be dutiful to) Him, and obey me,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That He may forgive you somewhat of your sins) He will forgive your sins through your repentance and belief in Allah's divine Oneness (and respite you) without sending a punishment on you (to an appointed term) until you die. (Lo! the term of Allah) the torment of Allah, (when it cometh, cannot be delayed, if ye but knew) if you believe in what I say to you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لاَ يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. “He (Allāh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allāh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: that He may forgive you some of your sins min dhunūbikum ‘some of your sins’ min may be taken as extra because submission to God islām expunges everything of sin that was committed previous to it; or it min may be understood as partitive to point out that which is due to those who were already God’s servants and defer you without chastising you until an appointed term the term for death. Indeed when God’s term for your chastisement — should you not believe — comes it cannot be deferred if only you knew’ this you would believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لاَ يُؤَخَّرُ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. “He (Allāh) will forgive you of your sins and respite you to an appointed term. Verily, the term of Allāh when it comes, cannot be delayed, if you but knew.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: When he despaired of them, after calling them to faith for 950 years, and they refused to believe or heed his advice, (He said: My Lord! Lo! I have called unto my people) to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (night and day) at night and during the day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلاً وَنَهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. He said: “O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islāmic Mono theism), (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said ‘My Lord I have summoned my people night and day that is to say continuously without interruption

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِي لَيْلاً وَنَهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. He said: “O my Lord! Verily, I have called to my people night and day (i.e. secretly and openly to accept the doctrine of Islāmic Mono theism), (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But all my calling) to them to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (doth but add to their repugnance) does but increase their remoteness from faith and repentance;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآئِيۤ إِلاَّ فِرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. “But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but my summon has only increased their evasion of faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآئِيۤ إِلاَّ فِرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. “But all my calling added nothing but to (their) flight (from the truth)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! Whenever I call unto them) to repentance and belief in Allah's divine Oneness (that Thou mayst pardon them) through their repentance and faith in Allah's divine Oneness (they thrust their fingers in their ears) so as not to hear my words and invitation (and cover themselves with their garments) and cover their heads with their garments so that they do not hear my voice or see me (and persist (in their refusal)) and they remain firm in their disbelief and worship of idols; it is also said that they all shouted in unison: “O Noah! We will not believe in you”, (and magnify themselves in pride) and feel too proud to accept faith or repent, because of their arrogance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوۤاْ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِيۤ آذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْاْ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُواْ ٱسْتِكْبَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “And Verily, every time I called to them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their gar- ments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified them selves in pride. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And indeed whenever I summoned them so that You might forgive them they put their fingers in their ears in order not to hear what I say and draw their cloaks over themselves they cover their heads with them in order not to catch sight of me and they persist in their disbelief and act in great arrogance disdaining faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنِّي كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوۤاْ أَصَابِعَهُمْ فِيۤ آذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْاْ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّواْ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُواْ ٱسْتِكْبَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. “And Verily, every time I called to them that You might forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, covered themselves up with their gar- ments, and persisted (in their refusal), and magnified them selves in pride. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! I have called unto them) to repent and believe in Allah's divine Oneness (aloud) openly, thus avoiding secrecy,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. “Then Verily, I called to them openly (aloud)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then indeed I summoned them aloud that is to say at the top of my voice;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّي دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. “Then Verily, I called to them openly (aloud)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! I have made public proclamation unto them) I called them openly to the message and explained to them, (and I have appealed to them in private) and I called them secretly to the message.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيۤ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. “Then Verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then assuredly I proclaimed to them with my voice and I confided my words to them secretly

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنِّيۤ أَعْلَنْتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. “Then Verily, I proclaimed to them in public, and I have appealed to them in private..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And I have said) to them: (Seek pardon of your Lord) declare the divine Oneness of your Lord and repent of disbelief and idolatry. (Lo! He was ever Forgiving) of those who repent of disbelief and believe in Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: saying “Ask your Lord for forgiveness from idolatry. Assuredly He is ever Forgiving.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُ كَانَ غَفَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “I said (to them): ‘Ask forgiveness from your Lord, Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain) whenever you need rain. This is because Allah had withheld rain from them for 40 years,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He will release the heaven the rain — for they had been deprived of it — for you in torrents in plenteous showers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُمْ مِّدْرَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. ‘He will send rain to you in abundance,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And will help you with wealth) camels, bovines, sheep (and sons) and daughters; this is because Allah had stopped their wives and beasts from conceiving for 40 years, (and will assign unto you Gardens and will assign unto you rivers) flowing rivers for your own benefits. This is because Allah had, before this, destroyed their fields and made their rivers dry for 40 years.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and furnish you with wealth and sons and assign to you gardens orchards and assign to you running rivers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُمْدِدْكُمْ بِأَمْوَالٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّاتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. ‘And give you increase in wealth and children, and bestow on you gardens and bestow on you rivers.’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (What aileth you that ye hope not towards Allah for dignity) what ails you that you do not fear Allah's might and majesty; and it is also said that this means: what ails you that you do not magnify Allah as He deserves to be magnified and, thus, believe in His divine Oneness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لاَ تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allāh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allāh or you believe not in His Oneness)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: What is wrong with you that you do not hope for dignity from God that is to say that you do not hope that God will dignify you by becoming believers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مَّا لَكُمْ لاَ تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. What is the matter with you, that [you fear not Allāh (His punishment), and] you hope not for reward (from Allāh or you believe not in His Oneness)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When He created you by (diverse) stages?) The stages refer to sperm drops, blood clots, small chunks of flesh and bones, etc.,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nuṭfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Muḍghah](1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when verily He created you in stages? atwār is the plural of tūr which means a state. Thus the sperm-drop is one state the blood clot is another state and so on until the creation of the human being is complete reflecting on the manner of his creation necessarily leads to belief in his Creator.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. While He has created you in (different) stages [i.e. first Nuṭfah, then ‘Alaqah and then Muḍghah](1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (See ye not) have you not been informed, O disbelievers of Mecca, (how Allah hath created seven heavens in harmony) He created them one above the other like a dome whose different parts are cemented with each other,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. See you not how Allāh has created the seven heavens one above another?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Have you not seen how God created seven heavens in layers one on top of the other

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَوْاْ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. See you not how Allāh has created the seven heavens one above another?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hath made the moon) along with them (a light therein) a shining light therein, (and made the sun a lamp) a radiance for the children of Adam?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُوراً وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and made the moon therein — that is to say within their totality but which is effectively true in the case of the heaven of this world — as a light and made the sun as a lamp? as an illuminating lantern more powerful than the light of the moon.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُوراً وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And has made the moon a light therein, and made the sun a lamp?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Allah hath caused you to grow as a growth from the earth) He created you from Adam, and Adam is created from dust and the dust is from the earth,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ نَبَاتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And Allāh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth. (Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And God has caused you to grow He has created you from the earth for He created your father Adam from it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَنبَتَكُمْ مِّنَ ٱلأَرْضِ نَبَاتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And Allāh has brought you forth from the (dust of) earth. (Tafsīr Aṭ-Ṭabarī).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And afterward He maketh you return thereto) He will burry you in the earth, (and He will bring you forth again) from the graves on the Day of Judgement, (a (new) forthbringing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then He will make you return into it entombed in your graves and bring you forth for the resurrection with a veritable bringing forth.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Afterwards He will return you into it (the earth), and bring you forth (again on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And Allah hath made the earth a wide expanse for you) to lay and sleep on

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلأَرْضَ بِسَاطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And Allāh has made for you the earth a wide expanse. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And God has made the earth a flat open expanse for you

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلأَرْضَ بِسَاطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And Allāh has made for you the earth a wide expanse. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That ye may thread the valley ways thereof) that you may follow wide ways thereof.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُواْ مِنْهَا سُبُلاً فِجَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. That you may go about therein in broad roads..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so that you may follow throughout it spacious routes.” ’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّتَسْلُكُواْ مِنْهَا سُبُلاً فِجَاجاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. That you may go about therein in broad roads..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Noah said: My Lord!) O my Lord! (They have disobeyed me) regarding repentance and faith in Allah's divine Oneness (and followed) and obeyed (one whose) abundant (wealth and children increase him in naught save ruin) in the Hereafter; this refers to the chieftains of his folk;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلاَّ خَسَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Nūḥ (Noah) said: “My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Noah said ‘My Lord they have disobeyed me and followed that is the riffraff and the paupers among them have followed those whose wealth and children namely their leaders who have been blessed with such things read wulduhu or waladuhu ‘whose children’ the first of which is said to be the plural of walad similar in pattern to khasab khushb or in fact it is said to be of the same meaning as walad but an alternative form as in the case of bukhl or bakhal ‘niggardliness’ only add to their loss to their insolence and disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِي وَٱتَّبَعُواْ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُ وَوَلَدُهُ إِلاَّ خَسَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Nūḥ (Noah) said: “My Lord! They have disobeyed me, and followed one whose wealth and children give him no increase but loss..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they have plotted a mighty plot) and they have uttered a tremendous lie,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْراً كُبَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. “And they have plotted a mighty plot..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they have devised namely the leaders a mighty plot extremely outrageous by denying Noah and harming him as well as his followers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَكَرُواْ مَكْراً كُبَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. “And they have plotted a mighty plot..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they have said) i.e. the chieftains said to the communality of the people: (Forsake not your gods) forsake not the worship of your Lord. (Forsake not Wadd) forsake not the worship of Wadd, (nor Suwa') nor the worship of Suwa', (nor Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr) nor the worship of Yaghuth and Ya'uq and Nasr. These were idols which Noah's folk worshipped.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ لاَ تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَذَرُنَّ وَدّاً وَلاَ سُوَاعاً وَلاَ يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth, nor Ya‘ūq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and have said to the riffraff “Do not abandon your gods and do not abandon Wadd read Wadd or Wudd nor Suwā‘ nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr” — these being the names of their idols.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالُواْ لاَ تَذَرُنَّ آلِهَتَكُمْ وَلاَ تَذَرُنَّ وَدّاً وَلاَ سُوَاعاً وَلاَ يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “And they have said: ‘You shall not leave your gods: nor shall you leave Wadd, nor Suwā‘, nor Yaghūth, nor Ya‘ūq nor Nasr’ (these are the names of their idols)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And they have led many astray) he says: they have misled through them many people; and it is also said: many people went astray because of them, (and Thou increasest the wrong-doers) the disbelievers and idolaters in their worship of these idols (in naught save error) loss and destruction.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيراً وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ ضَلاَلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allāh): ‘Grant no increase to the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) except error.’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they have certainly led astray by these gods many people by commanding them to worship them. And do not O God increase the evildoers except in error!’ wa-lā tazidi’l-zālimīna illā dalālan is a supplement to qad adallū ‘they have certainly led astray’ He Noah invoked God against them when it was revealed to him that ‘None of your people will believe except he who has already believed’ Q. 1136.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّواْ كَثِيراً وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ ضَلاَلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. “And indeed they have led many astray. And (O Allāh): ‘Grant no increase to the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) except error.’”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Because of their sins they were drowned) by the flood in the life of the world, (then made to enter) in the Hereafter (a Fire. And they found they had no helpers in place of Allah) they had no helpers to defend them against Allah's chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيۤئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُواْ فَأُدْخِلُواْ نَاراً فَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ لَهُمْ مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Because of mimmā mā indicates a relative clause their iniquities khatāyāhum a variant reading has khatī’ātihim they were drowned by the Flood then made to enter the Fire with which they were punished underwater after drowning. And they did not find for themselves besides that is to say other than God any helpers to protect them against the chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مِّمَّا خَطِيۤئَاتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُواْ فَأُدْخِلُواْ نَاراً فَلَمْ يَجِدُواْ لَهُمْ مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Because of their sins they were drowned, then were made to enter the Fire. And they found none to help them instead of Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Noah said) after Allah told him that none of his people will believe in him, apart from those who had already believed: (My Lord!) O my Lord! (Leave not one of the disbelievers in the land.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لاَ تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And Nūḥ (Noah) said: “My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And Noah said ‘My Lord do not leave from among the disbelievers a single dweller upon the earth dayyār means ‘one who inhabits a dwelling dār’ in other words not one.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لاَ تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَافِرِينَ دَيَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And Nūḥ (Noah) said: “My Lord! Leave not one of the disbelievers on the earth!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves) they will mislead from Your religion those who believe in You and those who wish to believe in You, (and will beget none save lewd ingrates) and will not beget save offspring who are sinful and disbelievers when they reach the age of reason; and it is also said this means: save those upon whom You have decreed disbelief and lewdness when they reach the age of reason; and it is also said that they did not have among them any children because Allah stopped their women from conceiving, and thus they had only adults amongst them, and the latter were all lewd disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلاَ يَلِدُوۤاْ إِلاَّ فَاجِراً كَفَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. “If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly if You leave them they will lead Your servants astray and will beget only disbelieving profligates fājir and kaffār derive respectively from yafjuru and yakfuru he said this on account of the mentioned revelation that had been given to him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّواْ عِبَادَكَ وَلاَ يَلِدُوۤاْ إِلاَّ فَاجِراً كَفَّاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. “If You leave them, they will mislead Your slaves, and they will beget none but wicked disbelievers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (My Lord!) O my Lord! (Forgive me and my parents) and forgive my believing parents (and him who entereth my house) my religion; and it is also said: my mosque; and it is also said: my ship (believing, and believing men and believing women) who are true in their faith and who will come after me, (and increase not the wrong-doers) the disbelieving idolaters (in aught save ruin) loss and destruction, like the destruction of those people whose Prophet received the revelation but refused to believe in him'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِناً وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ تَبَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: My Lord forgive me and my parents — both of whom were believers — and whoever enters my house my dwelling or my place of worship as a believer and believing men and believing women to the Day of Resurrection and do not increase the evildoers except in ruin’ in destruction — and thus they were destroyed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِي وَلِوَالِدَيَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِيَ مُؤْمِناً وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَلاَ تَزِدِ ٱلظَّالِمِينَ إِلاَّ تَبَاراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. “My Lord! Forgive me, and my parents, and him who enters my home as a believer, and all the believing men and women. And to the Ẓālimūn (polytheists, wrong-doers, and disbelievers) grant You no increase but destruction!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me): '(Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me) say, O Muhammad, to the disbelievers of Mecca that Gabriel has come down and informed me (that a company of the jinn) nine of the jinn of Nusaybin which is near Yemen (gave ear, and they said) after accepting faith and returning to their folk: O our folk! (Lo! it is a marvellous Qur'an) we have listened to the recitation of a marvellous, illustrious and noble Qur'an which resembles the Scripture of Moses, this is because they were followers of the Torah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآناً عَجَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Say (O Muḥammad ): “It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn(1) listened (to this Qur’ān). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ān)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say O Muhammad (s) to people ‘It has been revealed to me that is to say I have been informed by way of revelation from God exalted be He that annahu the suffixed pronoun is that of the matter a company of the jinn the jinn of Nasībīn. This was at the time of the morning prayer at Batn Nakhla a location between Mecca and Tā’if — these jinn being those mentioned in God’s saying And when We sent a company of jinn your way…’ Q. 4629 — listened to my recitation then said to their people upon returning to them “We have indeed heard a marvellous Qur’ān whose clarity the richness of its meanings and other aspects one marvels at

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوۤاْ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْآناً عَجَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Say (O Muḥammad ): “It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinn(1) listened (to this Qur’ān). They said: ‘Verily, we have heard a wonderful Recitation (this Qur’ān)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Which guideth unto righteousness) which guides to the Truth, guidance and right course, i.e. to “there is no deity except Allah”, (so we believe in it) we believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and we believe in the Qur'an (and we ascribe unto our Lord no partner) here meaning the devil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَهْدِيۤ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَن نُّشرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: which guides to rectitude to faith and propriety. Therefore we believe in it and we will never after this day associate anyone with our Lord.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَهْدِيۤ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَآمَنَّا بِهِ وَلَن نُّشرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. ‘It guides to the Right Path, and we have believed therein, and we shall never join (in worship) anything with our Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And (we believe) that He-exalted be the glory of our Lord-) and that the dominion of our Lord is exalted; it is also said this means: the tremendousness, sovereignty, absoluteness and attributes of our Lord are far exalted, and He (hath taken neither wife nor son) as the disbelievers claim,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. ‘And He, exalted is the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children) (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we believe that annahu the pronoun in this and in the next two instances is that of the matter — exalted be the majesty of our Lord transcendent is His majesty and magnificence above what is ascribed to Him — He has taken neither spouse nor son.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ تَعَالَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَاحِبَةً وَلاَ وَلَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. ‘And He, exalted is the Majesty of our Lord, has taken neither a wife nor a son (or offspring or children) (2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And that the foolish one among us) i.e. the devil (used to speak concerning Allah an atrocious lie.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblīs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allāh that which was a manifest false- hood..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that the fool among us the ignorant one among us used to utter atrocious lies against God extreme calumny by attributing to Him a spouse and a son.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. ‘And that the foolish among us [i.e. Iblīs (Satan) or the polytheists amongst the jinn] used to utter against Allāh that which was a manifest false- hood..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And lo! we had supposed that humankind and jinn would not speak a lie concerning Allah) and we thought that what humans and the jinn said about Allah was not a lie, but we know now that it is. From the beginning of the surah up to here, Allah related what the jinn said.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. ‘And Verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allāh. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we thought that an softened that is to say annahu humans and jinn would never utter a lie against God by attributing such things to Him until we discovered their mendacity thereby. God exalted be He says

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. ‘And Verily, we thought that men and jinn would not utter a lie against Allāh. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then said: (And indeed (O Muhammad) individuals of humankind used to invoke the protection of individuals of the jinn so that they increased them) because of that (in revolt (against Allah)) in pride, arrogance, sedition, and corruption. This is because they were afraid of them whenever they travelled, caught a game or camped in a valley. And to avoid their harm they used to say: “we seek refuge in the master of this valley from the foolish ones of his folk” after which they felt safe. As a result, the masters of these places increased in nothing but pride and arrogance towards the communality among their folk. There are three kinds of jinn: one kind flies in the air; another kind ascends and descends wherever they wish; and a third kind resembles dogs and snakes;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. ‘And Verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and trans gression..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that certain individuals of mankind used to seek the protection of certain individuals of the jinn when they stopped over in dangerous places during their journeys — whereat every man would say ‘I seek the protection of the lord of this place against the evil of the insolent ones in it’ — so that they increased them by their seeking their protection in oppressiveness such that they would say ‘We are now lords of jinn and humans!’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. ‘And Verily, there were men among mankind who took shelter with the males among the jinn, but they (jinn) increased them (mankind) in sin and trans gression..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And indeed they) the disbelievers of the jinn before they accepted faith (supposed, even as you suppose) O people of Mecca, (that Allah would not raise anyone (from the dead)) and it is also said that this means: and they supposed just as you did that Allah will not send anyone as a messenger.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allāh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they namely the jinn thought just as you O humans thought that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu God would never raise anyone after his death.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّواْ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. ‘And they thought as you thought, that Allāh will not send any Messenger (to mankind or jinn)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then went back to the talk of the jinn, saying: (And (the jinn who had listened to the Qur'an said): We had sought the heaven) before we accepted faith (but had found it filled with strong warders) angels (and meteors) preventing them from listening.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَساً شَدِيداً وَشُهُباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The jinn say And we made for the heaven we desired to listen by stealth but we found it filled with mighty guards from among the angels and meteors scorching stars this was at the time of the sending of the Prophet s.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَاهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَساً شَدِيداً وَشُهُباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. ‘And we have sought to reach the heaven; but found it filled with stern guards and flaming fires..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we used to sit on places (high) therein) in heaven (to listen) before the advent of Muhammad (pbuh). (But he who listened now) after the advent of Muhammad (pbuh) (findeth a flame) a shining star (in wait for him) from the angels in order to prevent them from listening;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَاباً رَّصَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. ‘And Verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we used to that is to say before his Mission sit in certain places therein to listen in; but anyone listening now will find a meteor lying in wait for him aimed at him ready to strike him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَاعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلآنَ يَجِدْ لَهُ شِهَاباً رَّصَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. ‘And Verily, we used to sit there in stations, to (steal) hearing, but any who listens now will find a flaming fire watching him in ambush..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we know not whether) in preventing us from listening (harm is boded unto all who are in the earth, or whether their Lord intendeth guidance for them) or whether their Lord intends guidance, goodness and the correct course for them; it is also said that this means: we do not know whether evil is intended for the people of the earth by the advent of Muhammad (pbuh) such that if they do not believe in him they will be destroyed or it is good, guidance and the correct course that their Lord intends for them if they believe in him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لاَ نَدْرِيۤ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we do not know by not being able to eavesdrop by stealth whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth or whether their Lord intends for them good.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لاَ نَدْرِيۤ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِي ٱلأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. ‘And we know not whether evil is intended for those on earth, or whether their Lord intends for them a Right Path..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And among us there are righteous folk) those who believe in Allah's divine Oneness; these are those who believe in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and among us there are far from that) and among us there are disbelievers, the disbelieving jinn. (We are sects having different rules) we followed different religions, i.e. Judaism and Christianity, before believing in Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that among us some have become righteous after having listened to the Qur’ān and some of us are otherwise that is to say a folk who are unrighteous; we are made up of different sects opposing groups some submitters to God and others disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّالِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَلِكَ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. ‘There are among us some that are righteous, and some the contrary; we are groups having different ways (religious sects)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And we know) and are certain (that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth) for He can reach us wherever we might be, (nor can we escape by flight) nor can we escape from Him by running away.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allāh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And we assume that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu we will never be able to elude God in the earth nor will we be able to elude Him by fleeing — we will not be able to escape Him whether we are on earth or fleeing from it in the heavens.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُ هَرَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. ‘And we think that we cannot escape (the punishment of) Allāh in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when we heard the guidance) and when we heard the recitation of the Qur'an by Muhammad (pbuh) (we believed therein) we believed in the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) (and whoso believeth in his Lord, he feareth neither loss) of all his works (nor oppression) nor decrease of his works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلاَ يَخَافُ بَخْساً وَلاَ رَهَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ān), we believed therein (Islāmic Mono the- ism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that when we heard the guidance the Qur’ān we believed in it. For whoever believes in his Lord read an implied huwa ‘he’ before fa-lā yakhāfu shall fear neither loss a diminishing of his good deeds nor oppression nor injustice by having his evil deeds increased.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰ آمَنَّا بِهِ فَمَن يُؤْمِن بِرَبِّهِ فَلاَ يَخَافُ بَخْساً وَلاَ رَهَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. ‘And indeed when we heard the Guidance (this Qur’ān), we believed therein (Islāmic Mono the- ism), and whosoever believes in his Lord shall have no fear, either of a decrease in the reward of his good deeds or an increase in the punishment for his sins..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah)) and there are among us those who are sincere in their belief in Allah's divine Oneness; these are the ones who believed in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and there are among us some who are unjust) i.e. disobedient ones who have deviated from the Truth and guidance; and these are the disbelievers among the jinn. (And whoso hath surrendered to Allah) and whoever is sincere in his belief in Allah's divine Oneness, (such have taken the right path purposefully) such have intended goodness and the correct course.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْاْ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. ‘And among us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allāh, after listening to this Qur’ān), and of us some are disbelievers — those who have deviated from the Right Path’. And whosoever has embraced Islām (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allāh), then such have sought the Right Path.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that among us some have submitted to God while some of us are unjust tyrants — on account of their disbelief. So whoever has submitted to God those are the ones who seek right guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُوْلَـٰئِكَ تَحَرَّوْاْ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. ‘And among us some are Muslims (who have submitted to Allāh, after listening to this Qur’ān), and of us some are disbelievers — those who have deviated from the Right Path’. And whosoever has embraced Islām (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to Allāh), then such have sought the Right Path.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And as for those who are unjust) i.e. the disbelievers, (they are firewood for hell.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And as for the disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path, they shall be firewood for Hell,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And as for those are unjust they will be firewood fuel for Hell!” ’ annā annahum and annahu totalling all twelve instances above including innahu ta‘ālā and annā minnā’l-muslimūna and what comes in between them may be read with a kasra sc. innā innahum etc. indicating a new sentence every time or with a fatha sc. annā annahum etc. indicating the statement that will follow as a relative clause.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَاسِطُونَ فَكَانُواْ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And as for the disbelievers who deviated from the Right Path, they shall be firewood for Hell,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: If they (the idolaters) tread the right path) the path of disbelief; and it is said: the path of Islam, (We shall give them to drink of water in abundance) We shall give them abundant wealth and a comfortable life

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَامُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّآءً غَدَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allāh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islām), We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says the following about the Meccan disbelievers And it has been revealed to me that if they allaw softened in place of the hardened form its subject having been omitted that is to say annahum law which is a supplement to annahu istama‘a ‘that a company of jinn listened’ adopt the right path the path of submission to God We will give them abundant water to drink plenteous water from the heaven — this was after rain had been withheld from them for seven years —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَامُواْ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لأَسْقَيْنَاهُم مَّآءً غَدَقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. If they (non-Muslims) had believed in Allāh, and went on the Right Way (i.e. Islām), We would surely have bestowed on them water (rain) in abundance..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That We may test them thereby) in order that they may revert to that which I have ordained for them, (and whoso turneth away from the remembrance of his Lord) and whoever turns away from believing in the divine Oneness and Scripture of his Lord, i.e. the Qur'an-this refers to al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi; (He will thrust him into ever growing torment) climbing a mountain of smooth stones; and it is said this means: climbing a mountain of copper in the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَاباً صَعَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ān, — and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so that We may try them test them therein and so know through knowledge outwardly manifested the nature of their gratitude. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord from the Qur’ān We will admit him naslukhu or read first person yaslukhu ‘He will admit him’ into a tortuous chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَاباً صَعَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. That We might try them thereby. And whosoever turns away from the Reminder of his Lord (i.e. this Qur’ān, — and practise not its laws and orders), He will cause him to enter in a severe torment (i.e. Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the places of worship are only for Allah) they are built for the remembrance of Allah, (so pray not unto) so worship not (anyone along with Allah) in mosques; it is also said that the places of worship refer to the different parts of a person that touch the ground upon prostrating in prayer: the forehead, the knees, the hands and the feet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلاَ تَدْعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And the mosques are for Allāh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allāh (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it has been revealed to me that the places of prayer belong to God so do not invoke in them anyone along with God by associating others with Him like the Jews and Christians do who when they enter their churches and temples they ascribe partners to God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَاجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلاَ تَدْعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And the mosques are for Allāh (Alone): so invoke not anyone along with Allāh (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the slave of Allah) Muhammad (pbuh) (stood up) in Batn Nakhl (in prayer to Him) to worship Allah through prayer, (they crowded on him, almost stifling) the jinn almost fell on him because of their love of the Qur'an and Muhammad (pbuh) when they heard him recite the Qur'an in Batn Nakhl.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And when the slave of Allāh (Muḥammad ) stood up invoking Him (his Lord — Allāh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other [in order to listen to the Prophet’s  recitation]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And that annahu; or innahu as a new sentence the pronoun being that of the matter when the servant of God the Prophet Muhammad (s) rose to invoke Him to worship Him at Batn Nakhla they that is the jinn listening to his recitation were almost upon him in heaps libadan or lubadan the plural of libda or lubda like felt in the way they were heaped on top of one another crowding in their eagerness to listen to the Qur’ān.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُواْ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And when the slave of Allāh (Muḥammad ) stood up invoking Him (his Lord — Allāh) in prayer they (the jinn) just made round him a dense crowd as if sticking one over the other [in order to listen to the Prophet’s  recitation]. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say (unto them, O Muhammad): I pray unto Allah only) I worship Allah only and call people to worship none but Him, (and ascribe unto Him no partner.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُواْ رَبِّي وَلاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I invoke only my Lord (Allāh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He said in response to the disbelievers saying ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’ a variant reading for qāla ‘he said’ has qul ‘Say’ ‘I invoke only my Lord as God and I do not associate anyone with Him’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُواْ رَبِّي وَلاَ أُشْرِكُ بِهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I invoke only my Lord (Allāh Alone), and I associate none as partners along with Him.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Say) O Muhammad, to the people of Mecca: (Lo! I control not hurt) I cannot drive away from you harm, forsakenness or chastisement (nor benefit for you) nor can I give you benefit and guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرّاً وَلاَ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Say: “It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘I truly have no power to bring you any harm to lead you astray or any guidance’ any good.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لاَ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرّاً وَلاَ رَشَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Say: “It is not in my power to cause you harm, or to bring you to the Right Path.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (Lo! none can protect me from Allah) from Allah's chastisement if I disobey Him, (nor can I find any refuge beside Him) nor can I find any escape or hiding place from Allah's chastisement if I disobey Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Say (O Muḥammad ): “None can protect me from Allāh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘Indeed none shall protect me from God from His chastisement were I to disobey Him and I shall never find besides Him that is other than Him any refuge.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنِّي لَن يُجِيرَنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِ مُلْتَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Say (O Muḥammad ): “None can protect me from Allāh’s punishment (if I were to disobey Him), nor can I find refuge except in Him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Mine is) but conveyance (of the Truth) from Allah) he says: nothing can save me except conveyance on behalf of Allah, (and His messages; and whoso disobeyeth Allah) regarding Allah's divine Oneness (and His messenger) in his conveyance of the message, (lo! His) in the Hereafter (is fire of hell, wherein such dwell forever) never to die or leave it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ بَلاَغاً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَالاَتِهِ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allāh and His Messages (of Islāmic Monothe ism), and whosoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: I have power to bring you only a communication illā balāghan is excepted from the direct object clause of amliku ‘I have power to bring’ that is to say I have power only to communicate the Message to you from God that is on His behalf and His Messages wa-risālātihi is a supplement to balāghan ‘a communication’; what comes between the excepted clause and the clause from which it is excepted is a parenthetical statement intended to emphasise the preclusion of the Prophet’s ‘ability to bring them anything else’. And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger concerning the affirmation of His Oneness and hence does not believe — indeed there will be for him the fire of Hell abiding khālidīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person indicated by man ‘whoever’ in lahu ‘for him’ taking into account its plural import; it khālidīna is also an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words they shall enter it with their abiding having been preordained therein forever’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ بَلاَغاً مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَالاَتِهِ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُ فَإِنَّ لَهُ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَالِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. “(Mine is) but conveyance (of the truth) from Allāh and His Messages (of Islāmic Monothe ism), and whosoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger, then Verily, for him is the Fire of Hell, he shall dwell therein forever.” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Till (the day)) He says: wait for them until the day (when they shall behold that which they are promised) of chastisement; (but then they will know for certain) this is a threat from Allah to them (who is weaker in allies and less in multitude) who has less helpers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِراً وَأَقَلُّ عَدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning num bers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Such that when they see hattā is for inceptiveness but also entailing a purposive sense to an implied preceding clause that is to say they persist in their disbelief until they come to see … what they are promised of chastisement they will then know at the moment that it befalls them either on the day of Badr or on the Day of Resurrection who is weaker in supporters and fewer in numbers in assistants is it them or the believers — according to the former reading? Or is it Me or them according to the latter. Some of them said ‘When will this promise be fulfilled?’ whereupon the following was revealed

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَتَّىٰ إِذَا رَأَوْاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِراً وَأَقَلُّ عَدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning num bers..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Say) to them, O Muhammad: (I know not whether that which ye are promised) of chastisement (is nigh, or if my Lord hath set a distant term for it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِيۤ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّيۤ أَمَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Say ‘I do not know if what you are promised of chastisement is near or if my Lord has set a distant length for it an extent and a term which only He knows.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِيۤ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُ رَبِّيۤ أَمَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Say (O Muḥammad ): “I know not whether (the punishment) which you are promised is near or whether my Lord will appoint for it a distant term..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He is) the knower of the Unseen) He knows when the chastisement will happen, (and He revealeth unto none His secret,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلاَ يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. “(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen).” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Knower He is of the Unseen what is hidden from servants and He does not disclose He does not reveal His Unseen to anyone from mankind

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلاَ يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِ أَحَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. “(He Alone is) the All-Knower of the Ghaib (Unseen), and He reveals to none His Ghaib (Unseen).” (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Save unto every messenger whom he hath chosen) He reveals to them some instances of the Unseen, (and then He maketh a guard) angels (to go before him) before the messenger (and a guard behind him) to protect him from the jinn, devils and human beings so that they do not hear Gabriel reciting the revelations.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except to a messenger of whom He approves. Then in addition to disclosing to him what He will to disclose of it by way of making it a miracle for him He despatches He appoints and sends forth before him namely the Messenger and behind him watchers angels to preserve him until He has conveyed it to him as part of the entire revelation

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُ يَسْلُكُ مِن بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِ رَصَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Except to a Messenger (from mankind) whom He has chosen (He informs him of unseen as much as He likes), and then He makes a band of watching guards (angels) to march before him and behind him..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That He) that Muhammad (pbuh) (may know that they) i.e. the messengers (have indeed conveyed the messages of their Lord) the angels protected them just as they are protecting you; it is also said that this means: so that the messengers, Muhammad and other messengers, know that the angels have conveyed the message from Allah; and it is also said that this means: so that the jinn and human beings know that the messengers have conveyed the messages of their Lord. (He surroundeth all their doings) He has full knowledge of all the angels that surround them, (and He keepeth count of all things) it is also said that He knows their number just as He knows the state of the one who is wrapped up in his raiment'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُواْ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. [He (Allāh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allāh). And He (Allāh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allāh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so that He God may know by knowledge outwardly manifested that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu they that is the messengers have conveyed the Messages of their Lord the plural person of the verb ablaghū ‘they have conveyed’ takes into account the plural implication of man ‘whom’ and He encompasses all that is with them wa-ahāta bimā ladayhim is a supplement to an implied clause that is to say so He has knowledge of that and keeps count of all things’ ‘adadan ‘count’ is for specification; it is transformed from a direct object sc. ‘adada originally ahsā ‘adada kulli shay’in ‘He keeps count of all things’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُواْ رِسَالاَتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ عَدَداً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. [He (Allāh) protects them (the Messengers)], till He sees that they (the Messengers) have conveyed the Messages of their Lord (Allāh). And He (Allāh) surrounds all that which is with them, and He (Allāh) keeps count of all things (i.e. He knows the exact number of everything)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning Allah's saying (O thou wrapped up in your raiment!): '(O thou wrapped up in your raiment!) He is referring here to Muhammad (pbuh) who wrapped himself up in his raiment in order to pray.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muḥammad )!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: O you enwrapped in your garment! the Prophet al-muzzammil is actually al-mutazammil but the tā’ has been assimilated with the zāy that is to say the one who wraps himself up in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes to him in fear of him because of his awe-inspiring presence.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. O you wrapped in garments (i.e. Prophet Muḥammad )!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Keep vigil the night long) in prayer, then He said (save a little);

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيلَ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Stand (to pray) all night, except a little —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Stand vigil perform prayer through the night except a little

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُمِ ٱلَّيلَ إِلاَّ قَلِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Stand (to pray) all night, except a little —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: He explained further, saying: (A half thereof) i.e. pray during half of the night, (or abate a little thereof) less than half and up to a third of the night,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نِّصْفَهُ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Half of it or a little less than that,.
