meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. He asks: “When will be this Day of Resurrection?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah said to him: (But when sight is confounded) and it is also said this means: when sight is pleased

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. So, when the sight shall be dazed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But when the eyes are dazzled read bariqa or baraqa startled and perplexed upon seeing some of those things which it used to deny;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. So, when the sight shall be dazed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the moon is eclipsed) and the light of the moon disappears

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And the moon will be eclipsed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the moon is eclipsed darkening its light disappearing

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And the moon will be eclipsed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And sun and moon are united) like two black, horned bulls whose hooves are beaten and then are thrown in the veil of light,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light) (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the sun and the moon are brought together so that both of them will rise from the west; or it means when the light of both of them disappears — and this will be on the Day of Resurrection —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And the sun and moon will be joined together (by going one into the other or folded up or deprived of their light) (2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On that day man) the disbelieving man: 'Adiyy Ibn Rabi'ah and his companions (will cry: Whither to flee) from the Fire and take refuse!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. On that Day man will say: “Where (is the refuge) to flee?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: on that day man will say ‘Where is the escape?’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَقُولُ ٱلإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. On that Day man will say: “Where (is the refuge) to flee?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Alas! No refuge!) Truly, there is no mountain to shield him from the Fire, nor are there any trees, cover, fortress, refuge or safety for them from Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ لاَ وَزَرَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. No! There is no refuge!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! — a deterrent against seeking to escape — There is no refuge no shelter to seek protection in.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ لاَ وَزَرَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. No! There is no refuge!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto thy Lord is the recourse) the return and last resort (that day) the Day of Judgement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. To your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: On that day the recourse will be to your Lord the final recourse of all creatures whereupon they will be reckoned with and requited.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. To your Lord (Alone) will be the place of rest that Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On that day) on the Day of Judgement (man is told) 'Adiyy Ibn Rabi'ah and others will be informed about (the tale of that which he hath sent before and left behind) the tale of what he has sent before of good or evil works and of what he left behind of good or evil wont; it is also said this means: he will be informed about what he has sent before of acts of obedience and what he left behind of acts of disobedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنَبَّأُ ٱلإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. On that Day, man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil or good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: On that day man will be informed of what he has sent ahead and left behind he will be informed of the his first and last deeds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُنَبَّأُ ٱلإِنسَانُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. On that Day, man will be informed of what he sent forward (of his evil or good deeds), and what he left behind (of his good or evil traditions)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Oh, but man) 'Adiyy Ibn Rabi'ah and others (is a telling witness against himself) He says: he will testify against his own self,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلِ ٱلإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Rather man has insight into his own soul for his limbs will speak of his deeds the hā’ sc. the tā’ marbūta in basīratun is for hyperbole and so he must be requited

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلِ ٱلإِنسَانُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِ بَصِيرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Nay! Man will be a witness against himself [as his body parts (skin, hands, legs, etc.) will speak about his deeds],.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Although he tender his excuses) and says: I have not done this and have not said that; it is also said that this means: every soul is aware of the faults of others, ignorant of and oblivious to its own faults.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: though he should offer his excuses ma‘ādhīr is the plural of ma‘dhira but following a different pattern from the usual ma‘dhira ma‘ādhir that is to say whatever excuse he offers will not be accepted from him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Though he may put forth his excuses (to cover his evil deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Stir not thy tongue) to read the Qur'an, O Muhammad, (herewith to hasten it) to hasten the recitation of the Qur'an before Gabriel finishes reciting it to you. This is because the Prophet (pbuh) used to repeat whatever revelations of the Qur'an Gabriel brought down to him before the latter finished a sentence of the Qur'an, out of fear of forgetting what was revealed to him. Allah warned him against doing so.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’ān, O Muḥammad ) to make haste therewith..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says to His Prophet Do not move your tongue with it with the Qur’ān before Gabriel is through with reciting it to hasten it fearing to lose it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَ تُحَرِّكْ بِهِ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Move not your tongue concerning (the Qur’ān, O Muḥammad ) to make haste therewith..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof) preserving the Qur'an in your heart (and the reading thereof) and also preserving the reading of Gabriel to you; it is also said that this means: upon Us rests its composition of the lawful and the unlawful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muḥammad ) the ability to recite it (the Qur’ān)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly it is for Us to bring it together in your breast and to recite it your reciting of it that is its flowing off your tongue.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُ وَقُرْآنَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muḥammad ) the ability to recite it (the Qur’ān)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when We read it) when Gabriel reads to you, (follow thou the reading) you, O Muhammad, read after him; it is also said this means: what We finish composing it with all the lawful and unlawful contained therein, do you follow its composition;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And when We have recited it to you [O Muḥammad  through Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)], then follow its (the Qur’ān’s) recital..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So when We recite it to you by means of Gabriel’s recital follow its recitation listen to its recitation thus the Prophet s would listen to it and then repeat it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَاهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْآنَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And when We have recited it to you [O Muḥammad  through Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)], then follow its (the Qur’ān’s) recital..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then lo! upon Us (resteth) the explanation thereof) the explanation of the lawful and unlawful, the commands and prohibitions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Then it is for Us (Allāh) to make it clear (to you)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then it is for Us to explain it by making you comprehend it the connection between this verse and what preceded it is that those verses before imply turning away from God’s signs whereas this one implies applying oneself to them by memorising them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Then it is for Us (Allāh) to make it clear (to you)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, (but ye do love the fleeting Now) working for the life of the world

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but you (men) love the present life of this world,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! kallā is for commencement with the sense of alā Rather you love the transitory life this world both verbs here and below may be read in the second or third person plural

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Not [as you think, that you (mankind) will not be resurrected and recompensed for your deeds], but you (men) love the present life of this world,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And neglect the Hereafter) and neglect working for the reward of the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلآخِرَةَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And neglect the Hereafter..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and forsake the Hereafter thus neglecting to work towards attaining bliss in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلآخِرَةَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And neglect the Hereafter..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That day) the Day of Judgement (will faces) the faces of the believers who are true in their faith (be resplendent) beautiful, seemly and tender,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Some faces that Day shall be shining and radiant..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Some faces on that day that is on the Day of Resurrection will be radiant fair and resplendent

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Some faces that Day shall be shining and radiant..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Looking towards their Lord) they behold the Countenance of their Lord and are not veiled from Him;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Looking at their Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: looking upon their Lord in other words they will see God glorified and exalted be He in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Looking at their Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And that day) the Day of Judgement (will other faces) the faces of the disbelievers and hypocrites (be despondent) gloomy; veiled from seeing their Lord,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And some faces, that Day, will be dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And other faces on that day will be scowling glowering frowning terribly

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ بَاسِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And some faces, that Day, will be dark, gloomy, frowning, and sad,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou wilt know) those faces will know (that some great disaster is about to fall on them) a severe and horrible punishment is about to befall them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: certain that a spine-crushing calamity will fall on them a great catastrophe one that ‘crushes the spine’ fiqār.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Thinking that some calamity is about to fall on them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, (but when the life cometh up to the throat) when the soul of the body reaches the throat

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! kallā in the sense of alā When it the soul reaches up to the collar bones

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِيَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Nay, when (the soul) reaches to the collar bone (i.e. up to the throat in its exit),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And men say) and those around it among his family and others say: (Where is the wizard (who can save him now)?) Is there any physician who can cure him? It is also said this means: the angels say to one another: who will rise with his soul to Allah?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And it will be said: “Who can cure him (and save him from death)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and it is said and those around him the dying one say ‘Where is the enchanter?’ to perform incantations on him and cure him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَقِيلَ مَنْ رَاقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And it will be said: “Who can cure him (and save him from death)?”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he knowth) and the dead person knows at that point (that it is the parting) the time of departing from the life of the world;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of parting (death);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and he suspects he the one whose soul has reached this stage that it is the time of parting the parting with this world

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. And he (the dying person) will conclude that it was (the time) of parting (death);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And agony is heaped on agony) and severity is heaped upon severity: the severity of the last day of the life of the world and that of the first day of the Hereafter; and it is also said this means: and the dead person's legs are twisted around each other;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And one leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded)(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the shank is intertwined with the other shank that is one of his shanks will be intertwined with his other shank at the moment of death; or it means the distress of parting with this world is intertwined with the distress of the arrival of the Hereafter;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And one leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded)(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto thy Lord that day) the Day of Judgement (will be the driving) the return of all created beings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allāh)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: on that day to your Lord will be the driving of the souls al-masāq means al-sawq; this indicates the operator of the above idhā ‘when’ the meaning being ‘when the soul reaches the throat it will be driven towards the judgement of its Lord’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. The drive will be, on that Day, to your Lord (Allāh)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (For he) i.e. Abu Jahl (neither trusted) neither believed in Allah's divine Oneness, (nor prayed) nor embraced Islam and became of those who perform the prayer.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ صَدَّقَ وَلاَ صَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’ān and in the Message of Muḥammad ) nor prayed!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For he man neither affirmed the truth nor prayed

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ صَدَّقَ وَلاَ صَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. So he (the disbeliever) neither believed (in this Qur’ān and in the Message of Muḥammad ) nor prayed!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But he denied) Allah's divine Oneness (and flouted) and turned away from faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. But on the contrary, he denied (this Qur’ān and the Message of Muḥammad ) and turned away! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but he denied the Qur’ān and he turned away from faith

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. But on the contrary, he denied (this Qur’ān and the Message of Muḥammad ) and turned away! (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then went he to his folk) in the life of the world (with glee) strutting and behaving wantonly.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. Then, he walked in conceit (full pride) to his family admiring himself!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then went off to his family swaggering strutting about in self-conceit.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ يَتَمَطَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. Then, he walked in conceit (full pride) to his family admiring himself!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The Prophet (pbuh) received him, grabbed him and shook him once or twice and then said: (Nearer unto thee and nearer) this is a threat to you, O Abu Jahl, it is indeed a threat.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe be nearer to you there is a shift from the third to the second person address here; the term awlā is a noun of action with the following lām being explicative in other words ‘what you are averse to is now near to you’ and nearer that is because you are more deserving of it woe than anyone else

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. Woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Again nearer unto thee and nearer (is the doom)) beware, O Abu Jahl.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then may woe be nearer to you and nearer! — repeated for emphasis.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. Again, woe to you [O man (disbeliever)]! And then (again) woe to you!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The Qur'an also said: (Thinks man) the disbelieving man, i.e. Abu Jahl (that he is to be left aimless) neglected, without any commands, prohibitions or admonition?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Does man think that he will be left neglected (without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord Allāh on him)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Does man suppose that he is to be left aimless? left to his own devices without being obligated to the prescribed laws let him not suppose that!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلإِنسَانُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Does man think that he will be left neglected (without being punished or rewarded for the obligatory duties enjoined by his Lord Allāh on him)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Was he not) i.e. Abu Jahl (a drop of fluid) man's sperm drops (which gushed forth) in the woman's womb; and it is also said: created in the woman's womb?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Was he not a Nuṭfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge) of semen emitted (poured forth)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Was he not — that is indeed he was — a drop of emitted semen? read yumnā or tumnā deposited into the womb.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِيٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Was he not a Nuṭfah (mixed male and female sexual discharge) of semen emitted (poured forth)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then he became a clot) then he became clotted blood; (then (Allah) shaped) him a living being (and fashioned) him with two hands, two feet, two eyes, two ears as well as with all the other members, and also placed in him the spirit.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Then he became an ‘Alaqah (a clot); then (Allāh) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then it the drop of semen became a clot; then He God created from it man and proportioned him making the parts of his body upright

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. Then he became an ‘Alaqah (a clot); then (Allāh) shaped and fashioned (him) in due proportion (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And made of him) after that (a pair, the male and female) Abu Jahl had a son called 'Ikrimah Ibn Abi Jahl and a daughter called Juwayrah Bint Abi Jahl.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلأُنثَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. And made of him two sexes, male and female..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and made of it of the drop of semen that became a blood-clot then an embryo a small mass of flesh the two sexes the two kinds the male and the female at times coming together and at times each being on their own.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلأُنثَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. And made of him two sexes, male and female..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Is not He (who doeth so) able to bring the dead to life) for the resurrection? Indeed, our Lord is Able to do so; He is Able to bring the dead back to life just as He did create Adam from dust'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِـيَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Is not He (Allāh Who does that) Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Is not such a Doer of all these things able to revive the dead? — the Prophet s would say ‘Yes indeed!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَيْسَ ذَلِكَ بِقَادِرٍ عَلَىٰ أَن يُحْيِـيَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Is not He (Allāh Who does that) Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Hath there come upon man (ever)): '(Hath there come upon man (ever)) there has come upon Adam (any period of time) a period of 40 years when he was created and fashioned (in which he was a thing unremembered?) not knowing who he was, what his name was or what Allah wanted from him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئاً مَّذْكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mention ing?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Has there ever been — there has indeed been — for man Adam a period of time forty years in which he was a thing unmentioned? — he was during this period a fashioned in clay and not mentioned; alternatively what is meant by insān ‘man’ is the generic noun and by hīn ‘a period of time’ the period of gestation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلإِنسَانِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْئاً مَّذْكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mention ing?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We create man) i.e. the progeny of Adam (from a drop of thickened fluid) from Adam and Eve's drops of two different kinds of fluid: that of man being white and thick and that of the woman being yellow and thin; thus progeny comes from both of them (to test him) with hardship and comfort; it is also said this means: to test him with good and evil; (so We make him hearing, knowing) We gave him the faculty of hearing so that he could hear the Truth and guidance and the faculty of sight so that he could see the Truth and guidance. It is also said that We make him hearing, knowing in order to test him with good and evil, faith and disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعاً بَصِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Verily, We have created man from Nuṭfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily We created man the species from a drop of mixed fluid from a mixture that is from the seminal fluid of the man and the ovarian fluid of the woman that have mixed and blended so that We may test him trying him with the moral obligations of religion nabtalīhi is either a new sentence ‘We will test him’ or an implied circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘intending to test him when he is ready’. So We made him for that very reason hearing seeing.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلإِنسَانَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَاهُ سَمِيعاً بَصِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Verily, We have created man from Nuṭfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We have shown him the way) of faith and disbelief, good and evil, (whether he be grateful) accepting faith (or disbelieving) it is also said this means: We have shown him the way to be either grateful or ungrateful.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِراً وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily We have guided him to the way We have pointed out to him the path of guidance by sending messengers to mankind whether he be grateful that is to say whether he be a believer or ungrateful both shākiran and kafūran are circumstantial qualifiers referring to the direct object; in other words We have pointed out to him in both presupposed states whether his gratefulness or his unthankfulness; immā is used to list the ‘states’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَاهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِراً وَإِمَّا كَفُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We have prepared for disbelievers) Abu Jahl and his followers (manacles and carcans) in the Fire (and a raging fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلاَسِلاَ وَأَغْلاَلاً وَسَعِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We have assuredly prepared for the disbelievers chains with which they are dragged through the Fire and fetters around their necks to which the chains will be attached and a hell-fire a fire set ablaze burning fiercely in which they shall be chastised.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَافِرِينَ سَلاَسِلاَ وَأَغْلاَلاً وَسَعِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith and obey Allah (shall drink of a cup) shall drink wine in Paradise (whereof the mixture is of water of Kafur,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Verily, the pious believers, shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring of Kāfūr in Paradise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly the righteous abrār is the plural of barr or bārr namely the obedient ones will drink from a cup ka’s is a vessel for drinking wine and this wine will be in it; what is meant is that they will drink from ‘wine’ a case where the actuality is referred to by the name of the locus in which it is found; min ‘from is partitive whose mixture that with which it is mixed is camphor;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Verily, the pious believers, shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring of Kāfūr in Paradise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allah) the friends of Allah (drink, making it gush forth abundantly) whenever they wish, from the Garden into their own habitations and palaces; it is also said that this means: they make it into a mixture;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allāh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for kāfūran containing the scent thereof from which the servants of God His friends drink making it gush forth plenteously directing it to wherever they wish of their dwellings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allāh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then described their traits when they were in the life of the world, saying: (Because they perform the vow) because they fulfil their pledges and oath by Allah; it is also said this means: they perform the obligations (and fear a day) and fear the torment of a day (whereof the evil) the torment (is wide spreading,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْماً كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They fulfil their vows pledged in obedience to God and fear a day the evil of which will be widespread.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْماً كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And feed with food the needy wretch, the orphan) among the Muslims (and the prisoner) and the Muslim prisoner in the captivity of the idolaters; and it is also said: any kind of prisoner, (for love of Him) despite their desire for food and its scarcity,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِيناً وَيَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskīn (1) (the needy), the orphan, and the captive.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they give food despite their love of it that is to say despite their love of food and their craving for it to the needy the poor and the orphan who does not have a father and the prisoner meaning the one who has been rightly imprisoned.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِ مِسْكِيناً وَيَتِيماً وَأَسِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskīn (1) (the needy), the orphan, and the captive.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Saying)) that is inwardly, because they did not utter this openly but Allah informed us about the genuineness of their hearts: (We feed you, for the sake of Allah only) we feed you for the sake of Allah's reward and beneficence only. (We wish for no reward) with which to pay us back (nor thanks from you) nor gratitude from you;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلاَ شُكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. (Saying): “We feed you seeking Allāh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘We feed you only for the sake of God seeking His reward. We do not desire any reward from you nor any thanks this contains the reason for the giving of the food. Now do they actually say this or is it that God knows this to be true of them and has thus praised them by mentioning it? The two are different opinions regarding this matter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لاَ نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلاَ شُكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. (Saying): “We feed you seeking Allāh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! we fear from our Lord) from the punishment of our Lord (a day of frowning) when faces are frowning (and of fate) a hard day whose torment and horrors are severe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْماً عَبُوساً قَمْطَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed we fear from our Lord a day of frowning one in which faces scowl in other words a horrid day to observe on account of its severity calamitous’ severe in that respect.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْماً عَبُوساً قَمْطَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. “Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Therefore Allah hath warded from them the evil of that day) the torment of that day, (and hath made them find) and has given them (brightness) bright and beautiful faces (and joy) in their hearts;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَقَٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَومِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. So, Allāh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them a light of beauty and joy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God has therefore shielded them from the evil of that day and has granted them radiance fairness and resplendence in their faces and joy.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَوَقَٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَومِ وَلَقَّاهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. So, Allāh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them a light of beauty and joy..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hath awarded them for all that they endured) in the life of the world of poverty and misfortunes, (a Garden and silk attire;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And He has rewarded them for their patience for their steadfastness in refraining from disobedience with a Garden into which they are admitted and silk which they are given to wear;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَزَاهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُواْ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Reclining therein) sitting comfortably in the Garden (upon couches) in curtained canopies, (they will find there neither (heat of) a sun nor bitter cold) He says: they are touched neither by the heat of the sun nor by cold.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَىٰ ٱلأَرَائِكِ لاَ يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْساً وَلاَ زَمْهَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the implicit verb udkhilūhā ‘they are admitted into it’ therein upon couches arā’ik are beds inside canopies. They will not find lā yarawna is a second circumstantial qualifier therein either sun or bitter cold neither heat nor cold; but it is also said that zamharīr means ‘the moon’ and so in other words it means that it will be bright without any sun or moon.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُّتَّكِئِينَ فِيهَا عَلَىٰ ٱلأَرَائِكِ لاَ يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْساً وَلاَ زَمْهَرِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The shade) of trees (thereof is close upon them and the clustered fruits thereof bow down) are made close and available to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلاَلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And close dāniyatan is a supplement to the syntactical locus of the clause lā yarawna in other words it is a supplement to the import ghayra rā’īna over them will be its shades its trees and its clusters of fruits will hang low its fruits will brought close so that they are reached by the one standing the one sitting or the one lying down.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلاَلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Goblets of silver are brought round for them) by servants, (and beakers (as) of glass) without handles or covers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَاْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they will be waited upon from all around them in it with vessels of silver and goblets akwāb are cups without handles of crystal —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِآنِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَاْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Bright as) glass but (made) of silver, which they (themselves) have measured) in the hands of slave youths (to the measure (of their deeds)) it is also said that the drink is so measured that it is neither more nor less than what is required.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: crystal of silver that is they are made of silver which is transparent like crystal — which they that is the ones passing around them in service have measured in a precise measure according to the measure required by the one drinking it neither more nor less which makes for a most delightful drink.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قَوَارِيرَاْ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (There) in the Garden (are they watered with a cup) of wine (whereof the mixture is of Zanjabil,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْساً كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with ginger, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they will be given to drink therein a cup wine whose mixture that with which it is mixed is ginger

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْساً كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with ginger, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The water of a spring therein) in the Garden, (named Salsabil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. A spring there, called Salsabīl..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for zanjabīlan ‘ginger’ therein named Salsabīl meaning that its water is like ginger which the Arabs find very tasteful and which is very palatable for the throat.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. A spring there, called Salsabīl..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: There wait on them youths of immortal youths) in Paradise who never die or are taken out of it; it is also said this means: youths wearing beautiful garments, (whom, when you see) O Muhammad, (thou wouldst take for scattered pearls) because of their brightness; and it is also said this means: because of their scatteredness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤاً مَّنثُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And they will be waited upon by immortal youths immortally in the form of youths never ageing whom when you see them you will suppose them because of their beauty and the way in which they are scattered about offering service to be scattered pearls strewn from their string or from their shells in which they are fairer than when they the pearls are otherwise not in their shells.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤاً مَّنثُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When thou seest) O Muhammad, (thou wilt see there) in the Garden (bliss) lasting bliss for its dwellers (and high estate) none enters in on them except with greetings of peace and permission.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيماً وَمُلْكاً كَبِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And when you look there that is to say when you begin to look about in Paradise you will see ra’ayta is the response to idhā ‘when’ bliss that is indescribable and a great kingdom vast without limit.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيماً وَمُلْكاً كَبِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Their raiment will be fine green silk and gold embroidery. Bracelets of silver will they wear. Their Lord will slake their thirst with a pure drink) pure from filth; it is also said this means: Allah purifies them from hatred, cheating and enmity.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوۤاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَاباً طَهُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Upon them will be green garments of fine and thick silk. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Upon them ‘āliyahum is in the accusative as an adverbial clause and constitutes the predicate of a subject that will follow; a variant reading has ‘ālīhim as a subject with what follows as its predicate; the suffixed pronoun -hum denotes those persons to whom the supplement refers will be garments of fine green silk and heavy silk brocade sundus is fine silk and constitutes the outer cushion while istabraq is coarse silk and constitutes the inner lining; either read thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqin or thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqun or thiyābu sundusin khudrun wa’stabraqun or wa-thiyābu sundusin khudrin wa’stabraqin. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver — elsewhere it is stated ‘of gold’ in order to show that they will be adorned with both types at the same time or separately — and their Lord will give them a pure drink to drink tahūran ‘pure’ is intended as a hyperbolic qualification of its purity and cleanness in contrast to the wine of this world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَالِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ وَحُلُّوۤاْ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَاهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَاباً طَهُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Upon them will be green garments of fine and thick silk. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! This) which I have described to you of food, drink and raiment (is a reward for you) is a reward from Allah. (Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance) your works were accepted and made to grow.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. (And it will be said to them): “Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Verily this bliss is a reward for you and your endeavour has been appreciated’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. (And it will be said to them): “Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! We, even We, have revealed unto thee the Qur'an) We have sent you Gabriel with the Qur'an, (a revelation) in instalments: one, two and three verses at a time;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ān to you (O Muḥammad ) by stages..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly We nahnu reiterates the subject of innā ‘assuredly for the purpose of emphasis; alternatively it is a separating pronoun have revealed the Qur’ān to you as a gradual revelation tanzīlan is the predicate of inna ‘assuredly’ in other words We have divided it into parts instead of not revealing it all at once.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْآنَ تَنزِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ān to you (O Muḥammad ) by stages..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So submit patiently to thy Lord's command) to your Lord's decree; and it is also said this means: be patient in conveying the message of your Lord, (and obey not of them) of the disbelievers of Quraysh (any guilty one) any lewd and liar one, i.e. al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (or disbeliever) in Allah, i.e. 'Utbah Ibn Rabi'ah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلاَ تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِماً أَوْ كَفُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Therefore be patient (O Muḥammad ) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allāh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So submit patiently to your Lord’s decree to you to deliver His Message and do not obey of them that is of the disbelievers any sinner or disbeliever namely ‘Utba b. Rabī‘a and al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra — both of whom said to the Prophet s ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’; it is also possible that what is meant is every sinner or disbeliever in other words ‘Do not obey any of these whichever of the two he may be in what he may summon you to of sin or disbelief’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلاَ تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِماً أَوْ كَفُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Therefore be patient (O Muḥammad ) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allāh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Remember the name of thy Lord) pray by the command of your Lord (at morn and evening) i.e. the prayers of Fajr, Zuhr and 'Asr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Aṣr prayers]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And mention the Name of your Lord during prayer at dawn and with the declining of the sun that is at dawn fajr noon zuhr and in the afternoon ‘asr;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Aṣr prayers]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And worship Him (a portion) of the night) pray the prayer of Maghrib and 'Isha'. (And glorify Him through the livelong night) pray to Him at night, this refers to supererogatory prayers; it is also said that the night prayer was made compulsory on him but not on his Companions.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلاً طَوِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishā’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer). *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and prostrate to Him for a portion of the night that is at after sunset maghrib and at night ‘ishā’ and glorify Him the length of the night perform supererogatory prayers during it as mentioned above for either two thirds a half or a third of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِنَ ٱللَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلاً طَوِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishā’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer). *.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! These) the people of Mecca (love fleeting life) love striving for the life of the world, (and put behind them (the remembrance of)) and refrain from striving for the day which is ahead of them (a grievous day) whose torment and horrors are severe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْماً ثَقِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Verily, these (disbeliev ers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly these love the transitory life this world and leave behind them a burdensome day an awful one namely the Day of Resurrection not working towards it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْماً ثَقِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Verily, these (disbeliev ers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (We, even We, created them) i.e. the people of Mecca, (and strengthened their frame) and made their constitution strong. (And when We will, We can replace them, bringing others like them) i.e. We destroy them (in their stead) He says: if We had willed, We would have destroyed these sinful and disbelieving people and brought instead of them people who are better and more obedient.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong build. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: We created them and made firm their frames their limbs and their joints and whenever We will We can completely replace them with others like them in terms of their created form in place of them by destroying them tabdīlan ‘completely’ is for emphasis; idhā ‘when’ functions in the sense of in ‘if’ similar to where God says in several places in yasha’ yudhhibkum If He will He can take you away cf. Q. 1419; but because He exalted be He has not willed this it has not happened thus far.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَاهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong build. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! this is an Admonishment) from Allah, (that whosoever will may choose a way unto his Lord) that whoever will may believe in Allah's divine Oneness and return to his Lord.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ān) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: This sūra is indeed a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path through obedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِ تَذْكِرَةٌ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ سَبِيلاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ān) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Yet ye will not) good or evil, faith or disbelief, (unless Allah willeth) that you will it. (Lo! Allah is Knower) of what you will whether it is good or evil, (Wise) He decreed that you do not will anything of good or evil except that which He wills.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. But you cannot will, unless Allāh wills. Verily, Allāh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But you will not tashā’ūna may also be read yashā’ūna ‘they will’ choose a way through obedience unless God wills this. Assuredly God is ever Knower of His creatures Wise in what He does.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيماً حَكِيماً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. But you cannot will, unless Allāh wills. Verily, Allāh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He maketh whom He will to enter His mercy) He honours whoever deserves it with the religion of Islam, (and for evil-doers) the disbelieving idolaters (hath prepared) soon in the Hereafter (a painful doom) whose pain extends to their hearts'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَٱلظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Ẓālimūn — (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He admits whomever He will into His mercy His Paradise namely the believers; and as for the evildoers al-zālimīna is in the accusative because of an implied verb that is to say a‘adda ‘He has prepared’ as explained by what follows He has prepared for them a painful chastisement — these are the disbelievers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِي رَحْمَتِهِ وَٱلظَّالِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَاباً أَلِيماً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Ẓālimūn — (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the emissaries, (sent) one after another): '(By the emissaries, (sent) one after another) He says: Allah swears by the many angels who are sent one after another, just like horses follow one another; it is also said that these are the angels who are sent with the good, i.e. Gabriel, Michael and Seraphiel.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By (the winds or the angels or the Messengers of Allāh) sent forth one after another..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By those sent in succession ‘urfan that is by the winds that follow one another in succession like the mane ‘urf of a horse one part of hair coming after the other ‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْمُرْسَلاَتِ عُرْفاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By (the winds or the angels or the Messengers of Allāh) sent forth one after another..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By the raging hurricanes) and He swore by the violent hurricanes which blow away people's houses,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by the winds that blow violently..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by the raging hurricanes the violent winds;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْعَاصِفَاتِ عَصْفاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by the winds that blow violently..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By those which cause earth's vegetation to revive) and He swore by the rain, i.e. He swore by the clouds from which comes the rain; it is also said: this refers to the angels who spread the Scripture;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وٱلنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by the sweeping spreaders by the winds that scatter the rains;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وٱلنَّاشِرَاتِ نَشْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by the winds that scatter clouds and rain..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By those who winnow with a winnowing) and He swore by the angels who differentiate between the Truth and falsehood; it is also said that this refers to the verses of the Qur'an which distinguishes the Truth from falsehood, the lawful from the unlawful; and it is also said that these three refer to the angels,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by (the Verses of the Qur’ān) that separate (the right from the wrong)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by the decisive discriminators that is by the verses of the Qur’ān which discriminate between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْفَارِقَاتِ فَرْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by (the Verses of the Qur’ān) that separate (the right from the wrong)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By those who bring down the Reminder) and He swore by those who bring down the revelations,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by (the angels) that bring the revelations (to the Messengers),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by the casters of the remembrance that is by angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers casting the revelation onto the various communities of mankind

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَٰتِ ذِكْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by (the angels) that bring the revelations (to the Messengers),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (To excuse) to leave no excuse for one to think that Allah is an oppressor or transgressor (or to warn) His created beings from His chastisement; it is also said that (to excuse) refers to that which He has made lawful while (or to warn) refers to that which He has made unlawful; and it is also said (to excuse) refers to His commands while (or to warn) refers to His prohibitions; Allah swore by all these things,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عُذْراً أَوْ نُذْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. To cut off all excuses or to warn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to excuse or to warn that is to say in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God exalted be He a variant reading for nudhran and ‘udhran has nudhuran and ‘udhuran.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عُذْراً أَوْ نُذْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. To cut off all excuses or to warn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Surely that which ye are promised) of reward and punishment in the Hereafter (will befall) will happen and visit you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Surely, what you are prom ised must come to pass..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Surely that which you are promised O disbelievers of Mecca in the way of resurrection and chastisement will befall it will be without any doubt.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Surely, what you are prom ised must come to pass..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then showed when this will be, saying: (So when the stars are put out) when the light of the stars is gone,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Then, when the stars lose their lights..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So when the stars are obliterated when their light is extinguished

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. Then, when the stars lose their lights..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the sky is riven asunder,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And when the heaven is cleft asunder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the heaven is rent asunder

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And when the heaven is cleft asunder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And when the mountains are blown away,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And when the mountains are blown away..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the mountains are blown away crushed to pieces and blown in the air

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And when the mountains are blown away..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And when the messengers are brought unto their time appointed) and when the messengers are gathered.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the time is set for the testimony of the messengers read uqqitat or wuqqitat that is to say when they are gathered to an appointed time

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And when the Messengers are gathered to their time appointed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (For what day is the time appointed) for these things? He says: for what day has its Master delayed it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. For what Day are (these signs) postponed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed? it has been appointed for witnessing of the messengers against their communities to the effect that they delivered their messages from God.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لأَيِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. For what Day are (these signs) postponed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then explained, saying: (For the Day of Decision) when differences between people will be settled.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For the Day of Decision for creatures from this one may infer the response to the clauses beginning with idhā ‘when’ in other words ‘when … the decision will be made for all creatures’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. For the Day of Sorting Out (the men of Paradise from the men destined for Hell)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Decision is!) How would you know about the Day of Decision?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And what will explain to you what is the Day of Sorting Out?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) a valley in Gehenna running with blood and puss; and it is also said: a well in the Fire; and it is also said that this refers to severe punishment (unto the repudiators) the disbelievers in Allah, the Scripture, the Messenger and resurrection after death (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Destroyed We not the former folk) by means of death as well as chastisement,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Did We not destroy the ancients?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Did We not destroy the ancients for their denial in other words We certainly destroyed them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Did We not destroy the ancients?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then caused the latter folk to follow after) through death and chastisement?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. So, shall We make later generations to follow them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then made the latter folk follow them? the latter folk of those who denied such as the disbelievers of Mecca whom We will destroy.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلآخِرِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. So, shall We make later generations to follow them..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus deal We ever with the guilty) with the idolaters among your folk.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Thus do We deal with the Mujrimūn (polytheists, disbeliev ers, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So just as We dealt with those who denied will We deal with the guilty with every individual who will be guilty in the future and destroy them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَذَلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Thus do We deal with the Mujrimūn (polytheists, disbeliev ers, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the deniers of resurrection after death from among the people of your folk (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day! — reiterated for emphasis.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Did We not create you) O disbelievers (from a base fluid) from a flimsy sperm drop

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Did We not create you from a base fluid one that is delicate — and this is semen

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Did We not create you from a despised water (semen)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Which We laid up in a safe abode) in the woman's womb.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then lodged it in a secure abode that is the womb

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَجَعَلْنَاهُ فِي قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Then We placed it in a place of safety (womb),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (For a known term) until the time of its birth after nine months or less or more?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. For a known period (deter mined by gestation)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: for a known span? namely the time for delivery.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. For a known period (deter mined by gestation)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus We arranged) its creation; it is also said this means: We controlled its creation; it is also said this means: and We fashioned its creation in the woman's womb. (How excellent is Our arranging!) how excellent is what We created and fashioned!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَادِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. So, We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Thus We were able to do this; so how excellent able ones We are!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَادِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. So, We did measure; and We are the Best to measure (the things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and resurrection after death (on that day) on the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلأَرْضَ كِفَاتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Have We not made the earth a receptacle.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Both for the living) on its surface (and the dead) in its belly; it is also said this means: We made the earth a channel for both the living and the dead,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوٰتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. For the living and the dead?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: for the living on its surface and the dead inside it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوٰتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. For the living and the dead?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And placed therein) in the earth (high mountains) firm mountains well-steeped in their locations (and given you) O repudiators (to drink sweet water therein) and it is said fine water?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ شَامِخَاتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَاكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. And have placed therein firm, and tall mountains, and have given you to drink sweet water?.
