meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Depart) O repudiators (unto that (doom) which ye used to deny) in the life of the world, claiming that it will never take place;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. (It will be said to the disbelievers): “Depart you to that which you used to deny!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers Depart to that chastisement which you used to deny!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. (It will be said to the disbelievers): “Depart you to that which you used to deny!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: The angels who are the keepers of the Fire will say to them after the end of reckoning: (Depart) O deniers (unto the shadow) caused by the smoke of the Fire (falling threefold) three groups.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلاَثِ شُعَبٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. “Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell which as it rises splits into three parts because of its magnitude —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱنطَلِقُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِي ثَلاَثِ شُعَبٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. “Depart you to a shadow (of Hell-Fire smoke ascending) in three columns,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Which yet is) no relief) from the heat of the Fire (nor shelter from the flame) of the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَّ ظَلِيلٍ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: which is neither shady neither protective unable to shade them from the heat of that Day nor of any avail against nor wards off from them anything of the flame the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَّ ظَلِيلٍ وَلاَ يُغْنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Neither shady, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! It) i.e. the Fire (throweth up sparks like the castles) like the bases of huge trees,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qaṣr (a fort or a huge log of wood),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed it that is the Fire throws up sparks namely those flame that are thrown by it into the air huge like palace edifices in terms of their enormity and vertical extension

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِي بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Verily, it (Hell) throws sparks (huge) as Al-Qaṣr (a fort or a huge log of wood),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Or) as it might be camels of bright yellow hue) black camels.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. As if they were yellow camels (or bundles of ropes)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as if they were dark yellow camels jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth it is stated ‘The sparks of humans thrown into the air by the Fire are black as pitch qīr’; the Arabs call dark camels sufr ‘yellow’ because a touch of yellow is mixed with their blackish colour and therefore it is said that ‘yellow’ in this verse actually means ‘black’ on account of what has been mentioned; but some say no to this interpretation; sharar is the plural of sharāra; qīr is qār ‘pitch’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُ جِمَٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. As if they were yellow camels (or bundles of ropes)..

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This is a day wherein they speak not) in some places and speak in others,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لاَ يَنطِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: This namely the Day of Resurrection is the day in which they will not utter anything

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لاَ يَنطِقُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. That will be a Day when they shall not speak (during some part of it),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nor are they suffered) nor are they given permission (to put forth excuses.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: nor will they be given permission to offer excuses and so offer excuses fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu ‘given permission’ but without being a direct result of it since it belongs within the confines of the general denial of permission in other words ‘there will be no permission hence no excuses’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلاَ يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And they will not be permitted to put forth any excuse..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This is the Day of Decision) regarding created beings, (We have brought you) O disbelievers (and the men of old together) as well as those who were after you.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you O deniers from this community and the ancients together the ancients from among the deniers before you so that you will all be reckoned with and chastised together;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ جَمَعْنَٰكُمْ وَٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. That will be a Day of Decision! We have brought you and the men of old together!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (If now ye have any wit) if you have the power to do anything to Me, (outwit Me) then do it; it is also said that this means: if you have any scheme against Me, then execute it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكمُ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. So, if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allāh B)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So if you have any stratagems any ploy to ward off your chastisement try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِن كَانَ لَكمُ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. So, if you have a plot, use it against Me (Allāh B)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then explained the abode of the believers, saying: (Lo! those who kept their duty) those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (are amid shade) amid the shade of trees (and fountains) plain, running water,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلاَلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Verily, the Muttaqūn (the pious)(1) shall be amidst shades and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades that is amid clusters of trees since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade and springs issuing forth with water

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلاَلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Verily, the Muttaqūn (the pious)(1) shall be amidst shades and springs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And fruits) different kinds of fruit (such as they desire).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. And fruits, such as they desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and fruits such as they desire this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is done according to their desires in contrast to the case in this world where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَفَوَاكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. And fruits, such as they desire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah will say to them (Eat) of the fruits, (drink) from the rivers (and welcome) fearing no sickness or death, (O ye blessed, in return for what ye did) and said of good in the life of the world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيـۤئاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. “Eat and drink comforta bly for that which you used to do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mutahanni’īna for what you used to do’ in the way of obedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشْرَبُواْ هَنِيـۤئاً بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. “Eat and drink comforta bly for that which you used to do.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thus do We reward the good) in words and deeds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Verily, thus We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers)(2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed so in the same way that We reward the God-fearing do We reward the virtuous.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّا كَذَلِكَ نَجْزِي ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. Verily, thus We reward the Muḥsinūn (good-doers)(2)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Eat) O disbelievers (and take your ease a little) in the life of the world. (Lo! ye are guilty) you are idolaters and your destination in the Hereafter will be the Fire. This is a threat to them from Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ مُّجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are Mujrimūn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little time at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كُلُواْ وَتَمَتَّعُواْ قَلِيلاً إِنَّكُمْ مُّجْرِمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. (O you disbelievers)! Eat and enjoy yourselves (in this worldly life) for a little while. Verily, you are Mujrimūn (polytheists, disbelievers, sinners, criminals)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 47. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When it is said unto them) to the disbelievers when they were in the life of the world: (Bow down) submit to Allah by believing in His divine Oneness, (they bow not down!) they did not submit to Allah by accepting His divine Oneness; it is also said that they will be asked to do so in the Hereafter, when Allah will say to them: " bow down, if you are truthful that you believed in that which you now claim " , this is because they said: " By Allah, our Lord, we were not idolaters ". But they will not be able to bow down and their bodies will remain erect and stiff. It is also said that this verse was revealed about Thaqif who said: " we will not bend down to bow or prostrate ".

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُواْ لاَ يَرْكَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And when it is said to them: “Bow down yourselves (in prayer)!” They bow not down (offer not their prayers) (3). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For when it is said to them ‘Bow down!’ perform prayer they do not bow down they do not perform prayer.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُواْ لاَ يَرْكَعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 48. And when it is said to them: “Bow down yourselves (in prayer)!” They bow not down (offer not their prayers) (3). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) to the disbelievers in Allah, His Messenger, Scripture and the resurrection (on that day) the day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.

meta_data.ayah_translation: 49. Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (In what statement) in what Scripture, (after this) after the Book of Allah, (will they believe) if they do not believe in these tidings?'

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ān) will they believe?
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: In what discourse then after this namely the Qur’ān will they believe? In other words they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this Qur’ān since it comprises that inimitability i‘jāz which none of the others do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثٍ بَعْدَهُ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: Then in what statement after this (the Qur’ān) will they believe?
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (Whereof do they question one another?): He says: 'what are they-meaning the people of Quraysh-talking about?'

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. What are they asking one another about?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: About what about what thing are they the people of Quraysh questioning one another?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. What are they asking one another about?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((It is) of the awful tidings) they are talking about the tidings of the noble, glorious and great Qur'an,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. About the great news (i.e. Islāmic Monotheism, the Qur’ān which Prophet Muḥammad  brought and the Day of Resurrection).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: About the awesome tiding this is the explication of that ‘thing’; the interrogative is meant to emphasise its magnitude — this awesome tiding is the Qur’ān comprising news of the Resurrection and so on which the Prophet s brought —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. About the great news (i.e. Islāmic Monotheism, the Qur’ān which Prophet Muḥammad  brought and the Day of Resurrection).

tafsir: (Concerning which they are in disagreement) some of them disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an while others believe in them. This is because whenever Gabriel brought down a section of the Qur'an to the Prophet (pbuh) and he recited it to them, they used to talk about it, and some of them would believe while others would persist in their disbelief.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. About which they are in disagreement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: concerning which they are at variance for the believers affirm it while the disbelievers repudiate it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. About which they are in disagreement..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) this is a reply to the disbelievers, (but they will come to know!) They will come to know upon the advent of death what will be done with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Nay, they will come to know!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! — a disavowal — they will come to know what will befall them for their rejection of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Nay, they will come to know!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, (again, but they will come to know!) They will come to know in the grave what will be done with them. This is a threat from Allah to those who disbelieved in Muhammad (pbuh) and in the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Nay, again, they will come to know!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Again no indeed! They will come to know! reiterated for emphasis; thumma is added here to declare that the second threat of chastisement is more severe than the first. God exalted be He then alludes to His power to resurrect saying

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ كَلاَّ سَيَعْلَمُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Nay, again, they will come to know!.

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed they never feared any reckoning given their rejection of the Resurrection

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُواْ لاَ يَرْجُونَ حِسَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They called Our revelations) Our Scripture and Messenger (false with strong denial.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَذَّبُواْ بِآيَاتِنَا كِذَّاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. But they denied Our Āyāt (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, and that which Our Prophet  brought) completely..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and they denied Our signs the Qur’ān mendaciously

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Everything) regarding the works of the children of Adam (have We recorded in a Book) We wrote it down in the Guarded or Preserved Tablet.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And all things We have recorded in a Book..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and everything in the way of deeds have We kept count of have We recorded precisely in a Book as individual written records in the Preserved Tablet in order to requite creatures in accordance with them including the record of their denial of the Qur’ān.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكُلَّ شَيْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَاهُ كِتَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And all things We have recorded in a Book..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So taste) the chastisement in the Fire. (No increase do We give you) in the Fire (save of torment) one kind of torment after another.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلاَّ عَذَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. So, taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: ‘So now taste! — in other words it will be said to them in the Hereafter when the chastisement has befallen them taste now your requital! For We will increase you in nothing but chastisement’ in addition to your due chastisement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلاَّ عَذَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. So, taste you (the results of your evil actions). No increase shall We give you, except in torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! for the duteous) for those who ward off disbelief, idolatry and indecencies (is achievement) safety from the Fire and nearness of Allah

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Verily, for the righteous,(1) there will be a success (Paradise);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Truly for the God-fearing there will be a triumph a place of triumph in Paradise

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. Verily, for the righteous,(1) there will be a success (Paradise);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Gardens) of trees and palm-trees (enclosed and vineyards,

meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Gardens and vineyards,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

meta_data.ayah_arabic: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. Gardens and vineyards,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And maidens for companions) who are all of the same age: 33 years of age,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and buxom maidens kawā‘ib is the plural of kā‘ib of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. And young full-breasted (mature) maidens of equal age,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And a full cup) one cup after another.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَأْساً دِهَاقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And a full cup (of wine)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and a brimming cup wine filling the vessels in which it is in; in sūrat al-Qitāl it is said and rivers of wine Q. 4715.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَكَأْساً دِهَاقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. And a full cup (of wine)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (There) in Paradise (hear they) the inhabitants of the Garden (never vain discourse) oaths or falsehood, (nor lying) they do not lie to each other.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَّ يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواً وَلاَ كِذَّاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. No vain discourse shall they hear therein, nor lying;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They will not hear in it that is in Paradise when they drink wine and in other situations any vain talk any words of falsehood or lies between one another read kidhāban to mean kadhiban ‘lies’ or kidhdhāban to mean takdhīban ‘lying’ in contrast to what happens in this world when wine is drunk

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لاَّ يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْواً وَلاَ كِذَّاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. No vain discourse shall they hear therein, nor lying;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Requital) a reward (from thy Lord a gift) that He bestows upon them in the Garden (in payment) ten rewards for each good deed; and it is also said this means: reward in proportion to their good deeds

meta_data.ayah_arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (accord ing to the best of their good deeds),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: this will be a reward from your Lord in other words God has rewarded them with this reward as a gift ‘atā’an substitutes for jazā’an ‘reward’ that is sufficing that is abundant hisāban as meaning ‘abundant’ derives from their saying a‘tānī fa-ahsabanī ‘he gave me so abundantly that I said “that is enough for me”’ hasbī

meta_data.ayah_arabic: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. A reward from your Lord, an ample calculated gift (accord ing to the best of their good deeds),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lord of the heavens and the earth, and (all) that is between them) of creation and marvels, (the Beneficent) He is the Beneficent; (with Whom none) none of His slaves, i.e. the angels as well as others (can converse) with regard to intercession until Allah gives them permission to do so.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth read rabbi ‘from the Lord of’ or rabbu ‘He is the Lord of’ and all that is between them the Compassionate One likewise read rahmāni or rahmānu or read rahmānu with rabbi for the preceding Whom exalted be He they that is creatures will not be able to address that is to say not one of them will be able to address Him for fear of Him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ لاَ يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. (From) the Lord of the heavens and the earth, and whatsoever is in between them, the Most Gracious, with Whom they cannot dare to speak (on the Day of Resurrection except by His Leave)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On the day when the angels and the Spirit) Gabriel; and it is also said: this is a created being whose tremendousness only Allah knows; Ibn Mas'ud also said: the Spirit is an angel greater than every thing save the Throne, and this angel glorifies Allah each day 12,000 formulas of glorification, and which each glorification he utters Allah creates an angel who seeks forgiveness for the believers until the Day of Judgement; it is also said this refers to a group of angels who have feet and hands like those of humans (stand arrayed, they speak not) to intercede, (saving him whom the Beneficent alloweth) to intercede (and who speaketh right) truly “there is no deity save Allah”.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ صَفّاً لاَّ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. The Day that Ar-Rūḥ [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allāh) allows, and he will speak what is right..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: on the day yawma is the adverbial qualifier for lā yamlikūna ‘they will not be able to’ when the Spirit Gabriel or God’s hosts and the angels stand arrayed saffan is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mustaffīna. They creatures will not speak except him whom the Compassionate One permits to speak and who says what is right from among the believers and the angels as if meaning that they will intercede for he whom He approves of.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلاَئِكَةُ صَفّاً لاَّ يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلاَّ مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. The Day that Ar-Rūḥ [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel) or another angel] and the angels will stand forth in rows, they will not speak except him whom the Most Gracious (Allāh) allows, and he will speak what is right..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That is the True Day) in which will happen what I have mentioned. (So whoso will should seek recourse) whoever will believe in Allah's divine Oneness and seek through his belief in Allah's divine Oneness a way of return (unto his Lord.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: That is the True Day whose coming to pass is definite namely the Day of Resurrection. So whoever wishes to let him seek resort with his Lord a return to Him that is to say let him return to God by being obedient to Him so that he may be secure from chastisement in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذَلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِ مَآباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. That is (without doubt) the True Day. So, whosoever wills, let him seek a place with (or a way to) His Lord (by obeying Him in this worldly life)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! We warn you) O people of Mecca (of a doom at hand) which will surely happen, (a day whereon a man will look) when the believer will look; and it is also said: when the disbeliever will look (on that which his own hands have sent before) have earned of good or evil, (and the disbeliever will cry: “Would that I were dust!”) with the beasts. Because of the horrors, severity and torment of that day, the disbeliever will wish to be turned into dust along with beasts. This will occur on the day when the first trumpet resounds'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَاباً قَرِيباً يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Verily, We have warned you of a near torment — the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbe liever will say: “I wish I would have been dust.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Lo! We have warned you O disbelievers of Mecca of a chastisement that is near the chastisement of the impending Day of Resurrection — for anything that is impending is also near — the day yawma adverbially qualifies ‘adhāban ‘a chastisement’ by describing it when a person when every person will behold what his hands have sent ahead of good and evil and the disbeliever will say ‘O yā is a particle used to call attention to something would that I were dust!’ in other words and not be chastised. He says this when God exalted be He says to the beasts after each of them has retaliated against the other ‘Be dust!’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَاكُمْ عَذَاباً قَرِيباً يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يٰلَيْتَنِي كُنتُ تُرَاباً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. Verily, We have warned you of a near torment — the Day when man will see that (the deeds) which his hands have sent forth, and the disbe liever will say: “I wish I would have been dust.”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said concerning the interpretation of Allah's saying (By those who drag forth): '(By those who drag forth) He says: Allah swears by the angels who take away the souls of the disbelievers (to destruction) the souls of the disbelievers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By those that wrest by the angels who wrest the souls of disbelievers violently;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّازِعَاتِ غَرْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By the meteors rushing) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who busy the disbelievers with grief and anxiety; it is also said that this refers to the souls of the believers which hasten to come out of their bodies in order to go to the Garden.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by those that draw out by the angels who draw out the souls of believers gently;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلنَّاشِطَاتِ نَشْطاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. By those (angels) who gently take out (the souls of the believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By the lone stars floating) and it is also said that He is here swearing by the angels who take away the souls of the righteous slowly and gently and then let them rest; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by those that glide serenely by the angels who descend from the heavens with His command exalted be He;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّابِحَاتِ سَبْحاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by those that swim along (i.e. angels or planets in their orbits)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (By the angels hastening) and He swears by the angels who hasten to Paradise with the souls of the believers and to the Fire with the souls of the disbelievers; it is also said this refers to the souls of the believers that hasten to Paradise,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: by those that race forward by the angels who race forward to Paradise with the souls of believers;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلسَّابِقَاتِ سَبْقاً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And by those that press forward as in a race (i.e. the angels or stars or the horses)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And those who govern the event) and He swears by the angels who govern the matters of the slaves, meaning Gabriel, Michael, Seraphiel and the angel of death. It is said that (those who govern the event) refers to the spears of soldiers, (the meteors rushing) refers to the ropes of soldiers and (the lone stars floating) refers to the ships of soldiers who fight at sea, (the ones who do the hastening) refers to the horses of soldiers, while (those who govern the event) refers to the generals of soldiers; it is also said that (the lone stars floating) refer to the sun, the moon, the day and the night. Allah swore by all these that the two blowings of the trumpet will take place, with an interval of 40 years separating the two blowings.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by those (angels) who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbe liev ers will be called to account)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by those that direct the affair by the angels who direct the affairs of this world that is to say they descend with the directions for it from God the response to all of these oath clauses has been omitted understood to be something like la-tub‘athunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you shall certainly be resurrected O disbelievers of Mecca!’ which is also the operator of the following clause

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَاتِ أَمْراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And by those (angels) who arrange to do the Commands of their Lord, (so verily, you disbe liev ers will be called to account)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: So Allah said: (On the day when the first trump resoundeth) this refers to the first blowing of the trumpet when everything will quake.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. On the Day when (the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the moun tains will shake violently (and everybody will die)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when the Tremor quakes that is to say the first blast as a result of which everything will be shaken violently thus it the subject has been described in terms of the effect it produces

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. On the Day when (the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the moun tains will shake violently (and everybody will die)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the second followeth it) this is the final blowing on the trumpet,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and is followed by the Aftershock the second blast; between the two blasts is a span of forty years the sentence tatba‘uhā’l-rādifatu is a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-rājifa ‘the Tremor’ in other words the ‘day’ can adverbially accommodate both blasts and other events and so for this reason it can also properly function as the adverbial qualifier for the Resurrection that will take place after the second blast;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. The second blowing of the Trumpet follows it (and everybody will be resurrected)..

tafsir: (So Allah seized him) Allah punished him ((and made him) an example for the after (life) and for the former) the punishment that he suffered in the life of the world is drowning and the punishment of the Hereafter will be in the Fire; it is also said that this means: Allah has punished him because of his former and latter pronouncements. His first pronouncement being: “I do not know of any other god for you except Me” and the second being (I am your Lord the Highest) and it is said that there is an interval of 40 years between the first and second pronouncements.

tafsir: (But when the great disaster cometh) but when the Hour comes, it will tower above everything and nothing will escape it,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So when the Greatest Catastrophe befalls — the second blast —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. But when there comes the greatest catastrophe (i.e. the Day of Recompense) —.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The day when man will call to mind) when the disbeliever, al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith and his host, will remember and know (his (whole) endeavour) the works he did in his state of disbelief,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. The Day when man shall remember what he strove for..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the day when man will remember yawma yatadhakkaru’l-insānu substitutes for idhā ‘when’ his efforts in the life of the world in the way of good or evil

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلإِنسَانُ مَا سَعَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. The Day when man shall remember what he strove for..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hell will stand forth visible to him who seeth) to him who is ordained to enter it,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And Hell‑fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and the Hell-fire the consuming Fire is revealed for all to see for every on-looker the response to idhā ‘when’ is what follows

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. And Hell‑fire shall be made apparent in full view for (every) one who sees..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then, as for him who rebelled) him who was too arrogant and proud and disbelieved in Allah, i.e. al-Nadr Ibn al-Harith Ibn 'Alqamah

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Then for him who trans gressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allāh). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as for him who was rebellious who disbelieved

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 37. Then for him who trans gressed all bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and evil deeds of disobedience to Allāh). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And chose the life of the world) rather than the Hereafter and also chose disbelief rather than faith,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآثَرَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and preferred the life of this world by pursuing carnal desires

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَآثَرَ ٱلْحَيَاةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 38. And preferred the life of this world (by following his evil desires and lusts),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! Hell will be his home) the Fire is the home of him who is thus.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Hell-fire will indeed be the abode his abode.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 39. Verily, his abode will be Hell-fire;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But as for him who feared) upon committing a sin (to stand before his Lord) his standing before his Lord and abstains from engaging in sin (and restrained his soul from lust) from that which is unlawful, even though he desires it, this refers to Mus'ab Ibn 'Umayr.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. But, as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But as for him who feared the stance before his Lord his standing before Him and forbade the evil-bidding soul from pursuing desire that leads to perdition as a result of that person’s lusting after carnal desires

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 40. But, as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires and lusts..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the Garden will be his home) Paradise will be the home of him who is thus.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Verily, Paradise will be his abode..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Paradise will indeed be the abode in sum the response to idhā ‘when’ verse 34 is that the disobedient one will be in the Fire and the obedient one in Paradise.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِيَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 41. Verily, Paradise will be his abode..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They ask thee) the disbelievers of Mecca ask you, O Muhammad, (of the Hour) about the advent of the Hour: (when will it come to port?) When is it going to happen? Because they disbelieved in it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. They ask you (O Muḥammad ) about the Hour — when will be its appointed time?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: They that is the disbelievers of Mecca will ask you about the Hour when will it set in? when will it come to pass and when will it begin?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 42. They ask you (O Muḥammad ) about the Hour — when will be its appointed time?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Why (ask they)? What hast thou to tell thereof?) What has it to do with you that you should mention it to them?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. You have no knowledge to say anything about it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: What have you to do with the mention of it? in other words you have no knowledge of it in order to mention it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 43. You have no knowledge to say anything about it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto thy Lord belongeth (knowledge of) the term thereof) the knowledge of its timing belongs to Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَٰهَآ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: With your Lord it belongs ultimately ultimate knowledge of it lies with Him; none other than Him has any knowledge of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَٰهَآ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 44. To your Lord belongs (the knowledge of) the term thereof?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou art but a warner) you are but a warning messenger by means of the Qur'an (unto him who feareth it) to him who fears its advent.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. You (O Muḥammad ) are only a warner for those who fear it,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: You are only a warner for your warning will only benefit the one who fears it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 45. You (O Muḥammad ) are only a warner for those who fear it,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On the day when they behold it) i.e. the Hour, (it will be as if they had but tarried) in the graves (for an evening) the duration of an evening (or the morn thereof) or the duration of one morning'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوۤاْ إِلاَّ عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: The day they see it it will be as if they had only tarried in their graves for an evening or the morning thereof that is to say as if only one evening of a day or its morning the annexation of duhā ‘morning’ to ‘ashiyya ‘evening’ is valid on the basis of their contiguity since both constitute either side of the day; the annexation has also allowed for the word to fall in harmony with the end-rhyme of the verses.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوۤاْ إِلاَّ عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَٰهَا
meta_data.ayah_translation: 46. The Day they see it, (it will be) as if they had not tarried (in this world) except an afternoon or a morning..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (He frowned): '(He frowned) He says: Muhammad (pbuh) showed a stern face (and turned away) his face

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. (The Prophet ) frowned and turned away..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: He the Prophet frowned glowered with his face and turned away

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. (The Prophet ) frowned and turned away..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Because the blind man came unto him) when 'Abdullah Ibn Umm Maktum came to him. His real name is 'Abdullah Ibn Shurayh. Umm Maktum was his father's mother. What happened is that the Prophet (pbuh) was sitting with a group of men among the nobles of Quraysh, among whom were his uncle al-'Abbas Ibn 'Abd al-Muttalib, Umayyah Ibn Khalaf al-Jumahi and Safwan Ibn Umayyah, who were at that time disbelievers. The Prophet (pbuh) was admonishing and inviting them to Islam when Ibn Maktum came to him and said: “O Messenger of Allah! Teach me of that which Allah has taught you”. The Prophet (pbuh) turned his face from him because he was busy with these people. When this happened Allah revealed: he frowned and turned away because the blind man came unto him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلأَعْمَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Because there came to him the blind man ..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: because the blind man came to him ‘Abd Allāh son of Umm Maktūm who interrupted him while he was busy with those notables of Quryash whose submission to God he was very eager for. The blind man was not aware that he was busy with these and so he called out to him ‘Teach me of what God has taught you’. However the Prophet s went off to his house. He was then reproached for this with what was revealed in this sūra. Afterwards whenever he came to him the Prophet would say to him ‘Greetings to him on whose account God reproached me!’ and would lay down his cloak for him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلأَعْمَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Because there came to him the blind man ..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (What could inform thee) O Muhammad (but that he might) i.e. the blind man (grow (in grace)) became righteous through the admonitions of the Qur'an

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And how would you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself yazzakkā the original tā’ of yatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy that is perhaps he would purge himself of sins by what he hears from you

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُ يَزَّكَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And how can you know that he might become pure (from sins)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Or take heed) by means of the Qur'an (and so the reminder) by means of the Qur'an (might avail him?) It is also said that this means: how do you know O Muhammad, whether or not he becomes righteous and whether or not he benefits from the admonitions of the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Or he might receive admo nition, and the admonition might profit him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: or be admonished yadhdhakkar the original tā’ of yatadhakkar has been assimilated with the dhāl and so the reminder the admonition heard from you might benefit him a variant reading for tanfa‘uhu has tanfa‘ahu as the response to the optative statement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Or he might receive admo nition, and the admonition might profit him?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (As for him who thinketh himself independent) of Allah, i.e. the three men mentioned above,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But as for the one who thinks himself self-sufficient through wealth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. As for him who thinks himself self-sufficient,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto him thou payest regard) you turn your face to them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. To him you attend;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to him you do attend tasaddā a variant reading has tassaddā where the original second tā’ of tatasaddā has been assimilated with the sād him you accept and turn your attention to;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنتَ لَهُ تَصَدَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. To him you attend;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Yet it is not thy concern if he grow not (in grace)) it is not your concern if these three men do not believe in Allah's divine Oneness.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلاَّ يَزَّكَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. What does it matter to you, if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: yet it is not your concern if he does not cleanse himself if he does not believe.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلاَّ يَزَّكَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. What does it matter to you, if he will not become pure (from disbelief: you are only a Messenger, your duty is to convey the Message of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But as for him who cometh unto thee with earnest purpose) hastening for goodness

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. But as to him who came to you running,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But as for him who comes to you hurrying yas‘ā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb jā’a ‘comes’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. But as to him who came to you running,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hath fear) of Allah, and is also a Muslim; this is because Ibn Umm Maktum had accepted Islam before this incident,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And is afraid (of Allāh and His punishment)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: fearful of God wa-huwa yakhshā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb yas‘ā ‘hurrying’ — this being the blind man —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And is afraid (of Allāh and His punishment)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (From him thou) O Muhammad (art distracted) being busy with those three men.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to him you pay no heed talahhā the original second tā’ of tatalahhā has been omitted that is to say from him you are distracted by other things.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Of him you are neglectful and divert your attention to another,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) do not do this; He says: do not turn to those who think themselves independent of Allah and turn away from he who fears Allah. After this reminder, the Prophet (pbuh) used to honour Ibn Umm Maktum and treat him well, (but verily it) this surah (is an Admonishment) from Allah both for the rich and the poor,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ān) is an admonition..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! do not behave like this. Truly it the sūra is or the verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Nay, (do not do like this); indeed it (this Qur’ān) is an admonition..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So let whosoever will pay heed to it) whoever Allah wants him to be admonished will be admonished,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. So, whoever wills, let him pay attention to it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: so let whoever will remember it preserve it in his memory and thus be admonished by it —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. So, whoever wills, let him pay attention to it..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On honoured leaves) He says: the Qur'an is written on scrolls made of skin which are honoured in the sight of Allah

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَي صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. (It is) in Records held (greatly) in honour (Al-Lauḥ Al-Maḥfūẓ),.

tafsir: When the sun is folded away enfolded and stripped of its light

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. When the sun shall be wound round and its light is lost and is overthrown(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the stars fall) on the face of the earth,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And when the stars shall fall..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the stars scatter when they are extinguished and hurtle down towards the earth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And when the stars shall fall..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the hills are moved) from above the surface of the earth

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the mountains shall be made to pass away;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the mountains are set in motion when they are blown away from the face of the earth becoming as scattered dust

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the mountains shall be made to pass away;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the camels big with young are abandoned) because they are preoccupied with their own selves,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And when the pregnant she-camels shall be neglected;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the pregnant camels are neglected abandoned without a herdsman or anyone to milk them on account of the matter that has come over them — even though previously no wealth was dearer to them than these pregnant camels;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And when the pregnant she-camels shall be neglected;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the wild beasts are herded together) for retaliation; and it is also said this means: when they are dead,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the wild beasts are mustered when they are brought together after being resurrected so that each of them may retaliate against the other before becoming dust;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the seas rise) and mix with each other, the sweet seas and the salty seas, such that they become one sea; and it is also said this means: when they become a burning site,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And when the seas shall become as blazing Fire (or shall overflow)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the seas are set afire read sujirat or sujjirat when they are set alight and become a mass of fire;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. And when the seas shall become as blazing Fire (or shall overflow)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when souls are reunited) in pairs; it is also said this means: when souls are reunited with their companions: the believer with the maiden of Paradise and the disbeliever with Satan; the righteous with the righteous and the sinful with the sinful,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And when the souls shall be joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the souls are coupled when they are paired up with their bodies;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And when the souls shall be joined with their bodies, (the good with the good and the bad with the bad)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the girl child that was buried alive is asked) i.e. when she asks her father

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) shall be questioned:(2) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the girl buried-alive the young girl buried alive for fear of shame and impoverishment asks — in rebuke of its slayer —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And when the female (infant) buried alive (as the pagan Arabs used to do) shall be questioned:(2) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (For what sin she was slain) for what sin did you kill me; it is also said that this means: when the one who killed her is asked: for what sin did you kill her,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. For what sin, was she killed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: for what sin she was slain sa’alat ‘asks’ a variant reading has su’ilat ‘she is asked’ narrating the address directed to her to which she then responds by saying ‘I was slain without having committed any sin’;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بِأَىِّ ذَنبٍ قُتِلَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. For what sin, was she killed?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the pages) the registers of good and bad deeds (are laid open) for reckoning; it is also said this means: when they fly about in people's hands,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] shall be laid open..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the scrolls the scrolls containing the deeds are unrolled read nushirat or nushshirat when they are unfolded and spread out;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. And when the (written) pages [of deeds (good and bad) of every person] shall be laid open..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the sky is torn away,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And when the heaven shall be stripped off and taken away from its place;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the heaven is stripped off torn away from its place just as the skin of a sheep is stripped off;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. And when the heaven shall be stripped off and taken away from its place;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And when hell is lighted) for the disbelievers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And when Hell‑fire shall be set ablaze..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the Hell-fire is set ablaze read su‘irat or su‘‘irat when it is set alight;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And when Hell‑fire shall be set ablaze..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the Garden is brought nigh) for the believers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And when Paradise shall be brought near..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when Paradise is brought near when it is brought close to those who have merited it that they may enter it the response to idhā ‘when’ at the beginning of the sūra and all that has been supplemented thereto is the following

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. And when Paradise shall be brought near..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Then) every soul will know) every soul whether it is righteous or sinful will know at that point (what it hath made ready) what it has sent forth of good or evil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then a soul every soul at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection will know what it has presented of good or evil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Oh, but I call to witness) He says: I swear by (the planets) which appear at night and disappear during the day,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the receding planets

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. So verily, I swear by the planets that recede (i.e. disappear during the day and appear during the night)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The stars which rise and set) they move at night in the galaxy sweeping away the day and then go back to their positions and disappear; the reference here is to five planets: Venus, Saturn, Mars, Jupiter, and Mercury;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And by the planets that move swiftly and hide them selves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: the movers the setters that is the five planets Saturn Jupiter Mars Venus and Mercury takhnusu means ‘they sink away’ during their orbit whereas we see stars at the end of their zodiacal course return to the start; taknisu means that they enter their kinās ‘hideaway’ in other words they retreat into their setting-places;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And by the planets that move swiftly and hide them selves..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the close of night,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And by the night as it departs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the night as it approaches as it falls with its darkness or it means as it recedes;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And by the night as it departs..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And the breath of morning) and when the morning and brightens come; Allah swore by all these

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And by the dawn as it brightens..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the dawn as it breathes as it extends until it becomes broad daylight

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And by the dawn as it brightens..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That this) i.e. the Qur'an (is in truth the word of an honoured messenger) Allah says: it is brought down by Gabriel to a messenger who is honoured by Allah, i.e. Muhammad (pbuh)

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ān brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel), from Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad ]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: truly this Qur’ān is the word of a messenger who is noble in the sight of God exalted be He — this being the messenger Gabriel it qawl ‘word’ has been annexed to him because he descends with it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. Verily, this is the Word (this Qur’ān brought by) a most honourable messenger [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel), from Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad ]..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Mighty) against his enemies, i.e. Gabriel, (established in the presence of the Lord of the Throne) he has standing and esteem with his Lord,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allāh), the Lord of the Throne,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: powerful one of mighty powers eminent one of eminent status makīnin is semantically connected ‘inda ‘in the presence of’ in the presence of the Lord of the Throne that is God exalted be He;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ذِي قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِي ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. Owner of power, (and high rank) with (Allāh), the Lord of the Throne,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((One) to be obeyed) i.e. Gabriel is obeyed in Heaven: the angels obey him, (and trustworthy) in conveying the message to the prophets;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens) and trustworthy. d) To beg of men (i.e., begging). And Allāh hates for you: 1) Sinful and useless talk like backbiting., or that you talk too much about others, 2) To ask too many questions (in disputed religious matters), and 3) To waste the wealth (by extravagance with lack of wisdom and thinking).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: obeyed there the angels obey him in the heavens trustworthy with the Revelation.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. Obeyed (by the angels in the heavens) and trustworthy. d) To beg of men (i.e., begging). And Allāh hates for you: 1) Sinful and useless talk like backbiting., or that you talk too much about others, 2) To ask too many questions (in disputed religious matters), and 3) To waste the wealth (by extravagance with lack of wisdom and thinking).”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And your comrade) your Prophet Muhammad, O Quraysh (is not mad) bewitched as you claim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And (O people) your companion (Muḥammad ) is not a madman..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And your companion Muhammad (s) wa-mā sāhibukum a supplement to the clause from innahu ‘truly this is’ up to the last of the oath clauses is not a madman as you claim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُمْ بِمَجْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. And (O people) your companion (Muḥammad ) is not a madman..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Surely he beheld him) Muhammad (s)aw Gabriel (on the clear horizon) on the high setting of the sun.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And indeed he (Muḥammad ) saw him [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: For verily he Muhammad (s) saw him Gabriel in the form in which he was created on the clear horizon the highest one towards the east;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَآهُ بِٱلأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And indeed he (Muḥammad ) saw him [Jibrā’īl (Gabriel)] in the clear horizon (towards the east)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And he is not) i.e. Muhammad (pbuh) (avid of the Unseen) he is accused with regard to the revelation; and it is also said this means: he is not avaricious.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And he (Muḥammad ) withholds not knowledge of the Unseen..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and he Muhammad (s) is not to be accused of knowing the Unseen what is hidden of the revelation and the tidings of the heaven a variant reading for bi-zanīnin has bi-danīnin meaning that he is not ‘niggardly’ with the Unseen so as to reduce something of it and not disclose it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. And he (Muḥammad ) withholds not knowledge of the Unseen..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nor is this) i.e. the Qur'an (the utterance of a devil worthy to be stoned) the utterance of an accursed, rebellious devil whose name is al-Marmi.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And it (the Qur’ān) is not the word of outcast Shaiṭān (Satan)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And it that is the Qur’ān is not the word of an accursed satan eavesdropping stealthily.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَانٍ رَّجِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. And it (the Qur’ān) is not the word of outcast Shaiṭān (Satan)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Whither then go ye) from Allah's chastisement, commands and prohibitions, O disbelievers? It is also said this means: why do you lie? And it is also said this means: why do you deviate from the Qur'an and refuse to believe in it?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Then where are you go ing?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So where are you going? So what path are you going to follow in repudiating the Qur’ān and turning away from it?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. Then where are you go ing?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This is) i.e. the Qur'an (naught else than a reminder) an admonition from Allah (unto creation) the jinn and humankind,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Verily, this (the Qur’ān) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Ālamīn (mankind and jinn) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of mankind and jinn

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنْ هُوَ إِلاَّ ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. Verily, this (the Qur’ān) is no less than a Reminder to (all) the ‘Ālamīn (mankind and jinn) (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight) to whoever wills to conform to the commands of Allah: the belief in Allah's divine Oneness and other things.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: for those of you who li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-‘ālamīna ‘for all worlds’ using the same preposition wish to go straight by following the truth;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And ye will not) conform with or believe in Allah's divine Oneness, (unless (it be) that Allah willeth) it for you, (the Lord of Creation) the Lord of all that which has a soul and creeps on the face of the earth, from the inhabitants of the heaven and of the earth'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
