meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And you cannot will, unless (it be) that Allāh wills — the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but you will not wish to go straight along the path of truth unless God the Lord of the Worlds of all creatures wills that you should go straight along it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلاَّ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. And you cannot will, unless (it be) that Allāh wills — the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is cleft asunder): '(When the heaven is cleft asunder) by the descent of the Lord-a descent without modality-and the angels and whatever He wills of His command,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. When the heaven shall be cleft asunder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When the heaven is split open when it is rent asunder

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. When the heaven shall be cleft asunder..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When the planets are dispersed) on the face of the earth,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And when the stars shall be fallen and scattered..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the stars are dispersed when they expire and begin to fall

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And when the stars shall be fallen and scattered..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When the seas are poured forth) into each other, the sweet into the salty, such that they become one sea,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the seas shall be burst forth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the seas are burst forth released one upon the other forming one mass of water so that the sweet water mixes with the salty;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the seas shall be burst forth..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And the sepulchres are overturned) the dead in them are taken out,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And when the graves shall be turned upside down (and bring out their contents)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the tombs are overturned when their earth above them is dug up and its dead are raised the response to idhā ‘when’ and all that is supplemented thereto is the following

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And when the graves shall be turned upside down (and bring out their contents)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A soul) every soul at that point (will know what it hath sent before (it)) of good or evil (and what left behind) of good or evil wont; it is also said this means: it will know the acts of obedience it offered and those it missed.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: a soul every soul will know at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection what it has sent ahead in the way of deeds and what it has left behind of these and did not do.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (O man!) i.e. O disbelieving man; here referring specifically to Kildah Ibn Usayd (What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord) when you disbelieved in Him, (the Bountiful) the Forgiving,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: O disbelieving man! What has deceived you with regard to your generous Lord? so that you have disobeyed Him

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. O man! What has made you careless about your Lord, the Most Generous?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who created thee) a living being from a sperm drop, (then fashioned) in the womb of your mother, (then proportioned thee) then made your stature erect?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Who created you when you were not then made you upright in your created form with sound limbs then proportioned you read fa-‘adalak or fa-‘addalak making you symmetrical in shape with well-proportioned parts so that no hand or leg is longer than the other

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّاكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Who created you, fashioned you perfectly, and gave you due proportion..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee) if He wills He makes you resemble your paternal or maternal uncles, He can make you handsome or ugly; and if He wills He can turn you into the form of an ape or swine, or the like of them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيۤ أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. In whatever form He willed, He put you together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: assembling you in whatever mā is a relative form He will?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فِيۤ أَيِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. In whatever form He willed, He put you together..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, (but they) the Quraysh (deny the Judgement) and the Reckoning.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Nay! But you deny Ad-Dīn (i.e. the Day of Recompense)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! — a deterrent against letting oneself be misled by the generosity of God exalted be He. Rather you that is disbelievers of Mecca deny Judgement requital for deeds;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. Nay! But you deny Ad-Dīn (i.e. the Day of Recompense)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! there are above you guardians) among the angels who guard and preserve your works,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Yet lo! there are above you watchers from among the angels over your deeds

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَافِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. But verily, over you (are appointed angels in charge of mankind) to watch you,(1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Generous) who are honoured in the sight of Allah and completely surrendered to Him (and recording) they record your works,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِرَاماً كَاتِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Honourable, writing down (your deeds),(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: noble in God’s sight writers of these deeds

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِرَاماً كَاتِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Honourable, writing down (your deeds),(2).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who know (all) that ye do) and say of good and evil and record all of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. They know all that you do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: who know whatever you do all of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. They know all that you do..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the righteous) who are true in their faith: Abu Bakr and his believing brothers (verily will be in delight) in the Garden whose bliss is everlasting.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, the pious believers will be in Delight (Paradise);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed the pious the believers who are sincere in their faith shall be amid bliss in Paradise

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, the pious believers will be in Delight (Paradise);.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And lo! the wicked) Kildah and his fellow disbelievers (verily will be in hell;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And verily, the wicked, will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and indeed the profligates the disbelievers shall be in Hell-fire a scorching fire

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِي جَحِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. And verily, the wicked, will be in the blazing Fire (Hell),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: They will burn therein) they will enter the Fire (on the Day of Judgement) on the Day of Reckoning and Judgement between created beings,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: entering it to suffer its heat on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Therein they will enter, and taste its burning flame on the Day of Recompense,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And will not) i.e. the disbelievers (be absent thence) whence they enter it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And they will not be absent therefrom. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and they shall not be absent from it they shall not be taken out of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. And they will not be absent therefrom. (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what the Day of Judgement is!) what is the Day of Reckoning. (Again, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And what would show you what would inform you what the Day of Judgement is?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (what the Day of Judgement is!) what the Day of Reckoning is. He said this to arouse his astonishment, in order to magnify such a Day.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Again what would show you what the Day of Judgement is? — repeated to emphasise its enormity.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Again, what will make you know what the Day of Recompense is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah the explained to him, saying: (A day on which no soul) no believing soul (hath power at all) no power to save or intercede (for any (other) soul) for any disbelieving soul. (The (absolute) command) sentencing and judging between people (on that day is Allah's) is in Allah's hands; none other than Him has that in his power and none will challenge Him about it'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئاً وَٱلأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is a day read yawmu when no soul will be of any avail any use to another soul and the absolute command on that day will be God’s there will be no power of command for anyone other than Him thereat in other words none has been given the power to mediate thereupon in contrast to situations in this world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ لاَ تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِنَفْسٍ شَيْئاً وَٱلأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِلَّهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. (It will be) the Day when no person shall have power (to do) anything for another, and the Decision, that Day, will be (wholly) with Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying: (Woe unto the defrauders): '(Woe) severe punishment (unto the defrauders) in weighing and measurement; this refers to the people of Medina who used to cheat in weighing and measurement before the coming of the Prophet (pbuh) and so this surah was revealed to the Prophet (pbuh) on his way when he was migrating to Medina:

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Woe to Al-Muṭaffifīn (those who give less in measure and weight)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe waylun a term entailing chastisement; or it is the name of a valley in Hell to the defrauders

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. Woe to Al-Muṭaffifīn (those who give less in measure and weight)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then explained who these defrauders are, saying: (Those who when they take the measure from mankind) those who, when they buy from people and weigh or measure that which they buy for themselves, (demand it full) they weigh and measure their merchandise in full,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: those who when they take measure from people demand it in full the measure;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُواْ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. Those who, when they have to receive by measure from men, demand full measure,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But if they measure unto them) but when they measure for others (or weigh for them, they cause them loss) they decrease the measurement or the weight and behave very badly; it is also said that the above means: severe punishment on that day is unto the defrauders in the prayer, the poor-due, fasting and other acts of worship.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: but who when they measure for them or weigh for them they cause them loss they diminish for them the measure or the weight.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَوْ وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when they have to give by measure or weight to (other) men, give less than due..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Do such (men)) those who deal in fraud in weight and measurement (not consider) not know and believe (that they will be raised again) brought back to life

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Do such individuals not know for certain alā indicates an interrogative of rebuke that they will be resurrected

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَلا يَظُنُّ أُوْلَـٰئِكَ أَنَّهُمْ مَّبْعُوثُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Do they not think that they will be resurrected (for reckoning),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Unto an awful Day) the Day of Judgement whose horrors are great,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. On a Great Day?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: for an awful day that is to say on it and this is the Day of Resurrection

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. On a Great Day?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (The day when (all) mankind stand) after emerging from the graves (before the Lord of the Worlds) the Lord of every living being who walks on the earth and the Lord of the dwellers of heaven? When the Prophet (pbuh) read to them this surah, they repented and started giving full weight and measurement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: a day when yawma is a substitution for the syntactical locus of li-yawmin ‘to an awful day’ and as such is in the accusative because of the verb mab‘ūthūna ‘will be resurrected’ mankind will rise from their graves before the Lord of the Worlds? the Lord of all creatures for His affair His reckoning and His requital.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَالَمِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. The Day when (all) mankind will stand before the Lord of the ‘Ālamīn (mankind, jinn and all that exists)?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the vile) the works of the disbelievers (is in Sijjin

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the disbelievers and the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjīn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay! verily the record of the profligates that is to say the record of the deeds of the disbelievers is in Sijjīn — this is said to be a book containing the record of all the deeds of the devils and the disbelievers; but it is also said to be a location in the lowermost part of the seventh earth the place of Satan and his hosts.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِي سِجِّينٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Nay! Truly, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the disbelievers and the wicked is (preserved) in Sijjīn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Ah! what will convey unto thee what Sijjin is) what is in Sijjin! This is mentioned by way of aggrandizement of Sijjin.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And what will make you know what Sijjīn is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And what would tell you what Sijjīn is? what the book of Sijjīn is.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And what will make you know what Sijjīn is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A written record) He says: the works of the children of Adam are written on a green rock under the seventh earth; this is Sijjin.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. A Register inscribed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is a sealed book.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. A Register inscribed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Woe) severe punishment (unto the repudiators) unto the deniers of faith and the resurrection (on that day) the Day of Judgement!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Woe, that Day, to those who deny..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Woe to the deniers on that day

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Woe, that Day, to those who deny..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Those who deny the Day of Judgement) and the Reckoning which will take place in it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Those who deny the Day of Recompense..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: who deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital alladhīna yukadhdhibūna bi-yawmi’l-dīn either a substitution for or an explication of al-mukadhdhibīna ‘the deniers’;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. Those who deny the Day of Recompense..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Which none denieth) i.e. none denies the Day of Judgement (save each criminal transgressor) save each sinful and unjust person who transgresses against the Truth, such as al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah al-Makhzumi,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلاَّ كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allāh) the sinner!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and none deny it but every sinful the form athīm is hyperbolic transgressor overstepping the bounds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِ إِلاَّ كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And none can deny it except every transgressor beyond bounds, (in disbelief, oppression and disobedience to Allāh) the sinner!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Who, when thou readest unto him) unto al-Walid Ibn al-Mughirah (Our revelations) the Qur'an explaining the commands and prohibitions, (saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old) this is nothing but the lies and idle talk of the people of old.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. When Our Verses (of the Qur’ān) are recited to him he says: “Tales of the ancients!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When Our signs of the Qur’ān are recited to him he says ‘Mere fables asātīr of the ancients!’ mere tales that were written down sutirat in ancient times asātīr is the plural of ustūra or istāra.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آيَاتُنَا قَالَ أَسَاطِيرُ ٱلأَوَّلِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. When Our Verses (of the Qur’ān) are recited to him he says: “Tales of the ancients!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but that which they have earned) which they have done and said in their state of idolatry (is rust upon their hearts) Allah has sealed the hearts of those who disbelieve in the Day of Judgement; it is also said that the accumulation of sins blackens the heart and this is what is meant by the rust of hearts.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Nay! But on their hearts is the rust (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: No indeed! — a deterrent and a warning against saying such things. Rather there has slayed engulfed their hearts covering them like rust that which they earned of acts of disobedience.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ بَلْ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِمْ مَّا كَانُواْ يَكْسِبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Nay! But on their hearts is the rust (covering of sins and evil deeds) which they used to earn(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but surely on that day) the Day of Judgement (they) i.e. the deniers of the Day of Judgement (will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord) they will be prevented from beholding their Lord while the believers will behold Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay! verily they on that day the Day of Resurrection will be screened off from their Lord and so they will not see Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Nay! Surely they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then lo! they verily will burn in hell) then they will enter the Fire,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُواْ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then they will be exposed to Hell-fire then they will enter the scorching Fire;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُواْ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. Then, verily, they will indeed enter (and taste) the burning flame of Hell..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And it will be said (unto them)) the keepers of hell will say to them when they enter it: (This is that which ye used to deny) this is the chastisement which you used to claim it will never happen.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Then, it will be said to them: “This is what you used to deny!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: then it will be said to them ‘This that is the chastisement is that which you used to deny!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِي كُنتُمْ بِهِ تُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. Then, it will be said to them: “This is what you used to deny!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay) truly, O Muhammad, (but the record of the righteous) the works of those who are true in their faith (is in 'Illiyyin

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the pious believers is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyūn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay! verily the record of the pious that is the record of the deeds of the believers who were sincere in their faith is in ‘Illiyyūn — this is said to be the book containing all the good deeds of the angels and the believers from among the two heavy ones sc. mankind and jinn; but it is also said to be a place below the Throne in the seventh heaven;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كَلاَّ إِنَّ كِتَابَ ٱلأَبْرَارِ لَفِي عِلِّيِّينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. Nay! Verily, the Record (writing of the deeds) of the pious believers is (preserved) in ‘Illiyyūn..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Ah, what will convey unto thee) O Muhammad (what 'Illiyyin is!) what is in 'Illiyyin.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyūn is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and what will tell you what will inform you what ‘Illiyyūn is? what the book of ‘Illiyyūn is.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أَدْرَاكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. And what will make you know what ‘Illiyyūn is?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (A written record) it is said that the works of the righteous are written on tablets made of green chrysolite which are placed above the seventh heaven below the Throne of the Beneficent; this is 'Illiyyin,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. A Register inscribed, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: It is a sealed book

meta_data.ayah_arabic: كِتَابٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. A Register inscribed, (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Attested by those who are brought near (unto their Lord)) the works of the righteous are attested by the dwellers of heaven who are near their Lord.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. To which bear witness those nearest (to Allāh, i.e. the angels)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: witnessed by those brought near from among the angels.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. To which bear witness those nearest (to Allāh, i.e. the angels)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the righteous) those who are true in their faith, and these are the ones who do not harm even the tiniest ant (verily are in delight) in Paradise whose bliss is everlasting,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Verily, the pious believers will be in Delight (Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly the pious will be amid bliss in Paradise

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلأَبْرَارَ لَفِي نَعِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Verily, the pious believers will be in Delight (Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the inhabitants of the Fire,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. On thrones, looking (at all things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: upon couches upon beds beneath canopies gazing at the bliss which they have been given.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. On thrones, looking (at all things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou wilt know) O Muhammad (in their faces) the faces of the inhabitants of Paradise (the radiance of delight

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: You will perceive in their faces the radiancy of bliss the splendour and beauty of blissfulness

meta_data.ayah_arabic: تَعْرِفُ فِي وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. You will recognise in their faces the brightness of delight..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: They are given to drink) in Paradise (of a pure wine, sealed) mixed,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: as they are given to drink a nectar a wine free of any impurities that is sealed in its vessel none other than them breaking its seal

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. They will be given to drink of pure sealed wine..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Whose seal) whose end result (is musk. For this) for what I have mentioned (let (all) those who strive for bliss) let those who work and those who strive and those who hasten and those who take the initiative take the initiative.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذَلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: whose seal is musk that is whose final sip is followed by an emanating scent of musk — so for such bliss let the viers vie let them desire to apply themselves to obedience of God —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: خِتَامُهُ مِسْكٌ وَفِي ذَلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَافِسُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 26. The last thereof (that wine) will be the smell of musk, and for this let (all) those strive who want to strive (i.e. hasten earnestly to the obedience of Allāh)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And mixed with water of Tasnim,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnīm:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and whose mixture that is to say that with which it is mixed is of Tasnīm which is explained by His following words

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمِزَاجُهُ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 27. It (that wine) will be mixed with Tasnīm:.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: A spring) gushing forth for them from the Garden of Eden (whence those brought near to Allah drink) those who are near to the Garden of Eden drink from the spring of Tasnim.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: a spring ‘aynan is in the accusative because of an implicit prefatory amdahu ‘I extol this spring’ from which those brought near will drink yashrabu bihā should be yashrabu minhā or it may be that bihā is used because yashrabu is meant to imply the sense of yaltadhdhu bihā ‘in which they delight’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَيْناً يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 28. A spring whereof drink those nearest to Allāh..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the guilty) the idolaters, Abu Jahl and his host (used to laugh at those who believed) used to mock and poke fun at 'Ali and his fellow believers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Verily the guilty like Abū Jahl and his ilk used to laugh at the believers such as ‘Ammār b. Yāsir and Bilāl the Ethiopian and those like them in mockery of them;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ يَضْحَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 29. Verily, (during the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And wink one to another) they slander the believers (when they passed them) when the believers passed the disbelievers in their way to the Messenger of Allah (pbuh);

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when they the believers passed them by they would wink at one another the guilty beckoned with their eyebrows and eyelids towards the believers in mockery;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا مَرُّواْ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 30. And, whenever they passed by them, used to wink one to another (in mockery)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when they) the disbelievers (returned to their own folk, they returned jesting) they returned happy with their idolatry and mocking the believers;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when they returned to their folks they would return blithely fākihīna a variant reading has fakihīna rejoicing in their disparaging mention of the believers;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوۤاْ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُواْ فَكِهِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 31. And when they returned to their own people, they would return jesting;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when they saw them) and when they saw the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (they said) i.e. the disbelievers said: (Lo! These) the Companions of the Prophet (pbuh) (have gone astray) from true guidance.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ لَضَالُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And when they saw them, they said: “Verily, these have indeed gone astray!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when they see them that is the believers they say ‘Lo! these men are astray!’ on account of their belief in Muhammad (s).

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوۤاْ إِنَّ هَـٰؤُلاَءِ لَضَالُّونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 32. And when they saw them, they said: “Verily, these have indeed gone astray!”.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Yet they were not sent) they were not set upon the believers (as guardians over them) as guardians over them or over their works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: God exalted be He says Yet they that is the disbelievers were not sent as watchers over them over the believers to preserve them or to keep a record of their deeds and thus guide them back to what is best for them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُواْ عَلَيْهِمْ حَافِظِينَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 33. But they (disbelievers, sinners) had not been sent as watchers over them (the believers)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (This day) which is the Day of Judgement (it is those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an: i.e. 'Ali and his fellow believers (who have the laugh of disbelievers) who will laugh at the disbelievers,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So today that is the Day of Resurrection the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 34. But this Day (the Day of Resurrection) those who believe will laugh at the disbelievers (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (On high couches) in curtained canopies, (gazing) looking at the people of the Fire being dragged therein.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. On (high) thrones, looking (at all things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: upon couches in Paradise gazing out from their dwellings at the disbelievers while they are being tortured; and they will laugh at them just as they the disbelievers had laughed at them in the world.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: عَلَى ٱلأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 35. On (high) thrones, looking (at all things)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Are not the disbelievers paid) rewarded in the Hereafter (for what they used to do) except for what they used to do and say in the life of the world?'

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do? (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do? Yes indeed!

meta_data.ayah_arabic: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفْعَلُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 36. Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do? (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (When the heaven is split asunder): '(When the heaven is split asunder) by the clouds because of the descent of the Lord-a descent without any modality-and the angels and whatever Allah wills of His command.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. When the heaven shall be split asunder,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: When the heaven is rent asunder

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. When the heaven shall be split asunder,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And attentive) and it obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear) and it befits her to do so,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And listen to and obey its Lord — and it must do so..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and heeds gives ear to and in rending itself asunder obeys its Lord as it should that is as its duty is to heed and obey

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And listen to and obey its Lord — and it must do so..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And when the earth is spread out) like the spreading out of a flat plain; and it is also said this means: when the earth is removed from its place and then flattened.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the earth shall be stretched forth,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and when the earth is stretched out when its width is increased just as a piece of leather is stretched so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا ٱلأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And when the earth shall be stretched forth,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And hath cast out all that was in her) of corpses and treasures, (and is empty) from all of that

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And shall cast out all that was in it and become empty..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and casts out all that is in it of the dead onto its surface and empties itself thereof

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. And shall cast out all that was in it and become empty..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And attentive) and obeys and listens (to her Lord in fear!) and it behoves her do so.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And listen to and obey its Lord — and it must do so..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and heeds and in this respect gives ear to and obeys its Lord as it should all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection the response to idhā ‘when’ and to all that is supplemented thereto has been omitted; but it is indicated by what follows it and is implied to be something like laqiya’l-insānu ‘amalahu ‘man will encounter his deeds’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. And listen to and obey its Lord — and it must do so..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Thou, verily, O man) O disbelieving man, in reference to Abu'l-Aswad Ibn Kildah Ibn Usayd Ibn Khalaf, (art working) He says: you are working something in your state of disbelief and shall return with it (towards thy Lord) in the Hereafter (a work which you will meet (in His presence)) whether your work is righteous or evil.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحاً فَمُلاَقِيهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: O man! Verily you are labouring exerting your efforts toward the encounter with your Lord that is death laboriously and you will encounter it that is you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: يٰأَيُّهَا ٱلإِنسَٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحاً فَمُلاَقِيهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. O man! Verily, you are returning towards your Lord with your deeds and actions (good or bad), a sure returning, and you will meet (the results of your deeds which you did)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Then whoso is given his account) the account of his good works (in his right hand) in reference here to Abu Salamah Ibn 'Abd al-Asad

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Then, as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Then as for him who is given his book the record of his deeds in his right hand — and this is the believer —

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَـٰبَهُ بِيَمِينِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. Then, as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He truly will receive an easy reckoning) this refers to his parade before Allah

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَاباً يَسِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. He surely will receive an easy reckoning,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: he will receive an easy reckoning which simply entails the presentation of his deeds to him as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim — in which there is also a hadīth saying ‘He who is reckoned with at length will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation of his deeds to the believer he will be excused

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَاباً يَسِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. He surely will receive an easy reckoning,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And will return) in the Hereafter (unto his folk) whom Allah prepared for him in Paradise (in joy) with them.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And will return to his family in joy!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and return to his family in Paradise joyful because of it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. And will return to his family in joy!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (But whoso is given his account) the account of his evil deeds (behind his back) in his left hand, referring here to al-Aswad Ibn 'Abd al-Asad, the brother of Abu Salamah,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. But, whosoever is given his Record behind his back,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand by which he is given the book is placed behind his back

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. But, whosoever is given his Record behind his back,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He surely will invoke destruction

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُواْ ثُبُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. He will invoke (for his) destruction,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: he will pray upon seeing what is in it for annihilation he will invoke destruction against himself by saying yā thabūrāh ‘O annihilation of mine!’

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُواْ ثُبُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 11. He will invoke (for his) destruction,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And be thrown to scorching fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And he shall enter a blazing Fire, (and made to taste its burning)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and he will enter the Blaze an intense fire a variant reading for yaslā ‘he will enter’ has yusallā ‘he will be admitted’.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. And he shall enter a blazing Fire, (and made to taste its burning)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: He verily lived joyous with his folk) he was happy with his folk,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيۤ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, he was among his people in joy!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed among his folk his clan in the world he used to be joyful wanton lusting after his desires;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِيۤ أَهْلِهِ مَسْرُوراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, he was among his people in joy!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (He verily deemed that he would never return (unto Allah)) in the Hereafter.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: indeed he thought that an softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say annahu he would never return to his Lord.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 14. Verily, he thought that he would never come back (to Us)!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but lo! his Lord) when He created him (is ever looking on him!) knew that He will raise him again after death

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay! he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him knowing that he would return to Him.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلَىٰ إِنَّ رَبَّهُ كَانَ بِهِ بَصِيراً
meta_data.ayah_translation: 15. Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Oh, I swear by the afterglow of sunset,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. So, I swear by the afterglow of sunset;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the twilight al-shafaq the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَلاَ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 16. So, I swear by the afterglow of sunset;.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And by the night and all that it enshroudeth) and I swear by the night and that which returns to its place when the night falls,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the night and what it envelops what it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 17. And by the night and whatever it gathers in its darkness,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And by the moon when she is at the full) for three nights: the nights of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth of the lunar month

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And by the moon when it is at the full..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the moon when it is at the full and its light is complete and this happens during the nights of the full moon

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 18. And by the moon when it is at the full..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (That ye shall journey) the whole creation shall be transformed (on from plane to plane) from one state to another; from the time He created them until the time they die, and from the time they die until they enter either Paradise or hell: in all these times Allah transforms them from one state to another; it is also said that this means: you shall journey, O Muhammad, from one heaven to another on the day of the ascent; and it is also said that this means: this denier will go from one state to another, from the time he dies until he enters the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقاً عَن طَبقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: you will surely journey tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another and the wāw is omitted because of two unvocalised consonants coming together from stage to stage state after state namely death then life then what comes afterwards of the states at the Resurrection.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقاً عَن طَبقٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 19. You shall certainly travel from stage to stage (in this life and in the Hereafter)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (What aileth them) the disbelievers of Mecca; and it is said this refers to the three sons of 'Abd Yalayl al-Thaqafi: Mas'ud, Habib and Rabi'ah, the last two had later on accepted Islam (then, that they believe not) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. What is the matter with them, that they believe not?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So what is wrong with them that is the disbelievers that they do not have faith that is to say what is there to prevent them from embracing faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَمَا لَهُمْ لاَ يُؤْمِنُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 20. What is the matter with them, that they believe not?.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And, when the Qur'an is recited unto them) and when Muhammad (pbuh) recites the Qur'an to them explaining the commands and prohibitions, (worship not (Allah)) do not submit to Allah by believing in Allah's divine Oneness?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِىءَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْآنُ لاَ يَسْجُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they fall not prostrate..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and what is wrong with them that when the Qur’ān is recited to them they do not prostrate? they do not submit by believing in it given its inimitability?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَإِذَا قُرِىءَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْآنُ لاَ يَسْجُدُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 21. And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they fall not prostrate..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Nay, but those who disbelieve) the disbelievers of Mecca and those among the sons of 'Abd Yalayl who did not believe (will deny) will disbelieve in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Nay, those who disbelieve, deny (Prophet Muḥammad  and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ān and Islāmic Monothe ism, etc.) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Nay but the disbelievers deny resurrection and other matters

meta_data.ayah_arabic: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يُكَذِّبُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 22. Nay, those who disbelieve, deny (Prophet Muḥammad  and whatever he brought, i.e. this Qur’ān and Islāmic Monothe ism, etc.) (1). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding) and Allah knows best what they say and do; and it is also said this means: Allah knows best what they hear and hide in their hearts.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And Allāh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and God knows best what they are amassing accumulating in their scrolls in the way of disbelief denial and evil deeds.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 23. And Allāh knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (So give them) so give, O Muhammad, to those who disbelieve in Allah (tidings of a painful doom) whose pain will extend to their hearts on the Day of Badr as well as in the Hereafter,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. So, announce to them a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: So give them good tidings inform them of a painful chastisement

meta_data.ayah_arabic: فَبَشِّرْهُمْ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 24. So, announce to them a painful torment..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then exempted from these the believers, saying: (Save those who believe) in Muhammad (pbuh) and the Qur'an (and do good works) and do acts of obedience privately between themselves and their Lord, (for theirs is a reward) in Paradise (unfailing) undiminished and unblemished; it is also said this means: they will not be constantly reminded about the blessings bestowed upon them; and it is also said this means: their good deeds will not be decreased after they reach old age or after they die'.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds theirs will be an unfailing reward one that is unending undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِلاَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 25. Except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them is a reward that will never come to an end (i.e. Paradise)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: And from his narration on the authority of Ibn 'Abbas that he said regarding the interpretation of Allah's saying (By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars): '(By the heaven, holding mansions of the stars) He says: Allah swears by the heaven which includes mansions of the stars; it is also said: He swears by the heaven which has mansions between heaven and earth; Allah knows that,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the heaven holding the big stars(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: By the heaven of the constellations the twelve constellations of the planets — as explained in sūrat al-Furqān Q. 2561;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 1. By the heaven holding the big stars(1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And by the Promised Day) which is the Day of Judgement.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the promised day the Day of Resurrection;

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 2. And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And by the witness) the day of Friday (and that whereunto he beareth testimony) the day of 'Arafah and it is said it is the day of immolation; it is also said that 'the witness' refers to the children of Adam while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' refers to the Day of Judgement; and it is also said that 'the witness' is Muhammad (pbuh) while 'that whereunto he bears testimony' is his community; Allah swore by all these things that His chastisement of those who disbelieve in Him is very severe,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by the Witnessing (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed [i.e. the day of ‘Arafāt (Ḥajj), the ninth of Dhul-Ḥijjah];.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and by the witness Friday and the witnessed the day of ‘Arafa — that is how these three elements have been explained in hadīth for the first one is ‘promised’ the second one is ‘a witness’ that testifies to deeds performed in it while the third is ‘witnessed’ by mankind and angels the introductory particle of the response to the oath has been omitted but is implied to be laqad ‘verily’ sc. laqad qutila ashābu’l-ukhdūd

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 3. And by the Witnessing (i.e. Friday), and by the Witnessed [i.e. the day of ‘Arafāt (Ḥajj), the ninth of Dhul-Ḥijjah];.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: ((Self-)destroyed were the owners of the ditch

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأُخْدُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King)(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: perish accursed be the men of the ditch! the pit in the ground

meta_data.ayah_arabic: قُتِلَ أَصْحَابُ ٱلأُخْدُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 4. Cursed were the people of the Ditch (in the story of the Boy and the King)(2). (1).
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Of the fuel-fed fire) slandered were the owners of the ditch; it is also said that they were believers who were killed by the disbelievers by means of fire in which they threw naphtha, oil and firewood,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Of fire fed with fuel,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: of the fire al-nāri is an inclusive substitution of it al-ukhdūdi ‘of the ditch’ abounding in fuel by which it was fuelled

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 5. Of fire fed with fuel,.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (When they) i.e. the disbelievers (sat by it) by the ditch; and it is said: they sat on chairs when Allah burned them with the Fire,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. When they sat by it (fire),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: when they sat by it around the edge of the ditch on chairs

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 6. When they sat by it (fire),.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (And were themselves the witnesses) they used to testify that the believers were folk of error (of what they did to the believers) and it is said this means: they were present when they did this to the believers.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: and they themselves to what they did to those who believed in God in the way of torturing them by hurling them into the fire when they did not recant their faith were witnesses they were themselves present thereat. It is reported in a hadīth that God saved the believers who had been thrown into the fire by taking their souls before they fell into it and that the fire then rose up and burnt all those sitting around it.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 7. And they witnessed what they were doing against the believers (i.e. burning them)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (They had naught against them) against the believers nor did they find any fault with them (save that they believed in Allah, the Mighty) in His retribution against those who disbelieve in Him, (the Owner of Praise) for those who believe in Him,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَن يُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And they had no fault except that they believed in Allāh, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of all Praise!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: And all that they were vindicative towards them of was that they believed in God the Mighty in His kingdom the Praised

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنْهُمْ إِلاَّ أَن يُؤْمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 8. And they had no fault except that they believed in Allāh, the All-Mighty, the Worthy of all Praise!.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Him unto Whom belongeth the Sovereignty) the stores (of the heavens) rain (and the earth) plants; (and Allah is of all things the Witness) He is the Witness over their works.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allāh is Witness over everything..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and God is Witness to all things in other words all that the disbelievers disavowed of the believers was their faith.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَٱلأَرْضِ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 9. To Whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth! And Allāh is Witness over everything..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! they who persecute) those who burn and torture with fire (believing men) men who are true in their faith (and believing women) who are true in their faith (and repent not) from their idolatry and disbelief, (theirs verily will be the doom of hell) in the Hereafter, (and theirs the doom of burning) in the Fire; and it is also said: in the life of the world, for Allah had burned them with the Fire. These were people from Najran, and it is said from Mosul, who tortured and consequently killed a group of believers with fire in attempt to make them renounce their religion. The name of the king of these people is Yusuf, and it is said his name is Dhu'l-Nuwas.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and the believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allāh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed those who persecute believing men and believing women by having them burnt then do not repent there will be for them the chastisement of Hell in return for their disbelief and there will also be for them the chastisement of burning that is to say the chastisement for their having had the believers burnt in the Hereafter; but it is also said that there is this chastisement for them in this world as when the fire rose up and burnt them as mentioned above.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 10. Verily, those who put into trial the believing men and the believing women (by torturing them and burning them), and then do not turn in repentance (to Allāh), then they will have the torment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the burning Fire..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Allah then mentioned the believers who did not renounce their religion despite being tortured, saying: (Lo! those who believe) in Allah (and do good works) privately between themselves and their Lord, (theirs will be Gardens beneath which) beneath its trees and habitations (rivers flow) rivers of wine, water, honey and milk flow. (That is the Great Success) they earned the Garden and were saved from the Fire.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Indeed those who believe and perform righteous deeds for them there will be gardens underneath which rivers flow that is the supreme triumph.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ آمَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّالِحَاتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّاتٌ تَجْرِي مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلأَنْهَارُ ذَلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: Verily, those who believe and do righteous good deeds, for them will be Gardens under which rivers flow (Paradise). That is the great success.
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: (Lo! the punishment of thy Lord) the seizure of your Lord of those who disbelieve in Him (is stern.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Verily, (O Muḥammad ) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly your Lord’s assault against the disbelievers is severe as severe as He will it to be.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 12. Verily, (O Muḥammad ) the Seizure (punishment) of your Lord is severe and painful (1)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: Lo! He it is Who produceth) He it is Who begins creation from a sperm drop, (then reproduceth) a new creation after death,

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِىءُ وَيُعِيدُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Assuredly it is He Who originates creation and restores and is never thwarted in what He wills

meta_data.ayah_arabic: إِنَّهُ هُوَ يُبْدِىءُ وَيُعِيدُ
meta_data.ayah_translation: 13. Verily, He it is Who begins (punishment) and repeats (punishment in the Hereafter) (or originates the creation of everything, and then repeats it on the Day of Resurrection)..
meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tafsir al-Jalalayn

tafsir: When the Prophet (pbuh) informed them of this, the disbelievers of Mecca said: " Bring us a sign to prove that Allah has sent you to us as a Messenger ". Therefore Allah said: (Will they not regard the camels, how they are created) with their strength and power, carrying burdens that no one else can carry?

meta_data.ayah_arabic: أَفَلاَ يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلإِبْلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ

meta_data.En_tafsir_source: Tanwīr al-Miqbās min Tafsīr Ibn ʿAbbās

tafsir: Will they the Meccan disbelievers not consider by way of reflection the camels how they are created?

tafsir: And the earth how it was laid out flat? and thus infer from this the power of God exalted be He and His Oneness? The commencing with the mention of camels is because they are closer in contact with it the earth than any other animal. As for His words sutihat ‘laid out flat’ this on a literal reading suggests that the earth is flat which is the opinion of most of the scholars of the revealed Law and not a sphere as astronomers ahl al-hay’a have it even if this latter does not contradict any of the pillars of the Law.

tafsir: (And the Even) the day of 'Arafah and the day of immolation (and the Odd) three days after the day of immolation; it is also said that the Even refers to all prayers which are made of an even number of units: two or four units of prayer-the Subh, Zuhr, 'Asr and 'Isha' prayers-while the Odd refers to the prayers which consists of an odd number of units of prayer such as the Maghrib and Witr prayers; it is also said that the Even refers to Heaven and earth, the life of the world and the Hereafter, Paradise and hell, the Throne and the Stool, the sun and the moon, while the Odd refers to everything that is odd in number; it is also said that the Even refers to the male and female, disbeliever and believer, the sincere and hypocrite, the righteous and the sinful, while the Odd refers to Allah.

meta_data.ayah_arabic: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
